enable_sol_attn.tooltip: Scheduled Sol attention: sparsifies self-attention on high-noise steps (tau ramp), denser near the end. Applied after the sigma shift so its schedule matches.

enable_chunk_ff.tooltip: Chunked feed-forward: splits each MLP pass to reduce peak VRAM. Composable with Sol attention and Spectrum.

enable_spectrum.tooltip: Spectrum forecast: predicts solver steps from past denoised anchors to cut sampling NFEs. Applied last so it wraps the final patched model.

live_preview.tooltip: Decode intermediate video previews during sampling via the auto-downloaded taeh3 approximation (RGB-factor fallback when offline). Adds per-step decode overhead - disabled by default.

vae_decode_tiled.tooltip: Decode video latents in tiles to reduce peak VRAM at the cost of additional processing time.

unload_before_decode.tooltip: Unload the diffusion model after sampling and before VAE decode to reduce decode-time VRAM.

low_vram.tooltip: Unload CLIP after conditioning and the VAEs before sampling, then reload the VAEs for decode.

megapixels_target.tooltip: Target canvas area in megapixels, ceiled to the model's 32px grid (0.98 at 16:9 is the official 1344x768 768p canvas).

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Canvas aspect. Ignored in I2V when a First/Last frame is connected - the frame sets the canvas. In R2V, 'Ref Image 1' / 'Ref Video 1' take the aspect from the connected reference (scaled to megapixels, rounded to the nearest 32).

fl_aspect_mode.tooltip: I2V with BOTH frames connected: how to reconcile different aspect ratios. Preserve First/Last: that frame defines the canvas and the other is cover-cropped to it. Optimal: a middle-ground canvas (geometric mean of both ratios) at the megapixel target; both frames are cover-cropped to it. ControlNet: with a CNET models pipe, keep the I2V keyframe canvas (Optimal) and let the native patch resize the control video to it instead of forcing the control video's aspect.

length_frames.tooltip: Clip length in frames at 24 fps, snapped to the model's 17n+5 grid (124 frames = ~5s; trained range is 124-362).

audio_frames_override.tooltip: REF2VA only. OFF (default): Duration (frames) is a hard cap - the output length equals it and longer references are trimmed, never stretched. ON: the output length derives from the longest Ref Audio instead (no cap - long inputs risk OOM). Output is always snapped to the 17n+5 grid at 24 fps.

video_frames_override.tooltip: REF2VA only. ON (default): the output length derives from the longest Ref Video, snapped to the 17n+5 grid (no cap - long inputs risk OOM). OFF: Duration (frames) is a hard cap and longer references are trimmed. A CNET models pipe always wins with the control_video quantized frame count.

generated_audio_gain_db.tooltip: Gain applied to the generated audio after decode, in decibels.

enable_derope.tooltip: De-ROPE (motion smearing fix): after the main pass, detect jerk-fast motion from the latent, time-smear those spans onto a slower dilated clock, re-render them with a partial-denoise second pass, then recover the original frame count. Costs ~2-3x the pass-1 compute on hot clips.

derope_preset.tooltip: One scenario dropdown for the whole de-rope. Balanced = measured default; Fast action = sharper, keeps more of the source; Camera motion = camera-compensated oracle (stops pans scoring as jerk); End burst = holds the tail at real time; Uniform x4 = slow the whole clip 4x (zero-artifact reference, most expensive). Pick Custom to reveal the individual knobs.

derope_inject.tooltip: Custom preset only. How much of the denoise trajectory runs on top of the smeared init. 0.50 is the metric best (sharpest, closest choreography), 0.70 the safe playback default, 0.80 looser / more creative.

derope_audio.tooltip: Custom preset only. Safe default: pass-2's audio rows are seeded with the slowed performance (keeps mouths/foley on the dilated clock) but the OUTPUT keeps pass-1's track. 'pass-2 foley (seeded)' returns the regenerated performance instead (leaner, quality varies). 'pass-2 invents audio' does not seed the rows.

derope_mode.tooltip: Custom preset only. adaptive = dilate only the jerk-hot spans (cheaper, preserves the clip's pacing). uniform x4 = hold every frame 4x (zero-artifact reference, highest cost).

derope_profile.tooltip: Custom preset only. Which signal the adaptive oracle thresholds. 'value |d3|' is the shipped detector but tracks motion ENERGY, so a steady pan scores as jerk. 'trajectory centroid |d3|' differentiates the energy centroid's path (closer to true jerk); 'camera-compensated' aligns each frame to the last so pans read as stillness.

derope_abstain.tooltip: Custom preset only. Absolute gate on the jerk profile's peak-to-mean contrast. q is a quantile, so the oracle always dilates the top (1-q) of token-times even on a clip with nothing to fix; below this contrast the de-rope abstains and returns the pass-1 output. 0 disables the gate.

derope_protect_tail.tooltip: Custom preset only. Hold the LAST n frames at real time whatever the oracle says. A burst that runs into the end of the clip has no 'after' for the model to slow into, so it can play back fast after recovery; 17 (one token group) is the measured fix. 0 = off.

enable_derope_adapter.tooltip: Apply the MATLOWAI MiniMax-H3 Motion Adapter LoRA (temporal-expansion warm100, strength 1.0) to the de-rope pass only (never pass 1). Downloads ~63 MB from Hugging Face on first use into models/loras/minimax_h3/. Trained on the de-rope task: smooths fast motion, but mutes strong colour and over-corrects calm content.

enable_negpip.tooltip: NegPiP: (word:-1.0) in the prompt SUBTRACTS the concept by flipping that token's attention value vector, and (word:-1.0@2.5-4.0) limits the subtraction to that window (@v = video only, @a = audio only). Plain (word:1.3) emphasis is scaled as well. Runs at exact-flip strength (1.0); turn OFF to fall back to the weaker in-place weighting.

shift_video.tooltip: Video sigma shift. Turbo LoRAs distill a fixed schedule: 12.0 for the 544p/v0.1 family, 6.0 for the 768p v1.0 family - match this to the connected Turbo LoRA.

shift_audio.tooltip: Audio sigma shift. Turbo LoRAs distill a fixed schedule: 3.0 for all current families.

Color Correct GPU (mtb).name: Color Correct GPU (mtb)
Color Correct GPU (mtb).description: Various color correction methods using only Torch.

ColorMatch.name: ColorMatch
ColorMatch.description:
color-matcher enables color transfer across images which comes in handy for automatic  
color-grading of photographs, paintings and film sequences as well as light-field  
and stopmotion corrections.  

The methods behind the mappings are based on the approach from Reinhard et al.,  
the Monge-Kantorovich Linearization (MKL) as proposed by Pitie et al. and our analytical solution  
to a Multi-Variate Gaussian Distribution (MVGD) transfer in conjunction with classical histogram   
matching. As shown below our HM-MVGD-HM compound outperforms existing methods.   
https://github.com/hahnec/color-matcher/

The prompt carries the style, instrumentation and mood; lyrics are sung rather than described, and an empty lyric leaves the track instrumental. Runs on a Comfy Cloud GPU, billed by how long it runs at $0.001295/GPU-second (0.27 credits). Paid in credits, no Cloud subscription required.

seed.tooltip: Random seed for sampling.

total_frames.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps; snapped to MiniMax 17k+5 grid (124 ≈ 5s).

timeline_data.tooltip: Internal — video, segments, refs (populated by UI).

i2v_groups.tooltip: External Image to Video group(s) (t2v / i2v / fl2v). When connected, overrides UI cards for execution (external priority). Connect Group (Image to Video).group, or Groups Combine.

r2v_groups.tooltip: External Reference to Video group(s). When connected, overrides UI cards for execution (external priority). Connect Group (Reference to Video).group, or Groups Combine.

semantic_bridge.tooltip: Optional Semantic Bridge node (above SelfLift). When connected, official cond tokens are rewritten with the student MLP (RMS-norm → residual mix). Unconnected = identical. Distilled on FL2VA; r2v / v2v / rv2v is forced-compat — use with care.

selflift.tooltip: Optional SelfLift node (above Refine). When connected, first-pass is low-res prefix + 3D lift + high-res tail on this Director canvas. Unconnected = current single-stage sample. Refine may still upscale afterward (e.g. 1.0MP first pass → 2.0MP). Timeline continuity keeps native low-res carry + high-res pin. Euler only.

refine.tooltip: Optional Refine node. When connected, each segment runs a second sample pass (same-size refine, or upscale then sample). Wire a MODEL into Refine.refine_model to use a different UNET for that pass; unwired uses this Director model. images is the refined result; images_pre_refine is the first pass. Unconnected = single-pass (current behavior).

face_refine.tooltip: Optional FaceRefine node. When connected, Director tracks the face on the final decoded frames (after Refine if that is also wired), re-samples the crop, and pastes the face back. images is after stitch; images_pre_face_refine is before stitch when「输出修脸前」is on (otherwise that output is blocked). Unconnected = no face pass (that output stays blocked).

steps.tooltip: 一采步数（官方模板 25）。接了 sigmas 口后忽略此项，改用外接噪声表。

scheduler.tooltip: 一采调度器（官方模板 simple）。接了 sigmas 口后忽略此项，改用外接噪声表。

clear_vram_between_segments.tooltip: 段间清理显存：每段结束后卸载模型并清空 CUDA 缓存。

clear_vram_before_refine.tooltip: 二采前清理显存：一采结束后、放大或二采开始前卸载模型并清空 CUDA 缓存。默认关。24GB 或一采/二采不同 UNET 时勾上，可降低二采峰值，但每段会多一次加载。

clear_vram_before_face_refine.tooltip: 脸修前清理显存：成片解码后、FaceRefine 开始前卸载模型并清空 CUDA 缓存。默认关。未接 FaceRefine 时无效。24GB 或解码后立刻 OOM 时勾上，但每段会多一次加载。

cache_frames_codec.tooltip: 分段缓存的像素帧怎么存。raw：uint8 .pt，读写快，磁盘大。ffv1：无损压缩，体积大约三分之一，命中和写入都会多一次编解码。两种都能读；某一段被重新写入时才换成当前选项。latent / 音频缓存不受影响。

export_source_images.tooltip: 将时间轴原片解码到独立的 source_images 输出口；需将 source_images 另接预览/合成节点才能查看，不会改变主 images。默认关以节省内存。

export_pre_face_refine.tooltip: 将修脸前的视频输出到 images_pre_face_refine，方便和 images 对比。分段导出时同时写入 seg_XXXX_facepre.mp4。默认关：该口阻断、下游不执行，也不占成片内存。未接 FaceRefine 时无效。

cache_name.tooltip: 分段缓存目录：output/minimax_seg_cache/<这个名字>_<节点id>/。留空 = 只用节点 id（旧行为，已有缓存目录不变）。填了名字后，同一张图里的不同导演台、以及节点 id 不同的工作流会分开存放。复制工作流后节点 id 通常不变，名字也相同的话仍然共用一个目录；要隔开就改名字。非法字符 / \ : * ? " < > | 会自动替换成下划线。

sigmas.tooltip: 可选。一采噪声表，接 BasicScheduler 或 ManualSigmas。接线后覆盖导演台「步数」和「调度器」（采样器下拉仍有效）。BasicScheduler 请接 SigmaShift 之后的同一套 H3 MODEL。不接则仍用步数 + 调度器、denoise=1 自动算表。

vsr.tooltip: 可选 RelayVSR。不接时和以前一样。接上后，在一采、二采、修脸都完成以后，对成片再做一次视频放大采样。有二采就在二采后面，有修脸就在修脸后面。音频和帧数不变。

ComfyMiniMaxH3Director.name: ComfyMiniMaxH3Director
ComfyMiniMaxH3Director.description: MiniMax H3 Director: MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo / ReferenceToVideo conditioning, single-stage KSampler + MiniMaxH3SigmaShift, LTXVSeparateAVLatent decode. Supports t2v / i2v / fl2v / r2v / v2v / rv2v. Optional i2v_groups / r2v_groups accept multi-group packs from Director Group nodes (external priority over UI cards). Optional semantic_bridge accepts MiniMax H3 Director Semantic Bridge (cond-token student; Ref2VA forced-compat). Optional selflift accepts MiniMax H3 Director SelfLift (progressive first-pass on this canvas). Optional refine accepts MiniMax H3 Director Refine (second sample / upscale). Optional face_refine accepts MiniMax H3 Director FaceRefine (crop / re-sample / stitch). Optional vsr accepts MiniMax H3 Director RelayVSR (upscale after refine and face refine). images_pre_refine is the first-pass video before refine. images_pre_face_refine is the video before face stitch (blocked unless FaceRefine is connected and「输出修脸前」is on). Defaults: 0.4MP 16:9 (864×480), 5s / 124 frames @ 24 fps.

ComfyNotNode.name: ComfyNotNode
ComfyNotNode.description: Logical NOT operation. Returns true if the value is falsy. Uses Python's rules for truthiness.

ComfyOrNode.name: ComfyOrNode
ComfyOrNode.description: Logical OR operation. Returns true if any of the values are truthy. Uses Python's rules for truthiness.

images.tooltip: The plate. Connect Load Video -> Get Video Components, Load Plate Sequence, or any crop/resize chain. Then click 'Load plate' in the node. Best quality at 1920x1088 (a 1920x1080 plate is padded to 1088 automatically): LTX alpha-gen is tuned for that size. Bigger plates (4K, DCI, 2K) are matted on a 1080p proxy, with the edges rendered again at native resolution (native-resolution edges). Smaller plates work, but edges can come out softer.

fps.tooltip: Plate frame rate (connect Get Video Components / Load Plate Sequence fps)

first_frame.tooltip: Frame number of the first image (1001 for VFX plates): output files use it

render.tooltip: preview chunk = first 49 frames from the pick frame

ltx_model.tooltip: Recommended: ltx-2.5-22b-distilled-transformer-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors | folder: ComfyUI/models/diffusion_models/ (press R after adding files) | Low RAM/VRAM: LTX-2.5-Distilled-Q4_K_M.gguf (needs the ComfyUI-GGUF node pack); keep models on an NVMe SSD so ComfyUI streams them from disk

alpha_lora.tooltip: Recommended: ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-alpha-gen-0.9.safetensors | folder: ComfyUI/models/loras/ (press R after adding files)

text_encoder.tooltip: built-in empty prompt (no text encoder needed): same result, skips loading the 13 GB encoder. Or pick gemma4-12b-with-proj-ltx-2.5-comfy-int8-convrot.safetensors from ComfyUI/models/text_encoders/
text_encoder.default: built-in empty prompt (no text encoder needed)
options: built-in empty prompt (no text encoder needed)

video_vae.tooltip: Recommended: ltx-2.5-video-vae-conv-bf16.safetensors | folder: ComfyUI/models/vae/ (press R after adding files)

audio_vae.tooltip: Recommended: ltx-2.5-audio-vae-bf16.safetensors | folder: ComfyUI/models/vae/ (press R after adding files)

vitmatte.tooltip: Folder in ComfyUI/models/vitmatte/, or auto-download on first run

chunk.tooltip: LTX renders the shot in chunks of this many frames (8n+1). 49 fits 1920x1088 on 32 GB.

overlap.tooltip: Frames shared by neighbouring chunks and cross-faded so the joins don't show. More = smoother joins but more chunks (slower). 9 = a new chunk every 40 frames.

near_px.tooltip: v7 zone around other excluded subjects (Best)

stabilize_radius.tooltip: Removes frame-to-frame chatter in the SAM3/ViTMatte edges: each frame is averaged with this many frames before and after, warped by optical flow (occlusions are ignored). 0 = off, 2 = default (5-frame window). Higher is smoother but fast motion can lag or ghost, and it is slower. LTX edges are already stable.

fast_attention.tooltip: Comfy Kitchen int8 attention for LTX: about 36% faster sampling, matte difference ~0.004 (7x smaller than changing the seed). Turn off to use standard PyTorch attention.

clean_plate_lora.tooltip: Recommended: ltx-2.5-22b-ic-lora-clean-plate-1.0.safetensors | folder: ComfyUI/models/loras/ (press R after adding files) | Only for edge colour = perfect; without it perfect runs as quick

overlap_mode.tooltip: For people crossing the subject (hands, arms, hair). LTX mattes the subject and everyone else on the real plate (3 LTX passes instead of 2, plus a depth pass) and subtracts the others where SAM3 and depth say they are in front: their fingers and curls come out crisp instead of soft. Replaces the quality setting. If a limb of the subject that rests on someone goes missing, add a click on it. Needs other subjects picked; without them it runs Best (v12).

v13_depth.tooltip: Depth Anything V2 Small decides who is in front where SAM3 gives a pixel to both people or neither (fingers over a chest). Off = SAM3 alone (a local vote): faster, but fast thin fingers in front of the subject can ghost.

hair_guide.tooltip: Overlap (v13) only. Where someone's hair crosses the subject, re-fit their hair matte to the plate's own edges (guided filter): more single strands, cleaner gaps between curls. Can read dark stripes or patterns on the subject's clothes as hair, so check the comp. Off by default.

hair_radius.tooltip: How far the hair sharpening looks for plate edges. Smaller = finer strands but noisier; larger = smoother but picks up more clothing pattern.

attn_grow.tooltip: How far each SAM3 mask is grown before it steers LTX's attention, so hair outside the SAM outline is still matted. Tested best: 20.

attn_blur.tooltip: Feather of that attention mask. 0 = hard edge (cuts hair, ~1.5x error). Tested best: 10.

attn_strength.tooltip: How strongly LTX follows the attention mask. Lower lets it drift to other people. Tested best: 1.0.

occluder_reach.tooltip: How far past an in-front person's overlap the subtraction reaches, to catch their soft edge (strands, fast fingertips). Larger can bite the subject's own thin parts. Tested best: 20.

limb_cap.tooltip: LTX also draws parts of the subject it cannot see (amodal). Anything further than this from the SAM3 selection is removed (fades over the last 40 px). Raise it if real edges far from the selection get cut. Tested best: 90.

front_smoothing.tooltip: Frames averaged so the in-front / behind decision never pops. 1 = off. Tested best: 3.

native_edges.tooltip: Plates bigger than 1920x1088: LTX also renders the subject's edges on native-resolution 1920x1088 tiles, for strand-level detail at the plate's own size. Roughly 2-3x the render time on a 4K plate. Off: matte at 1080p and scale the alpha up (fast). Plates at 1080p or smaller are not affected. Plates only a little bigger than 1080p (up to about 2300 px wide, e.g. 2K) gain little detail for the full tile cost: switch it off there to save time.

edge_colour.tooltip: quick: rebuilds the colour of the soft edges from the subject itself, so sky or grass behind hair does not stay in the strands (CPU, no extra VRAM: about 2 s a frame at 1080p, 4 s a frame at 4K). perfect: LTX Clean Plate rebuilds the background, which is then subtracted from the edges (one extra LTX pass per chunk on the 1080p proxy, plus about 2 s a frame at 4K; needs the Clean Plate IC-LoRA). off: the raw plate in the edges, as v0.4.1. The alpha is the same in every mode. Saves rgba_ files next to the alpha.

track_backward.display_name: track backward from the pick frame
track_backward.tooltip: Full shot: matte the whole plate. Every pick is tracked backward to the first frame as well as forward, so you can pick the subject on any frame where it is clear. Frames before the subject enters get an empty alpha. Off: the shot starts at the pick frame (as before v0.6). The preview always starts at the pick frame.

skip_sam3.tooltip: Plain LTX alpha-gen: no picks, no SAM3. LTX mattes every main subject in the plate, and you still get the chunked full shot, native 4K edges, edge colour and EXR with plate frame numbers. The preview starts at the scrubber frame. Quality and overlap mode do not apply.

ComfyProAlphaGenerator.name: ComfyProAlphaGenerator
ComfyProAlphaGenerator.description: Comfy Pro Alpha Generator by Rikin Patel (Comfy Compositing). Matte ONE chosen subject with LTX-2.5 alpha-gen edge quality. Type what to find (person, dog, car...), click Detect, click the subject; alt-click cuts parts, shift-click adds parts.

path.tooltip: Folder of frames, or a pattern: D:/plates/sh010/plate.####.exr (or %04d). Absolute, or relative to ComfyUI/input.

first.tooltip: First frame NUMBER to load (0 = from the start)

last.tooltip: Last frame NUMBER to load (0 = to the end)

ComfyProAlpha_LoadPlateSequence.name: ComfyProAlpha_LoadPlateSequence
ComfyProAlpha_LoadPlateSequence.description: Image sequence -> IMAGE. Keeps the plate's frame numbers (first_frame) so the matte comes out as alpha_01001... EXR is treated as scene-linear and converted to sRGB.

ComposeColorMatch.name: ComposeColorMatch
ComposeColorMatch.description: Composite source over destination via a mask, with a per-frame correction so the inserted region matches the plate. 'Grade match (surround)' estimates the VAE/grading drift from the unchanged area outside the mask (where source & destination share content) and applies it to the source inside the mask -- fixes seam luminance/contrast without changing the element's colors. 'Color match (palette)' is the distribution-based color-matcher approach. 'temporal_anchor' (iterative video) re-matches each iteration's element to the previous iteration's corrected tail so VAE drift can't compound.

videos.tooltip: Video segments to concatenate in input order.

video.tooltip: A video segment to append.

codec.tooltip: Codec used to encode videos tensors. Auto uses H.264; already encoded videos remain unchanged.

complete_audio.tooltip: Optional complete soundtrack for the concatenated video. Overrides audio carried by the input videos.

CondPassThrough.name: CondPassThrough
CondPassThrough.description:
Simply passes through the positive and negative conditioning,
    workaround for Set node not allowing bypassed inputs.

condition.tooltip: On: pass value_true. Off: pass value_false.

value_true.tooltip: Passed on when condition is on (only this branch runs).

value_false.tooltip: Passed on when condition is off (only this branch runs).

source.tooltip: What picks the branch. condition: the switch above. compare: compare_a <operator> compare_b (true -> value_true, false -> value_false). index: the branch number below (0 value_false, 1 value_true, 2-4 value_2..value_4).

index.tooltip: source 'index': 0 = value_false, 1 = value_true, 2..4 = value_2..value_4. A number without a wired branch uses 'fallback' (an error when that is not wired either).

compare_a.tooltip: source 'compare': the value to test (any type: number, text, boolean, a tensor for 'is empty').

operator.tooltip: source 'compare': how compare_a is tested against compare_b. contains / starts with / ends with / matches regex compare as text; 'is empty' / 'is not empty' ignore compare_b.

compare_b.tooltip: source 'compare': the value compare_a is tested against, typed as compare_as says.

compare_as.tooltip: source 'compare': read both sides as numbers, text or booleans (true/false, yes/no, on/off, 1/0). auto: from compare_a's type. A side that cannot be read that way stops the run with a message.

value_2.tooltip: source 'index': branch 2 (only the chosen branch runs).

value_3.tooltip: source 'index': branch 3 (only the chosen branch runs).

value_4.tooltip: source 'index': branch 4 (only the chosen branch runs).

fallback.tooltip: Used when the chosen branch is not wired or the index is out of range. Not wired: that case stops the run with a message instead.

ConditionalSwitchMEC.name: ConditionalSwitchMEC
ConditionalSwitchMEC.description: Return value_true when condition is True, else value_false. Both inputs are wildcard (*) so it works for any type. Optional: decide by a typed comparison (compare_a <operator> compare_b), or route one of up to five branches by index, with an explicit fallback.
output_tooltips: value_true or value_false, whichever the condition chose.

conditioning_to.tooltip: base conditioning to concat to (or pass through, if second is empty)

conditioning_from.tooltip: conditioning to concat to conditioning_to, if empty, then conditioning_to is passed through unchanged

ConsolidateMasksKJ.description: Consolidates a batch of separate masks by finding the largest group of masks that fit inside a tile of the given width and height (including the padding), and repeating until no more masks can be combined.

model.tooltip: The model to apply context windows to during sampling.

context_length.tooltip: The length of the context window.

context_overlap.tooltip: The overlap of the context window.

context_schedule.tooltip: Step-dependent scheduling algorithm for context windows.

context_stride.tooltip: The stride of the context window; only applicable to uniform schedules.

closed_loop.tooltip: Whether to close the context window loop; only applicable to looped schedules.

fuse_method.tooltip: The method to use to fuse the context windows.

dim.tooltip: The dimension to apply the context windows to.

freenoise.tooltip: Whether to apply FreeNoise noise shuffling, improves window blending.

cond_retain_index_list.tooltip: List of latent indices to retain in the conditioning tensors for each window. For concat-style I2V models (e.g. Wan I2V, HunyuanVideo I2V, Cosmos I2V, SVD) the encoded start image lives in the c_concat conditioning channels; setting this to '0' will retain that start image content at sub-pos 0 of every window.

split_conds_to_windows.tooltip: Whether to split multiple conditionings (created by ConditionCombine) to each window based on region index.

latent_retain_index_list.tooltip: List of latent indices to retain in the noise latent itself for each window. Use for workflows where reference content (e.g. a start image) lives directly in the noise latent rather than in separate conditioning channels (e.g. inplace-style I2V like LTXV, AnimateDiff). Independent of cond_retain_index_list.

causal_window_fix.tooltip: Whether to add a causal fix frame to non-0-indexed context windows.

output_tooltips: The model with context windows applied during sampling.
ContextWindowsManual.name: ContextWindowsManual

frame_units.tooltip: Units for the frame counts below. 'pixel' converts to latent via ((n - 1) // temporal_downscale) + 1.

dim.tooltip: Latent temporal dimension: 2 for WAN-like, 0 for AnimateDiff-style. Model path only.

temporal_downscale.tooltip: VAE temporal compression for pixel->latent. WAN/Hunyuan/CogVideoX=4, Mochi=6, LTXV=8.

num_frames.tooltip: Total frames to visualize. Ignored on the model path (the real latent length is used).

context_schedule.tooltip: Window placement. standard_static_balanced: static with windows spread evenly (uniform seams, any frame count). batched_shifted: zero-overlap windows whose seams roll each step (~1.0x compute, pairs with freenoise). Uniform schedules also shift per step.

context_stride.tooltip: Max stride power for uniform schedules (adds dilated windows: 1, 2, 4...).

closed_loop.tooltip: Wrap looped-schedule windows around the end back to frame 0.

causal_window_fix.tooltip: Prepend an anchor frame to non-0 windows, stripped after the model call.

freenoise.tooltip: FreeNoise noise shuffling for smoother blending. Model path only.

cond_retain_index_list.tooltip: Comma-separated window-relative indices that keep their original conditioning, e.g. '0' reuses the start frame's cond per window. No viz effect; model path only.

model.tooltip: Optional model to apply the context windows to during sampling.

output_tooltips: Model with context windows applied; only valid when a model is connected.
ContextWindowsVisualizerKJ.name: ContextWindowsVisualizerKJ
ContextWindowsVisualizerKJ.description: Interactive visualization of ComfyUI context windows: window placement, overlap, fuse weights and per-frame blending, updated live. Optionally applies the settings to a model like the core Context Windows (Manual) node.

blend_mode.tooltip: How the 'blended' overlay combines passes. screen = least-destructive; linear_dodge clips; multiply darkens.

preview_layout.tooltip: Layout for the 'combined' output: horizontal_3 = depth | pose | canny; grid_2x2 = depth|pose // canny|original.

image.tooltip: Source frames — preprocessors below run on this.

depth_model.tooltip: Depth backend. VENDORED (run inside this pack): da_v2/da_v1/midas (transformers), da3 (Depth-Anything-3), depth_pro, depthcrafter (video), dvd (DVD — deterministic Wan-2.1 VIDEO depth, EnVision-Research; needs the DVD ckpt in models/DVD/, CC BY-NC). The depth_anything_* options delegate to comfyui_controlnet_aux. 'off' = wire an external depth map. NON-COMMERCIAL weights: dvd (CC BY-NC), depth_pro (apple/DepthPro-hf, Apple research licence); see depth_size for Depth-Anything.

normal_model.tooltip: Normal backend (vendored): sobel_from_depth (no model) or normalcrafter (video). 'off' = wire an external normal map.

depth_size.tooltip: DepthAnything backbone: small=ViT-S (fastest, test default), medium=ViT-B, large=ViT-L. giant: only DA3 has one; da_v2 / da_v1 / midas use large and the run note says so. Ignored by metric/zoe. Licences: Depth-Anything-V2 small = Apache-2.0; V2 base / large and DA3 large / giant (DA3NESTED-GIANT-LARGE) = CC BY-NC 4.0, NON-COMMERCIAL.

depth_custom_ckpt.tooltip: Pick your own depth model, or '(auto)' = use the backend/size default.

CreateFadeMaskAdvanced.name: CreateFadeMaskAdvanced
CreateFadeMaskAdvanced.description:
Create a batch of masks interpolated between given frames and values. 
Uses same syntax as Fizz' BatchValueSchedule.
First value is the frame index (not that this starts from 0, not 1) 
and the second value inside the brackets is the float value of the mask in range 0.0 - 1.0  

For example the default values:  
0:(0.0)  
7:(1.0)  
15:(0.0)  
  
Would create a mask batch fo 16 frames, starting from black, 
interpolating with the chosen curve to fully white at the 8th frame, 
and interpolating from that to fully black at the 16th frame.

DepthPoseCannyCombinedV2.name: DepthPoseCannyCombinedV2
DepthPoseCannyCombinedV2.description:
Self-contained ControlNet preprocessor producing depth, pose, canny, normal, layout-combined preview, AND a weighted blended map.

DEPTH backends (set via `depth_backend`):
  - auto       : prefer external_depth_map -> any wired loader -> built_in_midas
  - external   : require external_depth_map IMAGE input
  - built_in_midas : MiDaS small via torch.hub (downloads ~80MB to torch hub cache, no extra node pack needed)
  - damodel_v2     : kijai/ComfyUI-DepthAnythingV2 (models/depthanything/)
  - da3            : PozzettiAndrea/ComfyUI-DepthAnythingV3 (models/depthanything3/) - delegates to V3 pack
  - depthcrafter   : akatz-ai/ComfyUI-DepthCrafter-Nodes (models/depthcrafter/)
  - depth_pro      : spacepxl/ComfyUI-Depth-Pro (models/depth/ml-depth-pro/)

POSE source priority: external_pose_map > posemodel.

NORMAL map: Sobel-from-depth (Lambertian-style RGB). No extra model.

BLEND modes (research-backed, Wikipedia/W3C Compositing 1.0):
  - none           : returns the depth_map
  - weighted_avg   : per-channel sum normalised by total weight (perceptually balanced)
  - screen         : 1 - prod(1 - layer_i*w_i)  (avoids highlight clipping, good for stacking depth+canny gradients)
  - linear_dodge   : min(1, sum(layer_i*w_i))  (additive; sharpens edges; preferred for pose+canny per Fooocus/SDXL controlnet community)
  - max            : per-pixel maximum across weighted layers (preserves strongest cue per pixel)
  - multiply       : prod(layer_i^w_i)  (darkening; emphasises overlap)
  - overlay        : combined multiply/screen S-curve on weighted_avg base
  - channel_split  : R=depth, G=canny, B=pose (Fun-Control / IP-Adapter style multi-condition packing)

OUTPUTS: depth_map, pose_map, canny_map, normal_map, combined_map (layout), blended_map (per blend_mode).

face_images.tooltip: OPTIONAL face crop IMAGE batch (typically the face_images_512 output of PoseAndFaceDetectionV2). When wired, the node validates frame-count parity with the pose batch, optionally force-resizes to 512x512, and forwards it on the 'face_video' output so a single DrawViTPoseV2 can feed the Wan-Animate sampler's pose+face inputs in one place.

face_cfg_scale.tooltip: Passthrough face CFG scale, CONNECTION-ONLY (forceInput) so there is exactly one source of truth: PoseAndFaceDetectionV2.face_cfg_scale. It used to be a second independently-editable widget with the same default, so you could set 2.0 upstream, leave 1.0 here, and get no warning that they had diverged. Unconnected = 1.0 (no-op), which matches the old default. NOTE: Kijai's ComfyUI-WanVideoWrapper has no face-CFG input to wire this into today — for real control over expression adherence use WanVideoAnimateEmbeds.face_strength (spec 2.2's stronger, more direct block-scale lever) instead.

enforce_512_face.tooltip: If True and 'face_images' is provided at a non-512 size, force-resize each frame to 512x512 (bilinear) before forwarding. Default True so the encoder always sees the trained input shape.

reference_expression_coeffs_json.tooltip: Wan-Animate spec 3.1 (closed-loop critic): wire in the 'expression_coeffs_json' output of a PoseAndFaceDetectionV2 run (export_expression_coeffs=True) on the SOURCE driving video. When non-empty, this node measures ARKit-52 blendshapes from ITS OWN pose_data.iris_data (i.e. the GENERATED Wan-Animate output side, since this node is downstream of the generation pass) and reports per-AU + per-segment error against the reference — a numeric fidelity signal instead of eyeballing frames. Leave empty to skip entirely (zero extra cost).

segment_length.tooltip: Frames per segment for the critic's worst-segment breakdown — match WanVideoAnimateEmbeds.frame_window_size (default 77) so segments line up with Wan-Animate's own splice boundaries (spec 2.5/3.5). Only used when reference_expression_coeffs_json is wired.

top_k_aus.tooltip: How many worst-tracked AUs the critic reports, worst-first. Only used when reference_expression_coeffs_json is wired.

apply_pose_edits_to_face.tooltip: Expression-edit DELIVERY (2026-07-24). When pose_data carries edited face landmarks (WanFaceController3DV2 expression dials / dragged landmarks) AND face_images is wired, 'warp' moves the ACTUAL face-crop pixels from the original landmark positions to the edited ones (same Delaunay piecewise-affine engine as FC3D's preview), so the Wan-Animate face encoder sees the edit. Without this, landmark edits only change the drawn skeleton — the photographic face crop stays neutral and the sampler follows the crop, i.e. your expression edits silently do nothing. No-op when landmarks are unedited (zero cost), so the default stays 'warp'.

CSV 'name,mae' for the top_k_aus worst-tracked AUs, worst first. Empty string when the critic did not run.

Uses Eye-Aspect-Ratio: the eye's height over its width, which collapses when the lid closes. A blink needs BOTH eyes below threshold for several consecutive frames, so a single bad detection frame does not read as one. Use it to keep a retargeted performance blinking where the actor did.

Tweak live, then run for full quality.

A new layer input appears as you connect the previous one. RGBA layers (like the *_layer_alpha outputs of the ER suite) composite with their own per-pixel alpha; RGB light layers over black work best with add or screen.

EREditGen.name: EREditGen
EREditGen.description: Multi-reference generative editing in a single node, for edit models that take reference latents (FLUX.2 klein, FLUX.1 Kontext, Qwen-Image-Edit...). Pick the model, the text encoder and the VAE right here (no loader nodes to wire), plug up to 4 reference images (a new image slot appears as you fill the previous one) plus a prompt, and it handles the scaling, the VAE encoding, the reference chain on both positive and negative, the model's own noise schedule and the sampling. The latent output feeds the latent input of the next ER EditGen, so you can keep editing round after round WITHOUT decoding and re-encoding the image (no generation loss).

ERGlow.name: ERGlow
ERGlow.description: Advanced GPU glow / bloom with a real-time preview: soft-knee highlight extraction (luma, max, average or per channel), multi-octave optical falloff, anamorphic stretch, glow gamma / saturation / tint with chromatic dispersion, Add / Screen / Max blending, mix and Result / Glow only / Highlights views. Works on images and frame batches (video).
output_tooltips: The image with the glow applied.
Glow only over pure black (RGB): additive light for Add/Screen in a compositor, and the CLEAN input for edit models (klein, nano banana) that dislike alpha.
Glow only with alpha (RGBA, alpha = brightness): for normal-blend compositing. Do NOT feed this one to edit models.

ERLensCameraDirt.name: ERLensCameraDirt

Deterministic by seed, with size, density, softness, tint and highlight-reveal controls. dirt_layer outputs just the dirt over pure black, ready to use as a compositing pass.
output_tooltips: The image with the camera dirt revealed by its highlights.
Dirt only over pure black (RGB): additive, for Add/Screen or as a CLEAN edit-model input (no alpha).
Dirt only with alpha (RGBA, alpha = brightness): for normal-blend compositing. Do NOT feed this one to edit models.

ERLensEffects.name: ERLensEffects
ERLensEffects.description: GPU lens effects for images with a real-time preview: photographic Brown-Conrady distortion (k1+k2), chromatic aberration, movable vignette, sharpen, highlight glow, corner softness, diffusion and halation, plus lens-type presets that fill values as a starting point.

ERLensFlare.name: ERLensFlare

Screen-blended. flare_layer outputs just the flare over pure black, ready to use as a compositing pass or as an input for other models.
output_tooltips: The image with the flares screened on top.
Flares only over pure black (RGB): additive light for Add/Screen in a compositor, and the CLEAN input for edit models (klein, nano banana) that dislike alpha.
Flares only with alpha (RGBA, alpha = brightness): for normal-blend compositing. Do NOT feed this one to edit models.

Grain only over mid gray (RGB): Overlay / Linear Light in a compositor, or feed edit models directly (no alpha).
Grain only with alpha (RGBA, alpha = deviation from mid gray): for normal-blend compositing. Do NOT feed this one to edit models.

image.tooltip: One image or a video (frames). Any size.

face_finder.tooltip: How the face box is found. yunet: OpenCV's face finder (MIT, 0.2 MB, downloaded with allow_download). whole image: the image is already a face crop. yolo: an installed Ultralytics face model (models/ultralytics/bbox). A wired face_mask overrides this.

max_faces.tooltip: Faces per frame, left to right.

passes.tooltip: Network passes per face. Each pass re-frames the box on the previous points (the model's own procedure; 3 = the released default).

track_video.tooltip: Video: start each frame's box from the face's points in the previous frame (steadier, and the finder only looks for new faces). Off: every frame is found on its own.

landmark_set.tooltip: The points drawn into landmark_image. pose_keypoint is always OpenPose's 68 + 2 pupils.

point_size.tooltip: Dot radius in pixels for landmark_image and overlay.

allow_download.tooltip: Allow downloading myned-ai/facepoints (416 MB, CC BY-NC 4.0 = non-commercial use only) and YuNet (0.2 MB, MIT) into models/facepoints when they are missing.

face_mask.tooltip: A mask over the face (per frame, or one for all): its box is used instead of the face finder. One face.

finder_confidence.tooltip: Minimum score for yunet / yolo faces.

confident_pct.tooltip: A point counts as sure when its calibrated error estimate is below this % of the face size (2.5 = a little above a typical good point); its confidence c is 0.5 exactly there. Unsure points are drawn faint in overlay.

appearance_scheme.tooltip: Appearance. model card: the original colours (white dots on black; 620 points coloured by kind). custom: the colours below. Colours change the images only, never the POSE_KEYPOINT numbers.

appearance_overlay_colour.tooltip: Appearance (custom): one colour for every dot in overlay, #RRGGBB. Empty = the per-set / per-kind colours below.

appearance_colour_lmk.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 620-point kind 'lmk', #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_skin.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 620-point kind 'skin', #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_lid.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 620-point kind 'lid', #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_teeth_u.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 620-point kind 'teeth_u', #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_teeth_l.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 620-point kind 'teeth_l', #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_iris.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 620-point kind 'iris', #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_68.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 68 + iris set, #RRGGBB.

appearance_colour_98.tooltip: Appearance (custom): overlay colour of the 98 set, #RRGGBB.

appearance_kinds_on_landmark_image.tooltip: Appearance (custom): landmark_image uses the overlay's per-set / per-kind colours instead of one dot colour.

strength_overlay_opacity.tooltip: Strength: how opaque the overlay's dots are over the image (real alpha blending). 1 = solid.

strength_dot_intensity.tooltip: Strength: landmark_image dot brightness, blended toward the background (a weaker control image). 1 = full colour.

strength_low_confidence_opacity.tooltip: Strength: how strong an unsure point is drawn - its colour factor in 'dim' mode, its opacity in 'fade' mode.

strength_render_threshold.tooltip: Strength: a point whose confidence is below this is drawn as unsure (see screening_low_confidence_points). Drawing only.

strength_pose_confidence_scale.tooltip: Strength: multiplies the confidence values in pose_keypoint (clamped to 0..1). Coordinates are unchanged.

resolution_processing.tooltip: Resolution: size the faces are FOUND and cropped at. source = the input; a number = the longer side at most that (downscale only, aspect kept). The network itself always sees the checkpoint's own input size. Points come back in source pixels.

resolution_processing_max.tooltip: Resolution: the longer side for resolution_processing = custom.

resolution_output.tooltip: Resolution: size of landmark_image, overlay, face_mask - and the coordinates in pose_keypoint and JSON follow it, so everything stays aligned. original = the input size.

resolution_keep_aspect.tooltip: Resolution: fit inside the output size keeping the aspect ratio (the output is the fitted size). Off: stretch to exactly that size.

screening_face_confidence_min.tooltip: Screening: faces whose overall landmark confidence is below this are left out of the images and pose_keypoint (the face finder's own threshold is finder_confidence).

screening_point_confidence_min.tooltip: Screening: pose_keypoint points below this confidence get c = 0 (consumers skip them); their x, y stay. JSON always keeps every point and lists the screened ones.

screening_low_confidence_points.tooltip: Screening: how unsure 620-set points (below strength_render_threshold) are DRAWN - dim (the original look, overlay only), fade (transparent), hide, or keep (like sure points). fade / hide apply to landmark_image too. Data is never removed by this.

screening_keep_rejected_faces.tooltip: Screening: list rejected faces (no face in the box, below the face confidence) in the JSON with the reason, for diagnosis. They never enter the images or pose.

mask_grow.tooltip: Face mask: expand (dilate) by this many px.

mask_shrink.tooltip: Face mask: contract (erode) by this many px (after mask_grow).

mask_feather.tooltip: Face mask: Gaussian blur, sigma in px (soft on both sides of the edge).

mask_edge_softness.tooltip: Face mask: fade in from the edge over this many px (the outer edge stays put).

mask_threshold.tooltip: Face mask: > 0 makes the mask hard at this level (applied last). 0 = off.

mask_hull_smoothing.tooltip: Face mask: rounds the hull outline (corner-cutting passes). 0 = the original hull.

mask_preview.tooltip: Face mask: show the mask on the overlay image (tint or outline). The MASK output is not changed by this.

temporal_smoothing.tooltip: Temporal: smooth landmark trajectories over a video (adaptive: still points steady, real motion followed). Independent of track_video. Raw points stay in the JSON.

temporal_strength.tooltip: Temporal: smoothing of still points. 0 = none; higher = steadier. A still point is averaged over about 1 / (1 - strength) frames (0.5: about 2, 0.8: about 5, 0.95: about 20); a point that moves faster than about (1 + 5 x strength) % of the face per frame follows at once.

temporal_confidence_aware.tooltip: Temporal: points the model is less sure of than before move less toward their new position.

temporal_max_offset.tooltip: Temporal: the most (px) smoothing may hold a point away from its detected position in a frame. 0 = no limit.

temporal_scene_cut.tooltip: Temporal: a frame that differs from the previous one by more than this (mean absolute difference, 0..1) is a scene cut: smoothing and identities restart. 0 = off.

temporal_reset_on_loss.tooltip: Temporal: when a face is not found in a frame, its smoothing restarts when it comes back.

temporal_stable_order.tooltip: Temporal: keep each face's position in pose_keypoint / JSON by identity across frames (matched by position). Off: left to right in every frame (the original order).

strength_connection_lines.tooltip: Strength: draw the face contours (jaw, brows, nose, eyes, lips) as lines between the points - 0 = off. For the 68 and 98 sets (the 620 dense points have no contour order). Drawing only.

appearance_line_width.tooltip: Appearance: connection line width in px (output pixels).

mask_faces.tooltip: Face mask: which faces fill face_mask - all, the largest, or one by its position in pose_keypoint.

mask_face_index.tooltip: Face mask: the face for mask_faces = face index (0 = first in pose_keypoint).

mask_part.tooltip: Face mask: which part of the head face_mask covers. Features (eyes, lids, brows, nose, lips, inner mouth) and areas (around the mouth, cheeks, chin + jaw) come from the landmarks; forehead, ears, hair and head + hair are ESTIMATED (no landmark covers them) and fitted to the picture by mask_head_refine. custom list: several parts joined, typed in mask_parts_custom.

mask_parts_custom.tooltip: Face mask (mask_part = custom list): parts joined into one mask, comma separated, e.g. 'eyes, lips' or 'head + hair (estimated), whole face'.

mask_invert.tooltip: Face mask: everything EXCEPT the chosen parts (applied after grow / shrink / feather).

screening_robust_detection.tooltip: Screening: low light, colour casts and motion blur. auto: a frame where no face is found is analysed and retried on enhanced copies (light, colour, deblur, a 1.5x look) and then with a nearby frame's face box; always: every frame is detected on the enhanced copy; off: as before. The copies are only shown to the detector - every output keeps the original footage.

FacepointsLandmarksC2C.name: FacepointsLandmarksC2C
FacepointsLandmarksC2C.description:
Dense face landmarks for any model: 620 points on Google's GNM Head mesh, each with its own error estimate, plus the standard 68-point (iBUG) and 98-point (WFLW) sets and both pupils, from myned-ai/facepoints. Outputs OpenPose POSE_KEYPOINT (face = 68 + 2 pupils, pixels), a white-dot control image, an overlay, a face mask and JSON with every set. Video: the box follows the face's own points frame to frame. Weights are CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial use only) and are downloaded only with allow_download, into models/facepoints.

Advanced controls (the node's collapsible sections):appearance_ (colours), strength_ (opacity, intensity, pose confidence), resolution_ (processing and output size; everything stays aligned), screening_ (face / point confidence, how unsure points are drawn, rejected faces in JSON), mask_ (grow, shrink, feather, softness, threshold, hull smoothing, preview), temporal_ (landmark smoothing, scene cuts, stable face order). The defaults give the original output.
output_tooltips: OpenPose JSON per frame; face_keypoints_2d = 68 iBUG points + 2 pupils (70 x [x, y, c], pixels of the output size). strength_pose_confidence_scale / screening_point_confidence_min change c only.
The chosen landmark set as dots (white on black by default) - a control image.
The input with the points drawn (620: coloured by kind, unsure points dim / faded / hidden).
Filled hull of the face points, 0..1 (grow / shrink / feather / softness / threshold when set).
Every set per frame and face: 620 points with std, 68, 98, iris, box, confidence; raw points when smoothed; screened points and rejected faces when asked.

Above 0: a pair of frames whose gray histograms differ by at least this (Bhattacharyya distance, 0 = same .. 1 = unrelated; hard cuts are usually above 0.4) is a scene cut and gets no in-betweens, so two shots are never blended. The cut pairs are listed in the TIMEMAP (scene_cuts).

motion_metric.tooltip: global p95: motion = 95th percentile of the whole frame's flow (as before). local tiles: the frame is cut into a 4x4 grid and the fastest tile counts, so a small fast subject (a hand, a ball) on a still background also gets in-betweens.

strength.tooltip: Maximum correction strength. 0.3-0.6 is a good starting range. Too high and you override the model's color decisions entirely.

ramp_curve.tooltip: Controls the shape of the correction ramp. Formula: progress^(1/curve). 1.0 = linear. >1 = fast start, tapers off  (e.g. sqrt for curve=2). <1 = slow start, aggressive late  (e.g. squared for curve=0.5). For few-step schedules (4-8 steps) values of 2-4 work well because they reach useful strength quickly.

ref_index.tooltip: Which reference latent to anchor colors from.

channel_weights.tooltip: uniform: correct all channels equally. by_variance: weight correction by how stable each channel's mean is in the reference (low-variance channels trusted more).

front_mult.tooltip: Multiplier for the FRONT section. With Sectioned Encoder upstream this is the actual front token range; otherwise it's the first 25% of active tokens (arbitrary).

preserve_original.tooltip: Linear blend back the unmodified active region. 0 = full effect.

active_scale.tooltip: Multiplier on every active-token embedding. 1.0 = unchanged. The model was trained on Qwen3's natural distribution; values far from 1.0 push it off-distribution.

per_token_whiten.tooltip: Amplifies per-token deviation from the sequence mean: (x - mean)*(1+w) + mean. >0 widens spread, <0 compresses. Was called 'contrast' in v1.

norm_equalize.tooltip: Blend each token toward the per-sequence mean L2 norm. Flattens magnitude variance — fights Qwen3's natural emphasis. 0 = no effect.

early_layer_scale.tooltip: Klein-specific. Scale the first Qwen3 layer slice (low-level / structural features). Klein conditioning stacks 3 layers along the embed dim; this targets the first.

mid_layer_scale.tooltip: Klein-specific. Scale the middle Qwen3 layer slice (intermediate semantic features).

late_layer_scale.tooltip: Klein-specific. Scale the last Qwen3 layer slice (high-level / abstract semantic features).

preserve_original.tooltip: Linear blend back the unmodified active region. 0.0 = full enhancement, 1.0 = no change.

active_end_override.tooltip: Override the active-region end. 0 = auto-detect from attention_mask, falls back to full sequence length if mask missing.

steps.tooltip: Denoising steps. Distilled: 4. Base: 25-50.

denoise.tooltip: 1.0 = full denoise from pure noise. Lower values blend noise into the input latent for img2img.

cfg_scale.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance scale. 1.0 = disabled (distilled default). Base model uses ~4.0. Requires negative conditioning.

guidance_embed.tooltip: Embedded guidance value. Only active if the loaded model has a guidance embedding layer. Klein 9B models do not — this will be ignored for them.

strength.tooltip: Attenuation strength in the BLACK regions of the mask. 1.0 = black regions multiplied by 0 (full attenuation). 0.5 = black regions kept at 50% of ref strength. 0.0 = mask ignored, ref passes through everywhere.

FluxKleinDeepDebiaser.name: FluxKleinDeepDebiaser
FluxKleinDeepDebiaser.description:
FLUX.2 Klein debiaser built from verified forward-pass hook analysis.

VERIFIED ARCHITECTURE:
  Double blocks (0-7): SEPARATE img/txt streams — no cross-modal interaction
    img_attn/img_mlp: processes ref+noisy image tokens [8140] ONLY
    txt_attn/txt_mlp: processes text tokens [512] ONLY

  Single blocks (0-23): CONCATENATED cross-modal [8652 tokens]
    Text and image tokens interact HERE
    This is where 'model overwrites your image' happens
    linear1 packs QKV+MLP gate (can't split at weight level)

  Global: img_in, txt_in, time_in, modulations, final_layer

63 controls. Strength 1.0 = unchanged. LoRA-safe.

SAVE: Export modified model as .safetensors:
  full_model: Complete model (~18GB), load directly as replacement
  diff_only: Just the changes (small), apply as additive patch

FluxVAEDebiaser.name: FluxVAEDebiaser
FluxVAEDebiaser.description:
Individual tensor-level debiaser for Flux VAE (Flux 2 Klein — 32ch latent).

125 tensor units — every conv1, conv2, norm1, norm2, nin_shortcut,
Q, K, V, proj_out, upsample, downsample gets its own knob.

All tensors F32 — fully modifiable (no quantization issues).

Strength 1.0 = unchanged. < 1.0 = weaken. > 1.0 = boost.

🎨 COLOR TIPS:
  • d_u0b*_conv* (Dec Up0, 128ch final stage) — fine color precision
  • d_u1b*_conv* (Dec Up1, 256ch) — color gradients & transitions
  • d_u2b*/d_u3b* (512ch) — coarse structure & base tone
  • d_mid_attn_* — global spatial color relationships
  • d_norm_out — overall brightness/contrast
  • d_conv_out — final RGB mapping (VERY sensitive!)

⚠️ Encoder units only matter for img2img/inpainting.
For txt2img, only decoder units affect output.

FluxVAEInspector.name: FluxVAEInspector
FluxVAEInspector.description:
Analyzes every tensor unit in Flux VAE (125 units).

⚡ WEIGHT ANALYSIS (default): Fast
  - Weight norms, distributions, max values per tensor unit
  - Identifies which convs/norms dominate

⚠️ DECODE ABLATION: Slow, needs latent
  - Weakens each decoder unit individually and decodes
  - Measures pixel-level + per-channel (R/G/B) impact
  - Precise importance rankings for color tuning

Run weight analysis first, then ablation with a sample latent.

suffix_mode.tooltip:
Where the `suffix` is applied:
  filename  — append to the output basename (legacy behaviour)
  subfolder — nest a folder AFTER the version, e.g. v001/mask/ — keeps mask vs wan outputs of the SAME run side by side, same version
  folder    — append to the TOP folder name, e.g. ATG_..._mask/ — fully separate folder tree with its own versioning.
For subfolder/folder a leading '_' or '-' is stripped from the folder name (so '_mask' → 'mask') and the basename is left clean.

label.tooltip: Fallback folder name (used only when no source file is connected)

date_format.tooltip: Date format for the date subfolder (e.g. 02-22-2026 or 2026-02-22)

path_style.tooltip: Path separator style for output strings. auto=detect from current OS, windows=backslash, linux/macos=forward slash. Use 'auto' unless you design workflows on one OS and run on another.

source_choice.tooltip: Where the source name comes from. 'image' → trigger_image, 'video' → trigger_video, 'auto' → prefer video if connected, else image, else legacy `trigger`. 'exr' → prefer an EXR/DPX/CIN plate (sequence or single); works WITHOUT a trigger — wire the plate path STRING into `source_path` and the stem is derived from it. 'custom' → use the ``custom_name`` widget verbatim and ignore all triggers.

name_format.tooltip:
How to format the detected filename for folder + prefix:
  basename      — strip extension only (e.g. clip_2160_25fps)
  strip_tags    — also strip trailing res/fps tags (clip)
  first_segment — keep only the first chunk before . or _ (clip)
The original file extension is preserved on output_filename.

numbered_still_mode.tooltip:
What a trailing number on a STILL means (png/exr/dpx/tif...):
  auto     — >=4 digits is a frame index and is stripped
             (plate.0001.png -> plate); <=3 digits is a shot
             number and is KEPT (shot_010.png -> shot_010).
  sequence — always strip a trailing 2-8 digit number. Use when
             your frames are bare-numbered (plate_01.png ...).
  identity — never strip bare digits; only #### and %04d go.
#### and %04d are stripped in every mode — they are never part
of a real name. auto errs toward KEEPING the number, because
over-grouping silently mixes unrelated plates into one sequence,
while over-splitting is merely inconvenient and visible.

trigger.tooltip: Legacy generic trigger – connect any output here.

trigger_image.tooltip: Connect a LoadImage / image source here. Used when source_choice = 'image' or 'auto'.

trigger_video.tooltip: Connect a LoadVideo / VHS_LoadVideo / video source here. Used when source_choice = 'video' or 'auto' (preferred).

source_filename.tooltip: Auto-filled from the connected loader (basename only, no extension). Drives folder name + output basename. Extension is stored separately in source_extension for output_filename. May also be a FULL PATH — the basename is extracted automatically.

source_extension.tooltip: Auto-filled file extension from the connected loader (e.g. .mp4, .mov). Used only for output_filename — not part of the folder name.

source_path.tooltip: Full path to a source media file (image / video / EXR / DPX sequence). When provided, the node extracts the filename stem from this path and uses it as the source name — this takes PRECEDENCE over source_filename and custom_name. Connect a STRING output here (e.g. an OCIORead 'source' widget, or any loader that exposes its file path as STRING). The extracted stem is returned on the `source_stem` output, and a trailing version token (e.g. _v001) is incremented to _v002 on the `next_version_token` / `next_version_stem` outputs.

custom_name.tooltip: Manual source name. Only used when source_choice='custom'. May include an extension (e.g. 'my_shot.mp4'); if no extension is given, output_filename will have none either. Sanitized for cross-platform safety.

base_path.tooltip: Override base output directory.  Leave empty → ComfyUI output dir.

folder_name_override.tooltip: Force a specific folder name instead of deriving from the input filename. Sanitized for cross-platform safety.

version_group.tooltip:
Which outputs share one version number.

LEAVE IT EMPTY (the normal case). Every incrementer in the same run whose folder is the same shot - including its _mask, _exr and _png variants - is handed the SAME version, so one render files as one version. An unrelated job in the same workflow keeps its own counter and is never dragged along.

Set a name here only when two outputs belong together but their folder names do not say so. Incrementers sharing a name share a version, whatever their folders.

reserve_version.tooltip: If True, create the version directory and write a `.reserved` marker file to claim the version number atomically. Prevents collisions in batch/render-farm workflows. Leave False for normal use (the directory will be created by ComfyUI's Save node when output is actually written).

layout.tooltip:
Folder layout.
  source / date / version  - <base>/<source name>/<date>/v### (the usual one)
  show / shot / task / version - <base>/<show>/<shot>/<task>/v###, the pipeline layout: no date folder, versions always v###, and with reserve_version each version is claimed with an exclusive .lock (retrying when another job took it) plus an optional version_manifest.json.

show.tooltip: show / shot / task layout: show or project name (top folder under base).

shot.tooltip: show / shot / task layout: shot identifier (folder under show).

task.tooltip: show / shot / task layout: task name (folder under shot, e.g. comp, matte).

write_manifest.tooltip: show / shot / task layout, reserve_version on: also write version_manifest.json (workflow hash, user, host, time) into the reserved folder.

versioning.tooltip:

  filename - on the file, no version folder: shot_A/<date>/shot_A_v001.png

- **conditioning** goes between to clip text encode and the sampler

bounding boxes.

GeminiNodeV3.name: GeminiNodeV3
GeminiNodeV3.description: Generate text responses with Google's Gemini models. Provide a text prompt and, optionally, one or more images, audio clips, videos, or files as multimodal context.

model.tooltip: The Gemini video model used to generate the video.

prompt.tooltip: Describe the video to generate. Specify the length and aspect ratio directly in the prompt, e.g. "a 6-second clip in 16:9". Length may be 3-10 seconds; the aspect ratio must be 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (portrait). The output is 720p, 24 FPS, with audio.

images.tooltip: Optional reference image(s) to guide or animate the video. Up to 14 images.

videos.tooltip: Optional reference video(s) to guide or edit. Up to 3 videos, each up to 10 seconds long.

temperature.tooltip: Controls randomness. Lower is more focused/deterministic, higher is more varied.

top_p.tooltip: Nucleus sampling: sample from the smallest token set whose cumulative probability reaches top_p.

seed.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

GeminiVideoOmni.name: GeminiVideoOmni
GeminiVideoOmni.description: Generate a video with audio from a text prompt using Google's Gemini Omni Flash model. Optionally provide reference images and/or videos to guide or edit the result. Describe the desired length (3-10s) and aspect ratio (16:9 or 9:16) directly in the prompt.

model.tooltip: The Gemini video model used to generate the video.

prompt.tooltip: Describe the video to generate, or the edit to apply to an attached video. Specify the length directly in the prompt, e.g. "a 6-second clip" or, for the 'extend' task, "extend by 5 seconds"; the generated length may be 3-15 seconds, and 'extend' adds at most 10 seconds.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Output aspect ratio: 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (portrait). The 'edit' and 'extend' tasks keep the aspect ratio of the input video instead.

task_type.tooltip: What to do with the prompt and the attached media. With 'auto' the model decides. 'text_to_video' generates from the prompt alone and rejects attached media. 'image_to_video' animates one image, or interpolates from a starting frame to an ending frame when two are attached. 'reference_to_video' treats the attached media as subject references. 'edit' rewrites exactly one attached video, and 'extend' appends new footage to it, so the output starts with the input video.

images.tooltip: Optional reference image(s) to guide or animate the video. Up to 14 images; with the 'image_to_video' task the first one is the starting frame and an optional second one is the ending frame.

videos.tooltip: Optional reference video(s) to guide or edit. Up to 3 videos, each up to 15 seconds long. The 'extend' task accepts up to 25 seconds, and its result can be at most 30 seconds.

seed.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

prompt.tooltip: Describe the video to generate, or the edit to apply to an attached video. Specify the length directly in the prompt, e.g. "a 6-second clip" or, for the 'extend' task, "extend by 5 seconds"; the generated length may be 3-10 seconds and defaults to 10. The output has audio.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Output aspect ratio: 16:9 (landscape) or 9:16 (portrait). The 'edit' and 'extend' tasks keep the aspect ratio of the input video instead.

'edit' rewrites exactly one attached video, and 'extend' appends new footage to it, so the output starts with the input video.

videos.tooltip: Optional reference video(s) to guide or edit. Up to 3 videos, each up to 10 seconds long.

seed.tooltip: Seed controls whether the node should re-run; results are non-deterministic regardless of seed.

start_y.tooltip: Normalized Y coordinate (0-1) for start position.

end_x.tooltip: Normalized X coordinate (0-1) for end position.

end_y.tooltip: Normalized Y coordinate (0-1) for end position.

track_spread.tooltip: Normalized distance between tracks. Tracks are spread perpendicular to the motion direction.

bezier.tooltip: Enable Bezier curve path using the mid point as control point.

mid_x.tooltip: Normalized X control point for Bezier curve. Only used when 'bezier' is enabled.

model_3d.tooltip: 3D model file from Load 3D or another 3D node. FBX/USDZ are not supported - convert to GLB first.

Get3DComponents.name: Get3DComponents
Get3DComponents.description: Parse a 3D model file (GLB, GLTF, OBJ, STL) into an editable MESH for the mesh-processing nodes (decimate, remesh, UV unwrap, bake, ...). All scene nodes/primitives are merged into one mesh with their transforms applied; textures and material factors come from the first material. Counterpart of MeshToFile3D.

latent.tooltip: The audio or audio/video latent to inspect.

output_tooltips: The audio latent length.
The number of audio channels. Latents without an audio channel dimension have one channel.

GetAudioLatentSize.name: GetAudioLatentSize
GetAudioLatentSize.description: Returns the length, audio channel count, and batch size of an audio latent.

batch_index.tooltip: Starting index. Negative wraps from the end (e.g. -1 = last extrinsic).

GrowMaskWithBlur.name: GrowMaskWithBlur
GrowMaskWithBlur.description:
# GrowMaskWithBlur
- mask: Input mask or mask batch
- expand: Expand or contract mask or mask batch by a given amount
- incremental_expandrate: increase expand rate by a given amount per frame
- tapered_corners: use tapered corners
- flip_input: flip input mask
- blur_radius: value higher than 0 will blur the mask
- lerp_alpha: alpha value for interpolation between frames
- decay_factor: decay value for interpolation between frames
- fill_holes: fill holes in the mask (slow)

parameter.tooltip:
Parameter group input (required, from the Minimax_H3_AutoContext_parameter node). The prompt plus segmentation/resolution/audio parameters all arrive through it; segmentation parameters in info take precedence over this group
参数组输入 (必选，来自 Minimax_H3_AutoContext_parameter 节点)。提示词与分段/分辨率/音频参数均由此传入；info 中的分段参数优先于本参数组

video_context_denoise.tooltip:
Denoise strength of the overlap head on cross-segment continuation (only effective for non-first segments). 0=exactly freeze the previous segment's tail (removes seam stalls/misalignment), 1=full repaint (old behavior), values in between=soft blend. When a second pass is wired to SplitSigmas, 1 is recommended to avoid artifacts
段间续接 overlap 头去噪强度 (仅非首段生效)。0=精确冻结上一段尾部 (消除接缝停顿/错位)，1=完全重绘 (旧行为)，中间值=软混合。二采接 SplitSigmas 时建议设 1 避免花屏

denoise.tooltip:
Denoise strength. 1.0=full resampling, lower values keep more of the original structure. With sigmas connected and denoise≠1, final_sigmas=sigmas*denoise
重绘强度。1.0=全量重采样，越小保留越多原结构。连接 sigmas 且 denoise≠1 时 final_sigmas=sigmas*denoise

enable_cache.tooltip:
Whether segment caching is enabled. When on, sampling results are saved to cache_dir and loaded directly on later runs with identical parameters.
Delete the cache files manually after changing the model/LoRA/acceleration node.
是否启用分段缓存。开启后，采样结果会保存到 cache_dir，后续运行时若参数一致则直接加载。
更换模型/LoRA/加速节点后请手动删除缓存文件。

clear_cache.tooltip:
Delete all cache files of this node. Use it to force regeneration after changing the model/LoRA/accelerator.
删除该节点的所有缓存文件。用于更换模型/LoRA/加速器后强制重新生成。

ignore_latent_hash.tooltip:
⚠️ Advanced option: disables fingerprint validation of the second-pass input latent.
Enable it only when a latent upscale node makes the hash unstable.

⚠️ 高级选项：禁用二采输入 Latent 指纹校验。
仅当latent放大节点导致哈希不稳定时启用。

sampler.tooltip:
External sampler object (SAMPLER, optional). Once connected it overrides the built-in sampler_name/scheduler; wired the same way as SamplerCustom
外部采样器对象 (SAMPLER, 可选)。接入后覆盖内置 sampler_name/scheduler，与 SamplerCustom 同款接法

sigmas.tooltip:
Custom sigma sequence (SIGMAS, highest priority, wired like SamplerCustomAdvanced). Once connected it takes over the sampling sigmas; when denoise≠1, final_sigmas=sigmas*denoise
自定义 sigma 序列 (SIGMAS, 优先级最高, 与 SamplerCustomAdvanced 接法一致)。接入后接管采样 sigma；denoise≠1 时 final_sigmas=sigmas*denoise

latent_input.tooltip:
Second-pass input latent (optional). Connect the latent output of a previous node or a latent upscale node to enable a second sampling pass; the spatial resolution follows that latent and width/height are ignored
二采输入 latent (可选)。接上一节点或 latent 放大节点输出的 latent 开启二次采样；空间分辨率以该 latent 为准，忽略 width/height

info.tooltip:
Parameter inheritance input (from the info output of a previous node of the same kind). Segmentation parameters present in info override the same names in parameter/this node, keeping segmentation consistent across chained nodes (second/multiple pass)
参数继承输入 (来自上一个同款节点的 info 输出)。info 中存在的分段参数覆盖 parameter/本节点同名值，保证多节点分段一致 (二采/多采串联)

first_frame.tooltip:
First-frame anchoring (FL2VA mode)
首帧锚定 (FL2VA 模式)

last_frame.tooltip:
Last-frame anchoring (FL2VA mode)
尾帧锚定 (FL2VA 模式)

ref_image.tooltip:
Reference image (referenced in the prompt as image1/image 1/图像1/图片1 or <Picture N>, 1-based)
参考图片 (提示词中用 image1/image 1/图像1/图片1 或 <Picture N> 引用, 1 基)

ref_video.tooltip:
Reference video frames (24fps, 2-15s)
参考视频帧 (24fps, 2-15s)

ref_video_audio.tooltip:
Paired audio track of the reference video with the same index
同编号参考视频的配对音轨

ref_audio.tooltip:
Standalone reference audio
独立参考音频

drive_audio.tooltip:
Audio drive source (Audio Drive). Connect the source audio to lock; with audio_drive enabled the output audio is this very track (lip movement/rhythm are driven by it). It may be the same audio as ref_audio_0
音频驱动源 (Audio Drive)。接要锁定的源音频，开启 audio_drive 后 输出音频=这条音频本身 (口型/节奏由它驱动)。可与 ref_audio_0 接同一条音频

H3AutoContextSampler.name: H3AutoContextSampler
H3AutoContextSampler.description:

MiniMax H3 长视频分段推理：自动分段、段间续接锚定、提示词时间轴切片

images.tooltip: Decoded FULL rendered frames from the accepted H3 clip.

analysis_window.tooltip: Inspect this many final frames first. If the whole window is already locked, analysis automatically expands backward.

freeze_hold.tooltip: Minimum trailing lock length. Stable-tail consensus must persist for at least this many ending frames.

safety_margin.tooltip: Pixel-frame safety before the detected lock. With safety_mode=fixed (recommended), this configured margin is always respected; adaptive preserves the older confidence-based behavior.

context_frames.tooltip: Minimum motion/audio history. phase_aligned_extended may extend backward beyond this value to restore canonical phase-0 alignment.

analysis_size.tooltip: Max edge used only for analysis. The rendered video is never resized or modified.

final_mean_diff_threshold.tooltip: PRIMARY lock test: maximum mean blurred RGB difference between a candidate frame and the median stable-tail reference. Lower = stricter/later lock.

final_active_pixel_threshold.tooltip: PRIMARY lock test: per-pixel RGB-difference level used to decide which image areas differ from the median stable-tail reference.

max_final_active_area_percent.tooltip: PRIMARY lock test: at most this percentage of the image may differ materially from the median stable-tail reference.

transition_mean_diff_threshold.tooltip: SECONDARY safety test: maximum mean luminance change between consecutive frames inside the detected final-frame lock.

transition_active_pixel_threshold.tooltip: SECONDARY safety test: per-pixel luminance change that counts as residual motion.

max_transition_active_area_percent.tooltip: SECONDARY safety test: maximum visibly changing area allowed for an individual transition.

min_static_transition_percent.tooltip: ROBUST secondary gate: minimum percentage of transitions inside the final-frame-matching suffix that must be near-static. Isolated shimmer/outliers are allowed.

max_consecutive_motion_outliers.tooltip: ROBUST secondary gate: maximum consecutive non-static transitions allowed inside an otherwise locked suffix. Prevents sustained real motion from being accepted.

final_reference_frames.tooltip: STABLE-TAIL reference: build the final-state image from the pixel-wise median of this many ending frames instead of trusting one possibly shimmering last frame.

min_final_match_percent.tooltip: ROBUST primary gate: minimum percentage of frames in the candidate locked suffix that must match the median final-state reference.

max_consecutive_final_outliers.tooltip: ROBUST primary gate: maximum consecutive final-state mismatches allowed inside the locked suffix. Candidate start itself must always match.

safety_mode.tooltip: fixed (recommended): always keep safety_margin frames before the detected lock. adaptive: legacy v0.4.1-v0.4.5 behavior that can reduce the effective margin at high confidence.

manual_landing_tail_frames.tooltip: Manual/fallback desired pixel tail. phase_aligned_extended/phase_aware snap the END only to an actual latent boundary; legacy_17 requires a multiple of 17. Never trims rendered video.

handover.tooltip: Auto-handover metadata from Load AV Latent.

H3ContinuousContinueV13.name: H3ContinuousContinueV13
H3ContinuousContinueV13.display_name: H3 Infinite - Continue from Latent v1.3
H3ContinuousContinueV13.description: v1.3 continuation with the proven v1.2 phase-aligned direct AV-latent handover, plus auto-growing Qwen References. The handover/stitching algorithm is unchanged.

previous_latent.tooltip: Loaded sampler output from the previous accepted clip.

duration.tooltip: Duration interpreted by Duration Mode. Net New Content (recommended) targets this much visible newly-generated body after the 39f video head is removed; Total Generation keeps the legacy whole-clip meaning. Net New Content therefore samples a longer total latent and takes correspondingly longer.

masked_context_frames.tooltip: Protected previous VIDEO context ending at the freeze-safe Auto Handover boundary. Exact joint H3 video boundaries are 39/90/141/192/... frames. 39 (~1.625s) is recommended.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Experimental/legacy control. Keep 0 for hard audio protection, especially for speech. Nonzero values let the final protected audio ticks be partially denoised and can weaken phoneme continuity.

duration_mode.tooltip: Recommended: Net New Content. Chooses the nearest legal H3 17k+5 total so the visible new video body stays close to Duration. Total Generation preserves the original whole-clip duration behavior.

audio_tail_carryover.tooltip: Recommended for dialogue: keep the freeze-safe 39f video handover, but protect original audio from the same context start through the previous clip's actual end. This lets valid word/phoneme endings survive even when the video must cut earlier. Match Video Handover reproduces the video-matched audio behavior.

handover.tooltip: Required safe-handover metadata for the previous clip. Connect Load AV Latent -> handover, or the previous clip's v1.4 Auto Handover directly. The protected video window ends BEFORE the unusable freeze/brightness tail.

images.tooltip:
Original video frames
原视频画面

canvas.tooltip:
Canvas from Minimax_H3_Face_Resample
来自 Face_Resample 的画布

bbox.tooltip:
face_pack from Minimax_H3_Face_Resample
来自 Face_Resample 的 face_pack

feather_px.tooltip:
Blend-back edge feather (pixels); box mode: rectangle edge, mask mode: erode+blur around SeC mask edge (scaled per-frame in v14)
贴回边缘羽化 (像素); 框模式羽化矩形边, mask 模式羽化 SeC mask 边 (v14 起随逐帧窗口等比缩放)

use_sec_mask.tooltip:
Blend back with feathered SeC mask (face only, background untouched). Source priority: masks port > face_pack > feathered box
用羽化的 SeC mask 贴回 (只贴人脸)。来源优先级: masks端口 > face_pack > 羽化框回退

lowfreq_lock.tooltip:
Pyramid low-freq lock: keep structure/color/geometry from the ORIGINAL frames, take only texture detail from the canvas. For DETAIL-sharpening workflows at LOW sigma (suppresses jitter). Keep OFF for structural repair of corrupted faces — at high sigma the canvas redraws correct geometry and this lock would keep the broken original geometry
金字塔低频锁定: 结构/色彩/几何取原帧, 仅纹理细节取画布。适用于低 σ 细节锐化 (抑制抖动)。修'崩坏脸'请保持关闭 — 高 σ 下画布重绘了正确的五官几何, 锁定反而会保住原帧的错误几何

motion_align.tooltip:
Local position correction at paste-back: per-frame NCC estimates how far the resampled canvas face drifted from the ORIGINAL frame's face and cancels it — the pasted face is glued to the original face position, its motion fully inherited from the source video. Kills paste-back jitter (esp. block boundaries at high sigma). Peak-gated + temporally median-smoothed; frames where the estimate is unreliable are interpolated. Soft-fails to plain paste
贴回局部位置修正: 逐帧 NCC 估计重采样画布脸相对原帧脸的位置漂移并抵消 — 贴回的脸被粘到原帧面部的真实位置, 运动完全继承原视频。消除贴回后抖动 (尤其高 σ 块边界)。峰值门控 + 时间中值平滑, 不可靠帧由邻帧插值, 失败自动回退普通贴回

masks.tooltip:
SeC masks from Minimax_H3_Face_Cut (rows 1:1 with crop_images/canvas rows, 1=face). Connect directly from Cut, bypassing Resample
来自 Face_Cut 的 SeC mask (行与裁剪/画布 1:1 对齐, 1=人脸)。从 Cut 直连, 不经过 Resample

H3FaceBlend.name: H3FaceBlend
H3FaceBlend.description:
Face fix step 3: per-subtrack scale + pixel blend-back (no VAE). v15: low-frequency lock paste-back — structure/color come from the original frames (no jitter at higher sigmas), texture/detail from canvas.
修脸第 3 步: 逐子轨缩放 + 像素贴回 (无VAE)。v15: 金字塔低频锁定贴回 — 结构/色彩锁定原帧 (高 sigma 也不抖), 纹理细节取自画布。

pre_blur.tooltip:
Gaussian blur (sigma, source-window px) applied to each crop BEFORE SR/bicubic upscale; 0 = off. Softens source noise & interpolation jaggies
放大/SR 前对裁剪窗口施加高斯模糊 (σ, 源窗口像素); 0 = 关闭

similarity_weight.tooltip: Used only by balanced_edit when source_image is connected. Higher values favor source similarity; lower values favor sharpness, exposure, contrast and temporal stability.

top_k.tooltip: Maximum number of highest-scoring frames returned by candidate_batch_debug for automatic strategies. emit_candidate_batch.tooltip: OFF: selected_image contains only the picked still. ON: selected_image contains the entire decoded 1-, 5-, 9-, 13-, or 20-frame batch, so an already-connected Preview Image or Save Image node shows or saves every generated image. candidate_batch_debug remains the ranked top-k subset. Enabling this intentionally retains more RAM/VRAM.
