clip_mode.tooltip:
How the prompt maps onto video segments: Clip_Tag splits by custom tags; timeline splits by time markers; sequential tiles by sentence order; global uses the whole prompt for every segment. In Clip_Tag and timeline modes total_frames and chunk_frames are ignored and segment length is decided by the prompt.
提示词映射到视频段的方式：Clip_Tag按自定义标签分段；timeline按时间标记分段；sequential按句读顺序平铺；global整段用于所有段。Clip_Tag和timeline模式下，total_frames和chunk_frames无效，段长由提示词决定。

clip_tag.tooltip:
Split-tag template for Clip_Tag mode (only used in Clip_Tag mode). It must end with a numeric index, e.g. '段1' (prefix '段' + 1 digit), 'A01' (prefix 'A' + 2 digits), '[片段001]' (prefix '[片段' + 3 digits + suffix ']'). A tag only splits segments when it occupies a line of its own; a line break after the tag is recommended, without one the separators (:：，,。；; —–- space) are skipped to take the segment content. The tags themselves are removed at inference time. Times written inside the prompt stay in seconds
Clip_Tag 模式的分割标签模板 (仅 Clip_Tag 模式生效)。必须以数字序号结尾，如 '段1' (前缀'段'+1位数字)、'A01' (前缀'A'+2位数字)、'[片段001]' (前缀'[片段'+3位数字+后缀']')。提示词中标签独占一行才作为分割点，标签后推荐换行，不换行时跳过分隔符 (:：，,。；; —–- 空格) 取段内容。推理时标签本身会被去除。提示词内时间写法保持秒不变

prompt_format.tooltip:
Prompt output format. official: [Shot N] At MM:SS.mmm + <Picture N>/<Video N>/<Audio N> tags + official field names (MiniMax H3 official training format, recommended); legacy: 【0-3秒】+ references kept in their original 1-based style + block headings (old format); raw: references are left completely untouched, output as-is after tag removal with no time-marker conversion (Clip_Tag mode only, segment-relative times kept as-is)
提示词输出格式。official: [Shot N] At MM:SS.mmm + <Picture N>/<Video N>/<Audio N> 标签 + 官方字段名 (MiniMax H3 官方训练格式，推荐); legacy: 【0-3秒】+ 引用保持原写法(1基) + 块标题 (旧格式); raw: 完全不处理引用，去标签后原样输出，不做任何时间标记转换 (Clip_Tag 模式专用，保留段内相对时间原样)

crop_mode.tooltip:
Resize/crop mode for reference images, first/last frames and reference videos. center: scale proportionally and center-crop to the target size; stretch: stretch straight to the target size; none: keep the original resolution with 32-alignment only (advanced option for ref2va scenarios, you handle any size issues yourself)
参考图/首尾帧/参考视频的缩放裁剪模式。center: 等比例缩放并中心裁剪到目标尺寸; stretch: 直接拉伸到目标尺寸; none: 保持原始分辨率，仅做 32 对齐 (高级用户选项，ref2va 场景使用，尺寸问题用户自行处理)

ref_sync_mode.tooltip:
Whether reference video/audio is sliced to each generated segment's time range. global: every segment uses the full reference video/audio (default); segmented: each segment only takes the matching time slice of the reference video/audio, for character replacement with lip sync and similar cases
参考视频/音频是否按生成段的时间范围切片。global: 每段使用完整参考视频/音频 (默认); segmented: 每段只取参考视频/音频中对应时间片段，用于替换人物并保持口型同步等场景

total_frames.tooltip:
Total frames to generate; must satisfy 17n+5 (5,22,39,56,73,90,...). Times inside the prompt are still parsed in seconds.In Clip_Tag and timeline modes this value is ignored and computed from the prompt content.
生成总帧数，需满足 17n+5 (5,22,39,56,73,90,...)。提示词内时间仍按秒解析。在 Clip_Tag 和 timeline 模式下，该值被忽略，由提示词内容自动计算。

fps.tooltip:
Frame rate, used only for audio sync and for converting seconds inside the prompt. Face_Resample standalone mode also uses it for audio slicing (lip sync) — must match the footage
帧率，仅用于音频同步和提示词内秒数换算。Face_Resample 独立模式同样用它做音频切片 (口型) — 必须与素材一致

chunk_frames.tooltip:
Frames generated per segment; must satisfy 17n+5 (5,22,39,...). Set it to >= total_frames to generate the whole video as one segment.In Clip_Tag and timeline modes this value is ignored and computed from the prompt content.
每段生成帧数，需满足 17n+5 (5,22,39,...)。设为 ≥ total_frames 时不拆分，整个视频作为一段生成。在 Clip_Tag 和 timeline 模式下，该值被忽略，由提示词内容自动计算。

context_frames.tooltip:
Tail frames of the previous segment reused for cross-segment continuation. Higher values give stronger continuity; 22 or more is recommended to prevent hard cuts. Valid grid points: 5,22,39,56,73,90,107,124
段间续接用的上一段尾部帧数。值越大连续性越强。建议 22 以上防硬切。有效网格点: 5,22,39,56,73,90,107,124

lock_audio.tooltip:
Lock the audio region on the second pass / face resample (noise_mask audio=0): only the video is resampled and the audio stays unchanged.
二采/修脸时锁定音频区 (noise_mask audio=0)：只重新采样视频、音频保持不变。

audio_drive.tooltip:
Audio-drive switch. When checked, the audio region is locked (noise_mask=0) and the video is generated to follow it.
音频驱动开关。勾选后音频区锁定 (noise_mask=0)，视频照音频生成。

video_guide.tooltip:
Strongly anchors multiple frames using the video fed into the ref_video ports. Only consumed by the main sampler node (Face_Resample has no head/tail anchoring path and ignores it)
利用 ref_video 端口输入的视频进行多帧强锚定。仅主采样节点消费 (Face_Resample 无头尾锚定路径, 会忽略该键)。

semantic_bridge.tooltip:
Semantic Bridge (upstream: github.com/Speach1sdef178/MiniMax-H3-Semantic-Bridge). C = H + alpha*(S-H). Distills SenseNova U1.5 teacher into a ~11MB SiLU MLP (5120→512→512→5120) that boosts prompt adherence on the FL2VA/text path. Only transforms the cond tensor; cross-segment keyframe anchors and ref channels are untouched. Put MiniMaxH3_SemanticBridge_v1.safetensors into models/semantic_bridge/.
语义桥 (上游: Speach1sdef178/MiniMax-H3-Semantic-Bridge)。C = H + alpha*(S-H)。把 SenseNova U1.5 教师蒸馏为 ~11MB SiLU MLP (5120→512→512→5120)，增强 FL2VA/文本路径的提示词遵循度。只变换条件张量，段间续接锚定与参考素材通道不受影响。适配器放入 models/semantic_bridge/。

semantic_bridge_adapter.tooltip:
Adapter file. 'none' disables the bridge.
适配器文件，'none' 表示禁用。

semantic_bridge_alpha.tooltip:
Blend strength. Official starting point 0.10; official A/B examples use 0.15. Tune in 0.10~0.15.
融合强度。官方起点 0.10，A/B 示例 0.15。建议在 0.10~0.15 之间微调。

semantic_bridge_magnitude.tooltip:
Magnitude alignment before blending. Official recommended: per_token.
融合前的幅度对齐方式。官方推荐 per_token。

shot_info.tooltip:
Optional shot map from Minimax_H3_Face_Cut's shot_info output. When connected, the segment prompts are assigned to these shot intervals: prompt count > shots → take the first N; < shots → repeat the last; the shot interval replaces the time marks inside each prompt
可选: Minimax_H3_Face_Cut 的 shot_info 输出。接入后分段提示词按镜头区间分配: 提示词数多于镜头数取前 N 条, 少于则重复最后一条; 镜头时间段代替每条提示词内的时间标注

H3Parameter.name: H3Parameter
H3Parameter.description:
H3 parameter group: centralizes segmentation/resolution/audio parameters, outputs parameter for the main node, and previews the expected segments. When shot_info (from Minimax_H3_Face_Cut) is connected, segment prompts are assigned to the detected shots: prompt count > shots → take the first N; < shots → repeat the last; the shot time interval replaces the time marks inside each prompt (parameter.shot_prompts, consumed by Face_Resample in BOTH wiring modes)
H3 参数组：集中管理分段/分辨率/音频等参数，输出 parameter 供主节点使用，并预览预计分段。接入 shot_info (来自 Minimax_H3_Face_Cut) 后，分段提示词按检测到的镜头分配：提示词数多于镜头数取前 N 条，少于则重复最后一条；镜头时间段代替每条提示词内的时间标注 (parameter.shot_prompts，Face_Resample 在两种接线模式下都消费)

prompt.tooltip: The plain text serialized and returned by this node.

references.tooltip: Optional authoring-only link from H3 Reference Inputs. It supplies the token palette and previews without evaluating reference media when only text is queued.

output_tooltips: The prompt as an ordinary ComfyUI STRING. Connecting this directly to TextEncodeH3Edit.prompt activates the IDE's task-aware Edit instruction category.
H3PromptIDE.name: H3PromptIDE
H3PromptIDE.description: Standalone rich prompt editor with strict H3 mode schemas, contextual completion, reference tokens, automatic MiniMax H3 Edit instruction context, and an ordinary STRING output. Reference media stays on the separate H3 Reference Inputs node.

pictures.tooltip: Up to nine prompt reference pictures, numbered in their H3 presentation order.

picture.tooltip: Reference picture for the matching MiniMax H3 token. The next socket appears automatically when connected.

videos.tooltip: Up to three reference video frame batches, numbered <Video 1> through <Video 3>.

video.tooltip: Reference video frames for the matching MiniMax H3 token. Use the same IMAGE frame batch sent to the native H3 ref_videos input.

audios.tooltip: Up to six emitted H3 audio labels: video soundtracks first, then standalone audio.

audio.tooltip: Reference audio for the matching MiniMax H3 token. Audio labels follow native presentation order: connected video soundtracks first, then standalone audio.

output_tooltips: Authoring references for H3 Prompt IDE.
H3PromptReferenceInputs.name: H3PromptReferenceInputs
H3PromptReferenceInputs.description: Authoring references for H3 Prompt IDE. Picture, video-frame, and audio sockets auto-grow with native MiniMax H3 labels. Connect the references output to the editor.

clip.tooltip: MiniMax H3 Qwen text/vision encoder.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE, or the experimental H3 image VAE for the one-frame profile.

source_image.tooltip: Primary REF2VA reference, addressed as <Picture 1> in the prompt.

edit_instruction.tooltip: Describe the final image and refer to inputs explicitly as <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, and so on.

width.tooltip: Generation canvas width; references retain their own aspect ratio before encoding.

height.tooltip: Generation canvas height; references retain their own aspect ratio before encoding.

quality_profile.tooltip: Start with 5 frames and the standard H3 video VAE. One frame with the experimental image VAE is faster but may reduce image quality and edit adherence.

source_fidelity.tooltip: Controls preservation wording for unmentioned Picture 1 traits. Explicit target instructions always take priority. This is NOT diffusion denoise strength and does not alter the sigma schedule.

source_fit.tooltip: How the primary source preview is fitted to the generation canvas.

reference_detail.tooltip: How much source resolution each REF2VA reference keeps before VAE encoding. max_identity_2048 may preserve more identity detail at higher memory cost.

optimize_for_still.tooltip: Adds a locked-camera still-image prompt wrapper and reference-preservation language. Sampling settings are unchanged.

reference_image_2.tooltip: Optional <Picture 2> reference. Different dimensions are supported.

reference_transport.tooltip: Native uses vision and VAE references. Semantic uses vision only: fewer reference tokens, but weaker identity and fine-detail preservation.

H3ReferenceEditPrepare.name: H3ReferenceEditPrepare
H3ReferenceEditPrepare.description: Prepares REF2VA editing with up to nine ordered references. Source Fidelity changes prompt text, not denoise.
output_tooltips: Positive REF2VA reference-edit conditioning for the sampler's positive input.
Packed H3 audio/video latent prepared for reference-guided regeneration.
Primary source fitted to the output canvas for preview and comparison.
Number of image frames that Exact Frame Decode should preserve and decode.
Final ordered-reference prompt after optional preservation optimization.
Reference count, temporal packet, checkpoint expectations and recommended selection strategy.

model.tooltip: Loaded MiniMax H3 diffusion model.

sampler_name.tooltip: ComfyUI sampler implementation. res_multistep is the H3 baseline.

scheduler.tooltip: Sigma schedule. beta_custom exposes alpha/beta below and now honors denoise identically to other schedulers.

steps.tooltip: Number of sampling steps actually executed.

denoise.tooltip: ComfyUI-style denoise strength. Below 1 builds a longer schedule and keeps only its final steps; 0 returns empty sigmas. This affects both beta_custom and standard schedulers.

shift_video.tooltip: Flow sigma shift for H3 video/image latent sampling.

shift_audio.tooltip: H3 audio sigma shift metadata. Image Studio does not decode the audio VAE.

beta_alpha.tooltip: Alpha parameter used only when scheduler is beta_custom.

beta_beta.tooltip: Beta parameter used only when scheduler is beta_custom.

H3SamplingSettings.name: H3SamplingSettings
H3SamplingSettings.description: Configures the sampler, scheduler, denoise value, and H3 video/audio sigma shifts.
output_tooltips: Cloned model patched with H3 video/audio flow-sampling shifts.
Configured ComfyUI sampler object for SamplerCustomAdvanced.
Sigma schedule after applying steps, scheduler and denoise semantics.
Resolved sampler, scheduler, step count, shifts and AV sampling backend.

images.tooltip:
Decoded full video frames (connect VAE Decode output)
解码后的完整视频帧 (接 VAE Decode 输出)

fix_color_preset.tooltip:
Color/exposure correction preset.
色彩/曝光处理档位。

fix_motion_preset.tooltip:
Seam continuity handling. Optical-flow alignment + local blending to repair motion/structure discontinuities.
接缝连续性处理。基于光流对齐+局部融合，修补运动/结构不连续。

fix_flash.tooltip:
Flash-frame handling. If the footage has intentional fast brightness changes such as lightning or explosions, suppression will flatten them.
闪帧处理，若画面有闪电、爆炸等合理快速明暗变化，抑制会削平这些效果。

flash_threshold.tooltip:
Transient-fix filter threshold, smaller is more aggressive, recommended 0.20~0.40.
瞬态修正筛选阈值,值越小越激进,推荐 0.20~0.40。

cut_threshold.tooltip:
Shot-detection sensitivity, smaller is more sensitive, recommended 10~20
镜头检测敏感度，值越小越敏感，推荐 10~20

blend_frames.tooltip:
Seam level-ramp window (frames). Larger values transition more smoothly, but too large on high-motion shots causes slight blurring.
接缝处电平渐变窗口 (帧)。值越大过渡越缓、但运动大的镜头过大会带来轻微糊感。

use_gpu.tooltip:
Run statistics, color transforms and optical flow on CUDA GPU
使用 CUDA GPU 进行统计、色彩变换与光流

H3SeamCorrection.name: H3SeamCorrection
H3SeamCorrection.description:
Minimax H3 inter-segment seam correction: segment-level global exposure/color alignment (MKL) + seam-local optical-flow warp/blend
Minimax H3 段间接缝修正：分段全局曝光/色彩对齐 (MKL) + 接缝局部光流 warp/blend

models.tooltip: Connect H3 Models or the last optional H3 LoRA. Multiple references are supported with or without LoRAs.

image.tooltip: Source image, <Picture 1>. Only the first item of a connected batch is used.

instruction.tooltip: Describe the change. With multiple references explicitly assign roles to <Picture 1>, <Picture 2>, etc. There is no hidden fidelity prompt or denoise slider.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Choose the canvas shape. Source image keeps Picture 1's ratio; custom pixels uses the advanced width/height controls.

megapixels.tooltip: Target image size, rounded to a 32-pixel grid. Start at 3 MP; 1 MP is a preview, 4–8 MP costs more. Ignored in custom pixels mode.

width.tooltip: Exact pixel width, only when aspect_ratio is custom pixels.

height.tooltip: Exact pixel height, only when aspect_ratio is custom pixels.

references.tooltip: Optional additional reference pictures. Add only what you need; eight extra pictures maximum.

reference.tooltip: One additional picture per socket, in displayed order. Use <Picture N> in the instruction.

output_tooltips: Editable reference conditioning and one-frame latent. Connect to Render Image.
H3StudioEdit.name: H3StudioEdit
H3StudioEdit.description: Image-to-image and reference editing in one node. Picture 1 is the source; additional picture sockets appear as needed, up to nine total. Output is a newly sampled still, never a locked source frame.

models.tooltip: Connect H3 Models directly, or the last optional H3 LoRA.

prompt.tooltip: Describe the final image. Your prompt is used directly without hidden preservation wording.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Choose the canvas shape. Source image keeps Picture 1's ratio; custom pixels uses the advanced width/height controls.

megapixels.tooltip: Target image size, rounded to a 32-pixel grid. Start at 3 MP; 1 MP is a preview, 4–8 MP costs more. Ignored in custom pixels mode.

width.tooltip: Exact pixel width, only when aspect_ratio is custom pixels.

height.tooltip: Exact pixel height, only when aspect_ratio is custom pixels.

output_tooltips: Prepared still and cached prompt conditioning. Connect to Render Image.
H3StudioGenerate.name: H3StudioGenerate
H3StudioGenerate.description: Describe one image and choose its size. Prepares exactly one H3 latent frame; no frame count or selection is needed.

models.tooltip: Connect H3 Models or the previous H3 LoRA. The original model bundle is not modified.

lora_name.tooltip: Choose a compatible MiniMax H3 LoRA from models/loras. None loads nothing. LoRAs for unrelated models are not compatible.

strength_model.tooltip: Manual adapter strength. Zero is a no-op. Larry v4's community still recipe uses 0.38 with 20 steps; other adapters need their own recipe.

output_tooltips: Connect another H3 LoRA, Text to Image or Image Edit. Bypass unused nodes.
H3StudioLoRA.name: H3StudioLoRA
H3StudioLoRA.description: Apply one compatible H3 model LoRA. Chain or duplicate nodes for multiple adapters. Native bypass passes the models through unchanged; no reference/edit features are removed.

diffusion_model.tooltip: Official FL2VA is the single starting model for both workflows, following Fizgig. REF2VA can also be selected for edit comparisons.

text_encoder.tooltip: MiniMax H3 Qwen text/vision encoder; shared by both workflows.

video_vae.tooltip: Official H3 video VAE, INT8 ConvRot or FP16. The still decoder is included.

turbo_lora.tooltip: Compatibility shortcut for Larry v4 at 0.38. Prefer chained H3 LoRA nodes for manual strengths/multiple adapters. Leave None when applying Larry through a LoRA node; do not load it twice.

output_tooltips: Shared H3 models. Connect to Text to Image or Image Edit.
H3StudioModels.name: H3StudioModels
H3StudioModels.description: Load one shared H3 model, Qwen encoder and VIDEO VAE for generation and editing. No image VAE, hybrid model, audio VAE or refiner is required.

image_job.tooltip: Connect Text to Image or Image Edit.

steps.tooltip: Always manual. Start at 50 without a LoRA, or 20 with the optional Larry v4 adapter at 0.38 (Fizgig's still recipe). Fewer steps trade quality for speed.

seed.tooltip: Seed for repeatable sampling. Changing only seed or steps reuses cached prompt/reference encoding.

sampler_name.tooltip: ER-SDE is the Fizgig still starting recipe. Change only for controlled comparisons.

scheduler.tooltip: Simple is the starting schedule. Uses the loaded H3 model's native flow shifts.

output_tooltips: Exactly one image. Connect directly to Save Image or Preview Image.
Actual canvas, steps, seed, sampler, reference count and sampling/decode seconds; excludes model loading and cached preparation.
H3StudioRender.name: H3StudioRender
H3StudioRender.description: Sample one H3 latent frame and decode one image using Fizgig's temporal-group technique. Prompt/reference preparation stays cached when only seed or steps changes. No video packet is sampled.

model.tooltip:
Input model (MiniMax H3); connect the patched model output to the sampler node
输入模型 (MiniMax H3)，输出补丁后的模型接到采样节点

tau.tooltip:
Correction strength. 0=pass through without patching (usable as an A/B baseline). Typical range 0.1~0.3, try 0.3 when small faces break down badly. Actual correction = tau * layer weight(stronger in deep layers) * step weight(stronger early)
校正强度。0=透传不挂载 (可作 A/B 基线)。常用范围 0.1~0.3，小脸崩坏明显时可试 0.3。实际校正量 = tau * 层权重(深层更强) * 步权重(早期更强)

H3TSTPatch.name: H3TSTPatch
H3TSTPatch.description:
H3 temporal state transfer (TST) attention correction: spectral tension diagnoses the frame-level transfer operator state and adaptively scales the video-row query. Chain it with the segment inference node; it affects every attention call of all segments after this node. Natively compatible with the official ModelAttentionBackend; chains with other attention patch nodes (this node must sit downstream of them)
H3 时间状态传输 (TST) 注意力校正：谱张力诊断帧级传输算子状态，自适应缩放视频行 query。与分段推理节点串联使用，对本节点之后所有段的所有 attention 调用生效。与官方 ModelAttentionBackend 天然兼容；与其它 attention patch 节点链式共存 (本节点需放在其下游)

clip.tooltip: MiniMax H3 Qwen text/vision encoder.

prompt.tooltip: Describe the final still image, including subject, composition, lighting and style.

width.tooltip: Output canvas width. Connect an H3 Image Resolution node for safer presets.

height.tooltip: Output canvas height. Connect an H3 Image Resolution node for safer presets.

quality_profile.tooltip: 5 frames is the normal FL2VA profile. The one-frame profile needs the experimental H3 image VAE; 20 frames adds temporal context at much higher cost.

optimize_for_still.tooltip: Adds a locked-camera still-image prompt wrapper. It does not change frames, resolution, steps, sampler, or model weights.

H3TextToImagePrepare.name: H3TextToImagePrepare
H3TextToImagePrepare.display_name: MiniMax H3 Image • Text to Image
H3TextToImagePrepare.description: Prepares FL2VA text conditioning and an H3 latent. One-frame output supports the experimental H3 image VAE.
output_tooltips: Positive FL2VA text-to-image conditioning for the sampler's positive input.
Packed H3 audio/video latent containing the requested temporal image packet.
Number of image frames that Exact Frame Decode should preserve and decode.
Final still-image prompt after optional optimization.
Temporal packet, canvas, checkpoint expectations and recommended output strategy.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent whose exact video/audio shape is reused.

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 model. The precision compatibility probe/patch is applied lazily only when this node executes.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

source_frames.tooltip: Full source video. It is converted deterministically to H3's 24 fps and encoded over the entire target latent.

source_audio.tooltip: Source audio matching source_frames. audio_strength=0 preserves it.

global_strength.tooltip: Native H3 video denoise-mask strength. Keep BasicScheduler denoise at 1.0.

audio_strength.tooltip: 0 preserves source audio; 1 fully denoises/regenerates audio.

source_mask.tooltip: Spatial V2V mask for mode=spatial. 1 uses inside_strength; 0 uses outside_strength.

H3V2VGranularFractionalDenoise.name: H3V2VGranularFractionalDenoise
H3V2VGranularFractionalDenoise.description: Full-source MiniMax H3 V2V latent with granular fractional video/audio denoise masks. Mask values can express continuous preserve-to-generate strength instead of only binary masking. V2V strength lives in the H3 mask; BasicScheduler denoise must remain 1.0. Near-1 mask precision compatibility is installed lazily and self-retires when ComfyUI provides it natively.

latent.tooltip: Any LATENT: image, video, or H3 AV nested latent

mask.tooltip: Regular MASK: white=change, black=lock. If not connected, full lock.

H3VideoLock.name: H3VideoLock
H3VideoLock.description: Auto-detect LATENT type. No mask = full lock (0.0). With MASK: white=change, black=lock. Works for IMAGE [B,C,H,W], VIDEO [B,C,T,H,W] and H3 AV nested latent.

section.tooltip: Visual section label for this workflow note.

text.tooltip: Plain-text workflow instructions. This text is never sent to MiniMax H3.

H3WorkflowNote.name: H3WorkflowNote
H3WorkflowNote.description: Displays text without affecting generation. Kept for compatibility with v15 workflows.

model.tooltip: The model to patch with HAP.

scope_plan_path.tooltip: Path to the scope-plan JSON (per-layer, per-head alpha/beta). Relative paths resolve against the ComfyUI-DyPE folder. Default ships the reference FLUX plan (57 layers x 24 heads). Generate a plan for your model/resolution with the 'HAP Calibrate' node or calibration/calibrate_hap.py. Ignored when a scope_plan is linked.

model_type.tooltip: Specify the model architecture. 'auto' usually works.

enable_hap.tooltip: Enable or disable HAP. When disabled, the model is returned unchanged.

scope_plan.tooltip: Calibrated scope plan linked from the 'HAP Calibrate' node. When connected, it OVERRIDES scope_plan_path — no file needed.

anchor_stride.tooltip: Global anchor blocks: every N-th image block is visible to all queries (keeps global coherence under pruning). 32 = HRDiT default. 0 = off.

text_len.tooltip: Number of leading text tokens (always fully attended). 512 = FLUX convention. When SPA is also active, the boundary is derived from the position ids and this is only a fallback.

proportional_attention.tooltip: HRDiT proportional attention scaling: scales the attention logits by sqrt(ln(seq_len)/ln(train_seq_len)) to compensate entropy dilution on long sequences. Exact no-op at/below the trained extent (1024px). Off by default (bit-identical to previous behaviour). Either the SPA or the HAP node may enable it.

output_tooltips: The model patched with HAP.
HAP.name: HAP
HAP.description: Head-Adaptive attention Pruning (HRDiT). Block-sparse attention from a calibrated scope plan — restores speed at high resolution. Combine with SPA for full HRDiT.

model.tooltip: The model to calibrate. Must be the SAME model + resolution you will run HAP on. Do NOT connect a HAP-patched model (calibrate unpruned).

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning (from a CLIP Text Encode node). Keep it representative of your typical prompts. The same conditioning is used for every calibration prompt; each prompt index varies the noise seed.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning (from a CLIP Text Encode node).

width.tooltip: Calibration resolution width. Calibrate at <= 2K (memory); reuse the plan at higher resolutions.

height.tooltip: Calibration resolution height. Calibrate at <= 2K (memory); reuse the plan at higher resolutions.

num_prompts.tooltip: Number of calibration prompts to actually run (first N of the list). Paper: 30. More prompts = better averaging but longer calibration.

num_scopes.tooltip: Candidate scopes N_scope. Paper: 50. More scopes = finer granularity but slower solver.

budget_ratio.tooltip: Attention cost ratio r_c (fraction of full attention compute retained). Paper: 0.1. Lower = faster but more pruning.

chunk.tooltip: Query rows per calibration chunk (memory knob; result-invariant). Lower = less VRAM but slower.

text_len.tooltip: Number of leading text tokens (never pruned). 512 = FLUX convention.

anchor_stride.tooltip: Global anchor blocks in the cost model. 32 = HRDiT default. 0 = off.

calib_sigma.tooltip: Denoising sigma at which the single calibration step runs. 1.0 = first step (max noise). Lower values probe mid-trajectory behaviour.

seed.tooltip: Noise seed base (prompt i uses seed + i).

loss_type.tooltip: Calibration loss. 'output_norm' = MSE of the denoised prediction vs zero (no external data needed). 'reference_mse' = MSE vs a reference latent (connect the reference_latent input).

run.tooltip: Master switch. False = return empty plan without running (for safe graph wiring).

prompts.tooltip: Calibration prompts, one per line. Empty = built-in default list (5 prompts). Paper uses 30.

prompts_file.tooltip: Optional text file with one prompt per line (overrides the 'prompts' input). Relative paths resolve against the ComfyUI-DyPE folder.

reference_latent.tooltip: Target latent for 'reference_mse' loss (e.g. an encoded real image). Only needed when loss_type='reference_mse'.

HDRPreviewKJ.name: HDRPreviewKJ
HDRPreviewKJ.description:
Realtime-exposure preview for HDR-compressed images.

Input: LogC3-compressed [0,1] image/video batch (e.g. the VAE-decoded output of an HDR IC-LoRA workflow, prior to HDR decompression).

Decompression + exposure + saturation + Reinhard tonemap + sRGB runs in a WebGL fragment shader in the browser for realtime slider feedback, and the same math runs server-side to produce the baked sRGB IMAGE output. Slider changes update the preview immediately; the IMAGE output only updates when the workflow is re-queued.

latent_image.tooltip: Base latent at the model's native resolution (e.g. from EmptySD3LatentImage). The cascade noises it to the first sigma itself — an empty latent + noise_seed reproduces the reference pipeline's from-noise start.

noise_seed.tooltip: Seed for the base-stage noise and each stage's initialization noise (one shared generator).

denoise.tooltip: Img2img strength for a CONTENT latent (KSampler convention): 1.0 regenerates from pure noise; lower keeps more of the input image (0.6 enters at ~37% content). Ignored for an empty latent — that always runs the full schedule.

cfg.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance for the BASE stage (FLUX-dev default 3.5). Guidance-free models (Z-Image, Chroma) or empty negatives: leave at 1.0 — CFG is auto-skipped when the negative carries no tokens.

steps.tooltip: Base-stage sampling steps (paper: 30). The per-step clean predictions form the reference trajectory.

guidance.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance for the guided upscale stages (paper uses 4.5-6). Same auto-skip rule as cfg.

steps_per_stage.tooltip: Guided-stage sampling steps per cascade stage (upper bound; repo default 16/10).

tau.tooltip: Stage-entry noise level (paper cascade: 0.6, 0.3, 0.3). Lower = stronger content preservation.

filter_ratio.tooltip: Normalized Butterworth low-pass cutoff D (direction alignment). Paper 0.4, repo default 0.2.

upsampling.tooltip: Per-step reference upsample: latent bicubic (repo default) or pixel decode->sharpen->encode. The stage-initialization anchor is always the pixel round-trip of the previous final image.

sharpen.tooltip: Unsharp strength applied to the pixel round-tripped stage anchor (reference default 1.0). Set 0 to disable — recommended for turbo/low-step models that show jagged, over-sharpened tone boundaries.

scale_factor.tooltip: Output scale relative to the input latent: 2 = double resolution per side, 1 = unchanged, 0.5 = half. Upscales run 2x doubling stages (so scales between 1 and 2 give one 2x stage); scales below 1 run a single refinement stage at the smaller size.

model.tooltip: The FLUX-family flow model.

vae.tooltip: VAE — used for the latent/pixel geometry (downscale ratio); the guidance latent itself is built in latent space.

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning.

latent_image.tooltip: Latent at the TARGET resolution (e.g. EmptySD3LatentImage at the desired output size). An empty latent is pure txt2img; a content latent + denoise < 1 is img2img.

noise_seed.tooltip: One shared generator: pass A's start noise, then pass B's img2img noise — same seed, same result (modulo the VAE encode sampling).

denoise.tooltip: Img2img strength for PASS B only (KSampler convention); pass A always starts from pure noise. Ignored for an empty latent — that always runs the full schedule.

cfg.tooltip: Classifier-free guidance for BOTH passes. FLUX-dev: leave at 1.0 — the guidance embeds below do the work. CFG is auto-skipped when the negative carries no tokens.

guidance_low.tooltip: FLUX guidance embed written into a copy of the conditioning for pass A (paper/gradio 3.5). 0.0 keeps whatever a chained FluxGuidance set.

guidance_high.tooltip: FLUX guidance embed for pass B (gradio 5.0). 0.0 keeps whatever a chained FluxGuidance set.

time_shift_low.tooltip: Static flow shift of pass A's sigma schedule (paper: 3.0) — I-Max owns both schedules, no model_sampling patch is involved.

time_shift_high.tooltip: Static flow shift of pass B's schedule (paper: 6.0) — the SNR re-balance between the passes.

ntk_factor.tooltip: NTK-aware RoPE base multiplier for the high-resolution pass (paper: 10 for Flux.1-dev). 1.0 = plain RoPE.

dwt_level.tooltip: Haar low-pass level of the guidance projection (paper: 1). Higher = coarser guidance detail.

guidance_schedule.tooltip: Projected-Flow guidance schedule (paper §2.2): cosine_decay is the README/gradio default; disable runs pass B as plain Euler.

guidance_strength.tooltip: Linear scale on the Projected-Flow correction (1.0 = the paper's unscaled pull; 0 = disable). Distilled checkpoints (Z-Image Turbo) hallucinate swirls/noise at extrapolated targets at full strength — use 0.25-0.5 there.

proportional_attention.tooltip: Scale the attention temperature with the joint sequence length (paper §2.3). Clamped to a no-op at/below the native 1024 px.

text_duplication.tooltip: Duplicate the text tokens per native 1024 px tile so the image/text token ratio stays in distribution (paper §2.3). No-op at/below 1024 px.

low_res_scale.tooltip: Scales the LOW-RES pass AREA (1.0 = the paper's native-area guidance; 0.5 halves it).

IMax.name: IMax
IMax.description: Tuning-free resolution extrapolation for FLUX (arXiv 2410.07536): a low-resolution pass builds a fixed guidance latent; the target-resolution pass is pulled toward its low pass while NTK RoPE, proportional attention and text duplication compensate the resolution gap. Feed a latent at the TARGET size (EmptySD3LatentImage).

model.tooltip: Requires ReferenceLatent connected. The reference must be in the image stream.

strength.tooltip: Per-block blend factor. Fires at every active block so the effect is cumulative. Start at 0.10 to 0.20.

start_block.tooltip: First block index to apply. 0 = earliest. Index is shared across double and single blocks (resets when single blocks begin).

end_block.tooltip: Last block index to apply. Covers 8 double blocks (0-7) then 24 single blocks (index resets 0-23). Higher values extend coverage into later single blocks.

mode.tooltip: cosine_pull: pulls each gen token toward its best-matching ref token. topk_replace: only affects the top K%% most similar tokens. mean_transfer: shifts overall feature distribution toward the reference.

top_k_percent.tooltip: topk_replace mode only. Fraction of generation tokens to affect. 0.25 = top 25%% most similar.

model.tooltip: Requires ReferenceLatent connected. The reference must be in the image stream.

reference_index.tooltip: Which reference image to draw features from when multiple are connected (0 = first).

mode.tooltip: cosine_pull: each generation token is pulled toward similar reference tokens. topk_replace: only the top K%% most similar tokens are affected. mean_transfer: shifts the overall feature distribution toward the reference.

top_k_percent.tooltip: topk_replace mode only. Fraction of generation tokens to affect.

double_enable.tooltip: Apply transfer on double blocks (0-7). These shape pose, color, and identity early in the network.

double_strength.tooltip: Per-block blend factor for double blocks. Cumulative across blocks. Raise for stronger identity guidance, especially when the reference contains multiple subjects.

double_start.tooltip: First double block to apply on (0-7).

double_end.tooltip: Last double block to apply on (0-7).

single_enable.tooltip: Apply transfer on single blocks (0-23). These refine style and texture later in the network.

single_strength.tooltip: Per-block blend factor for single blocks. Cumulative across blocks.

single_start.tooltip: First single block to apply on (0-23).

single_end.tooltip: Last single block to apply on (0-23).

block_schedule.tooltip: Strength curve across the active block range. flat = constant. ramp_down = stronger on early blocks. ramp_up = stronger on later blocks. peak_mid = strongest in the middle.

sim_floor.tooltip: Cosine similarity threshold gating which reference-to-generation matches contribute. Low (~0.05) = wide pull, tight identity lock, suited to subtle edits like outfit swaps. High = sparse pull, more freedom for broader edits.

mask_threshold.tooltip: Used only when subject_mask is connected. Reference tokens whose pooled mask value falls below this are excluded from the pull. 0.5 keeps boundary tokens; raise toward 1.0 to shrink the effective mask inward.

subject_mask.tooltip: Optional subject mask for the reference image. When connected, the cosine pull samples only from masked-in reference tokens, leaving everything else out of the transfer. The conditioning latent is not modified, so the model still sees the full reference. Mask aspect must match the encoded reference aspect.

IdentityFeatureTransferAdvanced.name: IdentityFeatureTransferAdvanced
IdentityFeatureTransferAdvanced.display_name: FLUX.2 Klein Identity Feature Transfer Advanced

mask_behavior.tooltip: focus_only preserves the original masking behavior: the mask limits this node's reference bank while Klein still sees the complete reference. zero_unmasked_tokens blocks each wired reference's unmasked tokens as attention sources in every block. References without a wired mask remain complete and unchanged.

sigmas.tooltip: Optional sampler sigma schedule. When connected, the existing block strengths decay per sampling step by delta_sigma_0 / delta_sigma_step.

model.tooltip: Connect this after your checkpoint model. ReferenceLatent must also be connected in the conditioning path.

preset.tooltip: Pick how strongly the reference should hold. Any preset except custom ignores the manual settings below.

reference_index.tooltip: Which reference image to use. 0 means the first reference.

double_schedule.tooltip: Custom preset only. Double block schedule.

single_schedule.tooltip: Custom preset only. Single block schedule.

double_sim.tooltip: Custom preset only. Higher means fewer double-block matches are allowed.

single_sim.tooltip: Custom preset only. Higher means fewer single-block matches are allowed.

commit_margin.tooltip: Custom preset only. Higher means the match has to be more obvious before it locks.

commit_confirm.tooltip: Custom preset only. How many times the same match must repeat before it locks.

commit_anchor.tooltip: Custom preset only. How much pull remains after a token has locked.

mask_threshold.tooltip: Used only when a mask is connected. Lower keeps more edge tokens. Higher keeps only the strongest mask area.

debug.tooltip: Print the active preset and schedules to the console.

subject_mask.tooltip: Optional mask for the reference image. Use it when the reference has more than one subject.

IdentityFeatureTransferV3.name: IdentityFeatureTransferV3
IdentityFeatureTransferV3.display_name: FLUX.2 Klein Identity Feature Transfer V3

identity_latent.tooltip: VAE-encoded reference image at full resolution.

strength.tooltip: How hard to pull toward the reference each step. 0.3 = move 30% of the distance.

start_percent.tooltip: When to start correcting. 0.0 = beginning of denoising.

end_percent.tooltip: When to stop correcting. 0.8 = last 20% runs freely for texture refinement.

mode.tooltip: adaptive: pulls only where prediction resembles reference. direct: pulls everywhere equally. channel_match: matches color/feature statistics without copying spatial content.

original.tooltip: The plate, at the SAME size as the refined image. If the refinement upscaled, upscale this to match first.

refined.tooltip: What came back from the model.

radius.tooltip: The split frequency. SMALLER locks harder and lets less refinement through; LARGER passes more detail and more movement with it. If a face is still moving, go SMALLER.

strength.tooltip: 0 = the raw refinement, 1 = fully locked. Set it to 0 WITH a protect mask to lock only the face and leave the background completely free.

corrections.tooltip: Extra passes that push the result's structure back onto the plate's. A Gaussian is not a brick-wall filter, so one pass alone holds only about 70% of a face shift; two hold about 94%, at a 2% cost in detail.

protect.tooltip: Where the lock is at FULL strength regardless of the strength above - a face. Everywhere else gets whatever strength says.

want_drift_map.tooltip: Also output a map of where structure moved. Bright means it moved. Use it to find what the drift number is telling you about.

band_radii.tooltip: Multi-band lock: comma-separated blur radii in px, fine to coarse (e.g. '2, 8, 32'). They cut the picture into bands: detail finer than the first, one band between each pair, and the structure coarser than the last. Empty = the single split at radius (as before). Needs band_strengths.

band_strengths.tooltip: Multi-band lock: one number 0-1 per band (radii + 1 of them, fine to coarse) = how much of that band comes from the PLATE (1 = locked, 0 = the refinement's). Example '0, 0.5, 1, 1' keeps the model's fine detail, half the mid band and the plate's structure. strength fades them all; inside protect they apply in full.

track_protect.tooltip: When protect has fewer frames than the clip (e.g. one mask drawn on frame 0), follow the protected region through the original clip (phase correlation, frame to frame) and move the mask with it. The offsets are in drift_report. Off = the mask as given.

IdentityLockMEC.name: IdentityLockMEC
IdentityLockMEC.description: Refine every pixel without letting anything move. Keeps the plate's low frequencies - where composition and face geometry live - and takes only the model's high frequencies. The face cannot move, because the only thing taken from the model is the band that does not encode where anything is.
output_tooltips: The refined detail on the plate's structure.
Where structure moved (bright = moved); all black unless want_drift_map is on.
How much structure the refinement moved (lower = closer to the plate).
Settings used and the drift numbers, as text.

JSON per frame: structure drift inside the protect region (the whole frame without one), how far that region moved from the original to the result in pixels [dy, dx] (phase correlation), and the tracked mask offset when track_protect is on.

chunk_ffn.tooltip: Chunk the feedforward activations over the sequence dim to cap the (B, L, hidden) intermediate.

ffn_chunks.tooltip: Number of chunks to split the feedforward sequence into. More chunks = lower peak, slightly more overhead.

ffn_seq_threshold.tooltip: Only chunk when the token sequence length exceeds this (skips chunking for tiny sequences).

bf16_rope.tooltip: Apply RoPE in the input dtype instead of fp32. ~Halves RoPE activation memory; matches the HF reference dtype.

Ideogram4OptimizationsKJ.name: Ideogram4OptimizationsKJ
Ideogram4OptimizationsKJ.description: EXPERIMENTAL AND MAY CHANGE THE MODEL OUTPUT!! Reduces peak VRAM of the Ideogram4 forward. chunk_ffn splits the SwiGLU activations over the token dim; bf16_rope applies RoPE in the model dtype instead of upcasting to fp32. Both target the two largest transient tensors in the block.

width.tooltip: Canvas aspect width (also the pixel grid the bbox is measured in). Ideogram 4 needs multiples of 16.

height.tooltip: Canvas aspect height (also the pixel grid the bbox is measured in). Ideogram 4 needs multiples of 16.

high_level_description.tooltip: Optional one-line overview of the whole image (blank = omitted).

background.tooltip: Required scene background description.

style_palette_data.tooltip: Serialized style color palette from the editor (managed by the node UI).

elements_data.tooltip: Serialized regions from the editor (managed by the node UI).

bg_brightness.tooltip: Background image brightness % (managed by the node UI slider).

import_mode.tooltip: How a wired import_json is used: 'when empty' only seeds the editor while it has no regions (then the editor wins, so you can edit); 'always' makes the wired JSON authoritative so its changes always propagate to the output.

output_format.tooltip: Output JSON formatting (set via the editor toolbar): 'compact' (default, what Ideogram 4 expects) or 'pretty' (indented, for readability).

coord_mode.tooltip: bbox coordinate space (set via the editor toolbar): 'normalized' (default, the 0-1000 grid Ideogram 4 expects) or 'absolute' (pixels, scaled by width/height — NON-STANDARD for Ideogram, for other tools that want pixel coords).

bbox_order.tooltip: bbox axis order (set via the editor toolbar): 'yx' (default, Ideogram's [ymin,xmin,ymax,xmax]) or 'xy' ([xmin,ymin,xmax,ymax], the standard x1,y1,x2,y2 that Qwen-VL and most detectors use).

image.tooltip: Optional reference image shown as the editor background (and behind the preview).

import_json.tooltip: Optional: a full caption JSON. When connected, it loads into the editor and drives the output per 'import_mode'.

bboxes.tooltip: Optional pixel-space boxes ({x, y, width, height}) used to seed the editor's regions when it has none. Ignored once regions exist.

Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ.name: Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ
Ideogram4PromptBuilderKJ.description:
Visual prompt builder for Ideogram 4's structured JSON caption format.

Drag on the canvas to draw regions; select a region to set its type (obj/text),  
description, text, and color palette. Set the background and optional style fields  
as widgets. Outputs the assembled caption JSON string.  

bbox is normalized to a 0-1000 grid as [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax]; width/height set
the canvas aspect ratio.

Canvas controls:
- Drag: draw a new region
- Ctrl/Cmd-drag: force-draw a new region even on top of an existing one
- Click: select a region · Alt-click: cycle overlapping regions
- Double-click: edit the description inline
- Right-click: region list (select / delete / duplicate / reorder, top = front)
- Del / Backspace: remove the selected region
- Ctrl/Cmd + C / V / D: copy / paste / duplicate the selected region
- bbox fields (px / out) next to obj/text are editable

Color swatches:
- Click: edit · Drag: reorder · Right-click: remove
- Hover + Ctrl/Cmd + C / V: copy / paste the hex
- "+": add a color (uses the clipboard color if it is one)

Toolbar:
- Live: use the live sampling preview as the background (and grab the final result)
- Grab BG / Clear BG: use the last generated image as the background
- brightness slider, token estimate, and Copy / Paste / Clear all

'crop' resizes so the image covers the desired width and height, and center-crops the excess, returning exactly the desired width and height.

images.tooltip: The frames to pick from (an IMAGE batch).

start.tooltip: Range mode: first frame. Negative counts from the end.

end.tooltip: Range mode: exclusive end. -1 = end of batch.

step.tooltip: Range mode: keep every Nth frame.

mode.tooltip: What to pick: a start:end:step range, a split (at a frame index or a fraction), or one frame (first, middle, last or by index).

split_index.tooltip: 'split at index': frames before this index go to 'images'.

split_ratio.tooltip: 'split at ratio': this fraction of the batch goes to 'images'.

frame_index.tooltip: 'frame at index': 0-based, clamped to the last frame.

ranges.tooltip: 'ranges' mode: comma-separated ranges, ends included, e.g. '0..9, 20..29/2, -5..'. Positions may be seconds ('1.5s..3s') or timecodes ('00:00:02:00..00:00:03:12', HH:MM:SS:FF) when fps is set. 'images' gets the frames in the order listed, 'remainder' every frame not picked.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate of the incoming batch. 'ranges': needed only for seconds / timecodes. 'resample to fps': the source rate.

ImageColorSpace.name: ImageColorSpace
ImageColorSpace.description: Convert sRGB, linear Rec.709, HDR (Rec.2020 HLG), HDR PQ (Rec.2020 PQ), HDR LogC3, linear ACEScg, and HDR ACEScct. LogC3 uses the EI 800 curve with Rec.709 primaries and codes clamped to [0, 1]. ACEScg is scene-linear AP1 with D60 white. ACEScct is the ACEScg log encoding. Both use Bradford adaptation to D65. Convert LogC3 or ACEScct to linear ACEScg (AP1 scene-linear) or linear (Rec.709) before saving EXR. Linear 1.0 and ACEScg 1.0 use the same 203-nit reference white as sRGB; HLG uses a 1000-nit reference display. Linear, ACEScg, and ACEScct outputs preserve extended values. Linear-to-HDR conversions preserve highlights without tone mapping; HLG and PQ outputs clip negative channels. SDR output and PQ-to-HLG conversion tone-map excess luminance across the batch and compress out-of-gamut colors. Conversions compute in float32 and return the intermediate device and dtype. Straight alpha is not color-transformed.

ImageSharpenKJ.name: ImageSharpenKJ
ImageSharpenKJ.description:
GPU-accelerated image sharpening with multiple methods.

**RCAS** — AMD's Robust Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening (from FSR).
Single 5-tap cross filter that adapts to local contrast.
Minimal artifacts, good for general use with little tuning.

**Adaptive USM** — Unsharp mask with local variance modulation.
Sharpens detail-rich areas more, flat/noisy areas less.
More controllable than RCAS via radius and threshold parameters.

**High-Pass** — Extracts high-frequency detail and blends it back.
Gives a "clarity" enhancement feel. Uses radius to control detail scale.

**Deconvolution** — Richardson-Lucy iterative deconvolution.
Can recover actual lost detail from blur, not just enhance edges.
Uses radius as the estimated blur kernel and iterations to control convergence.

ImpactWildcardEncode.name: ImpactWildcardEncode
ImpactWildcardEncode.description:
The 'ImpactWildcardEncode' node processes text prompts written in wildcard syntax and outputs them as conditioning. It also supports LoRA syntax, with the applied LoRA reflected in the model's output.

TIP1: Before the workflow is executed, the processing result of 'wildcard_text' is displayed in 'populated_text', and the populated text is saved along with the workflow. If you want to use a seed converted as input, write the prompt directly in 'populated_text' instead of 'wildcard_text', and set the mode to 'fixed'.
TIP2: If the 'Inspire Pack' is installed, LBW(LoRA Block Weight) syntax can also be applied.

populate: Before running the workflow, it overwrites the existing value of 'populated_text' with the prompt processed from 'wildcard_text'. In this mode, 'populated_text' cannot be edited.
fixed: Ignores wildcard_text and keeps 'populated_text' as is. You can edit 'populated_text' in this mode.
reproduce: This mode operates as 'fixed' mode only once for reproduction, and then it switches to 'populate' mode.
Fixed also pauses automatic seed changes, including choices in populated_text. Use populate for automatic variation.

ImpactWildcardProcessor.name: ImpactWildcardProcessor

TIP: Before the workflow is executed, the processing result of 'wildcard_text' is displayed in 'populated_text', and the populated text is saved along with the workflow. If you want to use a seed converted as input, write the prompt directly in 'populated_text' instead of 'wildcard_text', and set the mode to 'fixed'.

preresize.tooltip: Resize the original image before processing.

mask_fill_holes.tooltip: Mark as masked any areas fully enclosed by mask.

mask_expand_pixels.tooltip: Expand the mask by a certain amount of pixels before processing.

mask_invert.tooltip: Invert mask so that anything masked will be kept.

mask_blend_pixels.tooltip: How many pixels to blend into the original image.

mask_hipass_filter.tooltip: Ignore mask values lower than this value.

context_from_mask_extend_factor.tooltip: Grow the context area from the mask by a certain factor in every direction. For example, 1.5 grabs extra 50% up, down, left, and right as context.

output_resize_to_target_size.tooltip: Force a specific resolution for sampling.

InpaintCropImproved.name: InpaintCropImproved
InpaintCropImproved.description: Crops an image around a mask for inpainting, the optional context mask defines an extra area to keep for the context.

downscale_algorithm.tooltip: Resampling used when something is made smaller (pre-resize, fitting the crop to the target). area / box keep detail best when shrinking.

upscale_algorithm.tooltip: Resampling used when something is made bigger. bicubic / lanczos are sharp; nearest keeps hard edges.

preresize_mode.tooltip: preresize: scale the whole image up to at least the minimum, down to at most the maximum, or both (keeping its aspect).

preresize_min_width.tooltip: preresize: smallest width the image is scaled up to.

preresize_min_height.tooltip: preresize: smallest height the image is scaled up to.

preresize_max_width.tooltip: preresize: largest width the image is scaled down to.

preresize_max_height.tooltip: preresize: largest height the image is scaled down to.

mask_expand_pixels.tooltip: Dilate mask by this many pixels.

mask_blend_pixels.tooltip: Pixels of feather for stitch blending (lquesada default 32).

mask_hipass_filter.tooltip: Zero out mask values below this threshold.

extend_for_outpainting.tooltip: Extend image with edge-replicated padding for outpainting.

extend_up_factor.tooltip: extend_for_outpainting: grow the image upward by (factor - 1) x its height (1 = none, 1.5 = half the height more).

extend_down_factor.tooltip: extend_for_outpainting: grow the image downward by (factor - 1) x its height (1 = none, 1.5 = half the height more).

extend_left_factor.tooltip: extend_for_outpainting: grow the image to the left by (factor - 1) x its width (1 = none, 1.5 = half the width more).

extend_right_factor.tooltip: extend_for_outpainting: grow the image to the right by (factor - 1) x its width (1 = none, 1.5 = half the width more).

context_from_mask_extend_factor.tooltip: Resize context bbox around the mask. 1.0 = exact mask bbox. >1 grows outward (1.5 = +50% on every side). <1 shrinks INWARD so the crop is tighter than the mask bbox (0.7 = inset 15% on every side). Useful for 16:9 / portrait single-still crops where the mask bbox is larger than the subject you actually want sampled.

auto_context_factor.tooltip: Override context_from_mask_extend_factor automatically so the mask fills ~70% of the resulting crop area. Uses actual mask AREA (not just bbox) to handle sparse / thin / non-convex masks. Result clamped to [0.30, 10.00]. OFF = use the manual slider above. Recommended ON for batch / unattended runs.

aspect_preset.tooltip:
Force the output crop aspect ratio.
  Custom : use output_target_width / _height as-is (legacy lquesada behaviour - DEFAULT).
  Auto   : pick best of {Square, 16:9, 9:16, 4:3, 3:4} from the mask bbox aspect.
  Square / 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:3 / 3:4 : keep the SHORTER of (output_target_width, output_target_height) and recompute the longer side from this AR. Multiple-of-padding rounding still applies downstream.

output_resize_to_target_size.tooltip: Force output to a specific resolution for sampling.

output_target_width.tooltip: output_resize_to_target_size: width of the crop handed to the sampler.

output_target_height.tooltip: output_resize_to_target_size: height of the crop handed to the sampler.

output_padding.tooltip: Round the crop size up to a multiple of this (models want sizes divisible by 8 / 16 / 32 ...). 0 = no rounding.

device_mode.tooltip: Where the resizing and blending run. cpu when the GPU is busy or short of memory.

wan_align_multiple.tooltip: Force final crop W/H to multiples of this (Wan VAE patchify; 16 recommended).

wan_temporal_smooth_frames.tooltip: Gaussian smoothing of mask along time axis (frames). 0 disables.

wan_stable_crop.tooltip: Use a single union bbox across all frames (Wan replacement-mode).

wan_mask_polarity.tooltip: regenerate_subject: mask=1 -> regenerate (lquesada).  preserve_subject: mask=0 -> regenerate (Wan2.2 replacement: mask=1 keeps environment).

inpaint_mask_mode.tooltip: What the inpaint sampler sees: hard_binary (crisp), slight_feather (gentle), soft_blend (very soft).

stitch_blend_mode.tooltip: How the result is composited back: gaussian, edge_aware (Sobel), laplacian_pyramid, frequency_blend, video_stable.

blend_radius.tooltip: Feather radius for the stitch blend mask (independent of mask_blend_pixels).

video_stable_temporal_sigma.tooltip: [video_stable only] Temporal Gaussian sigma in frames. 3.0 ≈ 9-frame window. Higher = smoother but laggier on fast motion. 0 = off.

video_stable_dilate_px.tooltip: [video_stable only] Pixels to push the blend zone into background BEFORE feathering. -1 = derive from blend_radius. 16-32 typical.

video_stable_blur_sigma.tooltip: [video_stable only] Spatial Gaussian sigma for the wide feather. -1 = derive from blend_radius (×0.75). Match to dilate value.

fill_masked_area.tooltip: Fill masked region in the cropped image: none, edge_pad (Gaussian smear), neutral_gray, original, telea / navier_stokes (OpenCV inpaint from the surrounding pixels, radius 3 px; only masked pixels change). A pre-fill for low-denoise inpaints.

image.tooltip: The frames to inpaint (a still or a clip).

mask.tooltip: White = the area to regenerate.

optional_context_mask.tooltip: Extra area the crop must include as context, without being regenerated.

roto_quality.tooltip: Roto-Sync mode: tightens the inpaint seam for clean alpha edges. Forces laplacian_pyramid blend, halves blend_radius (min 4), and pre-erodes the inpaint mask by 1 px so the stitch falls just inside the subject. Safe to leave OFF for general inpaint; turn ON for compositing / roto / VFX work where boundaries must not bleed.

preview_frame.tooltip: Which frame the preview under the node shows (0 = the first). Display only: every frame is still cropped exactly as before.

crop_mode.tooltip: pro: the crop above (lquesada-style, video aware). smart aspect: the stills crop that sizes the output between a minimum and a maximum side (the former Smart Image Crop). mask prepare: no crop - clean the mask and make the inpaint and stitch masks for the whole frame (the former Inpaint Mask Prepare).

smart_max_resolution.tooltip: [smart aspect] Upper limit on the longest side. A crop larger than this is scaled DOWN to fit.

smart_min_resolution.tooltip: [smart aspect] Lower limit on the shortest side. A crop smaller than this is scaled UP, which is the whole point of cropping - a 200px face gets the model's full attention.

smart_mask_grow_pixels.tooltip: [smart aspect] Grow (or shrink) the mask before measuring the crop, so the model sees context around the region rather than a tight cut-out.

smart_patch_mask_holes.tooltip: [smart aspect] Close gaps and fill enclosed holes. A subject mask with holes regenerates those holes as background - the hole-in-the-face result.

smart_no_mask_mode.tooltip: [smart aspect] What to do when the mask is empty. Bypass passes the image through untouched, which is the safe default for a batch where only some frames have a mask.

smart_force_divisibility.tooltip: [smart aspect] Snap output dimensions to this multiple. A VAE silently pads anything else, which shifts the crop by a few pixels and breaks the stitch.

prepare_fill_holes.tooltip: [mask prepare] Fill interior holes in the mask

prepare_min_region_area.tooltip: [mask prepare] Minimum region area in pixels to keep

prepare_grow_pixels.tooltip: [mask prepare] Dilate mask by this many pixels

prepare_inpaint_edge_mode.tooltip: [mask prepare] Edge style for inpaint mask: hard_binary or slight_feather

prepare_stitch_edge_mode.tooltip: [mask prepare] Edge style for stitch blend mask: gaussian or edge_aware

prepare_stitch_feather_radius.tooltip: [mask prepare] Feather radius for the stitch blend mask

prepare_temporal_smooth.tooltip: [mask prepare] Apply Gaussian temporal smoothing along batch dimension (for video)

prepare_temporal_sigma.tooltip: [mask prepare] Temporal Gaussian sigma in frames

region_mode.tooltip: single: one crop around the whole mask (as before). per region: every separate part of the mask (8-connected, over the whole clip) gets its own crop and a stable region id; the crops come out region by region (all frames of region 0, then region 1 ...) and Inpaint Stitch Pro (blend) puts every region back. Regions and their boxes are listed in info. mask_invert is applied before the split.

region_min_area.tooltip: per region: parts of the mask smaller than this many pixels are ignored.

max_regions.tooltip: per region: keep at most this many regions (the largest), numbered top to bottom, left to right.

context_detail_aware.tooltip: Move each crop edge outward, off detail: when an edge of the context box cuts through more detail (mean luma gradient over the clip) than the image's median, it moves out to the quietest line within context_detail_max_grow. Never inward, so the mask stays inside. The aspect / target step runs after it.

context_detail_max_grow.tooltip: context_detail_aware: how far an edge may move, as a fraction of the box size (0.25 = a quarter of its width / height per side).

max_crop_megapixels.tooltip: Memory / model cap: when output_resize_to_target_size is on and the target size is larger than this many megapixels, it is scaled down (aspect kept) so that, after rounding to output_padding / wan_align_multiple, it fits; never below one multiple or 64 px. The change is noted in info. 0 = no cap (as before).

InpaintCropProMEC.name: InpaintCropProMEC
InpaintCropProMEC.description: Crop around mask for inpainting (lquesada API + Wan 2.2 Animate aware). crop_mode 'smart aspect' is the stills crop sized between a min and a max side; 'mask prepare' cleans the mask without cropping. Pair with Inpaint Stitch Pro (C2C).

noise_mask.tooltip: Add a noise mask to the latent so sampling will only happen within the mask. Might improve results or completely break things depending on the model.

InpaintStitchImproved.name: InpaintStitchImproved
InpaintStitchImproved.description: Stitches an image cropped with Inpaint Crop back into the original image

blend_mode_override.tooltip: Override the blend mode chosen at crop time, or use 'from_crop'.

color_match.tooltip: Apply mean+std color transfer before stitching to reduce color shift.

stitch_temporal_sigma.tooltip: Post-hoc temporal Gaussian smoothing applied to the per-frame blend mask before compositing. 0 = off. 2-4 = good for jittery segmentation video (≈3 means a 9-frame window). Works on top of any blend mode (gaussian / edge_aware / video_stable / etc.).

stitch_dilate_px.tooltip: Optional dilation (in pixels) applied to the binary core of the blend mask before temporal smoothing — pushes the seam into flat background. Use with stitch_temporal_sigma > 0 for jittery video. 0 = off.

stitcher.tooltip: Inpaint Crop Pro's stitcher output (where each crop came from).

inpainted_image.tooltip: The crops after inpainting (same count as the crop node gave; they may be a different size).

roto_quality_override.tooltip: Roto-Sync at stitch time. 'from_crop' honors the InpaintCropProMEC flag (recommended). 'force_on' applies tight-seam stitching even if crop didn't set it; 'force_off' disables it.

stitch_mode.tooltip: blend: the crop's blend mask and blend modes (as before). paste back: resize and paste the crop, optional feathered edge (the former Inpaint Paste Back). smart: the stitch for a crop made in 'smart aspect' mode; needs original_image (the former Smart Image Stitch). context blend: no stitcher - blend a full-frame inpainted image over original_image under mask, with colour correction and lightness rescue (the former Context Inpainter).

mask.tooltip: [smart: Mask Feather / context blend] The mask to blend along.

paste_upscale_method.tooltip: [paste back] Interpolation method for resizing crop back

paste_feather_edges.tooltip: [paste back] Apply Gaussian feather at crop boundary

paste_feather_radius.tooltip: [paste back] Feather radius in pixels (only used if feather_edges)

smart_blend_mode.tooltip: [smart] Box Feather softens the crop's rectangular edge. Mask Feather blends along the mask itself, which keeps untouched detail outside the subject. Hard Paste shows the seam and is for checking alignment.

smart_resize_full_image_output.tooltip: [smart] Only applies when the crop node ran in 'Resize Full Image' mode.

smart_enable_color_match.tooltip: [smart] Pull the crop's exposure and cast toward the plate before blending. A feathered seam turns a small mismatch into a visible halo instead of hiding it.

context_crop_padding.tooltip: [context blend] How far around the mask's box (x its size) colour match and lightness rescue look for reference colours when color_reference = around mask.

context_blend_softness.tooltip: [context blend] Gaussian feather radius applied to the blend mask in pixels.

context_mask_expansion_blend.tooltip: [context blend] Per-blend dilate (positive) / erode (negative) of the blend mask in pixels.

context_enable_color_correction.tooltip: [context blend] Reinhard mean/std color match between original and inpainted regions.

context_enable_lightness_rescue.tooltip: [context blend] Lift CIE LAB L-channel of the inpaint when it is more than ~5% darker.

context_enable_differential_diffusion.tooltip: [context blend] Use |orig - inpaint| as a soft preservation weight to keep unchanged pixels.

context_sampling_mask_blur_size.tooltip: [context blend] Kernel size (odd) for the additional blur on the output debug mask.

context_sampling_mask_blur_strength.tooltip: [context blend] Blend factor for the sampling mask blur applied to debug_mask.

context_color_reference.tooltip: [context blend] Where colour match / lightness rescue take their target colours. inside mask = the original pixels under the mask (re-rendering the same face or subject). around mask = the ring between the mask and its box grown by crop_padding (removing an object: match the background, not the thing removed).

registration.tooltip: [blend] Before compositing, measure how far the generated crop moved against the plate on the context ring (pixels the mask kept) and undo it: translation, or translation + scale (0.94-1.06). Applied only when it improves the match there and stays within registration_max_shift; per-frame results are in info. off = as before.

registration_max_shift.tooltip: [blend] registration: the largest shift (pixels, in the crop's size at stitch time) that is accepted; a larger measured shift is ignored.

seam_qc.tooltip: [blend] Measure the seam on every frame: the mean luma difference to the plate along the blend ring (where the blend weight is between 0.02 and 0.98), and how far each frame is from the clip's median. Reported as JSON in info. Changes nothing unless seam_repair_threshold > 0.

seam_repair_threshold.tooltip: [blend] seam_qc: frames whose seam error differs from the median by more than this (0-1 image units) are flagged and repaired on the ring only, from the nearest unflagged frames before / after. 0 = report only.

denoise.tooltip: The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

mode.tooltip: How to reconcile resolution mismatches before joining. Resize forces the source to the reference size, pad preserves content and pads outward, crop fills then center-crops, none raises an error on mismatch.

overlap_mode.tooltip: How overlapping frames are combined. Cut removes the overlap, linear_blend crossfades evenly, and ease_in_out applies a smoother cosine blend curve.

Krea2AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2.name: Krea2AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2
Krea2AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2.description:
Combined analyzer and selective loader for Krea 2 LoRAs.
Analyzes block impact and allows per-block control with strength shaping.

Block Guide (28 main SingleStreamBlocks):
- block_0-8: Early main blocks
- block_9-18: Mid main blocks
- block_19-27: Late main blocks

Non-main-block Krea 2 Linear layers such as first, last.linear, tmlp, txtmlp, tproj,
and txtfusion are controlled by other_weights.

Supports strength scheduling format: 0:.2,.5:.8,1:1.0
output_tooltips: Model with LoRA applied (filtered by enabled blocks).

Negative conditioning (with hooks if using schedule).
Per-block analysis showing impact scores.
JSON analysis data for UI coloring.

Krea2EnhancerPixaroma.description: Makes a Krea 2 model follow your prompt more closely. Put it between the model loader (and any LoRA loaders) and the sampler. text.tooltip: Prompt with per-token weights in parentheses, e.g. (word:-1) removes/represses a concept, (word:2) emphasizes it, plain text = 1.0. strength.tooltip: Global multiplier on the weighting effect. Effect compounds over all 28 blocks; lower if results break up, raise for a stronger effect. Removal (weight<0) is the reliable direction; emphasis (weight>1) works but is looser.

KreaLoraConvertPixaroma.name: KreaLoraConvertPixaroma
KreaLoraConvertPixaroma.description: Convert a Krea 2 LoRA trained on fal.ai into a ComfyUI-compatible file. fal.ai's Krea 2 LoRAs use layer names ComfyUI does not recognize, so they do not load; this node renames them and saves a new copy in your loras folder that any LoRA loader can use. width.tooltip: Target overall pixel width of the upscaled frame (snapped to a multiple of 32, the LTX VAE 32x grid). The 2x model upscale is followed by interpolation to this size. Must match the conditioning's generation size.

height.tooltip: Target overall pixel height of the upscaled frame (snapped to a multiple of 32, the LTX VAE 32x grid). The 2x model upscale is followed by interpolation to this size. Must match the conditioning's generation size.

LTX25LatentUpscaleParams.name: LTX25LatentUpscaleParams
LTX25LatentUpscaleParams.description: Bundle the LTX2.5 latent upscale settings for the 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale' node. The LTX2.5 model is a fixed 2x latent spatial upscaler; the requested width/height are the overall upscaled frame size, reached by 2x upscaling then interpolating to the target.

ref_images.tooltip: Reference stills; each BATCH item is one reference (order = MSR slot order). Encoded once at this node.

ref_vae.tooltip: The LTX2.5 VIDEO VAE used to encode the references.

ref_strength.tooltip: Reference guide conditioning strength: noise_mask value = 1 - strength (1.0 = guides stay fully clean/frozen; lower values let them drift slightly).

ref_frames.tooltip: Pixel frames each still is repeated to before encoding (25 -> 4 latent frames per reference, 33 -> 5).

msr_parameters.tooltip: Optional output of an MSR IC-LoRA loader: either this pack's 'LTX25 IC-LoRA Loader (MSR)' or the ComfyUI-LTX2.5-MSR package's 'IC-LoRA Loader' (same wire type). Adds learned slot embeddings and consecutive negative temporal offsets (MSR training layout). Leave unconnected for plain guides at offset 0.

output_tooltips: Encoded reference guides consumed by 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale'.
LTX25ReferenceParams.name: LTX25ReferenceParams
LTX25ReferenceParams.description: Encode reference stills (each BATCH item = one reference) into LTX2.5 guide latents for 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale'. Connect the output to the main node's 'reference_guides' input to pin identity/scene consistency across independently sampled chunks. Optionally connect an MSR IC-LoRA Loader output to use MSR slot embeddings and offsets.

upscale_width.tooltip: [rows_cols mode] Overall upscaled frame WIDTH in PIXELS that gets split into grid_cols equal-size tile columns. Must be a multiple of 32 and must match the width set in 'LTX25 Latent Upscale Params'. Ignored in specific_size mode.

upscale_height.tooltip: [rows_cols mode] Overall upscaled frame HEIGHT in PIXELS that gets split into grid_rows equal-size tile rows. Must be a multiple of 32 and must match the height set in 'LTX25 Latent Upscale Params'. Ignored in specific_size mode.

tile_size_mode.tooltip: How the tile size is determined. 'specific_size' (default): use tile_width/tile_height below. 'rows_cols': split the frame given by upscale_width/upscale_height into grid_rows x grid_cols EQUAL-SIZE tiles (edge tiles included) - the per-axis overlap is auto-solved (multiple of 32px, one LTX latent token) so every tile ends up exactly the same size; errors out if the solved tiles would be smaller than min_tile_size.

tile_width.tooltip: [specific_size mode] Tile width in PIXELS at the (upscaled) chunk resolution. Must be a multiple of 32 (LTX VAE 32x).

tile_height.tooltip: [specific_size mode] Tile height in PIXELS at the (upscaled) chunk resolution. Must be a multiple of 32.

grid_rows.tooltip: [rows_cols mode] Number of tile ROWS along the height axis (1-9).

grid_cols.tooltip: [rows_cols mode] Number of tile COLUMNS along the width axis (1-9).

spatial_w_overlap.tooltip: Horizontal overlap in PIXELS between neighbouring tiles. Must be a multiple of 32 and smaller than the tile width. In rows_cols mode this is the DESIRED overlap; the node auto-solves the actual value. If the solved tile size would not be a multiple of 32 (the model's 2x2 latent patch grid, which eliminates seams), the overlap is automatically increased by 32px and the tiles re-solved at the next valid 32px grid alignment.

spatial_h_overlap.tooltip: Vertical overlap in PIXELS between neighbouring tiles. Must be a multiple of 32 and smaller than the tile height. In rows_cols mode this is the DESIRED overlap; the node auto-solves the actual value. If the solved tile size would not be a multiple of 32 (the model's 2x2 latent patch grid, which eliminates seams), the overlap is automatically increased by 32px and the tiles re-solved at the next valid 32px grid alignment.

fade_width.tooltip: Width in PIXELS of the FADE segment (mask 0->1) at the interior edge of the overlap band. The overlap band splits into a FROZEN segment (seam side, mask=0) + this FADE segment (interior side). fade_width sets the fade length; the frozen segment takes the rest. Default 32. Set to 0 to freeze the entire overlap strip. Clamped to the solved overlap in rows_cols mode.

fade_height.tooltip: Height in PIXELS of the FADE segment (mask 0->1) at the interior edge of the overlap band. See fade_width. Clamped to the solved overlap in rows_cols mode.

min_tile_size.tooltip: Minimum PIXEL size of edge tiles. If a leftover edge tile would be smaller, the last tile is pulled back until it reaches at least this size. Must not exceed the tile size. In rows_cols mode an error is raised if the solved tile size falls below this.

overlap_mode.tooltip: Who wins each shared overlap band when stitching. 'earlier' (default): the already-stitched content wins. 'later': the re-sampled tile wins.

overlap_blend.tooltip: How the overlap band transitions when stitching: linear cross-fade (default), smoothstep (eased), overwrite (whole band from the overlap_mode side), midpoint (hard switch at the band's middle).

output_tooltips: Spatial split settings consumed by 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale'.
Resolved tile width in PIXELS: the validated input in specific_size mode, or the equal-tile solution computed from upscale_width/grid_cols in rows_cols mode.
Resolved tile height in PIXELS: the validated input in specific_size mode, or the equal-tile solution computed from upscale_height/grid_rows in rows_cols mode.
LTX25SpatialSplitParams.name: LTX25SpatialSplitParams
LTX25SpatialSplitParams.description: Bundle the spatial tile settings for the 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale' node: tile size, per-axis overlap and fade, and seam stitching rules (inner loop). Two tile sizing modes: explicit pixel sizes, or a row/column count with an auto-solved equal-size tile grid (all tiles identical, edge tiles included); the resolved tile size is exposed as tile_width/tile_height outputs.

chunk_length.tooltip: Target pixel frames per chunk. MUST satisfy (n-1) % 8 == 0 (the LTX 8k+1 grid). 97 = ~4s @24fps.

temporal_overlap.tooltip: Pixel frames of overlap between consecutive chunks. MUST satisfy (n-1) % 8 == 0. Recommended 9 (one latent token). With 'full' anchor_mode this mostly shifts the seam position; with 'first_frame'/'ramp' it controls the visible seam transition width.

anchor_mode.tooltip: How the next chunk's overlap band relates to the previous chunk's re-sampled result (pin strength set by 'anchor_strength'). 'full' (default, original behaviour): the ENTIRE overlap is copied from the previous chunk and pinned via the noise mask (mask = 1 - anchor_strength); the stitch cross-fade mixes identical content, so temporal_overlap mostly just shifts the seam position. 'first_frame' (Mode A, H3-style): only the FIRST latent token (~8 frames) is copied and pinned; the rest of the overlap re-samples freely and the stitch cross-fade blends the two versions across the whole band - temporal_overlap visibly controls the seam transition width. 'ramp' (Mode B, temporal fade): the overlap is initialised from the previous chunk and its noise-mask ramps linearly from (1 - anchor_strength) at the seam to 1.0 at the band end - a true temporal fade whose width IS temporal_overlap.

anchor_strength.tooltip: Pin strength at the seam side of the overlap band, used by every anchor mode (LTX image-to-video noise_mask). 1.0 = keep previous content exactly, 0.999 = model default, 0.0 = disable anchoring (cross-fade only).

output_tooltips: Temporal split settings consumed by 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale'.
LTX25TemporalSplitParams.name: LTX25TemporalSplitParams
LTX25TemporalSplitParams.description: Bundle the temporal split settings for the 'LTX25 Ultimate Upscale' node: how the input latent is cut into overlapping time chunks (outer loop) and how chunk seams are anchored (anchor_mode: full band / first frame / ramp).

model.tooltip: The LTX2.5 diffusion model used to re-sample every chunk/tile (guider is built internally).

conditioning.tooltip: Conditioning used to generate this latent (LTXVConditioning with frame_rate). Passed through unchanged to every chunk/tile (T2V mode, no spatial keyframe cropping).

latent.tooltip: Denoised LTX2.5 AV latent to enhance (nested video+audio).

noise.tooltip: Noise source; one noise tensor is generated per piece.

sigmas.tooltip: Sigma schedule used for every chunk/tile.

cfg.tooltip: CFG scale used when 'negative' is connected.

bypass_audio.tooltip: Audio handling. True = the output audio is the INPUT audio carried unchanged (frozen, never re-sampled). False = the audio is RE-SAMPLED by the model; with spatial tiling the FIRST tile's audio is taken for each time block, and consecutive chunks are cross-faded. Re-sampling costs extra compute but lets the model regenerate audio for the enhanced video.

negative.tooltip: Negative conditioning. When connected, a CFGGuider is used with the 'cfg' value; otherwise a basic guider (positive only).

latent_upscale_param.tooltip: Output of 'LTX25 Latent Upscale Params'. Leave unconnected to skip upscaling.

temporal_split_param.tooltip: Output of 'LTX25 Temporal Split Params'. Leave unconnected to process the latent as a single chunk. When connected, the next chunk's overlap is anchored to the previous chunk (strategy selected by 'anchor_mode': full band / first frame only / temporal ramp) and joined by cross-fade.

spatial_split_param.tooltip: Output of 'LTX25 Spatial Split Params'. Leave unconnected to sample each chunk whole (no tiling).

reference_guides.tooltip: Optional output of 'LTX25 Reference Params'. When connected, the encoded reference stills are appended to EVERY chunk as near-clean guide tokens (native LTXVAddGuide mechanism), pinning identity/scene consistency across independently sampled chunks. Leave unconnected for the previous behaviour.

output_tooltips: Upscaled, re-sampled, stitched LTX2.5 AV latent.
DEBUG ONLY. Per-chunk metadata: frame start/count, video token ranges, upscale applied.

LTX25UltimateUpscale.name: LTX25UltimateUpscale
LTX25UltimateUpscale.description: Re-sample an already-denoised LTX2.5 AV latent through the full auto pipeline in one node: temporal split (outer loop) -> latent upscale (per chunk: 2x model upscale then resized to the target width/height) -> spatial split (inner loop) -> per-tile sampling with preview -> spatial stitch -> temporal stitch. When a temporal split is used, the next chunk's overlap is anchored to the previous chunk's re-sampled result (LTX image-to-video noise_mask) and chunks are joined by cross-fade; 'temporal_split_param.anchor_mode' selects the strategy: 'full' pins the whole overlap band (original behaviour), 'first_frame' pins only the first token and blends across the band (H3-style), 'ramp' applies a linear temporal fade across the band. OPTIONAL reference guides: connect 'reference_guides' from 'LTX25 Reference Params' to anchor identity/scene consistency across chunks - the encoded reference stills are appended to every chunk as near-clean guide tokens (native LTXVAddGuide mechanism), optionally with MSR slot embeddings when an IC-LoRA Loader output is wired into the param node. Audio: by default the INPUT audio is carried unchanged (bypass_audio); disable it to let the model RE-SAMPLE audio (with spatial tiling the first tile's audio is taken per time block, chunks cross-faded). 'latent_upscale_param', 'temporal_split_param' and 'spatial_split_param' are optional - leave any unconnected to skip that stage (no upscale / single chunk / full-chunk sampling).
