seed.tooltip: Seed to determine if node should re-run; the API has no seed, so actual results are nondeterministic regardless of this value.

MetaMuseImageTextToImageApi.name: MetaMuseImageTextToImageApi
MetaMuseImageTextToImageApi.display_name: Meta Muse Image Text to Image
MetaMuseImageTextToImageApi.description: Generates images from a text prompt using Meta's Muse Image model, which reasons about the prompt before rendering.

image.tooltip: Image batch to pass through unchanged.

sidecar_path.tooltip: Filesystem path of the JSON sidecar to write.

metadata_json.tooltip: JSON object to write into the sidecar.

merge_existing.tooltip: If true, merge over an existing sidecar instead of overwriting.

MetadataWriterMEC.name: MetadataWriterMEC
MetadataWriterMEC.description: Write a JSON sidecar; pass the image through.
output_tooltips: Pass-through image batch.
Forward-slash path of the written sidecar.

MickmumpitzAddBlankFrames.name: MickmumpitzAddBlankFrames
MickmumpitzAddBlankFrames.description: Adds black frames in the same resolution, dtype, and device as the input IMAGE batch. Insert frames at the start or end.

low_threshold.tooltip: Weak edges above this join a strong edge. Lower for more lines.

high_threshold.tooltip: Edges above this always count. Raise to keep only silhouettes.

frames_per_pass.tooltip: Frames sent to the GPU at once. 8 needs about 1.5 GB at 1344x768; the result does not depend on this number.

MickmumpitzCanny.name: MickmumpitzCanny
MickmumpitzCanny.description: Canny edge detection for image batches and video frames. Identical to the core Detect Edges (Canny) node, but processes the clip a few frames at a time so a long video does not run out of VRAM.

fallback_fov.tooltip: Returned when the geometry can't pin down the focal length (degenerate / 1-point perspective). ~65 suits a 16:9 phone frame.

image.tooltip: The outpainted panorama (generated surroundings).

plate.tooltip: The ERP canvas from the Warp node (control_video) - your photo placed on the sphere.

inpaint_mask.tooltip: inpaint_mask from the Warp node. White = hole to generate, black = your photo.

strength.tooltip: 1.0 = generated side meets the plate exactly at the boundary. Lower keeps more of the generated look at the cost of a visible step.

solve_scale.tooltip: Downsample factor for the solve. The correction field is smooth, so 8 is plenty and fast. Lower = slower, no visible gain.

iterations.tooltip: Relaxation steps. More = the field spreads further from the boundary. 800 at scale 8 covers a 2048x1024 pano.

wrap_horizontal.tooltip: Equirect panoramas wrap left/right - keep this on so the correction is continuous across the seam.

max_megapixels.tooltip: Safety cap against running out of memory. 8 lets 2048x1024 through uncapped.

MickmumpitzPanoKrea2Reference.name: MickmumpitzPanoKrea2Reference
MickmumpitzPanoKrea2Reference.description: Sets the Krea-2 reference at full resolution so the ref and target grids line up. Without it, above 1 MP the reference sits in the top-left corner.

fraction.tooltip: Fraction of the image width. 0.5 pushes the seam exactly to the centre.

MickmumpitzPanoRollHorizontal.name: MickmumpitzPanoRollHorizontal
MickmumpitzPanoRollHorizontal.description: Horizontal wrap-around roll. Brings the wrap seam to the image centre and back.

seam_width.tooltip: Width of the strip that gets repainted.

feather.tooltip: Soft flank left and right, in pixels.

MickmumpitzPanoSeamMask.name: MickmumpitzPanoSeamMask
MickmumpitzPanoSeamMask.description: Centred seam strip as a mask; position and flanks are computed from width and strip width.

seam_width.tooltip: Width of the centre seam mask as a fraction of the pano width. 0.06 ~= a 6% strip. Wide enough to cover the wrap discontinuity.

feather.tooltip: Horizontal feather (px) on the seam mask. Keep 0 for a hard binary mask; raise for a soft-mask sampler.

image.tooltip: The outpainted panorama to inspect.

threshold.tooltip: Luminance below this counts as unfilled. 0.10 catches canvas black without touching deep shadow.

limit_to_poles.tooltip: Only consider this fraction of the height at the top and at the bottom. 0 = whole image (risky: masks real dark content).

grow.tooltip: Expand the mask into the good content so the fill has context to blend with.

width.tooltip: ERP canvas width. Keep 2:1 (width = 2*height) for a full pano.

length.tooltip: Frames in the still batch (N = 1+4k). 1 = single ERP still (fastest); 5 gives a video model a little temporal extent.

h_fov_deg.tooltip: HORIZONTAL field of view of the source photo, in degrees. Photos do not carry this, so it is set here. Too small places the photo too tightly, too large smears it across the canvas. Match your camera: phone main ~70, wide ~90, ultrawide ~110-120.

yaw_deg.tooltip: Where on the sphere the photo points. 0 is canvas centre, 180 is the wrap seam.

pitch_deg.tooltip: Camera tilt. 0 for a level shot. If the horizon comes out wrong, this is the value to change first.

mask_feather.tooltip: Feather (px) on the inpaint_mask edge, ramping INTO the known side only. Keep at 0 for models trained on hard edges; a ramp there is content mixed towards the fill colour.

supersample.tooltip: Anti-alias quality. The source is heavily minified into the ERP footprint; this area-prefilters it to footprint x this factor before a bicubic warp, killing aliasing/moire. 2 is a good default, 3-4 for very high-res sources, 1 = off (old bilinear-ish).

grid_spacing_deg.tooltip: Lat/lon grid spacing (deg) on the 'erp_guide' chart. The guide is a TECHNICAL equirect reference (no photo): lat/lon grid + degree labels, floor/ceiling perspective curves, and a dotted FOV box marking exactly where the image sits. Feed it to a generator as a pure geometry hint for the 360 layout.

guide_opacity.tooltip: 0 = draw only the lat/lon grid + FOV box; >0 = also draw the floor + ceiling perspective curves (how a ground/ceiling plane distorts into equirect).

fill_color.tooltip: Colour of the UNKNOWN region on the ERP canvas (everything outside the photo's footprint). Hex '#RRGGBB' / '#RGB', or 'r,g,b' with 0-255 components. Default black. This only tints control_video -- the masks are unchanged, so an inpainting sampler still regenerates the region regardless. Handy when a model reacts badly to black init (try '#808080' mid-grey).

chunks.tooltip: Number of chunks to split the feedforward tokens into. More chunks = lower peak VRAM, slightly more overhead.

seq_threshold.tooltip: Only chunk when the packed token count exceeds this (skips tiny sequences).

MiniMaxChunkFeedForward.name: MiniMaxChunkFeedForward
MiniMaxChunkFeedForward.description: Chunks the MiniMax H3 feedforward (SwiGLU) over the packed token dim to reduce peak VRAM usage. Each chunk still goes through ComfyUI's fused INT8 kernel when the model is quantized, and since activations are quantized per-token the output matches the unchunked model.

MiniMaxH3AVBridgeTiming.name: MiniMaxH3AVBridgeTiming
MiniMaxH3AVBridgeTiming.description: Validate 24 fps H3 bridge timing before generation. Contexts use 39 + 51*k; targets use 5 + 17*k.

MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Decode Safety / 音视频安全解码 (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVDecodeSafetyT8Advanced.description: Isolated AV decode preflight with explicit H3 latent/VAE contracts, output-size estimates and current headroom gates. preflight_only is the default and performs no decode. Current H3 regular decode also uses internal 256-pixel spatial tiles on larger canvases; explicit tile controls may be ignored and remain experimental.

start.tooltip: Existing Video loads/extends a source clip. T2V generates a Ref2VA starter without a keyframe. I2V / Custom Keyframes enables the starter keyframe image at frame 1 (resolved frame index 0).

active_extensions.tooltip: Generate Extensions 1..N. Later extension groups are automatically and visibly bypassed.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Audio latent-mask half-cosine feather. H3 audio latent rate is 40 Hz; 8 ticks = 0.2 seconds. 0 restores a hard audio mask.

previews.tooltip: Off disables all intermediate VHS previews. Last Active previews only the final enabled extension. All Active previews every enabled extension and the generated starter when applicable.

source_audio.tooltip: Existing Video only. Keep source audio preserves the original track (or exact-duration silence if none exists). Regenerate with H3 protects the complete source video and synthesizes a new synchronized soundtrack for the whole source clip before extension.

MiniMaxH3AVExtensionController.name: MiniMaxH3AVExtensionController
MiniMaxH3AVExtensionController.description: Workflow controller for the H3 AV Extension example. Its frontend companion applies real ComfyUI bypass mode to tagged groups; backend outputs drive lazy routing and the final streaming path.

MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Latent Builder (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVLatentBuilderT8Advanced.description: Combine separately encoded MiniMax H3 video and audio latents. Validates the official stream shapes and shared timeline before sampling.

MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8.name: MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8
MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Latent Separate / 联合潜空间拆分 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3AVLatentSeparateT8.description: Validates and separates a joint H3 AV latent without invoking either VAE. It preserves metadata and per-stream noise masks, so it is cheaper than decoding when only latent routing or replacement is needed.

tail_power.tooltip: 1.0 is exact identity; values above 1 move existing points toward the zero-sigma tail.

MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8A.name: MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Sigma Same-NFE / 音画同NFE重分布 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaSameNFERedistributionT8A.description: Default-off causal-control schedule. It keeps the exact joint AV model-call count and endpoints while optionally redistributing existing base-flow times. Turbo dual-clock validation uses eight steps and requires explicit OOD consent.

extra_substeps.tooltip: Total additional full H3 audio-video DiT calls. Zero is an exact pass-through.

tail_intervals.tooltip: Number of original intervals selected from the zero-sigma tail.

profile.tooltip: All project Turbo dual-clock tests use the 8-step baseline.

accept_turbo_schedule_ood.tooltip: Required before adding untrained intermediate times to an 8-step Turbo schedule.

MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Sigma Tail Subdivision / 音画尾段细分 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVSigmaTailSubdivisionT8Advance.description: Default-off H3 schedule experiment. It preserves every input sigma knot, inserts optional points in base-flow time, and reports both video and audio clocks. Turbo dual-clock validation uses 8 steps.

MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam.name: MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam
MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam.display_name: H3 AV Source Audio Mode (Controller Internal)
MiniMaxH3AVSourceAudioModeParam.description: Internal cache-isolated AV Extension parameter. The frontend controller mirrors only the Source Audio widget here so unrelated controller changes cannot invalidate source audio.

MiniMaxH3AVStartModeParam.name: MiniMaxH3AVStartModeParam
MiniMaxH3AVStartModeParam.description: Internal cache-isolated AV Extension parameter. The frontend controller mirrors only the Start widget here so unrelated controller changes cannot invalidate extension samplers.

extra_tail_steps.tooltip: Additional full H3 joint audio-video forwards. Zero is exact pass-through.

MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 AV Tail Detail Schedule / 音画尾段细化 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3AVTailDetailScheduleT8Advanced.description: Subdivides only the final H3 dual-clock interval. The default adds one joint AV model call; three adds a gradual 75/50/25% descent to zero. This does not inject random noise.

MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 MLP Activation Chunk / MLP激活分块 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ActivationChunkT8Advanced.description: Clone-local H3 DiT MLP token chunking. Attention is unchanged. Current TensorWise INT8 kernels already fuse SwiGLU and may show no memory benefit. Default report_only makes no MODEL change; apply_exp preserves and composes existing block hooks without a compatibility gate. KJ/Sage/Sol combinations are allowed at user risk, not guaranteed compatible; non-delegating hooks can bypass chunking.

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

MiniMaxH3AddGuide.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
MiniMaxH3AddGuide.description: Anchor an image, a short clip, audio, or a clip with its soundtrack at any frame of a MiniMax H3 video. Chain several nodes to anchor several frames.

positive.tooltip: Positive conditioning from CLIP encode

lora_name.tooltip: LoRA file to load and analyze

strength.tooltip: Overall LoRA strength (ignored when using schedule)

preset.tooltip: Quick preset selection. Individual toggles below override when changed.

lora_path_opt.tooltip: Optional: Override LoRA selection with a path

schedule_preset.tooltip: Select a preset schedule (populates the text field below for editing)

strength_schedule.tooltip: Strength schedule: 0:.2,.5:.8,1:1.0 (step:strength pairs). Edit freely after selecting preset.

save_refined_lora.tooltip: Enable to save the refined LoRA to disk

save_filename.tooltip: Filename for saved LoRA (timestamp auto-appended). Leave empty for auto-name.

block_weights_string.tooltip: Input/Output block profile string. Positional text syncs with the UI. String input overrides UI values.

MiniMaxH3AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2.name: MiniMaxH3AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2
MiniMaxH3AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2.display_name: MiniMax H3 Analyzer + Selective Loader V2
MiniMaxH3AnalyzerSelectiveLoaderV2.description:
Combined analyzer and selective loader for MiniMax H3 LoRAs.
Analyzes LoRA impact and allows per-block control with strength shaping.

Block Guide (50 main packed DiT blocks):
- block_0-12: Early DiT blocks
- block_13-37: Middle DiT blocks
- block_38-49: Late DiT blocks

Token-refiner and other non-main H3 tensors are controlled by other_weights.
Supports strength scheduling format: 0:.2,.5:.8,1:1.0
output_tooltips: Model with LoRA applied (filtered by enabled blocks).
Positive conditioning (with hooks if using schedule).
Negative conditioning (with hooks if using schedule).
Per-block analysis showing impact scores.
JSON analysis data for UI coloring.
Block profile string output for chaining or reuse.

MiniMaxH3AssembleBridgeAudio.name: MiniMaxH3AssembleBridgeAudio
MiniMaxH3AssembleBridgeAudio.description: Trim the two protected H3 audio contexts, conform the generated middle to its 24 fps picture span, and concatenate source A + middle + source B on absolute sample boundaries.

source_frames.tooltip: Decoded source video frames. They are normalized to the same 24-fps mapping used by the context node.

fps.tooltip: Use 24 for MiniMax H3. Audio is forced to the exact integer-sample duration implied by each image batch before concatenation.

crop.tooltip: Must match the crop setting used by H3 Existing Video Masked Context so the prepended source and conditioning tail use the identical spatial transform.

MiniMaxH3AssembleExtension.name: MiniMaxH3AssembleExtension
MiniMaxH3AssembleExtension.description: Concatenate the canonical source and the trimmed H3 continuation. No crossfade: both audio pieces are resampled/matched to exact frame durations first so the join cannot accumulate AV drift.

continuation_images.tooltip: Decoded H3 output frames (full timeline, all frames).

source_frames.tooltip: Decoded source video frames. Normalized using the same 24-fps mapping the context node used.

insert_frame.tooltip: Wire from the insert_frame output of H3 Existing Video Masked Context.

preserved_frames.tooltip: Wire from the preserved_frames output of H3 Existing Video Masked Context.

fps.tooltip: Use 24 for MiniMax H3.

crop.tooltip: Must match the crop setting used by H3 Existing Video Masked Context.

MiniMaxH3AssembleInterior.name: MiniMaxH3AssembleInterior
MiniMaxH3AssembleInterior.description: Splice the canonical source frames and audio back over the interior preserved interval in the decoded H3 continuation. Hard-cut splice with exact AV accounting. Required output path for interior inserts because the causal VAE cannot exactly round-trip interior latent regions.

MiniMaxH3AttachLoRAWindowsT8.name: MiniMaxH3AttachLoRAWindowsT8
MiniMaxH3AttachLoRAWindowsT8.display_name: H3 Multi LoRA Windows / 多LoRA区间条件 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3AttentionHooksT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AttentionHooksT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AttentionHooksT8Advanced.description: Expose standard attn1 and attn1-output patch hooks on older H3 cores. Native hook support is preserved. Official H3 Sol/SLA/VSA producers are adapted locally: VSA tiles and coarse gates remain active. Calls with hooks materialize full QKV and may use more VRAM; calls without hooks retain the original chunked producer.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

audio_mode.tooltip: lock_source preserves source latent; remix_source denoises it; reference_only/native generate target audio.

add_source_as_reference.tooltip: Presents drive_audio to Qwen/DiT as an official <Audio N> reference.

prompt_primary_audio_ordinal.tooltip: Prompt audio ordinal intended as the primary source; remapped after video soundtracks. Use 0 to disable.

final_audio.tooltip: Optional clean/stem track passed through for final mux; defaults to drive_audio.

allow_above_reference_area.tooltip: Legacy workflow compatibility input. Canvases above the 1920x1088 reference area are now allowed regardless of this value and only emit a VRAM/runtime warning.

MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3AudioConditioningT8.description: Unified native H3 T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Ref2VA/hybrid conditioning with correct media tags and source-audio control.

MiniMaxH3AudioFirstLockAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioFirstLockAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioFirstLockAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 AudioFirst · 实际成片锁音审计
MiniMaxH3AudioFirstLockAuditEXPT8.description: Tiny完成denoised_output→SourceAVPrepare regenerate/lock strict→实际完整视频denoised_output。核三LATENT时钟、原音频绑定、mask1/0、finite及固定2e-5；原样返回实际最终输出，不替换音频，不代替完整成片人审。

MiniMaxH3AudioFirstProjectionEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioFirstProjectionEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioFirstProjectionEXPT8.description: 复用完整场景embedding，CLIP零次。T2VA或单首帧；有首帧时用原图/VAE重新编码32×32，不能缩放原latent冒充。帧数来自完整AV。多参考/空间/已编译窗条件保留旧路线，不静默丢弃。

video_frame_count.tooltip: 0 skips A/V boundary comparison; otherwise use the decoded frame count.

MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Integrity Audit / 音频完整性审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3AudioIntegrityAuditT8Advanced.description: CPU-only, report-only audit for opening discontinuities, tail/head similarity, DC jumps, clipping, exact samples and optional video-boundary mismatch. It never repairs or modifies the audio.

MiniMaxH3AudioLatentControlT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioLatentControlT8
MiniMaxH3AudioLatentControlT8.description: Injects source audio once and preserves an existing video noise mask.

MiniMaxH3AudioOnlyConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioOnlyConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioOnlyConditioningEXPT8.description: 新独立入口，不改旧图。来源按输入slot顺序，原生positive/AV latent与raw text recipe供外置Sampler/Bridge/EAV/Relay。仅明确Ref2VA音频参考路径，画质/声纹待验。

MiniMaxH3AudioOnlyReferenceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioOnlyReferenceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioOnlyReferenceEXPT8.description: 明确原声来源，Qwen可看参考RGB，DiT只接音频latent。paired视频保留来源标记；不调用video VAE、不把声纹参考当DRIVE或FINAL。

mute_first_frames.tooltip: 对应开头N帧的声音置零，保留时长；太大会削掉首字。

fade_in_ms.tooltip: 静音后半余弦淡入；N=0时仅淡入。不做全片降噪或归一化。

fps.tooltip: 必须与视频一致；支持30000/1001。

MiniMaxH3AudioOpeningMuteFadeT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioOpeningMuteFadeT8
MiniMaxH3AudioOpeningMuteFadeT8.display_name: T8 开头音频静音＋淡入（AUDIO）

MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Perceptual Drift Audit / 音色远近漂移审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3AudioPerceptualDriftAuditT8Adva.description: CPU-only, report-only comparison of a synchronized candidate against a reference. It marks persistent spectral-envelope and level drift for human review; it does not diagnose distance, reverb or speaker identity.

previous_end_row.tooltip: 0 uses actual source end; otherwise select an explicit end row.

MiniMaxH3AudioPrefixCarryEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioPrefixCarryEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioPrefixCarryEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Carry / 生成尾音前缀接续 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3AudioPrefixCarryEXPT8.description: Copies explicitly selected previous AV audio rows into the next target and pins its actual audio mask. 0 rows is off; native H3 uses about40audio rows/second. Does not turn voice-reference tags into a latent pin or edit final PCM.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Audit / 音频精修前置审计 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only audit for an exact uncached MiniMax H3 joint-AV audio refinement tail. ALLOW is only a mechanical precondition; protected audio, unvalidated patches, and insufficient telemetry ABSTAIN.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Separate Tail Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageAuditEXPT.description: Recheck source and signed stage boundary after the existing external sampler. ABSTAIN must return original AV unchanged. Candidate audio is not accepted here; the existing Quality Gate and human listening remain authoritative.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Refine compatibility · Bind Separate Tail (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatStageBindEXPT8.description: Check signed Plan, existing Setup controls, original AV and exact 0-video/1-audio mask without changing MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Empty-SIGMAS abstain remains a no-sample path. No automatic cache or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8A.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Compatibility Plan / 音频精修兼容计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityPlanT8A.description: Builds the fixed four-NFE final audio tail for a signed compatibility route. Total NFE is reported as cost only, never as a training-distribution equivalence claim.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine 4/8-Step Compatibility Route / 音频精修4/8步兼容路由 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilityRouteT8.description: Append-only route for final-latent Audio Refine after Turbo4/8, learned two-pass, PDD, EAV, Prompt Relay and Long Video. The MODEL connected here is the explicit refine MODEL; filenames, sizes and disk hashes are never execution gates.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Compatibility Setup / 音频精修兼容装配 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineCompatibilitySetupT8.description: Revalidates the compatibility route, Relay/Long Video ownership when present, conditioning, final AV latent and resources, then emits the uncached four-NFE dual-clock audio tail for SamplerCustomAdvanced.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXP.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXP.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Commit Long Context After Freeze (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineContextCommitGateEXP.description: Only let the original long-video context saver write after the frozen native AV checkpoint has been explicitly saved and verified.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Dual-Clock Setup / 音频精修双时钟装配 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockSetupT8Adva.description: Revalidates the signed Plan and assembles deterministic NOISE, a BasicGuider-equivalent GUIDER, the stable T8 dual-clock sampler, exact tail SIGMAS and a nested 0/1 mask. It does not execute the model.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditE.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditE.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Separate Tail Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageAuditE.description: Recheck source and signed stage boundary after the existing external sampler. ABSTAIN must return original AV unchanged. Candidate audio is not accepted here; the existing Quality Gate and human listening remain authoritative.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEX.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEX.display_name: H3 Audio Refine dual_clock · Bind Separate Tail (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualClockStageBindEX.description: Check signed Plan, existing Setup controls, original AV and exact 0-video/1-audio mask without changing MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Empty-SIGMAS abstain remains a no-sample path. No automatic cache or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Dual-Model Setup / 音频精修双模型装配 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelSetupT8Adva.description: Revalidates the signed Audit/Route/Plan, refine MODEL, conditioning, latent and resource gates, then emits the exact uncached dual-clock partial tail for SamplerCustomAdvanced.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditE.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditE.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Separate Tail Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageAuditE.description: Recheck source and signed stage boundary after the existing external sampler. ABSTAIN must return original AV unchanged. Candidate audio is not accepted here; the existing Quality Gate and human listening remain authoritative.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEX.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEX.display_name: H3 Audio Refine dual_model · Bind Separate Tail (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineDualModelStageBindEX.description: Check signed Plan, existing Setup controls, original AV and exact 0-video/1-audio mask without changing MODEL/NOISE/GUIDER/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Empty-SIGMAS abstain remains a no-sample path. No automatic cache or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · External Effects Context (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsBindEXPT8.description: After the existing Audio Refine Stage Bind, expose a source-bound context for separate Relay, Stage EAV and Effects Guider nodes. Never samples or changes noise/masks/SIGMAS. Keep the original Quality Gate. Long tails need their exact window.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsGuiderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsGuiderEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsGuiderEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · External Effects Guider (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineEffectsGuiderEXPT8.description: Connect the effect-patched MODEL to the old external Core sampler. Optional positive accepts separately encoded Relay conditioning paired with this MODEL. Retains the frozen source AV, original sampling controls and cfg=1; no quality approval.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEX.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEX.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Match Frozen Video Frames (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenAVFrameGuardEX.description: Fail before audio refinement when the verified frozen H3 AV does not have this workflow's expected video frame count.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadE.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadE.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Load Verified First Pass (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineFrozenFirstPassLoadE.description: Load only a complete native H3 AV checkpoint whose explicit external manifest, whole-file SHA-256 and audio_refine_firstpass ID match. Empty evidence fails before any tail sampling.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8A.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Long Video Delivery Split / 长视频精修交付分流 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineLongVideoDeliveryT8A.description: Keeps the exact original segment AV latent for continuation and emits a separate reviewed delivery latent whose video is forcibly restored from the original. Never feed delivery_av_latent into the next segment.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Model Route / 音频精修双模型路由 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineModelRouteT8Advanced.description: Binds the audited first-pass MODEL to an explicit same-Turbo or base-without-Turbo refine MODEL using runtime base/patch UUIDs, weight-patch structure and LoRA metadata. Unknown stacks fail closed.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Phase 2 Plan / 音频精修二阶段计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePhase2PlanT8Advanced.description: Builds the signed four-NFE Phase 2 tail for a proven model route. Only the pre-registered 0.35 and 0.50 denoise points are accepted.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Plan / 音频精修尾段计划 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefinePlanT8Advanced.description: Builds a deterministic KSampler-equivalent partial-tail plan with fixed CFG 1, video/audio shifts 12/3, video mask 0, audio mask 1, dual_clock_euler and native_flow. It performs no sampling.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Keep false until you have listened to the saved original/candidate pair.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Audio Refine Quality Gate / 音频精修人工质量门 (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineQualityGateT8Advance.description: Defaults to the original result. It audits decoded candidate audio, rejects invalid shape/rate/duration/non-finite data, and only after explicit human acceptance splices the candidate AUDIO latent into the exact original VIDEO latent. Signal heuristics are review cues, not quality claims.

MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXP.name: MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXP.display_name: H3 Audio Refine · Audit Sample or Abstain (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AudioRefineTailDeliveryAuditEXP.description: For sampled tails, run the original strict two-pass audio audit unchanged. For signed ABSTAIN tails, require exact original AV and pass it through without inventing a sampling mask or claiming an accepted candidate.

report_json.tooltip: 连接已有条件／采样／放大报告，不是提示词，不改变声音。

MiniMaxH3AudioSourceExplanationT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioSourceExplanationT8
MiniMaxH3AudioSourceExplanationT8.display_name: T8 音频来源／缓存说明（只读）

MiniMaxH3AudioTailAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioTailAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioTailAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Tail Audit / 尾音释放实际记录 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3AudioTailReleaseEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioTailReleaseEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AudioTailReleaseEXPT8.display_name: H3 Audio Tail / 后段释放尾音约束 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3AudioTailReleaseEXPT8.description: Opt-in release on actual inpaint/audio-condition masks and T8 dual-clock mask update. Disabled by default. Step is a zero-based actual sigma interval, not a fixed30% recipe. Joint sampling may also change generated pictures. Does not modify source PCM or promise better voice.

MiniMaxH3AudioVAECompatibility.name: MiniMaxH3AudioVAECompatibility
MiniMaxH3AudioVAECompatibility.description: Route an H3 audio VAE through this node before stock H3 audio-reference nodes. Disables generic PCM center cropping only on an unfixed H3 AudioVAE instance. Already-fixed native VAEs are unchanged. Repo-owned audio encodes also do this lazily.

MiniMaxH3AudioWindowT8.name: MiniMaxH3AudioWindowT8
MiniMaxH3AudioWindowT8.description: Slices/pads source AUDIO to an aligned H3 context and returns exact final trim metadata.

MiniMaxH3AuthoredMaskSequenceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AuthoredMaskSequenceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AuthoredMaskSequenceEXPT8.display_name: H3 · 已绘制逐帧MASK / Authored Mask (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3AuthoredMaskSequenceEXPT8.description: 在导演台整片串播中绘制并导出MASK后刷新列表。连接完整原片，按源RGB24校验逐帧MASK；缩放裁时请让画面与MASK共用Source Conform。未画帧为空，不自动跟踪，不改声音。

MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · Deliver Original Recording + Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarDeliveryAuditEXPT8.description: Verify the completed HIGH's recording binding. Return original selected PCM unchanged for explicit final mux, not generated/decoded audio. Accepts saved HIGH without source re-encoding or sampling. Reports latent anchor difference; does not certify trained lip sync, voice identity or quality.

MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · HIGH Handoff — Recording Anchor (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarHighHandoffEXPT8.description: Restore frozen Avatar LOW and external learned lift. Default HIGH source is the bound recording source. Optional HIGH video source/mask may change, but clean audio and zero audio mask must match. Feed common Progressive HIGH/EAV/Relay nodes. No sampling.

MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · LOW Only — Recording Bound (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarLowStageEXPT8.description: Execute only initialized Avatar LOW. Use common Progressive Plan in initialized_av_exp mode and independent LOW EAV/Relay adapters. The completed boundary binds original recording/encoded source; no hidden HIGH or lift.

sampler.tooltip: 连接原生 Setup 的 euler，不使用 dual_clock_euler。

sigmas.tooltip: 完整首采时间表：从 1 到 0，至少 2 步。

upscaler_model.tooltip: models/latent_upscale_models 内的 H3 学习型潜空间放大模型。必须显式选择。

low_evaluations.tooltip: 小画幅的步数。例：完整 8 步中选 6，则放大后还采 2 步。至少留 1 步。

low_scale.tooltip: 小画幅宽高比例，按 32 像素对齐；0.5 不是保证 4 倍加速。

reserve_vram_mib.tooltip: 阶段边界和采样回调检查的显存余量，不代表峰值预测或不会 OOM。

model_hires.tooltip: 可选HIGH阶段MODEL；可独立串联LoRA/注意力补丁，原有补丁保留。结构和AV时钟须匹配；不接沿用model。

guide_resize.tooltip: 首帧LOW参考缩放；preserve_mean显式保持通道均值，HIGH原参考不变。

eav_mode.tooltip: 分阶段EAV使用完整8/20步原视频sigma时钟，CFG1。report_only只测量，apply_exp实际增强；不是画质认证。

eav_start_video_progress.tooltip: 1-原视频sigma；切换分辨率不重置。旧API省略该参数仍保留原0/1合同。

eav_g_hard_limit.tooltip: 真实超限正常报错，不截断或重试。关闭选disabled，tau=0不是关闭。

MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar 录音驱动渐进采样（EXP/T8）
MiniMaxH3AvatarProgressiveEXPT8.description: 人物首帧＋现成录音，经原 Audio Conditioning 的 lock_source 后接此节点。录音通过原生audio mask=0参与采样，不是仅保存时贴音轨；复用原learned3D与clean-anchor。默认LOW4＋HIGH4，支持可选独立HIGH MODEL／LoRA，旧渐进节点仍要求空AV。仅phase1独立单段；不含空间分块，不是同音色生成新台词。指定短片已验收，未知素材／组合需自行验证。

MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Avatar · Bind Encoded Source + Recording (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3AvatarSourceBindEXPT8.description: Bind your selected encoded AV and original PCM. Requires explicit nested AV masks with audio=0, e.g. Audio Latent Control lock. No encoding/sampling; this records your selected pair, not VAE provenance. Keep this neutral source independent of HIGH prompts.

model.tooltip: A native MiniMax H3 diffusion model.

residual_diff_threshold.tooltip: Higher values cache more model forwards and may change the result.

start_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress before which the cache stays in warmup.

end_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress after which the cache is disabled.

max_consecutive_hits.tooltip: Maximum cached forwards before a mandatory refresh.

cache_device.tooltip: CPU saves VRAM; GPU avoids residual transfers.

metric_stride.tooltip: Stride used for the audio/video stability metric. Lower values use more memory.

output_tooltips: The cloned MiniMax H3 model with Block Cache.
MiniMaxH3BlockCacheT8.name: MiniMaxH3BlockCacheT8
MiniMaxH3BlockCacheT8.description: H3-specific F1B0 residual cache. Recomputes the first block and skips later blocks when both audio and video are stable.

MiniMaxH3BranchGuideEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3BranchGuideEXPT8
MiniMaxH3BranchGuideEXPT8.display_name: H3 Branch-safe Guide / 分支安全追加引导 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3BranchGuideEXPT8.description: Append one native image/audio guide to every branch, preserving each branch's own anchors, references and sampling schedule. Opt-in; does not replace Core Add Guide or alter old workflows.

MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 CADS Visual Reference Annealing (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3CADSVisualReferenceT8Advanced.description: Applies the CADS paper formula to MiniMax H3 visual reference/keyframe latents at each denoising step. Audio conditioning and target audio are untouched.

max_steps.tooltip: Cache up to N consecutive steps

chunks.tooltip: FFN 分块数。更大可能降低激活峰值，但会增加 GEMM 调用开销；1 返回原 MODEL。

seq_threshold.tooltip: 只有 packed token 数严格大于该值才分块；等于或低于阈值时保持单次原生 FFN。

MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunk FeedForward / 分块前馈 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkFeedForwardT8Advanced.description: 独立 T8 H3 SwiGLU 分块节点：仅在 packed token 数超过阈值时按 token 轴分块，降低 FFN 激活峰值。chunks=1 是完全不改 MODEL 的旁路。已有 KJ/Sage/Sol、block 或 MLP 补丁不作兼容性硬拦截，仅警告并保留/委托调用；组合风险由使用者承担，不保证兼容或实际省显存。

MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Learned Lift ONE Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedLearnedLiftEXPT8.description: Runs exactly the legacy learned 3D latent upscaler on one sliced first-pass segment. The PASS2 model, conditions, noise and sampler remain external and independent. Does not sample or create a cache receipt.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · External PASS2 EAV (one tile, T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVApplyEXPT8.description: Bind an external Stage EAV Config to exactly one v1-v4 PASS2 segment. Currently accepts only full_frame_safe single-tile plans; multi-tile producer coverage is not certified. Connect the output MODEL to this segment's PASS2 and the runtime to the matching Chunked EAV Audit. The old graph is untouched.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · PASS2 EAV Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2EAVAuditEXPT8.description: Audit the matching full_frame_safe segment's actual EAV forward/attention calls after PASS2. A graph connection alone is not proof of effect coverage.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Prepare Global PASS2 State (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2PrepareEXPT8.description: Prepares v1-v4 original full-source mask and once-only global noise before any PASS2 chunk. This is not sampling or a portable result. Use the same NOISE seed at PASS2. The source first pass must be separately completed; v5 has another contract.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · PASS2 Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual standalone Relay forward and routed-attention calls after this full-clip PASS2. Relay+EAV combined calls belong to the EAV audit.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Bind External PASS2 Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2RelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair the existing external Prompt Relay Plan/Conditioning MODEL, positive and AV template with exactly one v2-v4 full-clip/full-frame PASS2. Validates its native packed layout, model-condition hash and lifted target geometry. v1 temporal chunks and spatial multi-tile need separate local-layout adapters.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Sample ONE PASS2 Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedPass2SegmentEXPT8.description: Samples only this v1-v4 upscaled time segment with independently wired PASS2 MODEL/CONDITIONING/NOISE/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. Keeps the original spatial tile and temporal merge math; pass the prior result for the next segment. Final segment output keeps the exact complete first-pass audio tensor. Stage-specific effects must be wired outside this node and actually audited; no automatic cache or portable result.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked · Slice ONE First-Pass Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedSourceSegmentEXPT8.description: Extracts exactly one pre-upscale AV time segment from a supplied first-pass latent. Use its latent with an external learned upscaler, then a separate PASS2 stage. This node does not sample or prove the supplied first pass completed; v5 joint-4+4 uses a different global-upscale contract and is rejected.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunked Two-Pass Global Noise Plan (v2 Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassGlobalNoisePlanT8.description: Opt-in v2 plan: creates one full target-resolution video-noise field and slices it by exact coordinates. Temporal overlap inherits the previous output only in the explicit guarded_overlap_exp route. The default full_clip_safe route never stitches temporal trajectories. Use full_frame_safe for quality: independent spatial H3 Transformer tiles change local coordinates and remain diagnostic EXP only. Old v1 plans and workflows are unchanged. Audio noise stays zero and the executor returns the exact input audio tensor.

second_pass_audio_policy.tooltip: joint_av_preserve_input matches the upstream model-context behavior but discards refined audio at output; locked_input_audio is a diagnostic alternative.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Complete First Pass + Low-Sigma Refine Plan (v3 Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassLowSigmaPlanT8Adv.description: Corrected append-only v3 route. Complete the first-pass trajectory to sigma zero before learned latent upscale, then connect a separate low-noise schedule. The published workflow uses ComfyUI BasicScheduler(simple, 3 steps, denoise 0.30). The default keeps one full-frame/full-clip H3 trajectory. Joint AV context is sampled during refine, while the exact first-pass audio tensor is returned for delivery. Old v1/v2 nodes and workflows are unchanged.

video_mask_policy.tooltip: Recommended: inherit_required. It refuses an unmasked input instead of silently reopening the full background.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPla.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPla.display_name: MiniMax H3 Mask-Preserving Low-Sigma Refine Plan (v4 Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassMaskedLowSigmaPla.description: Append-only v4 route for a first-pass H3 latent that already carries a nested video noise mask. The learned upscaler resizes only the mask's spatial grid with nearest-exact; the second pass multiplies that mask with spatial and temporal ownership. Mask value 0 protects the original region and 1 permits refinement. Dynamic mismatched time masks are rejected instead of interpolated. The exact first-pass audio is still returned. Old v1/v2/v3 nodes and workflows are unchanged.

target_width.tooltip: 仅target_dimensions模式使用。倍率/面积模式忽略此值；请用width输出连接HIGH条件。连接source_latent时会按aspect_policy计算实际目标尺寸。

target_height.tooltip: 仅target_dimensions模式使用。倍率/面积模式忽略此值；请用height输出连接HIGH条件。实际输出为32像素对齐后的尺寸。

sampling_contract.tooltip: 旧默认只重采视频并保留输入音频。标准4+4选standard_joint_4plus4_exp，并连接Parity Plan的report_json；每窗后4步联合AV，交付二采音频。

parity_report_json.tooltip: 标准4+4模式必接Learned Two-Pass Parity Plan的report_json；旧模式不需要。

size_mode.tooltip: 旧默认手填尺寸；scale_by按源LATENT倍率、target_megapixels按目标面积计算，均使用普通放大节点的数学与32像素对齐规则。

scale_by.tooltip: scale_by模式生效，例如1.5或2.0。必接source_latent，target_width/height在倍率模式不参与计算。

aspect_policy.tooltip: 连接源LATENT时preserve_source保持原比例；honor_dimensions_exp允许按手填尺寸改变比例，仍检查max_anisotropy。旧图不接源时仍保留原手填尺寸。

source_latent.tooltip: 接一采LATENT（标准4+4用denoised_output），用于读取实际原始宽高；不是HIGH条件的LATENT，不改变输入视频或音频。

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunked Two-Pass Plan (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassPlanT8Advanced.description: Plans learned 3D latent upscale followed by temporal-chunk H3 re-sampling. The safe default keeps each temporal chunk full-frame; independent spatial canvases remain explicit EXP. There is no project pixel-area ceiling; memory and runtime remain user-owned. Optional scale_by/target_megapixels sizing reads the actual first-pass LATENT and uses the ordinary learned-upscaler geometry, aspect and 32-pixel alignment rules. Connect width/height outputs to HIGH conditioning to keep its canvas synchronized.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chunked Two-Pass Upscale (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedTwoPassUpscaleT8Advanced.description: Runs learned latent upscale per temporal chunk and restores the exact input audio tensor. Full-frame mode preserves global H3 spatial context; independent spatial tiles are research-only because their content can diverge. Opt-in standard_joint_4plus4_exp instead upscales once, runs four joint AV refine intervals per window, and publishes refined audio. Multiple windows increase total model calls; this is not eight calls for the entire clip.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Segment Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit the paired local Relay MODEL's actual forwards/routed attention after exactly one v1 PASS2 segment. Relay+EAV combined calls belong to the EAV audit, not this standalone report.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Project Relay to ONE Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Project a stock full-clip Prompt Relay Plan/Conditioning onto one native v1 temporal segment, including the previous completed segment's anchor. Requires full_frame_safe and locked input audio; spatial tiles have no Relay certification. Connect a separate instance before each PASS2 segment.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Load Exact Frozen Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentLoadEXPT8.description: Load the explicitly selected completed v1 segment by exact manifest SHA. Recheck the current source/plan/segment and rebind current original full audio. The next segment can run without resampling the frozen one; changed MODEL or CONDITIONING is not treated as an automatic cache hit.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v1 · Freeze ONE Segment (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV1SegmentSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly freeze one completed v1 cumulative video and its original full-audio identity. Copy the returned manifest path and exact SHA. This is not automatic MODEL/conditioning cache reuse. Writing is off by default.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · External Window EAV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVApplyEXPT8.description: Apply a separately editable Stage EAV Config to the exact joint AV PASS2 window, including locked video/audio overlap. Connect its MODEL to the matching PASS2 window and runtime to the audit. Relay composition is not yet qualified.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Window EAV Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5EAVAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual EAV calls after one matching joint AV PASS2 window. A connection alone does not certify effect coverage or image/audio quality.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Global Learned Lift (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5GlobalLiftEXPT8.description: Runs the original learned 3D upscaler exactly once on the complete partial4 denoised_output AV. Does not sample PASS2 or create a portable cache receipt.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · One Joint AV PASS2 Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PASS2WindowEXPT8.description: Runs exactly one standard remaining4 refine window with external MODEL, HIGH CONDITIONING, NOISE, SAMPLER and SIGMAS. Later windows require the prior typed result; final audio is refined joint AV, not first-pass passthrough. Cumulative intermediate outputs are not portable cache receipts.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Prepare Full AV Noise (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5PrepareEXPT8.description: Draws global target video and audio noise once after the global learned lift. All PASS2 windows must consume this same typed live preparation.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Window Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual routed Relay attention calls after the matching v5 PASS2 window. This standalone audit does not certify Relay+EAV composition.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Project External Relay to Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Authenticate a full-clip external Prompt Relay Plan/Conditioning pair, then project its event coordinates and packed AV layout to one actual v5 PASS2 window. The 136-frame first window cannot use an unprojected 141-frame aligned Relay layout. Connect both projected MODEL and CONDITIONING to PASS2.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEX.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEX.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Verify Native Partial4 Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5VerifiedNativeSourceEX.description: Connect every receipt output of the native AV checkpoint Load. Recheck its external manifest, then remove only Load provenance so the original partial4 source identity can bind v5 windows.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Load Exact Frozen Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowLoadEXPT8.description: Load an explicitly selected completed v5 window by exact manifest SHA. Recheck current source, global lift, prepared noise, plan and window number; later windows may run without prior-window sampling. Today's MODEL/conditioning is not claimed equivalent to the frozen execution.

MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Chunked v5 · Freeze ONE Joint AV Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ChunkedV5WindowSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly freeze one completed v5 PASS2 window with cumulative joint AV. Copy both manifest path and exact SHA. This is not automatic MODEL/condition cache reuse.

MiniMaxH3ClearAVNoiseMask.name: MiniMaxH3ClearAVNoiseMask
MiniMaxH3ClearAVNoiseMask.description: Remove the complete nested H3 AV noise mask without changing latent samples. Use this H3-aware node when clearing masks before H3 AV sampling or before rebuilding only one mask stream with H3 Set AV Noise Mask.

projection_path.tooltip: Absolute path or filename under ComfyUI/models/clip_projections. The header is read without loading tensors.

MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 ClipProj Compatibility Audit / 小编码器投影审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3ClipProjCompatibilityAuditT8Adv.description: Passes the connected CLIP through unchanged while auditing a separately installed ComfyUI-ClipProj wrapper, version, projection dimensions, Qwen3-VL declaration, load mode and visual-reference boundary. It never loads an encoder or matrix. Encoder quantization choices do not certify the diffusion MODEL/DiT format.

MiniMaxH3CompleteFaceObserveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3CompleteFaceObserveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3CompleteFaceObserveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Complete Source Observe ONCE (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3CompleteFaceObserveEXPT8.description: All RGB frames through the existing local detector once. Exact source/model/code/clock binding. Missing model, errors or partial coverage are UNKNOWN, never no-face. Select Standard or Parity to preserve its original colour input. No segmentation/identity truth or sampling. Use matching Original Plan from Observation on the true lazy branch.

MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanc.display_name: T8 Context IR Prompt Compiler / IR提示词编译 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ContextIRPromptCompilerT8Advanc.description: Deterministically compiles one reviewed Context IR through the existing T8 Prompt Packet contract. The provider cannot alter local paths or sampling.

MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced.display_name: T8 Context IR Provider / 参考语义理解 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ContextIRProviderT8Advanced.description: Validates a local Context IR by default. External OpenAI-compatible visual analysis is opt-in, requires explicit upload confirmation and reads its API key only from an environment variable. Raw audio is never uploaded.

context_latent.tooltip: The previous clip's saved AV latent, straight from H3 Motion Context Load Latent.

tail_frames.tooltip: Pixel frames to inject, converted to latent steps. Only these lengths are whole numbers of steps: 5/22/39/56 -> 2/7/12/17 steps. Set this to the same value as Motion Context's context_length.

alpha.tooltip: Flat injection strength across the pinned steps.

alpha_end.tooltip: Strength at the last latent step, the one touching the seam.

ramp_steps.tooltip: Latent steps at the end that taper down to alpha_end. Steps are coarse: on a 22-frame window one step is 4 pixel frames, so 2 is roughly the pixel recipe's 3-frame ramp.

noise_scale.tooltip: match_latent_std scales the gaussian to the carried window's own standard deviation, so alpha means the same thing whatever the latent's scale. unit uses raw N(0,1).

MiniMaxH3ContextLatentTaperNoise.name: MiniMaxH3ContextLatentTaperNoise
MiniMaxH3ContextLatentTaperNoise.description: Inject tapered gaussian noise into the tail latent steps of an H3 AV context latent, for H3 Motion Context's context_latent input. Audio passes through untouched. Output is for context_latent only -- do not wire it into a VAE decode.

images.tooltip: The previous clip's decoded frames, exactly what you would otherwise wire straight into H3 Motion Context's context_frames.

tail_frames.tooltip: How many frames at the END of this clip get injected. Motion Context pins the LAST context_length frames, so keep this >= context_length or some pinned frames stay clean. Frames before the window pass through untouched.

alpha.tooltip: Flat injection strength across the window. 0.45 is the validated value. Lower keeps more of the previous clip's appearance; higher pushes the model harder onto the identity references.

alpha_end.tooltip: Strength at the very last frame, the one touching the seam. Must not exceed alpha.

ramp_frames.tooltip: How many frames at the end taper from alpha down to alpha_end. 3 is the validated value: 0.333 / 0.217 / 0.100.

seed.tooltip: Noise pattern seed. One stream feeds every injected frame, so the whole sequence is reproducible from this alone.

pattern.tooltip: poc_chroma_blocks is the validated 6-colour chroma palette. The other two are for experiments and are not validated.

grid_mode.tooltip: poc_36x64 reproduces the reference script bit-for-bit, but only equals 16x16 pixel blocks at 576x1024. block_size holds the block scale constant at any resolution.

block_size.tooltip: Pixel block size when grid_mode is block_size.

MiniMaxH3ContextTaperNoise.name: MiniMaxH3ContextTaperNoise
MiniMaxH3ContextTaperNoise.description: Inject tapered blocky chroma noise into the tail of a context clip before it reaches H3 Motion Context's context_frames. In-graph equivalent of inject_tail_taper.py, minus the mp4 round trip. The result is disposable: never feed it back in as the next link's context.

model.tooltip: The model to apply context windows to during sampling.

context_length.tooltip: The length of the context window in real frames. Must be 17*n + 5.

context_overlap.tooltip: The overlap of the context window in real frames. Must be 17*n + 5.

fuse_method.tooltip: The method to use to fuse the context windows.

freenoise.tooltip: Whether to apply FreeNoise noise shuffling, improves window blending.

split_conds_to_windows.tooltip: Whether to split multiple conditionings (created by ConditionCombine) to each window based on region index.

output_tooltips: The model with context windows applied during sampling.
MiniMaxH3ContextWindows.name: MiniMaxH3ContextWindows
MiniMaxH3ContextWindows.description: Set context windows for MiniMax H3. Windows start on the model's 17-frame chunks to keep video and audio in sync.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationCardEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationCardEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationCardEXPT8.display_name: H3 预览选片·继续／恢复卡（只读）
MiniMaxH3ContinuationCardEXPT8.description: 只接一个经校验Stage/MID或明确RES历史path+SHA。完成态读取0NFE；LOW8→HIGH3、MID4→后4、RES POST4→同轨余4分别显示。不是采样器，不从MP4恢复latent。

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

context_audio.tooltip: video_and_audio continues the generated AV latent. video_only keeps motion context but leaves audio to the selected native/source mode.

first_frame.tooltip: Exact frame 0 for the first segment. Later segments normally ignore it; persistent_identity_reference may reuse it as a compatibility fallback.

first_frame_reuse.tooltip: segment0_only preserves legacy behavior. persistent_identity_reference adds one non-timeline image reference on continuation segments. A connected persistent_identity_image is preferred; otherwise first_frame is reused. This remains experimental, adds reference rows/VRAM, and is not identity lock.

persistent_identity_image.tooltip: Optional continuation-only identity crop. Prefer one clear face or upper-body image. It is ignored on segment 0 and unless first_frame_reuse is set to persistent_identity_reference; first_frame still owns exact frame 0.

persistent_identity_strategy.tooltip: single_reference uses persistent_identity_image when connected, otherwise first_frame. scene_plus_identity supplies both images as separate references; it costs more reference rows/VRAM and remains a gated experiment.

persistent_identity_interval.tooltip: Continuation injection interval. 1 preserves the existing every-segment behavior; 2 injects on continuation segments 1, 3, 5, ... and lets the intermediate segments use motion context only. This is an Experimental identity-versus-motion control, not an adaptive drift detector.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · ONE Phase Conditions (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationConditioningEXPT8.description: Use independent LOW and HIGH nodes/prompts/references. Reuse the original native motion builder without resizing LOW guides twice. Only HIGH locks the completed video prefix. Both phases must retain matching source audio. Accepts external Bridge; for Relay connect projected compiled_prompt, then Continuation Relay Apply.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Prepare Accepted Contexts (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationContextsEXPT8.description: Decode accepted MP4 last39 RGB frames, existing resize then current VAE for LOW motion guides only. HIGH completed AV and shared audio are unchanged. Neutral preparation: no HIGH prompt, model, sampling, accept or timeline update.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Deliver Completed Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationDeliveryEXPT8.description: Revalidate the selected accepted parent and return completed HIGH unchanged. Saved HIGH can load without VAE preparation/LOW/HIGH sampling. mux_audio None means use native decoded generated audio; an explicitly selected PCM is preserved. Does not write candidate, accept, append or compose; no equivalence claim for today's edited recipe and previous job.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External HIGH EAV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Stage EAV Config applied only to this HIGH's typed restart and original clean-source mask. No LOW dependency. Keeps the accepted completed-prefix motion contract.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · HIGH Handoff Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighHandoffEXPT8.description: Bind frozen LOW, external learned3D output and this prepared HIGH. Preserves original video renoise and evolving audio; HIGH's clean prefix is not the noisy restart. No sampling. Original video noise policy: LOW seed+1 modulo uint64. Optional HIGH tail starts at frozen sigma.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · HIGH Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationHighStageEXPT8.description: Only the selected continuation HIGH. Independent MODEL/LoRA, conditions and external phase effects. Native CFG1, original AV/motion clocks. No LOW, lift, loop or auto-accept.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External LOW EAV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Stage EAV Config applied only to this accepted-parent LOW. Retains native motion guides/masks and global 1-sigma clock. disabled preserves the input MODEL object.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · LOW Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationLowStageEXPT8.description: Only this prepared LOW stage. Original accepted-picture motion guides and native CFG1. Independent MODEL/LoRA/NOISE/conditions; no hidden HIGH/learned lift.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Geometry + Stage Plan (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationPlanEXPT8.description: One native initialized Euler schedule and accepted-parent geometry. No HIGH prompt or condition dependency. Independent stages keep original AV clocks; not FastH3/HyperFlow/VDN math. Connect common Progressive Lift Input and external learned3D upscale.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External Relay ONE Phase (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayApplyEXPT8.description: Bind only this phase's prepared motion layout and projected events to its actual MODEL and CONDITIONING. Keep LOW and HIGH independent; no opposite-phase dependency. Apply before continuation EAV. Actual effect calls are recorded by common Progressive Effects Audit nodes.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · External Relay Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationRelayProjectEXPT8.description: Project one external global Relay plan to this accepted window using original absolute motion time. LOW/HIGH may use separate plan nodes. Connect compiled_prompt to the corresponding ONE Phase Conditions before Relay Apply. No encoding/sampling.

MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8.display_name: H3 Continuation · Select Accepted Parent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ContinuationSourceEXPT8.description: Select the existing immediate accepted parent in an output chain. Validates revision, candidate, actual MP4/context bytes and previous job SHA. No VAE, sampling or chain creation. previous_job_sha256 authenticates the selected previous job only; it is NOT proof that today's edited stage models/prompts are the same job. Does not auto-accept or compose.

MiniMaxH3ControlRegionAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ControlRegionAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ControlRegionAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 区域控制 · 采样后审计 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ControlRegionAuditEXPT8.description: after_sampling接对应采样LATENT，再接解码。核实际残差调用/区域行覆盖和未应用原因，不把配置成功冒充采样或画质通过。

action.tooltip: Always run prepare_only first and keep its manifest_json. quarantine moves reviewed files; restore/recover_to_source moves them back.

execution_manifest_json.tooltip: Empty for prepare_only. For quarantine, paste the exact prepared manifest. For restore, the quarantine receipt or original manifest is accepted.

expected_plan_hash.tooltip: Required for every mutating action and must exactly match the reviewed Retention Plan plan_hash.

execution_epoch.tooltip: 0 for prepare_only. Use a new positive integer for quarantine and reuse the same value for restore/recovery.

confirm_action.tooltip: False is non-mutating. Must be enabled explicitly for quarantine, restore or recovery after reviewing paths and hashes.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Bounded CPU read chunk for SHA-256 verification.

MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Artifact Quarantine / 候选文件可恢复隔离 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorArtifactQuarantineT8Adva.description: Append-only executor for a reviewed Creator Retention Plan. prepare_only hashes every proposed file without mutation. quarantine requires the retained manifest, exact plan hash, a new epoch and explicit confirmation, then atomically moves files into output/MiniMaxH3/creator_quarantine. restore/recover_to_source returns them to their original paths. It never permanently deletes files.

MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator × Long Video Run Select / 按后台进度选择镜头 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundRunSelectT8Adv.description: Uses the bound Long Video accepted_count and retry_count to choose the next Creator shot and deterministic seed. It never owns the queue; paused, failed, cancelled, detached or review-only states block downstream generation.

MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator × Long Video Background Start / 创作工作区后台绑定 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorBackgroundStartT8Advance.description: Binds one Creator Workspace hash to the existing proven Long Video background queue/cancel/retry controller. Use only with the Long Video candidate/Auto Accept terminal; review_only remains non-mutating.

MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Resume Plan / 下一候选与继续位置 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorResumePlanT8Advanced.description: Finds the next explicit render, review or retry from an immutable Creator Workspace and optional receipt ledger. It never queues, cancels or deletes.

MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Artifact Retention Plan / 候选保留与拟删除清单 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorRetentionPlanT8Advanced.description: Compiles each shot's retention policy against explicit run receipts. It emits reviewable keep/proposed-delete manifests and never touches the filesystem.

MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Run Receipt / 候选运行回执 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorRunReceiptT8Advanced.description: Records one explicitly observed candidate outcome, attempt, prompt ID, cache observation and artifact metadata. It never probes or mutates the queue/cache.

MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Segment Cache / 创作分段语义缓存计划 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorSegmentCacheT8Advanced.description: Hashes source/model/LoRA/prompt/sampling/effect contracts per shot variant, reports declaration matches (not verified file/cache hits) and scoped invalidation, and proposes LRU quarantine under byte/count limits. It never opens, moves or deletes artifacts, never authorizes runtime cache reuse; accepted media stays protected.

MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Shot Override / 可编辑镜头卡 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorShotOverrideT8Advanced.description: Adds one non-destructive overlay to an existing Studio Timeline shot: prompt, seed variants, media roles, retention and hold metadata. Chain one node per shot.

MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Synchronized A/B / 同步候选对比 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorSynchronizedCompareT8Adv.description: Creates a labelled side-by-side IMAGE batch on CPU, preserving aspect ratio by center padding and trimming only to the shorter frame count. Audio is not compared.

MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Workspace Shot Select / 工作区镜头选择 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceShotSelectT8Adv.description: Selects one run position and one deterministic variant seed for existing H3 Conditioning/Sampler nodes. No hidden queue execution is performed.

MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Creator Workspace / 创作运行窗口 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3CreatorWorkspaceT8Advanced.description: Compiles run-from/run-to selection, variants, retention and hold-map sidecar. It never queues, loads a model, deletes media or changes sampler math.

images.tooltip: Source video frames. Width and height are cropped DOWN to the nearest multiple of 32.

MiniMaxH3CropTo32.name: MiniMaxH3CropTo32
MiniMaxH3CropTo32.description: Center-crop source video frames down to the nearest width and height divisible by 32 and output the resulting dimensions for the H3 target.

conditioning.tooltip: H3 conditioning. The node replaces its complete minimax_keyframes list with the keyframes below.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode each still.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent; defines resolution and exact frame count.

keyframe_state.tooltip: Internal UI state. Normally managed by the keyframe position controls.

MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframes.name: MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframes
MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframes.description: Pin still-image MiniMax H3 keyframes at arbitrary output-frame positions. Starts with 3 keyframes; use + Add keyframe to add more.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent; defines resolution and exact frame count.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode each still.

keyframe_state.tooltip: Internal UI state. Normally managed by the keyframe position controls.

MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframesMasked.name: MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframesMasked
MiniMaxH3CustomKeyframesMasked.description: Hard-preserve still-image keyframes by writing each encoded still directly into the target AV latent and masking those steps from denoising. Pinned positions must be phase-0 to pin exactly one frame: 1, 18, 35, 52, ... in the default 1-based mode; 0, 17, 34, 51, ... in 0-based mode. Interior positions pin the full containing latent step (up to 4 frames of latent protection; decoded pixels may differ). Existing nested H3 AV masks are preserved and merged; a keyframe may not overlap an already protected video step. Audio mask state is preserved unchanged.

runtime_directory.tooltip: 留空使用 ComfyUI/models/DLSS-FI/310.7.0；也可填已安装运行目录。需要 dlssg-worker.exe 和 nvngx_dlssg.dll，不是 DLSS-NR 目录。

cut_frames.tooltip: 硬切后第一帧的索引，从 0 开始，例如 24,48。留空表示无硬切；不会自动识别镜头。

MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DLSSFrameInterpolationEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS 视频插帧 2x (T8 EXP)

MiniMaxH3DLSSNRImageSuperResolutionT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3DLSSNRImageSuperResolutionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRImageSuperResolutionT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS-NR Image / 图片超分 (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRImageSuperResolutionT8Adv.description: Runs each SDR IMAGE independently through the audited external runtime. Supports 1x NR-only or 1.5x/2x/3x SR-only and SR+NR. RGB uses an explicit 8-bit RGBA bridge; alpha and extra channels are resized from the source and reattached. Standard matches the reference wrapper; custom exposes every NR control and v1.3 SR model selector.

probe_mode.tooltip: feature_probe_1_frame：实际运行一帧自检，通过后可接超分。static_only：仅检查文件和环境，不输出可运行句柄。

dxgi_adapter_index.tooltip: 外部程序使用的 Windows 显卡编号，不是显存大小。单显卡一般用 0；必须与 CUDA 选择对应同一张卡。

cuda_device_index.tooltip: ComfyUI/PyTorch 使用的 CUDA 设备编号。单显卡一般用 0；不是 Windows DXGI 编号的同义词。

MiniMaxH3DLSSNRRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS-NR Runtime Audit (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only Windows/RTX audit for a user-supplied, allowlisted DLSS-NR runtime. It verifies the official release archive, installed EXE/DLL byte identity, driver, free VRAM and CUDA/DXGI adapter mapping. It never downloads, installs, unloads models, upgrades drivers or processes media in static-only mode.

MiniMaxH3DLSSNRVideoFileT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DLSSNRVideoFileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRVideoFileT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 DLSS-NR Video File / 文件视频超分 (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DLSSNRVideoFileT8Advanced.description: Streams an untrimmed SDR 8-bit Rec.709 CFR file-backed VIDEO without building a full IMAGE batch. Candidate video is encoded separately, source audio packets are copied and packet/PCM checked, and publication is atomic. HDR, VFR, rotation, crop metadata, odd target sizes and unsupported audio fail closed.
