MiniMaxH3DirectorControlHeadAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorControlHeadAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DirectorControlHeadAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 导演台 · HEAD区域控制审计 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DirectorControlHeadAuditEXPT8.description: 真实HEAD typed Boundary接此节点后再保存或接TAIL。校验原完成收据及区域实际调用；原对象透传，不重采样／抽噪，不授予不可变控制owner或可移植身份。

MiniMaxH3DirectorControlSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorControlSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DirectorControlSourceEXPT8.display_name: H3 导演台 · 控制源时轴与几何 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DirectorControlSourceEXPT8.description: 仅按实际输入FPS选择控制视频帧，保留原RGB尺寸；分别准备目标区域MASK与原源像素crop。没有PTS，不认证VFR时轴，不估计姿态／深度，不处理音频或采样。

detector.tooltip: 人脸检测权重，放到 models/ultralytics/bbox/（如 face_yolov8m.pt）。

confidence.tooltip: 检测阈值。更低更容易抓住侧脸和小脸。

crop_factor.tooltip: 裁剪边长 = 脸高 × 该倍数。2.0–3.0 常用。

canvas_width.tooltip: H3 生成裁剪的宽度。manual 模式按此值。

canvas_height.tooltip: H3 生成裁剪的高度。manual 模式按此值。

canvas_mode.tooltip: manual = 使用上面宽高。auto_capped_768 = 按最大裁剪自适应，上限 768。

select.tooltip: 锁定对象：最大脸，或最靠近画面中心的脸。锁定后按邻近框跟踪。

denoise.tooltip: 裁剪再采的 denoise（BasicScheduler）。H3 不要用 FaceDetailer 的 0.25；模板约 0.40。接了 sigmas 则忽略此项。

steps.tooltip: 脸修采样步数。配合 turbo LoRA 常用 8。接了 sigmas 则忽略。

sampler.tooltip: 脸修采样器。示例工作流常用 euler。

scheduler.tooltip: 脸修调度器。接了 sigmas 则忽略。

seed_mode.tooltip: inherit = 用导演台 seed；offset = seed+1+段号。

paste_region.tooltip: 只贴检测脸框（推荐）。full_crop 会贴整块裁剪，容易露方块。

feather.tooltip: 贴回羽化半径，单位为成片像素。矩形遮罩建议约 24。

sigmas.tooltip: 可选。接线后覆盖步数 / 调度器 / denoise。

MiniMaxH3DirectorFaceRefine.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorFaceRefine
MiniMaxH3DirectorFaceRefine.description: Connect to Director.face_refine. Director then face-refines the final decoded segment (after Director Refine if that is also connected). images is the stitched result; images_pre_face_refine is the video before stitch when Director「输出修脸前」is on. Unconnected Director is unchanged. Requires ultralytics + a face YOLO weight.

prompt.tooltip: Prompt for this group (can connect an expand/rewrite node).

duration_sec.tooltip: Clip duration in seconds (snapped to MiniMax 17k+5 frames @ fps).

first_frame.tooltip: Optional first frame → i2v / fl2v. Official FL2VA also allows last-only.

last_frame.tooltip: Optional last frame → fl2v (alone or with first_frame).

MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupImageToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupImageToVideo
MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupImageToVideo.display_name: MiniMax H3 Director Group (Image to Video)
MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupImageToVideo.description: Pack one MiniMax H3 Image to Video group for Director.i2v_groups. No frames = t2v; first only = i2v; last only / first+last = fl2v. Output size is controlled by the Director node (not this packer). Connect `group` to Director (single) or Groups Combine (batch).

prompt.tooltip: Prompt; use <Picture N> / <Video K> / <Audio J> tags.

duration_sec.tooltip: Clip duration in seconds (snapped to MiniMax 17k+5 frames @ fps).

ref_image_size.tooltip: Per-group ref sizing (Director reads this). match: downscale to the generation pixel area. 1024/1280/1536: cap the long edge, then official max. max: official 2048 short-edge. Default match; smaller is faster.

ref_images.tooltip: Reference images → <Picture N>. Connect to grow another slot.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (→ <Picture N>).

ref_video_audios.tooltip: Soundtrack paired with the same-numbered reference video.

MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupReferenceToVideo.display_name: MiniMax H3 Director Group (Reference to Video)
MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupReferenceToVideo.description: Pack one MiniMax H3 Reference to Video group for Director.r2v_groups. Autogrow slots for images (≤9), videos (≤3), video audios (≤3), audios (≤3) — same as official MiniMax H3 Reference to Video. Output size is controlled by the Director node. Connect `group` to Director (single) or Groups Combine (batch).

groups.tooltip: Director Group slots. Linking the last empty slot adds another.

group.tooltip: One Director Group (Image to Video or Reference to Video).

MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupsCombine.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupsCombine
MiniMaxH3DirectorGroupsCombine.description: Combine multiple Director Group outputs into one list for the Director. Connect a group to grow another empty slot (Autogrow, same as official MiniMax H3 Reference to Video). Empty slots are skipped; order follows connection index (group_0, group_1, …).

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 MODEL; the output is a scoped clone.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

first_frame_noise_aug.display_name: first frame raw noise_aug / 首帧原始混噪值
first_frame_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 value for the first timeline frame, not a calibrated strength percentage. Keep 0.999 unless running a controlled A/B.

last_frame_noise_aug.display_name: last frame raw noise_aug / 尾帧原始混噪值
last_frame_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 value for the last timeline frame, not a calibrated strength percentage. Keep 0.999 unless running a controlled A/B.

reference_visual_noise_aug.display_name: reference raw noise_aug / 普通视觉参考全局值
reference_visual_noise_aug.tooltip: One raw H3 value shared by non-timeline image/video reference blocks; not an independent or calibrated strength percentage.

first_frame_index.tooltip: Actual generated-frame index; -1 keeps the native first endpoint.

last_frame_index.tooltip: Actual generated-frame index; -1 keeps the native last endpoint.

MiniMaxH3DirectorKeyframeConditioningEXP.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorKeyframeConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DirectorKeyframeConditioningEXP.display_name: H3 首中尾关键帧条件 · 可选 Relay (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DirectorKeyframeConditioningEXP.description: 普通提示词无需Relay。连接Plan时复用同一次中间图新编码，绑定实际物理位置；MODEL和positive必须成对使用。旧节点和接口保持。

audio_vae.tooltip: Required for r2v / v2v / rv2v / reference video+audio.

first_frame.tooltip: Optional first keyframe (i2v / fl2v).

last_frame.tooltip: Optional last keyframe (fl2v).

reference_image_0.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 1> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_1.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 2> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_2.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 3> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_3.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 4> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_4.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 5> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_5.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 6> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_6.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 7> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_7.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 8> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

reference_image_8.tooltip: Reference image for <Picture 9> in prompt (r2v). Native aspect; H3 ref_image_size applies at encode time.

MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8
MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8.display_name: 曜石导演台 / Obsidian Director D1 (T8)
MiniMaxH3DirectorProjectT8.description: Open the real director UI using the node button. This D1 node only validates saved projects and compiles contracts on CPU; it never queues generation.

mode.tooltip: refine = 同分辨率二采（精修）。upscale = 先放大到目标画布再二采。latent_upscale = 只放大 H3 latent，不再二采。

upscale_method.tooltip: 仅 mode=upscale。h3_latent = 先按目标画布放大 H3 视频 latent，再二采（下方选 3D 权重）。lanczos = 像素插值；可另接 upscale_model（RealESRGAN 等）。nvidia_rtx_vsr = NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution（需 nvidia-vfx + NVIDIA GPU）。

latent_upscale_model.tooltip: H3 3D latent 放大权重。放到 ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/，目录里的 H3 系权重会自动列出（如 minimax_h3_latent_upscaler_3d_*.safetensors、h3_upscaler_lms_*.safetensors）。mode=latent_upscale，或 upscale + h3_latent 时使用。

sampler.tooltip: 二采采样器。海螺案例用 euler；BasicScheduler 高质量二采常用 res_multistep。

passes.tooltip: 精修次数。1 = 一次二采。upscale 时只有第 1 次放大，之后都是同分辨率精修。latent_upscale 不二采，此值无效。

refine_model.tooltip: Second-pass UNET (二采模型)。不接则用导演台主模型。适合一采挂 Turbo LoRA、二采卸掉或换另一套。

sigmas.tooltip: 二采噪声表。接 Comfy 自带 BasicScheduler 或 ManualSigmas。mode=refine / upscale 时必须接线。BasicScheduler 请接和二采相同的 MODEL（导演台主模型或 refine_model）。H3 的 SigmaShift 仍由 Refine 内部套上。

upscale_model.tooltip: 可选。用「加载放大模型」接入，例如 RealESRGAN_x2plus。仅 mode=upscale 且 upscale_method=lanczos 时使用。不接则纯 lanczos 插值。选 nvidia_rtx_vsr / h3_latent 时忽略此口。

seed_mode.tooltip: 二采种子从哪来。inherit = 跟随导演台（一采和二采用同一个 seed）。offset = 导演台 seed+1（二采和一采错开一号）。independent = 独立种子：只用下方 seed / 生成后控制，不改导演台 seed，确认二采仍可跳过一采。

aspect_ratio.tooltip: 已废弃：二采比例始终跟随导演台一采画布。请只用百万像素控制放大尺寸。

megapixels.tooltip: 放大目标百万像素。比例始终与导演台一采画布相同。例如一采 864×480（16:9），1.8 MP → 1824×1024。

width.tooltip: 自定义宽度（×32）。仅「自定义」时生效。

height.tooltip: 自定义高度（×32）。仅「自定义」时生效。

skip_fl2v.tooltip: 跳过首尾帧（fl2v）镜头的二采/放大。二采会改画面，容易把钉死的首尾帧画飘；默认跳过以保护关键帧。关掉则 fl2v 也走精修 / latent 放大。

confirm_first_pass.tooltip: 先确认一采再二采。默认关：一采完立刻二采（与现在相同）。开：没有一采缓存时只跑一采并写出缓存/_pre.mp4；已有精确匹配的一采缓存（同一 seed、一采参数、SelfLift、Semantic Bridge 接线与 alpha / magnitude_match）则跳过一采只跑二采。seed 请用 fixed，或第二次 Queue 前改回写出缓存时的 seed。Refine 面板「确认二采」与执行层用同一套指纹，不一致时不会跳过一采。

enable_latent_chunking.tooltip: H3 latent 放大的时间分块（省显存，默认关）。开：latent 超过 24 帧时按 24 帧切块、重叠区加权融合，放大网峰值更低，长段不易在这一步 OOM；接缝可能和整段前向不同。≤24 帧仍走整段。关则与现在完全一致。

enable_tiling.tooltip: 二采空间分块（省显存，默认关）。开：沿画面长边切开视频 latent，每步分块前向再叠回；音频整段参与，不切空间。关：整幅一次采样，与现在完全一致。mode=latent_upscale（不二采）时无效。

tile_count.tooltip: 分块数量。越大单块显存越低，但前向次数更多、更慢。1 等同不分块。

tile_overlap.tooltip: 块间重叠，单位为输出像素（步长 64）。越大接缝越轻，单块也越大，省显存越少。

seed.tooltip: 仅 seed_mode=independent 时生效。生成后控制：fixed=每次同一颗；increment=每次+1；decrement=每次-1；randomize=每次随机新种子。都不改导演台一采 seed。

MiniMaxH3DirectorRefine.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorRefine
MiniMaxH3DirectorRefine.description: MiniMax H3 Director Refine: connect to Director.refine. Director.images is the refined / upscaled result; Director.images_pre_refine is the first-pass video (before second sample). Second sample uses SIGMAS from BasicScheduler / ManualSigmas. Upscale canvas keeps the Director first-pass aspect; megapixels sets the enlarge size. Director first-pass stays at its own resolution; Refine target is the enlarge size. width / height are the resolved target canvas (×32). Does not sample by itself — no IMAGE output. confirm_first_pass: first Queue writes first-pass cache; second Queue with the same seed runs refine only.

model.tooltip: RelayVSR UNET。示例：relayvsr_x2_lightx2v_int8_convrot.safetensors。4 倍换成 relayvsr_x4_int8_convrot，并配合同倍数的 Flash VAE。

vae.tooltip: RelayVSR Flash 解码器。2 倍用 relayvsr_flash_vae_x2_fp32.safetensors，4 倍用 relayvsr_flash_vae_x4_fp32.safetensors。倍数必须和 UNET 一致。

seed.tooltip: 放大采样种子。官方示例是 KSampler 自己的种子，不跟随导演台。

steps.tooltip: 官方 RelayVSR 是 1 步。

cfg.tooltip: 官方示例 cfg=1，正负条件接的是同一路。

scheduler.tooltip: 官方示例 simple。

denoise.tooltip: 官方示例 denoise=1。

detail.tooltip: VSR Decode 的 detail。1 是模型完整细节，0 接近低清画面的双三次放大。

MiniMaxH3DirectorRelayVSR.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorRelayVSR
MiniMaxH3DirectorRelayVSR.description: Connect to Director.vsr. Director then upscales each segment with RelayVSR after Refine and FaceRefine, using the official 1-step graph (RelayVSR Conditioning → KSampler → VSR Decode). Audio and frame count pass through. Unconnected Director is unchanged. Pair relayvsr_x2 with flash_vae_x2, or x4 with flash_vae_x4.

split_mode.tooltip: highres_steps = 高清收尾步数（8 步默认 2，即低清 6 + 高清 2）。transition_step = SelfLift 论文的 k（8 步默认 6）。

highres_steps.tooltip: 仅 split_mode=highres_steps。高清阶段步数，建议约为总步数的 25%。

transition_step.tooltip: 仅 split_mode=transition_step。低清前缀步数 k。8 步 turbo 用 6。

lowres_scale.tooltip: 低清画布 = 导演台画布 × 该倍率，再对齐 ×32。1.0 = 不渐进，走原来的一采。

sampler_mode.tooltip: 默认 euler：SelfLift 两阶段都用 Euler（论文路径，s_churn=0）。不改导演台采样器。follow_director = 跟导演台，但必须也是 euler，否则直接报错。

native_low_carry.tooltip: 段间把上一段 native 低清尾写入当前低清前缀（与高清 pin 一起）。关掉则低清前缀只是高清尾再降格，接缝容易闪/糊。导演台未开段间引导时无效。

latent_upscale_model.tooltip: H3 3D latent 放大权重，与 Refine 同一目录：ComfyUI/models/latent_upscale_models/。rho=0（默认）时必选。

latent_upsample.tooltip: 降格 cond / 升采样过渡态 x 的插值。干净端点 x0 走 3D 网。

rho.tooltip: 论文像素锚混合。0 = 只用 3D lift（推荐，避免 VAE 往返）。>0 时解码低清 x0、lanczos 放大像素再编码，按 w_min/w_max 混进 3D 结果。真正的 3D 权重在上面的 latent_upscale_model。

w_min.tooltip: 仅 rho>0。低频区域的像素锚权重。

w_max.tooltip: 仅 rho>0。高频残差区域的像素锚权重。

enable_latent_chunking.tooltip: 3D lift 时间分块（省显存，默认关）。接缝可能和整段前向不同。

enable_tiling.tooltip: 仅高清收尾空间分块（默认关）。低清阶段不分块。音频不切空间。

tile_count.tooltip: 高清分块数量。1 等同不分块。

tile_overlap.tooltip: 块间重叠，单位为输出像素。

model_hires.tooltip: 可选高清阶段 UNET。不接则低清/高清都用导演台主模型。适合低清挂 Turbo、高清换一套。

MiniMaxH3DirectorSelfLift.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorSelfLift
MiniMaxH3DirectorSelfLift.description: Connect to Director.selflift (above refine). Director first-pass becomes low-res prefix + 3D lift + high-res tail on the timeline canvas. Unconnected = current single-stage sample. Refine may still enlarge afterward (upscale / latent_upscale) or stay same-canvas. FaceRefine still runs after decode. Timeline continuity keeps native low-res carry + high-res pin. Euler only. TST is not bundled; patch Director.model if needed.

adapter.default: (将 Semantic Bridge 权重放入 models/semantic_bridge)
adapter.tooltip: Student MLP 权重（约 11MB）。放到 ComfyUI/models/semantic_bridge/。原版蒸馏于 FL2VA；不随本插件分发。

alpha.tooltip: 残差混合强度。C = H + alpha*(S'−H)。原版工作流默认 0.15。

magnitude_match.tooltip: 把 student 输出的向量模长对齐到原 hidden。原版默认开。

MiniMaxH3DirectorSemanticBridge.name: MiniMaxH3DirectorSemanticBridge
MiniMaxH3DirectorSemanticBridge.description: Connect to Director.semantic_bridge (above selflift). Rewrites official cond tokens with the Semantic Bridge student. Unconnected Director is identical. Ref2VA is forced-compat — use with care.

manual_base_sigmas.tooltip: Used only by manual_h3_calibrated. Supply steps+1 strictly descending base-flow sigmas from 1.0 to 0.0.

schedule_label.tooltip: Human-readable provenance; a label is not validation evidence.

MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock AYS Schedule Contract (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3DualClockAYSScheduleT8Advanced.description: Builds the native H3 schedule or imports H3-calibrated base-flow knots, then maps the same knots onto separate video/audio clocks. It does not claim that image-model AYS schedules are valid for MiniMax H3.

MiniMaxH3DualClockEulerSampler.name: MiniMaxH3DualClockEulerSampler
MiniMaxH3DualClockEulerSampler.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock Euler / 双时钟 Euler
MiniMaxH3DualClockEulerSampler.description: MiniMax H3 Euler compatibility node. It delegates to native ComfyUI AV Euler when available and keeps the legacy dual-clock implementation for older ComfyUI versions.

sampler_name.tooltip: dual_clock_euler preserves the original T8 explicit dual-clock path. Other choices use ComfyUI's native MiniMax H3 FLOW_AV protocol.

scheduler.tooltip: native_flow preserves the original shifted uniform H3 flow schedule. beta57 uses ComfyUI's beta scheduler with alpha=0.5 and beta=0.7. Other choices use ComfyUI's built-in scheduler implementation.

MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8.name: MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8
MiniMaxH3DualClockSamplerT8.description: MiniMax H3 sampling setup with separate video/audio clocks. The default dual_clock_euler + native_flow path is unchanged; other ComfyUI samplers use native FLOW_AV support.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

global_prompt.tooltip: Used when Prompt Relay is disabled. With Relay, leave empty or copy the Plan global prompt exactly.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Prompt overrides must be empty when Prompt Relay owns the timeline.

prompt_relay_mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only compiles/projects Relay without attention bias; apply_exp enables the projected route.

eav_mode.tooltip: Stock20 only. report_only audits CFI/g without modifying attention; apply_exp enables target-video FETA gain.

minimum_free_vram_mib.tooltip: Rechecked before every segment; this is a start floor, not a peak guarantee.

source_motion.tooltip: Dance RGB motion source. Read a different source interval per segment; generated continuity is separate.

color_match.tooltip: Match each continuation to the accepted RGB tail; bounded color correction only, not geometry repair.

video_context_mode.tooltip: EXP: constrain high-pass overlap to the accepted final tail. Ramp mode releases three latent cells at 0.25/0.5/0.75. Audio unchanged; inspect the full continuation.

low_context_source.tooltip: Accepted picture: re-encode the previous accepted movie tail for LOW video guidance only. Adds a short VAE encode, no sampling steps. New chain_id when switching. Example reviewed at 0.4MP/8s/22 context/4+4.

color_match_mode.tooltip: Temporal mode suppresses short RGB flicker in the first12 continuation frames. Motion Color EXP additionally corrects confident, bracketed local color outliers; requires OpenCV. No frame blending, geometry or audio changes; new chain_id required.

MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 双MODEL潜空间放大长视频 / Dual Model Long Video (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3DualModelLongVideoEXPT8.description: Serial low-resolution first MODEL → learned latent upscale → independent high-resolution second MODEL. Each MODEL can have its own LoRA. Width/height are final resolution; low_width/low_height are first pass. Authenticated T8 LowVRAM Attention and ChunkFFN nodes may be connected independently to either MODEL. Auto audio continues joint AV for partial4+4; only complete Stock20 first-pass audio is locked. Both spatial continuations use completed output audio. Older partial first_pass zero-lock settings are migrated. EAV requires coarse_steps20; disable it for4+4. Resume verifies content, not filenames.

source_duration_seconds.tooltip: 0 means unknown; the Audio Window node reads it from AUDIO.

accept_true_cfg_cost.tooltip: Required for the two-branch true-CFG experiment.

accept_turbo_guidance_ood.tooltip: Required before applying a non-identity guidance curve to an 8-step Turbo profile.

MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dynamic Guidance / 动态引导 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DynamicCFGGuiderT8Advanced.description: Default-pass-through H3 guider. single_condition_gain_exp applies one device-side sigma-dependent gain to the BasicGuider route and is not true CFG. true_cfg_exp requires a layout-matched negative and explicit cost consent.

MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dynamic Guidance Audit / 动态引导审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3DynamicGuidanceAuditT8Advanced.description: Place after sampling. It reports observed guider calls, physical model forwards and cond/uncond branch batching without modifying the AV latent.

MiniMaxH3Easy.name: MiniMaxH3Easy
MiniMaxH3Easy.description: One MiniMax H3 node for text, image, reference-video, and digital-human workflows.

MiniMaxH3EasyAspectRatio.name: MiniMaxH3EasyAspectRatio
MiniMaxH3EasyAspectRatio.description: Keep downstream resolution selectors aligned with MiniMax H3 Easy without copying width or height.

MiniMaxH3EasyContextSegments.name: MiniMaxH3EasyContextSegments
MiniMaxH3EasyContextSegments.description: Prepare a Context Segment plan for MiniMax H3. Select the audio mode; Digital Human uses one Media audio track as a locked external driver, or falls back to normal generated-audio/reference processing when no audio is supplied. Connect the H3 Context output to MiniMax H3 Easy Segment Sample.

ref_image_size.tooltip: Official strategy keeps the VAE reference short edge within 1024-2048 pixels. Fixed short-edge modes resize it to 1024, 1536 or 2048 pixels, including upscaling small pictures. Text-encoder references always use a 1024-pixel short edge. Independent of output resolution.

MiniMaxH3EasyImage.name: MiniMaxH3EasyImage
MiniMaxH3EasyImage.description: H3 Image: text-to-image without references, image editing with references. Connect H3 Image Context to Easy Image Output, then use a standard sampler at 6 steps, CFG 1, Euler / Simple.

MiniMaxH3EasyImageLoader.name: MiniMaxH3EasyImageLoader
MiniMaxH3EasyImageLoader.description: Load the H3 Image transformer, shared H3 text encoder and dedicated image VAE.

MiniMaxH3EasyImageOutput.name: MiniMaxH3EasyImageOutput
MiniMaxH3EasyImageOutput.description: Unpack H3 Image conditioning, zero negative conditioning, image latent and VAE for standard sampling and decoding.

latent.tooltip: Input MiniMax H3 latent.

model_name.tooltip: Latent upscaler checkpoint.

mode.tooltip: How the output size is selected.

align.tooltip: Output pixel-grid alignment; 32 is recommended for H3.

enable_chunking.tooltip: Use temporal overlap blending for long clips.

output_tooltips: Upscaled H3 latent.
MiniMaxH3EasyLatentUpscaler3D.name: MiniMaxH3EasyLatentUpscaler3D

MiniMaxH3EasyLoader.name: MiniMaxH3EasyLoader
MiniMaxH3EasyLoader.description: Load either or both MiniMax H3 transformers, plus the text encoder and both AV VAEs.

MiniMaxH3EasyMediaBridge.name: MiniMaxH3EasyMediaBridge
MiniMaxH3EasyMediaBridge.description: Collect explicit image, video and audio inputs for API-friendly MiniMax H3 workflows.

MiniMaxH3EasyMediaLoader.name: MiniMaxH3EasyMediaLoader
MiniMaxH3EasyMediaLoader.description: Load enabled image, audio, and video references from ComfyUI input in their displayed order. Disabled media stays in the saved list without being loaded. Video components are reused through ComfyUI's node cache.

MiniMaxH3EasyMediaSplitter.name: MiniMaxH3EasyMediaSplitter
MiniMaxH3EasyMediaSplitter.description: Split one Media Bundle into standard IMAGE, VIDEO, and AUDIO outputs. Set the counts to expose the resources you want to use downstream; choose whether missing requested outputs should keep the original blocked-branch behavior or return None.

MiniMaxH3EasyModelAdapter.name: MiniMaxH3EasyModelAdapter
MiniMaxH3EasyModelAdapter.description: Assemble standard ComfyUI MODEL, CLIP and VAE outputs into a MiniMax H3 bundle.

MiniMaxH3EasyOutput.name: MiniMaxH3EasyOutput
MiniMaxH3EasyOutput.description: Unpack MiniMax H3 conditioning, AV latent, VAEs, and FPS.

MiniMaxH3EasySampler.name: MiniMaxH3EasySampler
MiniMaxH3EasySampler.description: Sample a normal MiniMax H3 Easy context. Without a Sampling plan this is equivalent to the ordinary Basic Guider path; connect a strategy such as SelfLift to switch execution.

MiniMaxH3EasySecondPassConditioning.name: MiniMaxH3EasySecondPassConditioning
MiniMaxH3EasySecondPassConditioning.display_name: MiniMax H3 Easy Second Pass Conditioning
MiniMaxH3EasySecondPassConditioning.description: Re-encode I2V/FL2V keyframes at the second-pass resolution while preserving text and reference-media conditioning.

MiniMaxH3EasySegmentCollect.name: MiniMaxH3EasySegmentCollect
MiniMaxH3EasySegmentCollect.description: Connect only the final Segment Step, then pass the complete chain to Segment Decode.

MiniMaxH3EasySegmentDecode.name: MiniMaxH3EasySegmentDecode
MiniMaxH3EasySegmentDecode.description: Decode Context Segment frames one segment at a time and return the complete VIDEO with muxed audio.

MiniMaxH3EasySegmentRefine.name: MiniMaxH3EasySegmentRefine
MiniMaxH3EasySegmentRefine.description: Run a resolution-aware second pass per context segment. Each segment keeps its own prompt and media references, then passes its refined tail to the next segment. Use tiled_low_vram to sample a high-resolution segment in spatial tiles.

MiniMaxH3EasySegmentRender.name: MiniMaxH3EasySegmentRender
MiniMaxH3EasySegmentRender.description: Sample the Context Segment plan with MotionContext-style latent continuity. Connect the result to Segment Decode for a preview or Segment Refine for per-segment second-pass refinement.

MiniMaxH3EasySegmentSampleSetup.name: MiniMaxH3EasySegmentSampleSetup
MiniMaxH3EasySegmentSampleSetup.description: Connect the Context, Model, sampler, and sigmas once, then use the setup on the first Segment Step.

MiniMaxH3EasySegmentStep.name: MiniMaxH3EasySegmentStep
MiniMaxH3EasySegmentStep.description: Process one Context Segment. Connect Sample Setup only to the first step, then chain each next step through Previous segment. Segment order is inferred from the chain; optionally override only this segment's prompt.

MiniMaxH3EasySelectedVideoContext.name: MiniMaxH3EasySelectedVideoContext
MiniMaxH3EasySelectedVideoContext.display_name: MiniMax H3 Easy Selected Video Context
MiniMaxH3EasySelectedVideoContext.description: Prepare a custom one- or multi-segment plan from a selected candidate VIDEO. Connect the H3 Context to Segment Sample, then Segment Refine and Segment Decode.

MiniMaxH3EasySelfLiftStrategy.name: MiniMaxH3EasySelfLiftStrategy
MiniMaxH3EasySelfLiftStrategy.description: Create a progressive-resolution SelfLift sampling strategy. Connect it to the optional Sampling plan input of MiniMax H3 Easy Sample, Segment Sample, or Sample Setup.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video Runtime Audit (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoAuditT8Advanced.description: Place after sampling. It verifies the selected schedule forward count, all 50 H3 DiT attention measurements, observed g range, and chunk workspace without changing the AV latent.

model.tooltip: Connect DualClock MODEL after MiniMax H3 Block Cache (T8). The first qualified recipe uses CPU cache. Other selected cache devices and callable wrappers are retained with unverified-composition warnings.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact native Stock20 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled preserves the exact BlockCache MODEL; report_only audits FETA without gain; apply_exp enables target-video gain.

tau.tooltip: Experimental FETA weight; 4 is a candidate, not an H3 optimum.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoBlockCacheComposer.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoBlockCacheComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoBlockCacheComposer.description: Explicit Stock20 composer for the separately installed T8 BlockCache. It runs FETA only in blocks that actually execute and audits one measurement on a cache hit versus 50 on a full forward.

model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of the matching Long Video Conditioning node.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact native Stock20 SIGMAS sent to this segment sampler.

context_frames.tooltip: Connect Long Video Planner context_frames (0, 5, 22 or 39).

mode.tooltip: disabled preserves the exact Long Video MODEL; report_only audits FETA without gain; apply_exp enables target-video gain.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video + Long Video (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoLongVideoComposerT.description: Keeps Long Video Conditioning as the scoped layout owner and adds one fresh EAV runtime per Stock20 segment. Segment/context inputs bind resume state and prevent a consumed audit token from leaking across segments.

model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of Prompt Relay Conditioning in apply_exp with at least two active events. For turbo8_alpha8, apply the corrected Alpha8 bypass LoRA after Relay and before this composer.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled preserves Prompt Relay exactly and disables only EAV; report_only measures FETA after Relay without scaling; apply_exp enables the target-video gain.

tau.tooltip: Experimental FETA weight; 4 is a candidate, not an H3 optimum.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

sampling_profile.tooltip: stock20 supports the bound visual/reference task. turbo8_alpha8 is strictly limited to T2VA with the corrected 208-hook bypass LoRA.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayCompose.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayCompose.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video + Prompt Relay (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoPromptRelayCompose.description: Explicitly replaces one authenticated Prompt Relay wrapper with a single combined owner. Relay performs its local-event attention route first; FETA then scales only target-video output rows. It does not add model forwards.

model.tooltip: Connect an unpatched native Stock20 H3 model. LoRA, Prompt Relay, Sage, BlockCache, STG, Long Video and model-Hybrid artifacts remain rejected.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact 20-step Stock20 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only audits without modifying output; apply_exp enables FETA. tau=0 is not an off switch.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer planning budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video Ref2VA / Hybrid Composer (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoReferenceComposerT.description: Isolated Stock20 composer for native Ref2VA or Hybrid conditioning. It audits the exact reference-segment layout, computes FETA only from target-video Q/K, and never directly scales reference, text, condition, or target-audio rows.

model.tooltip: Connect an unpatched native H3 model. Do not stack standalone STG, BlockCache, Prompt Relay, Sage, Long Video or another guidance hook.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact native Stock20 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled keeps STG active but disables only EAV for a controlled baseline; report_only measures FETA on both branches; apply_exp also enables the target-video gain.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not total workflow VRAM.

stg_scale.tooltip: Strength of the extra weak-branch guidance. 0.35 is a conservative starting point, not a universal quality optimum.

stg_double_blocks.tooltip: Comma-separated H3 double blocks skipped only by the weak branch.

shift_video.tooltip: Must match the native H3 video clock used by the schedule.

rescale.tooltip: Must remain 0; shared AV global-std rescale is not validated.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSTGComposerT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSTGComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSTGComposerT8Advan.description: One explicit Stock20 owner for target-video FETA and skip-block STG. FETA is applied consistently to both the main and weak branches; the runtime audit verifies the exact extra joint audio-video forwards.

model.tooltip: Connect the H3 stack to run. Attention-owner conflicts remain explicit, but LoRA identity, hook count and strength do not block loading.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

task_scope.tooltip: visual: T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA. reference: Ref2VA/Hybrid and Stock20 only. Scope is explicit so task routing cannot silently drift.

mode.tooltip: disabled returns the original model and runs neither Sage nor FETA. report_only still runs Sage but does not apply the FETA gain. apply_exp runs both.

tau.tooltip: Experimental FETA weight; 4 is a candidate, not an H3 optimum.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: FETA score-buffer budget only; not a whole-workflow VRAM claim.

sampling_profile.tooltip: reference scope is intentionally Stock20-only. visual scope also supports the Turbo8 schedule; LoRA identity is diagnostic only.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Enhance-A-Video + Strict Sage (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoSageComposerT8Adva.description: Owns both the H3 FETA route and a strict SageAttention HND backend. External callable patches are retained with user-risk warnings. Real strict Sage kernel errors propagate without hidden PyTorch retry; external owners may bypass this node's optimization.

model.tooltip: Connect the H3 model stack you want to run. LoRA hook count, strength, model identity and base family are reported but never used as load gates.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the exact Stock20 or Turbo8 SIGMAS sent to the sampler.

mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only measures CFI/g without changing the output; apply_exp enables the experimental gain. tau=0 is not off.

tau.tooltip: Paper enhancement weight. 4 is an upstream candidate, not a validated H3 optimum; always compare against disabled/report_only with the same seed.

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: Upper planning budget for chunked temporal score buffers. This is not a whole-workflow VRAM guarantee.

g_hard_limit.tooltip: Fail closed when the observed gain exceeds this value. The node refuses the run instead of silently clamping and calling it paper-equivalent.

sampling_profile.tooltip: Select the expected sigma schedule. Existing LoRA details are diagnostic only; incompatible user-selected models fail only in real execution.

MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnhanceAVideoT8Advanced.description: Experimental H3 full-3D adapter for Enhance-A-Video/FETA. It computes the paper temporal CFI only from target-video Q/K, in exact low-memory chunks, and directly scales only target-video attention output rows.

MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Environment Audit / 环境兼容审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3EnvironmentAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only audit of the current ComfyUI H3 core, known fix ancestry, VAE chunking/tiled-decode contracts, wrapper ownership, DynamicVRAM and a requested workload. When Sage is selected it also preserves the exact package/core import, KJ-required symbols and CUDA-architecture probe evidence. It never patches, unloads, downloads, runs an attention kernel, or changes settings.

latent.tooltip: Target H3 AV latent (for example from MiniMax H3 Reference to Video).

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

source_frames.tooltip: Decoded source video frames. The node converts CFR timing to H3's 24 fps.

source_audio.tooltip: Audio from the same source video. Mono is duplicated to stereo; multichannel must be downmixed first.

source_fps.tooltip: Source-frame FPS. Use CFR or a decoder-normalized frame stream; the example forces 24 fps.

context_length.tooltip: AV prefixes snap to shared H3 video+audio boundaries: 39/90/141/192/... frames.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Half-cosine release across the final audio-latent context ticks. 0 = hard audio mask; 8 = 0.2 s at H3's 40 Hz audio latent rate.

insert_frame.tooltip: Pixel frame where the preserved segment begins in the target latent. Snaps down to the nearest multiple of 17 (latent phase grid). Multiples of 51 also align the audio clock exactly. 0 is the original prefix behavior.

MiniMaxH3ExistingVideoMaskedContext.name: MiniMaxH3ExistingVideoMaskedContext
MiniMaxH3ExistingVideoMaskedContext.description: Prepare an existing decoded video as an exact preserved H3 AV segment. The source tail is normalized to H3 timing, VAE-encoded into the target latent at insert_frame, and protected with a per-stream denoise mask so H3 generates only the surrounding portions. Use H3 Assemble Interior Insert as the output path for interior inserts.
output_tooltips: Target AV latent with the preserved source segment written in and a denoise mask applied. Connect to the H3 sampler.
Frames to trim from the start of the generated output. Equals preserved_frames for prefix inserts (insert_frame=0); 0 for interior inserts. Wire to H3 Assemble Existing Video Extension.
Actual insert position used after snapping DOWN to the nearest multiple of 17. Wire to H3 Assemble Interior Insert.
Number of source frames preserved in the latent. Wire to H3 Assemble Interior Insert.

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 Ref2VA model. Evaluated only while MODE is REF2VA.

width.tooltip: Manual resolution width, also used as Auto fallback when no internal image reference is loaded.

height.tooltip: Manual resolution height, also used as Auto fallback when no internal image reference is loaded.

resolution_mode.tooltip: Auto uses internal Ref 1 as the aspect-ratio guide; with no internal image references it falls back to width/height.

megapixels.tooltip: Target total pixels for Auto resolution. Auto and Manual canvases use the MiniMax H3 32-pixel grid; Auto snaps downward without exceeding the requested pixel budget.

motion_context.tooltip: Ref2VA only: chain clips with Motion Context. Disable for independent random-access clips.

refine_enabled.tooltip: Direct latent upscale/refine mode. Changing this setting invalidates generated clips.

fl2va_model.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 FL2VA model. Evaluated only while MODE is FL2VA.

ref_audio.tooltip: Legacy alias of ref_audio_1. Kept for older workflows; new workflows should prefer ref_audio_1..ref_audio_3.

ref_audio_1.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 standalone reference audio 1. Up to three standalone audio references are supported.

ref_audio_2.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 standalone reference audio 2.

ref_audio_3.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 standalone reference audio 3.

ref_video_1.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 reference video 1 as an IMAGE frame batch. H3 expects 24 fps; use ref_video_fps_1 when the source batch came from another frame rate. Use <Video 1> in prompts.

ref_video_fps_1.tooltip: Optional source FPS from Get Video Components for ref_video_1. When disconnected the Extender assumes the IMAGE batch is already 24 fps.

ref_video_2.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 reference video 2 as an IMAGE frame batch. H3 expects 24 fps; use ref_video_fps_2 when the source batch came from another frame rate. Use <Video 2> in prompts.

ref_video_fps_2.tooltip: Optional source FPS from Get Video Components for ref_video_2. When disconnected the Extender assumes the IMAGE batch is already 24 fps.

ref_video_3.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 reference video 3 as an IMAGE frame batch. H3 expects 24 fps; use ref_video_fps_3 when the source batch came from another frame rate. Use <Video 3> in prompts.

ref_video_fps_3.tooltip: Optional source FPS from Get Video Components for ref_video_3. When disconnected the Extender assumes the IMAGE batch is already 24 fps.

ref_pack.tooltip: Optional external image-reference pack. Connected Ref N slots are imported into the matching internal Ref N slots on Queue; empty slots leave internal references untouched.

prompt_pack.tooltip: Optional external prompt pack. New/changed packs are imported into the normal clip textareas and synchronize the clip count.

sigmas.tooltip: Optional external SIGMAS schedule. When connected, steps/scheduler are ignored; connect the matching patched MODEL upstream.

continue_existing_video.tooltip: Optional existing source video to continue as locked Clip 0. Use a native file-backed Load Video output; choose the working resize on the Clip 0 card.

mode.tooltip: Choose once: generate a T2V/I2V starter, or extend an existing video. The workflow source-video group follows this choice automatically.

MiniMaxH3ExtensionStartMode.name: MiniMaxH3ExtensionStartMode
MiniMaxH3ExtensionStartMode.description: One global switch for the masked AV extension workflow. The user-facing choice is mapped to the internal load_video/generate_starter mode used by the H3 context, canvas, and final-output nodes.

profile.tooltip: 默认档严格复现上游当前默认值；manual才读取下方数值。

auto_vram.tooltip: 让上游运行时根据当前序列与可用显存缩小驻留窗口。

require_external_runtime.tooltip: 上游流式加载器未安装时提前报错。

MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 External BlockSwap Bridge / 流式驻留桥接 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ExternalBlockSwapBridgeT8Advanc.description: Builds a compatible BlockSwap payload for the optional external streaming MiniMaxH3KSampler. It never patches or replaces ComfyUI's official MODEL path.

MiniMaxH3ExternalContextEncodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalContextEncodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalContextEncodeEXPT8.display_name: H3 External · RGB / PCM Context Encode (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ExternalContextEncodeEXPT8.description: Decode the actual adopted integer tail, existing RGB resize then current H3 video VAE. Audio is explicitly unused or same-rate/same-channel stereo PCM reencoded with connected audio VAE. Reencoding is NOT reconstruction of original sampled latent state. Use independent LOW/HIGH instances. Zero diffusion evaluations; no original media modification or mux. Unknown VAE wrappers execute nonportable.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

first_frame.tooltip: Exact frame 0 for the first segment. Later segments normally ignore it; persistent_identity_reference may reuse it as a compatibility fallback.

first_frame_reuse.tooltip: segment0_only preserves legacy behavior. persistent_identity_reference adds one non-timeline image reference on continuation segments. A connected persistent_identity_image is preferred; otherwise first_frame is reused. This remains experimental, adds reference rows/VRAM, and is not identity lock.

persistent_identity_image.tooltip: Optional continuation-only identity crop. Prefer one clear face or upper-body image. It is ignored on segment 0 and unless first_frame_reuse is set to persistent_identity_reference; first_frame still owns exact frame 0.

persistent_identity_strategy.tooltip: single_reference uses persistent_identity_image when connected, otherwise first_frame. scene_plus_identity supplies both images as separate references; it costs more reference rows/VRAM and remains a gated experiment.

persistent_identity_interval.tooltip: Continuation injection interval. 1 preserves the existing every-segment behavior; 2 injects on continuation segments 1, 3, 5, ... and lets the intermediate segments use motion context only. This is an Experimental identity-versus-motion control, not an adaptive drift detector.

MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationConditionin.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationConditionin.display_name: H3 External · ONE Conditions / Model (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationConditionin.description: ONE independently editable native conditioning node for the explicit external RGB/PCM context. Original long-video motion builder and payload patch, not fake accepted native-parent ancestry. Connect ordinary or separated sampler nodes; external EAV/Relay/Bridge remain separate. Returned render includes context frames: explicitly trim that prefix for delivery; no automatic append, adoption or exact-source seam guarantee.

MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationSourceEXPT8.display_name: H3 External · Saved Adopted Take (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ExternalContinuationSourceEXPT8.description: Capture the SAVED manually adopted external take, complete file SHA, actual24fps zero-origin clocks and saved integer trim. Not a generated StageResult/native latent ancestor. No save/adopt/queue/convert/mux. Unsaved Director draft is not used.

MiniMaxH3ExternalMotionEffectsBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalMotionEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalMotionEffectsBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 External · Motion Effects Bind (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ExternalMotionEffectsBindEXPT8.description: Bind the actual external source/context, native motion guides, positive and exact stage AV before stage setup/EAV. Works with external ONE or Relay conditions. For HIGH, bind its own reencoded HIGH context and actual reconciled HIGH AV. Never an accepted native parent/P7 phase. Does not alter LoRA, conditions, masks, audio, sampling or QualityGate; unknown user encoders remain usable/nonportable.

expected_sha256.tooltip: Required SHA256 of the entire external file.

confirm_import.tooltip: Confirm source use and explicit import. Does not certify legal rights or AV synchronization.

MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceAudioImportEXP.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceAudioImportEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceAudioImportEXP.display_name: H3 Reference · Import encoded audio / 外部编码音频导入 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceAudioImportEXP.description: Explicit audio Encode voice reference import. Supply actual prepared float32 stereo 32000Hz PCM, at most 30s. native_exact encodes once; author_10s_native_exact encodes separate 10s native chunks without image-style FP16 casting. Selected latent must match byte-for-byte. No resampling, mono duplication, trimming, inferred synchronization, foreign config execution or LoRA attach. Audio is a reference, not a replacement final soundtrack; existing Save/Route/Apply stay external.

expected_sha256.tooltip: Required SHA256 of the whole external file.

member_ordinal.tooltip: One-based member ordinal; only image Encode members are qualified.

precision_profile.tooltip: Author Encode casts to FP16. Explicit FP16 matching is not native-FP32 bit parity.

confirm_import.tooltip: Confirm you may use this reference and its actual source image. Not a legal certificate.

MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceImageImportEXP.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceImageImportEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceImageImportEXP.display_name: H3 Reference · Import encoded image / 外部编码图像导入 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceImageImportEXP.description: Explicit v4/v5 or RefLoRA-reference-half image import. Actual original RGB at exactly the encoded geometry is re-encoded by the connected native VAE and compared byte-for-byte. No guessed normalization, resize, pooled/trained import, foreign config/path execution or LoRA attach. Only selected latent is loaded; input untouched. Existing Save is create-only; Route/Apply/EAV/Relay stay external.

expected_sha256.tooltip: Required SHA256 of the entire external file.

confirm_import.tooltip: Confirm source use and explicit import. Does not certify legal rights or AV synchronization.

MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceVideoImportEXP.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceVideoImportEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceVideoImportEXP.display_name: H3 Reference · Import encoded video / 外部编码视频导入 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ExternalReferenceVideoImportEXP.description: Explicit video Encode reference import. Supply actual prepared 24fps RGB at exactly the encoded geometry and native 17n+5 frame grid. Fresh connected VAE must match selected bytes; FP16 is explicit. No resize/crop/trim, audio-track import, inferred source PTS, foreign config execution or LoRA attach. Save/Route/Apply remain separate; old image and native loaders stay unchanged.

model.tooltip: 未接其他补丁的原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先 report_only；确认报告后再显式切到 apply_exp。

MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 External · Relay Conditions / Model (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayConditioningEXPT8.description: Original native Long Video Relay conditioning with independently bound external RGB/PCM motion guides. LOW/HIGH use separate contexts/plans/models. report_only keeps numerical Relay disabled but still supplies the native motion MODEL patch. EAV remains a separate stage node. Includes context frames; trim explicitly. No hidden second sampler, append, approval or audio mux.

MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayWindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalRelayWindowEXPT8.description: Project an explicit global Relay Plan against this reencoded external context. generated_start_frame is your independent global Relay clock after the context prefix, not inferred from the external movie/trim or a native accepted ancestor. No adoption or sampling.

MiniMaxH3ExternalStageEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ExternalStageEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ExternalStageEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 External · Stage EAV Apply (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ExternalStageEAVApplyEXPT8.description: External Stage EAV after the original stage setup. Authenticated external RGB/PCM scope and actual native motion payload are rechecked, without fake native ancestry or a forced20-step schedule. Existing Relay delegate is composed; actual completed Stage EAV audit reports coverage. Sampling, SIGMAS, masks and audio remain controlled by your separate original nodes.

MiniMaxH3FaceBranchStageSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceBranchStageSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceBranchStageSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Save Stage ONLY on selected Face branch (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceBranchStageSaveEXPT8.description: Connect the explicit Face Decision. True lazily requests a real completed StageResult and delegates to the unchanged original immutable saver. False does not request the sampler, write an artifact, invent a Stage or return a restore path/SHA. This gate is required for FullSave output roots as well as RGB/AUDIO switches.

MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Cast Merge / 2-3人角色表 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceCastMergeT8Advanced.description: Chains two or three unique character profiles into one in-memory cast. It refuses duplicate IDs and never saves biometric embeddings to disk.

MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Character Profile / 多人角色参考 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceCharacterProfileT8Advanced.description: Builds one in-memory character profile from one or more single-person reference images. OpenCV Zoo YuNet+SFace run on CPU. The embedding is a matching aid, never persistent identity proof.

MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStageAuditEX.name: MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStageAuditEX.display_name: H3 Face · Selected dependency ONLY: H3 Face Parity · Source-Bound Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStageAuditEX.description: Check a sampled Parity/Per-Frame/Sampler-Mask candidate against the current plan, source frames and input AV. Keep original source audio for delivery. Unknown sampler completion stays unverified; no automatic acceptance or quality claim. This independent adapter calls the unchanged operation ONLY as a selected dependency, not an eager output root. Keep its audit in the true lazy delivery branch.

MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStitchEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStitchEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStitchEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Selected dependency ONLY: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Stitch / 原版机制回贴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentParityStitchEXPT8.description: Creates a non-destructive review candidate with the audited upstream mechanics: centred face rectangle, chunk-midpoint 24px source feather and post-warp source-coordinate colour match. Pixels outside the mask are audited bit-exact; audio is not touched. This independent adapter calls the unchanged operation ONLY as a selected dependency, not an eager output root. Keep its audit in the true lazy delivery branch.

MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Selected dependency ONLY: H3 Face · Source-Bound Stage Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStageAuditEXPT8.description: After Stage Sampler/Load, check actual candidate receipt against current Face Plan, source frames and input AV before the existing Stitch node. Input audio mask lock does not guarantee bit-exact sampled audio; deliver the original source audio separately. Does not automatically approve or replace the candidate. This independent adapter calls the unchanged operation ONLY as a selected dependency, not an eager output root. Keep its audit in the true lazy delivery branch.

max_face_mean_abs_delta.tooltip: Frames above this normalized RGB change fall back to the source.

MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStitchEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStitchEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStitchEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Selected dependency ONLY: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Stitch Audit / 脸部回贴审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceDependentStitchEXPT8.description: Creates a review candidate with source-bound geometry, local color matching, per-frame fallback and a bit-exact outside-mask audit. It never overwrites or accepts the source and does not modify audio. This independent adapter calls the unchanged operation ONLY as a selected dependency, not an eager output root. Keep its audit in the true lazy delivery branch.

MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Parity/Window · Bind Local Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceLocalRelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair a local Ref2VA Relay Plan and CONDITIONING with one signed Face repair window. Parent/window mapping remains source-bound. The Plan is local, not a silent slice of global film events. Sampled audio is not the delivered source soundtrack.

MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Parity · Source-Bound Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageAuditEXPT8.description: Check a sampled Parity/Per-Frame/Sampler-Mask candidate against the current plan, source frames and input AV. Keep original source audio for delivery. Unknown sampler completion stays unverified; no automatic acceptance or quality claim.

MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Parity · Bind Separate Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceParityStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind the existing Parity Plan and currently connected MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS/AV. Keeps per-frame denoise and optional sampler-mask patch external. Exact-source default Core er_sde can certify completion; unknown samplers run without portable identity.

audio_policy.tooltip: require_locked refuses a missing or nonzero audio noise mask.

allow_multi_shot_exp.tooltip: Default refuses hard cuts; split the source into shot-local H3 windows.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Latent / 脸部二次生成条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineConditioningT8Advance.description: Strictly replaces only the video stream of an existing H3 AV latent with the VAE-encoded crop sequence. Audio latent and noise-mask objects are preserved; no temporal trim or padding is allowed. Use a native BasicScheduler denoise value for the second pass.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBase.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBaselineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBase.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine MANUAL512 REL Baseline / 人工验收512相对模式基线 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManual512RelativeBase.description: Fail-closed pass-through for the user-selected MANUAL512 REL author-parity v2. It requires a 512x512 crop canvas, crop factor 2.5, 21/51 smoothing, BGR YOLO, crop-derived relative 0.8/0.35 video denoise, locked zero-mask audio and the author's centred-mask/source-space 24/24 stitch. Reports must agree, including any explicit one-frame H3 alignment tail. It does not use proxy scores to replace the candidate and is not a universal quality guarantee.

accepted_subranges.tooltip: Optional 0-based inclusive source-frame ranges. Empty means the planned repair range, but only after confirm_accept is enabled.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face / Object Review · 局部返工选择回贴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineManualReviewT8Advance.description: Accepts a per-frame MASK for faces, objects or other regions. Shows the source window beside the candidate and keeps the complete source timeline by default. Acceptance requires an explicit confirmation and can only touch selected source repair frames inside the supplied changed mask. Context, padding and candidate audio are never accepted automatically.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Latent / 原版机制Latent (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityLatentT8Advance.description: Injects only the crop video latent into an existing MiniMax H3 AV latent. The audio latent and existing mask object are retained exactly. The real source frame batch is encoded directly; the VAE must naturally match the declared H3 latent time. Arbitrary pixel-tail duplication, trim, pad or resize is forbidden.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Plan / 原版机制规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds the isolated upstream-parity crop contract: audited BGR YOLO input, separate 21/51-frame Gaussian center/size smoothing, per-frame float crops and the author's centred FaceDetailer-style mask geometry. The best source crop is only a convenient reference, not identity proof.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Parity Stitch / 原版机制回贴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineParityStitchT8Advance.description: Creates a non-destructive review candidate with the audited upstream mechanics: centred face rectangle, chunk-midpoint 24px source feather and post-warp source-coordinate colour match. Pixels outside the mask are audited bit-exact; audio is not touched.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Per-Frame Denoise / 逐帧去噪 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePerFrameDenoiseT8Adva.description: Applies the audited upstream face-size curve (crop height divided by crop factor) to the video noise mask only. Defaults map a 30px face to 0.8 and a 120px face to 0.35 with 9-frame smoothing. The nested audio mask stays exactly zero.

frames.tooltip: Exact source IMAGE batch at the stated fps.

detector_mode.tooltip: OpenCV YuNet is the recommended real-person CPU route. The isolated anime ONNX route is EXP; manual ROI remains the fallback. No route downloads a model during execution.

scene_cut_threshold.tooltip: Low-resolution RGB mean absolute difference; smoothing resets at every cut.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Plan / 远景脸修复规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefinePlanT8Advanced.description: Builds a shot-aware, source-bound crop plan for a second H3 pass. It never downloads models or accepts a candidate automatically. The default OpenCV YuNet route runs a local MIT-licensed detector on CPU and destroys its detector object after planning; OpenCV may retain process-global CPU allocator pages. Manual ROI and local Ultralytics remain explicit alternatives.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Quality Gate / 候选质量门 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineQualityGateT8Advanced.description: Rejects obvious Face Refine regressions before export. It accepts only continuous runs whose source-relative structure, face delta, measured sharpness and temporal residual all pass conservative proxy thresholds; rejected frames return to the original source. Passing is not identity or quality proof and the result still requires full-video human review.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Sampler-Mask Fix V1.1 / 采样遮罩修正 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerMaskPatchV11T8.description: Optional, disabled by default: the reviewed fixture favored the original route. Disabled returns the exact input MODEL and LATENT unchanged. When enabled, Applies the audited H3 FaceRefine v1.1.1 correction on a cloned MODEL: the video noise mask remains on the sampler path only, held video is re-noised to the current sigma, and the locked audio mask still reaches MiniMax H3 unchanged. The connected latent and denoise report are hash-bound; unsupported models, stale reports and conflicting object patches fail closed.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Sampler / 低去噪双时钟采样 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineSamplerT8Advanced.description: Builds an isolated low-denoise dual-clock schedule for the face-refine second pass. It reuses the stable T8 sampler implementation without changing its source or any existing workflow. Denoise is experimental and not a calibrated strength.

max_face_mean_abs_delta.tooltip: Frames above this normalized RGB change fall back to the source.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Stitch Audit / 脸部回贴审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineStitchAuditT8Advanced.description: Creates a review candidate with source-bound geometry, local color matching, per-frame fallback and a bit-exact outside-mask audit. It never overwrites or accepts the source and does not modify audio.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face / Object Window Extract · 局部返工窗口提取 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowExtractT8Advanc.description: Extracts one contiguous 17n+5 IMAGE window without resizing. Explicit edge padding repeats only the boundary image while the corresponding AUDIO samples remain zero. Generated window audio is never authorized as the final soundtrack.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face / Object Window Plan · 局部返工窗口规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowPlanT8Advanced.description: Plans face or non-face object work with explicit shot-local 24fps H3 windows around 0-based inclusive repair ranges. It binds the source, rejects hard-cut crossings and overlap ambiguity, and never loads a model or accepts a candidate automatically. Empty or disabled plans are exact no-op routes.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8A.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Studio Commit / 人工决策提交 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioCommitT8A.description: Validates the current source-bound candidate again, then atomically records an explicit accept or reject. Accepted overlays are immutable and never overwrite source media. Only after that durable boundary may one next prompt be queued.

commit_barrier.tooltip: Optional Commit report link used only to enforce graph order.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Studio Compose / 已接受窗口合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioComposeT8.description: Rebuilds the full IMAGE timeline from immutable source frames plus accepted Studio overlays. Rejected and pending windows remain exact source. Connect the original complete AUDIO separately when saving the final video.

execution_mode.tooltip: Preview in review_only first. The second mode does not accept by itself; Commit still requires an explicit accept/reject decision.

MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Refine Window Studio Start / 多窗口串行启动 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceRefineWindowStudioStartT8Ad.description: Creates or resumes a source-bound multi-window manifest. review_only never queues work. Explicit accept-and-continue reuses the Long Video OS process lease, retry and cancellation controller and may queue only one next window.

MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Bind External Prompt Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceRelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair a full-clip standard Face refinement Stage with the stock external Relay MODEL/CONDITIONING. The Relay AV checks packed layout only; face-crop AV and untouched source audio stay authoritative. Not for Parity or windows.

MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Source-Bound Stage Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceStageAuditEXPT8.description: After Stage Sampler/Load, check actual candidate receipt against current Face Plan, source frames and input AV before the existing Stitch node. Input audio mask lock does not guarantee bit-exact sampled audio; deliver the original source audio separately. Does not automatically approve or replace the candidate.

MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Bind Separate Refinement Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind existing Face Plan/source and isolated low-denoise MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS to one editable stage. No sampling, VAE encoding or stitching. Standard Face Plan only; other Face variants require separate adapters.

MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Face Track Assign / 轨迹绑定角色 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FaceTrackAssignT8Advanced.description: Binds every shot-local SAM track to a reviewed character profile. CPU SFace suggestions are one-to-one within each shot and fail closed below similarity or margin thresholds. JSON overrides such as {"0:0":"Alice"} are authoritative.

MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Window · Source-Bound Candidate Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageAuditEXPT8.description: Before crop decode and Manual/Studio review, verify the sampled candidate still belongs to the current parent source, repair window, frame map and original/window audio. The sampled audio latent is not the delivered source track; no quality approval.

MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face Window · Bind Separate Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FaceWindowStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind one extracted repair window to its parent frames, signed window plan/mapping and original/window audio before a separate Parity sampler stage. The Manual and Studio review/commit nodes remain external; no automatic acceptance or delivery.

target_images.tooltip: Full smeared extension baseline on the de-rope clock.

source_context_images.tooltip: Previous clip's final recovered real-time context frames.

hold_map.tooltip: hold_map_used from the SAME H3 Time Smear node.

context_frames.tooltip: Real-time starter frames to fan onto the smear clock.

MiniMaxH3FanRecoveredContext.name: MiniMaxH3FanRecoveredContext
MiniMaxH3FanRecoveredContext.description: Fan the previous clip's recovered tail with the exact hold map used by the current H3 Time Smear. The repaired smear feeds the pass-2 init; the seam-nearest native-resolution guide and its exact dynamic target offset feed an interior H3 Motion Context guide.

MiniMaxH3FastH34StepSetupT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FastH34StepSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FastH34StepSetupT8Advanced.description: Configures the published T2VA-only FastH3 4-step DMD2 joint-AV sampling contract. Apply the matching FastH3 LoRA first. Dense ComfyUI attention remains the default; the opt-in VSA profile applies the learned 90%-sparse tile-64 route only when the LoRA gate payload and current Comfy Kitchen VSA kernel contract are both available, otherwise it falls back to dense.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted LOW / HIGH Context Port (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedContextEXPT8.description: Expose one authenticated accepted-parent context to separate native Long Video or Prompt Relay conditioning. LOW is accepted RGB24 resized and VAE-encoded; HIGH is the completed AV tail. No hidden sampler or HIGH dependency on LOW conditions.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowE.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowE.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Remainder Delivery Port (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedDeliveryWindowE.description: Expose the authenticated parent identity and exact final-window AV trim coordinates. For 124+22+68, trim decoded frame 22 onward to 68 fresh frames. Does not trim, save a candidate, accept it or certify the current edited job contract.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted HIGH Prefix After Reconcile (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedHighPrefixEXPT8.description: Apply the old V2 continuation HIGH video prefix and optional three-step mask ramp only after separate learned upscale/reconcile. Keeps the same completed-context source and the reconciled audio tensor; no sampling or delivery is hidden here.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Joint-Audio Reconcile (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedReconcileEXPT8.description: Reproduce the old V2 4+4 continuation legacy-policy audio selection from the learned LOW x0 and fresh HIGH template. Keep separate HIGH prefix node AFTER this reconcile; no hidden sampler or audio-freeze shortcut.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Timeline Relay Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedRelayProjectEXP.description: Project an external global Relay plan using the selected accepted parent's exact timeline; output plugs into separate LOW/HIGH native Long Video Relay conditioning. Requires Dense EXP when Relay is active on V2; trained VSA has no bias adapter yet.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Accepted Remainder Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2AcceptedWindowEXPT8.description: Choose a compact 90-frame remainder or the old loop's fixed 124-frame second render window. Both trim the same 22-context + 68-new delivery; the fixed variant discards a 34-frame suffix. Geometry only; no sampler.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Save Externally Colored Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ColoredCandidateSaveEXP.description: Save only a typed completed-HIGH + external Color Match result as an unaccepted candidate. Keeps the original raw-media candidate writer and sidecar intact.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Completed LOW x0 for Learned Handoff (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CompletedLowX0EXPT8.description: Verify the actual completed V2 LOW 0:4 StageResult and expose its denoised prediction_x0, never unfinished x_sigma. Connect the output to the existing learned 3D latent upscaler, then external reconcile and HIGH 4:8. Accepts an exact frozen LOW result for HIGH-only resume; no sampling here.

model.tooltip: 未接其他补丁的原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须来自同段 Long Video Window 节点。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先 report_only；确认报告后再显式切到 apply_exp。

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Long Video Relay Conditions + Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2ConditionProvenanceEXPT.description: Call the unchanged native Long Video Relay conditioner once, adding a typed origin receipt for actual CLIP/VAEs, first frame, projected plan and output conditions. This alone does not certify a HIGH handoff or accepted parent.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVer.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVerifyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVer.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify Accepted Two-Segment Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentAcceptedChainVer.description: Read-only verification of both accepted 124+68-frame segments, retained source-bound candidates, media/context hashes and one current job SHA before the unchanged long-video composer. Not a quality review.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewA.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewAcceptEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewA.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify, Review & Explicitly Accept (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateReviewA.description: A separate review step for a saved split candidate. Verify its MP4/context, current-job/media sidecar and exact 124/68-frame boundary before calling the unchanged reject-existing manifest transaction. Defaults to preview only; never composes a movie.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Save Bound Candidate, Not Accepted (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentCandidateSaveEXP.description: Only consume the typed completed-HIGH media receipt and current job binding. Use the unchanged durable candidate writer, add a source sidecar and stop before human Review & Accept or composition.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXP.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXP.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify LOW→Upscale→HIGH Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentHandoffAttestEXP.description: Read-only proof of completed LOW x0, one learned 3D call, deterministic HIGH reconcile/prefix and actual HIGH sampler source. Does not accept a segment.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Bind Current Job to Accepted Parent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentJobBindEXPT8.description: Compare the completed two-stage job SHA with the immediate accepted parent's saved job SHA and context/model identities. Segment 0 requires no parent. Does not write, accept or compose a candidate.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Decode + Trim Bound HIGH (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentMediaPrepareEXPT.description: Call the unchanged native AV Decode and Output Trim once, using the authenticated completed HIGH output. Produce exact 124/68-frame media plus a typed source receipt. Does not save or accept a candidate.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Current Editable Recipe Fingerprint (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentRecipeEXPT8.description: Hash the CURRENT two raw MODEL/LoRA branches, CLIP/VAEs, first frame, global Relay plans, external EAV configs and learned-upscaler bytes. This is not the previous accepted job SHA and does NOT attest stage execution, save a candidate or authorize acceptance.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify One Current Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2CurrentStageAttestEXPT8.description: Compare one completed LOW/HIGH StageResult against the current raw MODEL/LoRA, actual sampler MODEL/guider/noise/source/sigmas, projected Relay and EAV. Does not accept or save a segment; both stages and parent delivery require separate gates.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

global_prompt.tooltip: Used when Prompt Relay is disabled. With Relay, leave empty or copy the Plan global prompt exactly.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Prompt overrides must be empty when Prompt Relay owns the timeline.

prompt_relay_mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only compiles/projects Relay without attention bias; apply_exp enables the projected route.

eav_mode.tooltip: Stock20 only. report_only audits CFI/g without modifying attention; apply_exp enables target-video FETA gain.

minimum_free_vram_mib.tooltip: Rechecked before every segment; this is a start floor, not a peak guarantee.

source_motion.tooltip: Dance RGB motion source. Read a different source interval per segment; generated continuity is separate.

color_match.tooltip: Match each continuation to the accepted RGB tail; bounded color correction only, not geometry repair.

video_context_mode.tooltip: EXP: constrain high-pass overlap to the accepted final tail. Ramp mode releases three latent cells at 0.25/0.5/0.75. Audio unchanged; inspect the full continuation.

low_context_source.tooltip: Accepted picture: re-encode the previous accepted movie tail for LOW video guidance only. Adds a short VAE encode, no sampling steps. New chain_id when switching. Example reviewed at 0.4MP/8s/22 context/4+4.

color_match_mode.tooltip: Temporal mode suppresses short RGB flicker in the first12 continuation frames. Motion Color EXP additionally corrects confident, bracketed local color outliers; requires OpenCV. No frame blending, geometry or audio changes; new chain_id required.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleLoadEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Load Exact Frozen LOW Recipe (T8 EXP)
