MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Save Attested Frozen LOW Recipe (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2FrozenLOWBundleSaveEXPT.description: Attach the verified current recipe, executed LOW stage and actual LOW condition receipt to an exact completed Stage Save manifest. Does not change the generic stage artifact or freeze newly edited LOW settings.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Verify Stage + Condition Origin (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2OriginStageAttestEXPT8.description: Require the same executed condition call's typed origin receipt and latent, then bind its CLIP/VAEs/first frame/positive to the completed sampler. Does not certify HIGH handoff, accepted parent, candidate save or assembly.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Actual Dispatch Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2RuntimeAuditEXPT8.description: Wire the sampler output to run after sampling. VSA profiles count sparse dispatch and Dense eligibility failures. Dense compatibility preserves its backend; separate instrumentation is needed to measure its dispatch. Not quality acceptance.

min_tokens.tooltip: Below this packed-token count native VSA runs Dense and reports it; 0 forces eligibility testing.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2SetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2SetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2SetupEXPT8.description: Full V2 student, not a four-step LoRA. Exact DMD8 / shift10+3 / learned VSA20%. Dense compatibility and official Comfy template are separate EXP recipes. Use the existing encoders/VAEs. Model: https://huggingface.co/FastVideo/FastVideo-FastH3-Comfy

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8.display_name: FastH3 V2 · Separate LOW / HIGH Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FastH3V2StageSetupEXPT8.description: Sets up ONE exact DMD stage, never runs a hidden loop. Use two standard SamplerCustomAdvanced nodes and the existing learned upscale/reconcile nodes. Each stage accepts its own MODEL and LoRA chain. LOW uses absolute 0:4; HIGH uses 4:8 with AV shifts 10/3. Split/reference use remains experimental.

aspect_policy.tooltip: preserve_source is the safe default. honor_dimensions_exp permits different X/Y scales but still enforces max_anisotropy.

release_policy.tooltip: offload_after keeps a CPU cache but releases GPU weights; clear_after also removes the CPU cache; keep_loaded is opt-in and retains GPU memory.

MiniMaxH3FastH3V2UpscaleProvenanceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FastH3V2UpscaleProvenanceEXPT8

MiniMaxH3FinalAudioAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FinalAudioAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FinalAudioAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Final Audio Audit / 最终保留音轨核对 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3FinalAudioAuditEXPT8.description: Offline CPU ASR on the final retained PCM. Returns the same AUDIO object: no peak limiter, trim, retime or automatic retry. Select an existing local faster-whisper directory; expected windows use final playback time, not discarded generation overlaps.

MiniMaxH3FinalizeVHSOutput.name: MiniMaxH3FinalizeVHSOutput

MiniMaxH3FiniteAudioTrimTail.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteAudioTrimTail

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopInitialize.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopInitialize
MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopInitialize.description: Initialize native ComfyUI Loop state for a finite H3 segment plan. Connect this to Start Loop's initial_iteration_value.

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopOutput.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopOutput

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopPrepare.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopPrepare
MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopPrepare.description: Prepare one encoded H3 segment for sampling. It carries the preceding latent tail, applies Drift-Control, and locks original or muted video audio when requested by the material plan.

MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopSegment.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopSegment
MiniMaxH3FiniteLoopSegment.description: Resolve the current per-segment material plan, prompt, and overlap. Connect a native Start Loop iteration_index, then feed the plan and prompt to MiniMax H3 Plan Encoder.

MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentSampler.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentSampler
MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentSampler.description: Expand a finite plan into a standard acyclic sampling graph. Sampler and scheduler remain external; no Loop, Loop Variable, or Close Loop nodes are required.

MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentVideoSampler.name: MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentVideoSampler
MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentVideoSampler.display_name: MiniMax H3 有限分段采样(低内存版本)
MiniMaxH3FiniteSegmentVideoSampler.description: Decode and encode one segment at a time in ComfyUI's temporary folder, then join the encoded segments as VIDEO. It does not save latent checkpoints or provide segment reruns.

threshold.tooltip: block0 残差的相对 L1 变化低于这个值就跳过其余 49 层。越大越快、越容易掉细节。0.05 保守 / 0.08 均衡 / 0.12 激进；设 0 完全关闭跳过。

warmup_steps.tooltip: 前 N 步始终全量。早期步决定构图和运动，跳这些步最容易毁画面。

max_consecutive_skips.tooltip: 最多连续跳过几步，之后强制来一次全量刷新缓存。防止误差累积。0 = 不限制。

dense_last_step.tooltip: 最后一步始终全量。末步直接决定输出清晰度，开着基本没有速度损失。

metric_stride.tooltip: 比较残差时的抽行步长。1 = 精确。H3 的残差单份可达数百 MB，显存紧张时设 4~8 能省下大部分缓存占用，判定几乎不受影响。

verbose.tooltip: 在控制台打印每步的命中情况和整段的命中率。调 threshold 时建议先开。

MiniMaxH3FirstBlockCache.name: MiniMaxH3FirstBlockCache
MiniMaxH3FirstBlockCache.description: MiniMax H3 First Block Cache：用第 0 层残差的步间变化预测其余 49 层的变化，变化小就复用上一次的残差，命中一次省掉 49/50 的 block 计算。

ref_image.tooltip: Exactly one reference image, <Picture 1>.

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityLoRAEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityLoRAEXPT8

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityPromptRelayEXPT.display_name: FreeVideo Quality · 外置Prompt Relay条件
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityPromptRelayEXPT.description: 连接现有Plan/Query Route。原生编码并绑定精确token；两个阶段分别接独立计划。保留VDN原window keyset，linear使用显式实验性加权text seed，不冒称论文等价。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualitySamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualitySamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualitySamplerEXPT8.description: Light输出完整LOW8，还需外置放大＋独立HIGH3。其他三档12/16/20单采终态，可直接解码，不接HIGH。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityStageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityStageLoadEXPT8.description: 填写真实v2缓存path/SHA。LOW8可接独立HIGH3，单采或HIGH终态直接解码；旧Stage/MID不互换。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityVideoDecodeEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityVideoDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityVideoDecodeEXPT.display_name: FreeVideo · 独立视频解码 · Quality HIGH／单采
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoQualityVideoDecodeEXPT.description: 只接完整终态；原音频latent原样传出，另接正常音频VAE。独立原FP32 VAE分片与v0.2.3配置；默认eager，compile需显式选择，不自动回退，不改变旧解码或采样。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitHIGHEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitHIGHEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitHIGHEXPT8.display_name: FreeVideo · 分段HIGH 后4步 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitHIGHEXPT8.description: 原8步时序后4步：放大的partial x0按独立seed重新加噪到原index4；真实MID音频继续联合去噪，不冻结。兼容分段路线，非作者8+2配方。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitLOWEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitLOWEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitLOWEXPT8.display_name: FreeVideo · 分段LOW 前4步 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoSplitLOWEXPT8.description: 原8步时序前4步；partial x0接外置learned放大。MID音频仍含噪声，必须接分段HIGH后4步，不能当成片解码。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageLoadEXPT8.display_name: FreeVideo · 冷加载完成阶段 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageLoadEXPT8.description: 填实际保存path和完整SHA，不接受占位/partial或其他家族缓存。Cold HIGH只连接本节点，不连旧LOW。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageSaveEXPT8.display_name: FreeVideo · 保存完成阶段 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoStageSaveEXPT8.description: create-only safetensors+SHA manifest；不覆盖旧缓存。

MiniMaxH3FreeVideoVideoDecodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FreeVideoVideoDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoVideoDecodeEXPT8.display_name: FreeVideo · 独立视频解码 · 原8+2／真4+4 HIGH
MiniMaxH3FreeVideoVideoDecodeEXPT8.description: 只接完整终态；原音频latent原样传出，另接正常音频VAE。独立原FP32 VAE分片与v0.2.3配置；默认eager，compile需显式选择，不自动回退，不改变旧解码或采样。

MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet Apply (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FunControlApplyT8Advanced.description: Drive H3 target video rows with a preprocessed depth, pose or edge video. Returns both MODEL and CONDITIONING so it works on current and future native cores.

MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet Loader (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3FunControlLoaderT8Advanced.description: Load an H3 Fun ControlNet from models/controlnet. Uses the official ComfyUI implementation when available and a clone-scoped fallback on older cores.

mask.tooltip: 1 marks the regions to regenerate.

source_video.tooltip: Video behind the mask; only read when a mask is given.

MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply
MiniMaxH3FunControlNetApply.description: Apply a MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet to a text-to-video model as a model patch.

MiniMaxH3FunControlRegionApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FunControlRegionApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FunControlRegionApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Fun Control · 区域与裁框 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3FunControlRegionApplyEXPT8.description: 可选目标区域MASK与源像素crop JSON。只门控目标视频控制残差，保留原控制塔及其它行贡献；不是最终像素/音频锁。LOW/HIGH各按实际画布接入。普通控制仍用原Apply。

MiniMaxH3FunUnion2ApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FunUnion2ApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FunUnion2ApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Fun Union 2.0 · 源视频＋外置重绘MASK
MiniMaxH3FunUnion2ApplyEXPT8.description: White MASK regenerates; native keep/visibility and post_norm. Align source/control/mask explicitly. Apply to each MODEL stage separately; EAV/Relay external. Joint audio not guaranteed unchanged.

MiniMaxH3FunUnion2LoaderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3FunUnion2LoaderEXPT8
MiniMaxH3FunUnion2LoaderEXPT8.display_name: H3 Fun Union 2.0 · 显式10×5 / post_norm
MiniMaxH3FunUnion2LoaderEXPT8.description: Explicit 10-block 49-channel Union2. Converts raw VideoX-Fun names in memory; delegates Core. Not the legacy 5-block loader.

latent.tooltip: Fresh target AV latent from MiniMax H3 Image/Reference to Video.

source_latent.tooltip: Previous generated H3 AV latent. Its final AV run is copied directly into the new target prefix.

context_length.tooltip: Protected AV prefix. Snaps to shared 24-fps video / 40-Hz audio boundaries: 39/90/141/192/... frames.

audio_feather_ticks.tooltip: Half-cosine release across the final audio-latent context ticks. 0 = hard audio mask; 8 = 0.2 s at H3's 40 Hz audio latent rate.

MiniMaxH3GeneratedAVMaskedContext.name: MiniMaxH3GeneratedAVMaskedContext
MiniMaxH3GeneratedAVMaskedContext.description: Chain generated H3 clips without a decode/re-encode round trip. The previous clip's final joint video/audio latent run is copied into the new target prefix and protected with AV noise-mask 0; only the future region denoises.

MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Generic Loop Capability / 通用循环能力探针 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3GenericLoopCapabilityT8Advanced.description: Read-only detection of the draft ComfyUI Generic Loops scheduler contract. It never enables a draft backend or changes the released T8 long-video runtime.

MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advanced
MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Tiled VAE Coordinate Audit (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3GlobalCoordinateTiledVAET8Advan.description: Audit the upstream global-coordinate tiled-VAE proposal. A real fp16 H3 VAE check regressed grid artifacts, so the safe default reports only and returns the source VAE unchanged.

MiniMaxH3H16EAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16EAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16EAVApplyEXPT8.description: Bind a separately editable EAV config to one exact H16 PASS2 window, including the inherited video mask and prior-window guarded overlap. Connect the MODEL to that window and audit its actual calls. External Relay composition requires a separate local projection.

MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Window EAV Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16EAVAuditEXPT8.description: Audit actual EAV forward and attention calls after this exact H16 window. Returns the H16-selected final audio, not the core video's first-pass-audio intermediate. Connection alone proves no effect.

MiniMaxH3H16Pass2PlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16Pass2PlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16Pass2PlanEXPT8.description: Builds the old H16 v4 full-frame plan from the already completed HIGH input. It does not sample. Connect the same source to Chunked Source/Prepare, then one independent PASS2 node per temporal window.

MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Sample ONE PASS2 Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16Pass2WindowEXPT8.description: Samples one explicit v4 H16 full-frame PASS2 window with external editable MODEL/positive/NOISE/SAMPLER/SIGMAS. The previous window is a typed input. At the final window, refined_exp applies the old absolute-time audio crossfade/quiet-tail policy; merge failure retains first-pass audio. The denoised_output of the old node was only an output alias, not x0.

MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Window Relay Actual Calls (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16RelayAuditEXPT8.description: Audit routed attention and completed forwards for a standalone projected H16 Relay window. For Relay+EAV use the EAV joint audit.

MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Project External Relay to Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16RelayProjectEXPT8.description: Authenticate a full-clip external Relay MODEL/CONDITIONING pair and project its timeline/layout to one exact guarded H16 PASS2 window. Pass both returned MODEL and positive CONDITIONING to that window.

MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Verified Native Resume Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16VerifiedNativeSourceEXPT8.description: Require a native AV checkpoint's exact external manifest and file SHA before removing only its volatile Load provenance for H16 window identity. Never samples or decodes media.

MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H16-3 · Load Exact Frozen Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3H16WindowLoadEXPT8.description: Load an explicitly selected completed H16 window by exact manifest SHA. Rechecks the current source, plan and window number, then restores the typed result for the next window without sampling prior windows. Changed MODEL/conditioning is not treated as an automatic cache hit.

MiniMaxH3H16WindowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3H16WindowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3H16WindowSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly save one completed H16 PASS2 window with its cumulative video and audio history. Copy both returned manifest path and exact SHA. This freezes the selected result; it is not automatic MODEL/conditioning cache reuse.

MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Artifact Builder / 小型混合补丁构建 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactBuilderT8Advanced.description: Builds or reuses a content-addressed 13.8–83.1 MiB FP16 target-slice artifact under ComfyUI/models/h3_hybrid_artifacts. It never copies a complete model and never overwrites a mismatched artifact.

action.tooltip: inspect_only has no side effects. Every other action requires explicit confirmation and a positive, single-use operation epoch.

confirm_action.tooltip: Required for mutation. Files are moved inside models/h3_hybrid_artifacts/_recycle instead of being permanently deleted.

operation_epoch.tooltip: Use a new positive value for each quarantine. Reuse the same value to restore or recover that exact transaction.

stale_after_minutes.tooltip: Only stale build-residue and stale maintenance-lock recovery use this age gate. A lock whose owner is still running is refused.

MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Artifact Maintenance / 混合补丁安全维护 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridArtifactMaintenanceT8Adva.description: Inspects one exact content-addressed Hybrid artifact by default. Explicit actions can move a verified artifact pair or stale build residue into a recoverable quarantine, restore a quarantined pair, or recover an interrupted transaction. It never scans or deletes diffusion checkpoints.

enforcement.tooltip: report_only never blocks or mutates the MODEL. block_hard_conflicts raises on mechanically proven patch/order/contract/memory-gate failures.

require_applied_vram_policy.tooltip: Require Loader provenance showing that a non-report-only T8 VRAM policy was applied before the stock model load.

positive.tooltip: Optional final Conditioning lets the audit verify Long Video/MultiKeyframe MODEL pairing and reference-modality coverage.

MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Compatibility Audit / 混合模型组合兼容审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridCompatibilityAuditT8Advan.description: Passes the exact same MODEL through while auditing Hybrid offset-set integrity, LoRA ordering/overlap, Block Cache, SageAttention, Long Video, MultiKeyframe, sampling, DynamicVRAM/VBAR policy provenance, current VRAM and host commit. Place it after every MODEL patch/sampler node and before BasicGuider.

base_model.tooltip: Primary checkpoint -- every tensor starts here.

overlay_model.tooltip: Secondary checkpoint -- tensors matched by overlay_preset come from here. May equal base_model (effectively loads base only).

overlay_preset.tooltip: Which tensor groups to take from overlay_model. 'none' = pure base loading (equivalent to stock UNETLoader). 'ref2va_adaln_over_fl2va' (default) = take per-block adaln_proj from the overlay only. 'ref2va_all_adaln_over_fl2va' = also take final_layer.adaln_proj. 'ref2va_full_over_fl2va'/'fl2va_full_over_ref2va' = take everything from the overlay (sanity check). 'block_range_adaln' = take adaln_proj only for blocks in [block_range_start, block_range_end] (inclusive). 'custom' = use custom_overlays only.

block_range_start.tooltip: Only used when overlay_preset == 'block_range_adaln'. Lower-inclusive bound on the block index whose adaln_proj comes from overlay_model. The minimax h3 DiT has 50 blocks indexed 0..49.

block_range_end.tooltip: Only used when overlay_preset == 'block_range_adaln'. Upper-inclusive bound on the block index. Set block_range_end < block_range_start to take NO blocks from the overlay (effectively pure base).

final_adaln_from_overlay.tooltip: Toggle overlay of final_layer.adaln_proj.linear.{weight,bias} from overlay_model. Additive on top of any preset:  - False (default): leave final_layer.adaln on the base (unless a preset already covers it, e.g. ref2va_all_adaln_over_fl2va).  - True: pull final_layer.adaln from the overlay in addition to whatever the preset does.

custom_overlays.tooltip: Comma-separated keys/prefixes/globs to *also* take from the overlay on top of the preset. E.g. 'blocks.49.,final_layer.video_out.'. Bare prefixes ending in '.' match by prefix; other strings are matched as fnmatch globs (e.g. 'blocks.[0-4].*.attn.qkv_proj.weight').

custom_base.tooltip: Comma-separated keys/prefixes/globs that should be forced *back* to the base even if the preset or custom_overlays would take them from the overlay. Useful for keeping e.g. final_layer.adaln_proj on the base while everything else adaln comes from the overlay.

weight_dtype.tooltip: Same meaning as the stock 'Load Diffusion Model' node. Leave 'default' unless you know what you are doing.

MiniMaxH3HybridLoader.name: MiniMaxH3HybridLoader
MiniMaxH3HybridLoader.description: Load a MiniMax H3 diffusion model by merging selected tensor groups from an 'overlay' checkpoint onto a 'base' checkpoint. Useful for combining the higher output quality of fl2va with the reference-conditioning pathway of ref2va. See the companion analysis file for what differs between the two checkpoints. Behaves like the stock 'Load Diffusion Model' node when overlay_preset is 'none'.

mode.tooltip: base_only is the stock-loader control. apply_artifact_exp requires the exact artifact and remains experimental.

vram_policy.tooltip: Optional T8 policy applied before the stock diffusion-model load.

MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Model Loader / 混合模型加载 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridModelLoaderT8Advanced.description: Loads the quality base through ComfyUI's stock diffusion loader, preserving DynamicVRAM/VBAR file-backed behavior, then applies only the connected small artifact to a clone. Use Hybrid -> LoRA ordering.

quality_base.tooltip: Exact validated FL2VA pruned ConvRot checkpoint used as the base.

reference_overlay.tooltip: Exact validated Ref2VA pruned ConvRot checkpoint used as the overlay source.

profile.tooltip: Neutral experimental recipes only. None is a proven quality winner; static modality rows also affect target streams.

verification.tooltip: header_only_exp is diagnostic and always blocks artifact construction. Use full_sha256 for a buildable plan.

positive.tooltip: Optional existing H3 Conditioning. With auto_match_reference_modalities_exp, its real ref kinds select the minimal video/audio modality recipe.

MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Hybrid Pair Inspector / 混合模型配对检查 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3HybridPairInspectorT8Advanced.description: Strictly checks the exact P0 FL2VA-pruned quality base and Ref2VA-pruned reference overlay before any artifact can be built. Explicit profiles run independently; auto modality matching waits for the optional Conditioning input.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCoarseSamplerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCoarseSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCoarseSamplerT8Advance.description: Runs only absolute intervals 0:4. Feed SamplerCustomAdvanced's denoised_output (socket 1), not its nonterminal x_sigma result, to the learned 3D upscaler. HIGH then starts a separately re-noised 4:8 tail; this is not a continuous trajectory.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveBaseLoaderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveBaseLoaderEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveBaseLoaderEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Load Native FP32 Curve Base (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveBaseLoaderEXPT8.description: Explicit fresh native pruned H3 loader. Preserves Core's declared FP32 AdaLN/input/output precision islands and its original quantized backbone operations. Use BEFORE branching into independent content LoRAs/Curve Apply; does not repair an already loaded MODEL or change ordinary UNET loading. No fit, sampling, download or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitBuildEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitBuildEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitBuildEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Build Explicit Fit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitBuildEXPT8.description: Explicit potentially expensive producer. Select the native pruned base, matching full-time teacher and ORIGINAL HyperFlow adapter. Builds all51 independent projections and pins, measures residuals, writes a NEW unique asset under output/MiniMaxH3/curve_fits. No sampling, conversion of the base, hidden download, overwrite, full-model equivalence or quality certificate.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Load Selected Fit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFitLoadEXPT8.description: Reads models/hyperflow/curve_fits, or an explicit absolute advanced path for an already built asset. Optional SHA pins exact bytes. Does not load or certify a MODEL. Model Apply separately checks original adapter and selected base/basis. Never creates a fit on a cache miss.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFullSamplerSetupE.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFullSamplerSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFullSamplerSetupE.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Full 8-Interval Setup (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveFullSamplerSetupE.description: Only the full trained8 trajectory for SamplerCustomAdvanced. No partial-start selector: use typed HEAD/TAIL for actual captured x_sigma continuation. This is an approximation, not full-time HyperFlow equivalence. For persisted external effects use the dedicated stage binding nodes, not this standalone setup.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsAuditE.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsAuditE.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · HEAD Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsAuditE.description: Read immutable sampled curve HEAD effect evidence, never mutable Apply-node counters. Pass exact boundary through, no quality approval.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsBindEX.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsBindEX.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Bind External HEAD Effects (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadEffectsBindEX.description: Curve Apply -> optional paired Relay Conditioning -> this binding -> optional Stage EAV Apply -> HEAD Only. Same split on binding/sampler. Returned SIGMAS/context/template validate effects, not a new sampler/restart plan. CFG1 with active effects. No sampling here.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Load Exact Frozen HEAD (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadLoadEXPT8.description: Explicit relative path AND whole-file SHA. CPU-only selected artifact read, zero HEAD sampling/no MODEL loading/no fallback regeneration. Connect only TAIL branches in a cold graph. TAIL verifies same actual base/adapter/fit and producer implementation.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow Curve · Save Frozen HEAD (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadSaveEXPT8.description: Archive captured x_sigma/scaffold/actual51 execution receipt in a NEW unique directory under output/MiniMaxH3/curve_stage_artifacts. Save path AND SHA. Not clean x0/quality approval; only certified portable identity can be loaded for a later process.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowCurveHeadStageEXPT8

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLoaderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshLoaderEXPT8

Use a full native H3 base; content LoRAs may be independent on each branch.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageAuditEXPT8

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageLoadEXPT8

Existing generic Load schema and old workflows remain unchanged.

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3HyperFlowFreshStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · Separate Full8 / Partial4 / Fresh4 Setup (T8 EXP)

MiniMaxH3HyperFlowHeadEffectsAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 HyperFlow · HEAD Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)

Keep the paired MODEL and CONDITIONING together. No GPU/quality claim.

width.tooltip: 0 uses the width of image_1 after its reference scaling, or 2048 without images. The model is tuned for 2048x2048 pixels of area

height.tooltip: 0 uses the height of image_1 after its reference scaling, or 2048 without images.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

MiniMaxH3Int8RowChunksAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3Int8RowChunksAuditEXPT8

rows.tooltip: 每次 INT8 投影的行数；0 关闭，不限制整个序列长度。

MiniMaxH3Int8RowChunksEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3Int8RowChunksEXPT8

samples.tooltip: The clip the sampler just made.

strength.tooltip: How much of the measured step to remove. 1.0 removes all of it, 0.0 turns it off.

context_length.tooltip: Frames pinned by Motion Context. Wire Motion Context's trim_frames here so the two always agree. 0 passes the clip through. Has to be a whole number of latent steps (5, 22, 39, 56).

min_excess.tooltip: Manual tuning only. Averages: only correct when the join moves more than this many times what the picture normally moves over the same stretch inside the clip. Guards against treating motion as a step.

match_spread.tooltip: Also match how far each channel swings around its average, which is where contrast and fine texture live. Off matches the averages only.

min_excess_spread.tooltip: Manual tuning only. Spread: only correct when it changes more than this many times its normal change inside the clip. 1.5 is the safe default for any shot. On a locked-off shot, 1.0 lets it correct at every join. The correction is capped at 10% either way.

match_detail.tooltip: Also match the fine, pixel-to-pixel part of each channel, where grain, skin texture and wrinkles live. It builds up at every join even when the averages and spread hold.

min_excess_detail.tooltip: Manual tuning only. Fine detail: only correct when it changes more than this many times its normal change inside the clip. 1.5 is the safe default; 1.0 suits a locked-off shot. Capped at 10% either way.

tuning.tooltip: Auto reads the shot from this clip (still camera or moving) and sets the three min_excess guards itself. Manual uses them as set.

context_latent.tooltip: The previous clip, the same latent loaded for Motion Context. Leave it unwired on the first clip.

MiniMaxH3JoinMatch.name: MiniMaxH3JoinMatch
MiniMaxH3JoinMatch.description: Experimental. After sampling, measures the step between the previous clip's last frames and this clip's first new frames, and moves this clip so it starts where the last one ended.

position_mode.tooltip: percent uses an explicit 0..100 scale; no 0..1 ambiguity.

position.tooltip: Absolute 24fps frame, seconds, or 0..100 percent according to position_mode. It must resolve strictly between first and last.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabBlockMemoryTracer.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabBlockMemoryTracer
MiniMaxH3LatentLabBlockMemoryTracer.description: Internal first-forward H3 transformer block VRAM tracer.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabFirstStepMemoryProfile.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabFirstStepMemoryProfiler
MiniMaxH3LatentLabFirstStepMemoryProfile.description: Internal first-step CUDA allocator profiler for Long Media sampling.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabInfo.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabInfo

MiniMaxH3LatentLabLipSyncSetup.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabLipSyncSetup
MiniMaxH3LatentLabLipSyncSetup.description: Replace the native H3 audio stream and configure independent video/audio denoise controls for lip-sync-oriented sampling.

batch_size.tooltip: Legacy H3 VAE spatial tile batching. Frames-aware ComfyUI VAEs use their own batching. 1 = Auto (4 tiles/call on a cleared 16GB-class GPU, 8 on 24GB+). OOM automatically falls back to smaller batches. Other VAEs ignore this value.

color_match_strength.tooltip: 0 disables. >0 nudges every frame's color statistics toward frame 0, useful when frame 0 is pinned to a reference and the rest of the clip drifts in color (visible as a jump at a loop seam).

MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaDecode.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaDecode
MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaDecode.description: Decode the final stitched H3 AV latent back to pixel frames and audio. This is the single combined result after any multi-pass long-media segmentation.

video_context_denoise.tooltip: 0 preserves the inherited overlap exactly; 1 fully denoises it.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaNextSegment.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaNextSegment
MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaNextSegment.display_name: MiniMax H3 • Long Media Next Segment
MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaNextSegment.description: Prepare the next segment AV latent by injecting the frozen overlap from the previous result and source media after the overlap.

video_context_denoise.tooltip: 0 preserves each inherited overlap exactly; 1 fully denoises it.

offload_completed_segments.tooltip: Move each pass's stitched result to CPU RAM once it has been folded in, instead of leaving the whole growing clip resident on the GPU for the rest of the run. Only the accumulator moves — the small per-pass sampling context stays on the GPU as before — so this has no effect on output, only on peak VRAM during long multi-pass runs. Turn off only to restore the previous (all-GPU) behavior.

mlp_chunk_tokens.tooltip: Token chunk size for the low-VRAM H3 MLP path. Manual mode uses 512-token increments so low-VRAM users can select 4096/3072/2048/1536/1024/512. 24576 is the normal quantized throughput default. Larger values are faster but use more VRAM. Set 0 to effectively disable MLP chunking for A/B testing.

attention_mode.tooltip: sol_h3 enables the hardware-adaptive Sol-H3 profile. On <=18.5 GiB DynamicVRAM GPUs it keeps exact Comfy Kitchen attention, secures activation workspace before QKV allocation, and bypasses resident AdaLN trajectory precompute to avoid startup/VRAM regression. Roomier resident GPUs may use AdaLN caching. FastH3 uses four calls only when a trained FastH3/VSA contract is detected. auto selects existing/Sage vs embedded Sol by geometry. sol/scheduled_sol force embedded SM120 Sol.

sol_qkv_chunk_tokens.tooltip: Stream H3 QKV projection in token chunks. In streamed mode token-level K/V are retained as INT8+scale while Sol block summaries stay BF16; Q is reprojected and consumed chunk-by-chunk. This targets very long single-pass clips on limited VRAM. Manual mode uses 512-token increments so 4096/3072/2048/1536/1024/512 are selectable. 0 restores the full fused-QKV path.

sol_out_proj_chunk_tokens.tooltip: Token chunk size for the embedded Sol output projection. Smaller values reduce peak VRAM; larger values are faster. Manual mode uses 512-token increments for fine low-VRAM tuning. 0 disables out_proj chunking.

vram_activation_reserve_mb.tooltip: Extra VRAM headroom requested from ComfyUI before model loading. ComfyUI will keep fewer H3 weights resident and offload more to RAM, leaving this space for long-sequence activations. 0 disables the extra reserve.

inter_block_vram_guard_mb.tooltip: Minimum driver-free VRAM target between H3 transformer blocks. When free VRAM falls below this value and PyTorch is holding >=256 MB of dead reserved cache, LongMedia returns that cache to the driver. 0 disables inter-block trimming.

inter_block_guard_cooldown_blocks.tooltip: Completed H3 blocks to wait between normal cache trims. Emergency pressure bypasses this cooldown. 0 restores the 0.2.36 behavior.

inter_block_guard_emergency_mb.tooltip: Emergency driver-free VRAM threshold. Below this value the emergency guard may trim even while the normal guard is cooling down. 0 disables emergency mode.

inter_block_guard_emergency_cooldown_blo.tooltip: Minimum completed H3 blocks between EMERGENCY cache trims. This prevents Dynamic VRAM/AIMDO free==0 states from causing a trim storm. 0 restores the 0.2.37 immediate-emergency behavior.

late_block_guard_start.tooltip: First H3 transformer block where the late hard guard is allowed to run. 40 targets only the tail of the 50-block H3 stack.

late_block_guard_target_mb.tooltip: Driver-free VRAM target before attention/FFN in late H3 blocks. 0 disables the late-block hard guard.

late_block_guard_min_cached_mb.tooltip: Minimum reclaimable PyTorch CUDA cache required before a late-block hard trim is attempted.

step_boundary_cleanup_mb.tooltip: Minimum driver-free VRAM target after each completed denoise step. Dead allocator cache is returned before the next H3 forward. 0 disables.

latent_hires_enabled.tooltip: Learned H3 latent hi-res stage between base sampling and refine. Video latent only; audio is preserved exactly.

latent_hires_scale.tooltip: Spatial latent upscale multiplier. Model supports continuous 1.0x-4.0x.

latent_hires_precision.tooltip: Upscaler inference precision. fp16 is the practical default.

latent_hires_align.tooltip: Output pixel alignment. 32 is recommended by the upstream model to avoid edge/light-band artifacts.

refine_enabled.tooltip: Enable internal Sampler #2. Stage 1 output is handed to a normal second sampling stage driven only by Refine Sigmas. Whole-video execution is used when safe; with windowed refine enabled, very large sequences can fall back to temporal windows while Stage-1 audio stays exact.

refine_add_noise.tooltip: Legacy compatibility input. Ignored: Hi-Res Refine uses stock Sampler #2 fresh noise; non-Hi-Res Refine uses its bounded internal policy.

refine_seed.tooltip: Legacy compatibility input. Ignored: Hi-Res Sampler #2 parity uses the main effective seed, matching the integrated 0.5.40 contract.

refine_steps.tooltip: Legacy serialized input retained for workflow compatibility. Ignored since 0.6.24; Refine step count comes from Refine Sigmas.

memory_mode.tooltip: Sampler-local residency policy. auto uses physical quantized storage + activation headroom (logical model size for unquantized weights); low_vram and ultra_low_vram remain explicit bounded profiles.

sampler_mode.tooltip: auto uses the validated production attention/VRAM policy. manual exposes all low-level tuning widgets.

windowed_refine.tooltip: Allow memory-bounded temporal Refine windows for long/high-resolution video. Disable to force one full-latent Stage 2 pass for maximum temporal/lighting continuity. Exact-only Refine can require substantially more VRAM and will raise OOM instead of silently falling back to windows.

refine_sigmas.tooltip: Independent sigma schedule for the Refine stage. Required when Refine is enabled.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaSampler.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaSampler
MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaSampler.description: Expand a long-media plan into a sequential multi-pass sampler graph. When manual_duration exceeds segment_seconds, segments are sampled one after another, context is carried across segment boundaries, and the result is stitched into one final AV latent.

prompt.tooltip: Prompt text. Can also be connected directly through the prompt input socket.

duration_source.tooltip: Controls target timeline length independently from audio_mode and prompt conditioning. In video_ref_edit, auto follows video_1. video follows video_1 explicitly; audio follows audio_1; manual uses manual_duration; longest_input follows the longest connected audio/video input. Choosing a shorter source trims the target timeline; choosing a longer source allows the edited scene to continue beyond video_1. MultiClip Planner and Video Reconstructor own their own timeline lengths.

segment_seconds.tooltip: New output timeline per segment. transition_frames is added as continuation context and does not reduce this duration.

loop_closure_enabled.tooltip: Context-preserving seamless loop closure. Runs one extra H3 tail pass guided toward the opening-frame macro context while keeping motion and fine detail free. Available in every workflow.

loop_closure_frames.tooltip: Approximate tail region used for loop closure. It snaps to the nearest valid H3 frame count without unnecessarily expanding the ending.

audio_mode.tooltip: auto: legacy behavior; in video_ref_edit, connected audio_1 is also the authoritative source-performance timing clock and is restored untouched. preserve: restore original audio at output; in video_ref_edit it also locks replacement facial/mouth timing to audio_1. generate: generate final H3 audio. reference_only: use input audio as H3 reference but output generated audio. preserve_reference: use input audio as H3 reference/timing source and restore the untouched original track; in video_ref_edit it also locks source-performance sync. lip_sync: audio_1 is encoded directly into the target H3 audio stream and frozen as the sole speech/singing clock; it is not duplicated as a Ref2VA audio reference. MultiClip slices the exact global waveform per clip and restores the untouched audio_1 at output.

conditioning_mode.tooltip: auto_refs keeps the original LongMedia behavior. hybrid_first_frame: image_1 is the opening keyframe, image_2..image_9 become <Picture 1>..<Picture 8> identity/style refs. hybrid_first_last: image_1 is the first keyframe, image_2 is the last keyframe, and image_3..image_9 become <Picture 1>..<Picture 7> refs. Manual mode only. auto_refs sends all connected images as Picture refs. hybrid_first_frame uses image_1 as the opening keyframe. hybrid_first_last uses image_1/image_2 as first/last keyframes. video_1..3 and audio_1..3 remain native H3 refs.

motion_repair.tooltip: Optional temporal anti-smear repair. off preserves the historical sampling path. auto detects overloaded fast-motion spans in the completed H3 latent and selectively re-renders only those temporal regions. fluid is more sensitive to fine chaotic structures such as water jets, spray, smoke, hair and cloth. strong uses wider/more aggressive local temporal dilation. Audio is frozen during repair and the original audio latent is restored exactly.

release_guard.tooltip: Production console guard. ON suppresses routine LongMedia diagnostics and keeps only actionable failures. OFF prints the full internal execution/memory/attention diagnostics for profiling and A/B tests.

clip_plan.tooltip: Connect MiniMax H3 LongMedia Planner/Cameras. It is authoritative only when timeline_mode=multiclip and no Director is connected.

director.tooltip: Single LongMedia Director contract: complete Director timeline, camera transitions and Director-managed Picture/Video/Audio media. One MAIN shot is valid; two or more use native MultiClip continuation. Explicit Setup image/video/audio sockets still override matching Director media slots.

workflow_mode.tooltip: hybrid_auto: image_1 is first frame; if image_2 is connected it is last frame; segmented_continuation: fixed-duration timeline policy using the exact same Ref2VA/Motion-Context clip executor as MultiClip; every generated clip has the same H3-aligned length and the final excess is trimmed. segment_duration controls fixed clip size; Planner is ignored. remaining images are Picture refs. video_ref_edit: video_1 is the main motion/camera/composition reference, image_1..9 are Picture refs for identity/style replacement, and audio_1 can carry the paired source soundtrack. ref2va_full: all connected images are Picture refs with no first/last anchors. loop: image_1 is reused as BOTH first and last frame for a seam-friendly viral loop; image_2..9 are Picture refs. manual: exposes legacy conditioning and segmentation controls for advanced diagnostics and A/B tests.

reconstruction.tooltip: Optional MiniMax H3 LongMedia Video Reconstructor contract. When connected it owns source video/audio, FPS, chunking and reconstruction strength.

multiclip_json.tooltip: MultiClip backend storage. JSON array: [{prompt, duration, seed}, ...]. Prompt is local to the clip; null seed uses sampler seed + clip index.

image_1.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 <Picture 1> reference.

image_2.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 <Picture 2> reference.

image_3.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 <Picture 3> reference.

image_4.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 <Picture 4> reference.

video_1.tooltip: Video frames only (IMAGE batch). video_ref_edit: primary motion/camera/composition source as <Video 1>. Other modes: regular <Video 1> reference. If the source video has audio, connect that extracted audio to audio_1.

video_2.tooltip: Video frames only (IMAGE batch). Passed as <Video 2> reference. Pair with audio_2 when they come from the same source.

video_3.tooltip: Video frames only (IMAGE batch). Passed as <Video 3> reference. Pair with audio_3 when they come from the same source.

audio_1.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 <Audio 1> reference. In video_ref_edit with auto/preserve/preserve_reference, audio_1 is the paired source-performance clock and can be addressed from the prompt. With audio_mode=lip_sync, Audio 1 is the authoritative forced target-audio clock and is excluded from native Ref2VA audio references. duration_source controls timeline length separately.

audio_2.tooltip: Optional second native H3 audio reference in normal modes. audio_mode=lip_sync disables native audio references so the forced Audio 1 target clock remains unambiguous.

audio_3.tooltip: Optional third native H3 audio reference in normal modes. audio_mode=lip_sync disables native audio references so the forced Audio 1 target clock remains unambiguous.

loop_closure_strength.tooltip: Structural attraction of the regenerated tail toward the opening-frame context. 0 keeps the existing ending; 1 applies the strongest macro-geometry guidance. Fine detail remains free.

control_mode.tooltip: Setup control surface. auto uses Setup H3/timeline/audio choices. director lets a connected LongMedia Director own MultiClip conditioning/audio semantics while Setup media sockets remain explicit overrides. manual exposes advanced Setup-only conditioning/transition controls.

h3_mode.tooltip: Native H3 conditioning family. FL2VA uses image_1 as first frame and optional image_2 as last frame without LongMedia latent injection. Ref2VA keeps images as Picture refs. Hybrid enables LongMedia first-frame injection controls. video_ref_edit uses video_1 as the source motion/camera/composition stream.

timeline_mode.tooltip: LongMedia timeline only. single is one H3 pass; segmented uses fixed-duration continuation clips; multiclip consumes Clip Plan / per-clip prompts. It does not choose the H3 conditioning family.

transition_frames.tooltip: Transition/context length between adjacent Segmented or MultiClip units. Native H3 values are 5, 22, 39, 56... frames. Replaces the old hidden overlap_frames control for public timeline modes.

first_frame_mode.tooltip: Hybrid image injection policy. native_keyframe is pure native H3 frame conditioning; latent_inject seeds the leading target latent; pixel_override/blend are decode-time opening-frame policies. FL2VA always forces native_keyframe.

first_frame_denoise.tooltip: Hybrid latent-injection denoise amount. Used only when first_frame_mode=latent_inject.

first_frame_blend_frames.tooltip: Hybrid decode blend span. Used only when first_frame_mode=blend.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaSetup.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaSetup
MiniMaxH3LatentLabLongMediaSetup.description: Orchestrate long-media generation: build a multi-segment plan, encode source media, and set up references for NativeReferenceToVideo.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabMLPChunking.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabMLPChunking
MiniMaxH3LatentLabMLPChunking.description: Internal H3 low-VRAM token-chunked MLP wrapper.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabMergeAV.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabMergeAV
MiniMaxH3LatentLabMergeAV.description: Blend video and audio independently from a source H3 AV latent into a target H3 AV latent. The target defines output geometry.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabPackAV.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabPackAV
MiniMaxH3LatentLabPackAV.description: Pack MiniMax H3 video/audio streams back into AV latent form. Automatically rebuilds LongMedia MultiClip native containers when the streams originated from Split AV Streams; ordinary streams remain ordinary AV.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Snapped down to the 17*k+5 H3 grid.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabPrepareContinuation.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabPrepareContinuation
MiniMaxH3LatentLabPrepareContinuation.description: Create a new H3 AV latent whose opening is the synchronized tail of a previous result. Sample it, then use Stitch Continuation to remove overlap.

denoise.tooltip: 0 preserves the replacement exactly; 1 fully denoises it.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceAudio.description: Deprecated — kept only so old saved graphs keep loading. Use "MiniMax H3 • Replace Stream" for new graphs (stream=audio).

denoise.tooltip: 0 preserves the replacement exactly; 1 fully denoises it.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceStream.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceStream
MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceStream.description: Replace the video or audio stream in an H3 AV latent. strict is lossless; crop_pad center-crops/pads spatially and uses alignment for time.

denoise.tooltip: 0 preserves the replacement exactly; 1 fully denoises it.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceVideo.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceVideo
MiniMaxH3LatentLabReplaceVideo.description: Deprecated — kept only so old saved graphs keep loading. Use "MiniMax H3 • Replace Stream" for new graphs (stream=video).

MiniMaxH3LatentLabRuntimeContinuationGui.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabRuntimeContinuationGuider
MiniMaxH3LatentLabRuntimeContinuationGui.description: Internal runtime continuation guider with real previous-segment motion context.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabSplitAV.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabSplitAV
MiniMaxH3LatentLabSplitAV.description: Split MiniMax H3 AV latents into editable video and audio streams. Automatically expands LongMedia MultiClip containers into their native per-clip latents; ordinary AV latents are handled as a one-item stream.

blend_video_overlap.tooltip: Smoothstep blend the video overlap seam.

offload_to_cpu.tooltip: Move the stitched result to CPU RAM instead of leaving it on the GPU. Safe to enable for long multi-pass runs: this accumulator is never read back by the sampler, only by the next stitch and the final decode, so keeping it resident on the GPU across many passes just wastes VRAM.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabStreamDenoise.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabStreamDenoise
MiniMaxH3LatentLabStreamDenoise.description: Independent H3 stream control through ComfyUI's stock noise_mask path. 0 preserves a stream; 1 fully regenerates it.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabVRAMCacheCleanup.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabVRAMCacheCleanup
MiniMaxH3LatentLabVRAMCacheCleanup.description: Internal post-sampling CUDA cache cleanup and diagnostics.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabVRAMPressureGuard.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabVRAMPressureGuard
MiniMaxH3LatentLabVRAMPressureGuard.description: Internal adaptive VRAM pressure guard for Long Media sampling.

target_av.tooltip: Optional H3 AV latent whose video shape is the target.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabVideoEncode.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabVideoEncode
MiniMaxH3LatentLabVideoEncode.description: Encode IMAGE frames as a standalone MiniMax H3 video stream. Connect target_av to force exact H3 canvas and temporal shape before packing/replacement.

MiniMaxH3LatentLabVideoInpaint.name: MiniMaxH3LatentLabVideoInpaint
MiniMaxH3LatentLabVideoInpaint.description: Map a ComfyUI MASK onto the H3 video latent grid. White uses denoise_inside, black uses denoise_outside; audio is controlled separately.

chunk_frames.tooltip: Latent frames per chunk; 0 runs the full video. Full temporal halo is added.

MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale2DT8.name: MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale2DT8
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale2DT8.display_name: H3 2D Latent Upscale / 六档潜空间放大 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscale2DT8.description: Optional learned 2D visual resize. Preserves joint audio, masks and metadata. Sharpness tiers are model conditions; higher tiers do not guarantee better motion.

pixels_per_latent.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video latent uses 16 pixels per latent cell. Choose 8 only for a plain SD/SDXL-style latent.

alignment_policy.tooltip: best_aspect checks the four closest legal size pairs and minimizes aspect-ratio error. nearest/floor/ceil prioritize the requested size.

MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8.name: MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8.display_name: Latent Upscale by 32 / 32整除潜空间放大 (T8)
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleBy32T8.description: Upscales a plain latent or the video part of a MiniMax H3 joint AV latent. The returned pixel width and height are always divisible by 32; best_aspect minimizes the unavoidable ratio error caused by the 32-pixel grid.

MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleWithModel.name: MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleWithModel
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleWithModel.display_name: MiniMax H3 Latent Upscale With Model
MiniMaxH3LatentUpscaleWithModel.description: Resizes the video of a MiniMax H3 latent with a latent upscale model; audio passes through unchanged.

aspect_policy.tooltip: preserve_source is the safe default. honor_dimensions_exp permits different X/Y scales but still enforces max_anisotropy.

release_policy.tooltip: offload_after keeps a CPU cache but releases GPU weights; clear_after also removes the CPU cache; keep_loaded is opt-in and retains GPU memory.

MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Learned Latent Upscale / H3学习型潜空间放大 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3LearnedLatentUpscaleT8Advanced.description: Runs the verified 24-channel learned 3D H3 latent-resizer checkpoint on video only while preserving the native joint audio latent. Output pixel dimensions are exactly divisible by 32. Resolutions above the official 1920x1088 reference area are allowed and reported as a memory risk instead of being blocked. The default unloads this upscaler from the GPU after every execution without unloading the user's H3 models.

model.tooltip: Connect a MiniMax H3 model carrying the same video/audio shifts that both passes will use.

refine_steps.tooltip: Defaults to the published four-call high-resolution profile so the 4+4 graph executes eight total joint AV forwards. Saved workflows that explicitly store 3 or 5 remain compatible.

MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Learned Two-Pass Parity Plan / H3学习放大原版二采计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3LearnedTwoPassParityPlanT8Advan.description: Reproduces the published LBH low-resolution simple-schedule split and its current 3/4/5-step high-resolution raw video-sigma sequences. The native H3 sampler derives the matching audio clock from the active video/audio shifts.

MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 LightX2V SLA Runtime Audit (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAAuditT8Advanced.description: Place after the sampler. It fails unless every scheduled H3 forward and all 50 main blocks per forward used the selected dense-control or sparse path without a hidden kernel fallback.

model.tooltip: Connect Dual-Clock MODEL to KJNodes MiniMax H3 Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch, then connect that MODEL here. A recognized built-in ModelAttentionBackend is redundant and will be replaced by the SLA owner; Sol-Attn and foreign attention overrides are still refused.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same native_flow SIGMAS from Dual-Clock. The official checkpoint defaults to 4-step/6V/3A; 8-step is allowed and audited as an experimental user-selected NFE schedule.

lora_name.tooltip: Defaults to the LightX2V H3 FL2V Turbo-SLA LoRA. Compatible repacked or alternate H3 SLA LoRAs use structural/full-mapping validation instead of one fixed file hash.

mode.tooltip: apply_lightx2v_sla uses a diagnostic sequence/forward policy that failed full-duration human review and is not quality-safe. Use the Turbo / SLA Profile Router for recommended Turbo8 output. The upstream-exact EXP option keeps all forwards 85% sparse. dense_lora_control keeps the same LoRA and routes all 50 main blocks through the authenticated upstream KJ Sage forward.

base_policy.tooltip: The official SLA base is BF16 FL2VA; quantized bases remain explicit compatibility experiments.

max_router_workspace_mib.tooltip: Fail-closed ceiling for SLA router score/map workspace.

MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 LightX2V SLA + KJ Sage Composer (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAKJSageComposerT8Adva.description: Compose an upstream KJNodes MiniMax H3 memory-efficient Sage patch with LightX2V SLA under one audited attention owner. Diagnostic sparse forwards use block-sparse Sage2; planned dense forwards, dense-control and calls outside the SLA route retain KJ Sage. No attention call runs both kernels.

model.tooltip: Connect the clean native H3 MODEL output from Dual-Clock. Do not place KJ Sage, Sol-Attn, FETA, BlockCache, STG or another LoRA before it.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect the same native_flow SIGMAS from Dual-Clock. The included upstream SLA checkpoint is officially 4-step/6V/3A; 8 steps and other NFE values run under an explicit experimental schedule report.

lora_name.tooltip: Default LightX2V MiniMax H3 FL2V Turbo-SLA ComfyUI BF16 LoRA. File name, SHA, size, metadata and tensor layout are diagnostic only. The selected file is passed to the real ComfyUI loader.

mode.tooltip: apply_lightx2v_sla is a diagnostic auto mode, not quality-safe: under 50K packed tokens it uses dense attention; longer sequences keep dense first/last forwards and protect text/keyframe/audio keys during sparse middle forwards. Both the short all-dense result and the earlier fixed-sparse result failed full-duration human review. Use the new Turbo / SLA Profile Router for the recommended Turbo8 fallback. apply_lightx2v_sla_upstream_exact_exp reproduces 85% sparse attention on every forward and may collapse outside the published long 768p profile. dense_lora_control keeps the same SLA LoRA but uses dense attention for a scientific A/B. disabled_identity changes nothing.

base_policy.tooltip: Controls report labels only. Base dtype and quantization are recorded but never used to reject a user-selected model.

max_router_workspace_mib.tooltip: Fail-closed ceiling for estimated router score/map workspace. This is not a whole-workflow VRAM limit.

MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 LightX2V SLA Loader + Attention (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3LightX2VSLAT8Advanced.description: Loads a structurally valid H3 FL2VA Turbo-SLA LoRA and owns the LightX2V Sage2 attention path. The saved apply_lightx2v_sla mode remains loadable as a diagnostic policy: short sequences stay dense; eligible sequences use dense boundary forwards and prefix-protected sparse middle forwards. The exact all-sparse upstream route remains an explicit EXP mode. The upstream checkpoint defaults to 4 steps, video shift 6 and audio shift 3; other native_flow NFE values are accepted as experimental. External SageAttention/Sol-Attn/LoRA nodes must be bypassed.

file_alpha_policy.tooltip: Default keeps old tensor-only scaling. Explicit metadata_alpha_per_rank uses literal ss_network_alpha / actual rank only for mapped linear pairs without per-key alpha. Metadata is not proof of the training scale; zero means zero here. User strength and order remain unchanged.

prefix_policy.tooltip: Default keeps existing Core mappings. Explicit unique_double_prefix adds an alias only for a complete matching linear pair with exactly one known target. No key rewriting, cross-namespace pair joining or collision overwriting.

MiniMaxH3LoRACompatibilityLoaderT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3LoRACompatibilityLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LoRACompatibilityLoaderT8Advanc.description: MODEL-only H3 LoRA loader supporting native ComfyUI plus direct DiffSynth-Studio/ModelScope module names. It uses structural key mapping only; filenames and sizes are display-only, with no hash scan or model-file execution gate. Select disabled to pass the MODEL through, which makes an optional per-stage external LoRA safe.

MiniMaxH3LoRAWindowT8.name: MiniMaxH3LoRAWindowT8
MiniMaxH3LoRAWindowT8.display_name: H3 LoRA Window / LoRA采样生效区间 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LoRAWindowT8.description: Create native weight hooks and attach them to conditioning. Progress uses the selected model's actual percent-to-sigma mapping. Quantized/offloaded weight switching may substantially increase host RAM and runtime. Chain previous_hooks for multiple LoRAs; don't also load the same LoRA statically.

latent_path.tooltip: A saved latent file, or a folder (relative paths resolve against the ComfyUI output directory). Pointing at a specific FILE always loads that file, ignoring clip_index.

clip_index.tooltip: The clip to CONTINUE FROM: that clip's slot is loaded. Generating clip 2 from clip 1: set 1 here and 2 on the Save node. 0 = newest file in the folder (NOT retry-safe: a re-roll loads its own rejected audio).

vae.tooltip: Optional video VAE. When connected, decodes and outputs previous clip frames as IMAGE.

audio_vae.tooltip: Optional audio VAE. When connected, decodes and outputs previous clip soundtrack as AUDIO.

MiniMaxH3LoadLatent.name: MiniMaxH3LoadLatent

Decoded frames of previous clip (when VAE is connected). Wire to Video Merge (images_a) or Video Extender (prev_frames).

director_json.tooltip: Internal serialized Director timeline. The frontend replaces this raw JSON field with the timeline editor.

MiniMaxH3LongMediaDirector.name: MiniMaxH3LongMediaDirector
MiniMaxH3LongMediaDirector.description: Timeline director for LongMedia. Author shots, references, camera transitions and audio-reactive directions on one semantic timeline, then connect the single director output to Long Media Setup. Director selects MultiClip timeline execution automatically.

global_prompt.tooltip: Global Prompt shared by every MultiClip clip. Kept separate from editable per-clip prompts and joined only at runtime.

multiclip_prompt.tooltip: Multiple Clips Prompt import source. Use clip_1:/clip_2: or shot_1:/shot_2:. Import copies text into editable clip cards.

multiclip_auto_import.tooltip: Automatically import a valid structured Multiple Clips Prompt when that source changes.

clips_json.tooltip: Internal serialized clip-card state. The LongMedia Planner frontend hides this field and renders clip cards instead.

multiclip_import_request.tooltip: Internal one-shot manual import request used when Multiple Clips Prompt is connected to a dynamic source.

multiclip_last_import_source.tooltip: Internal source snapshot so Auto Import never overwrites edited cards unless the structured source actually changes.

MiniMaxH3LongMediaPlanner.name: MiniMaxH3LongMediaPlanner
MiniMaxH3LongMediaPlanner.description: Build a MultiClip storyboard with a stable identity, name, prompt, duration, and optional seed per clip. Connect clip_plan to Long Media Setup; the Setup automatically uses MultiClip mode.

source_video.tooltip: Full source video as an IMAGE batch. Frames are sliced lazily per LongMedia chunk.

source_fit.tooltip: How source frames are fit to the LongMedia target canvas. center_crop preserves geometry, stretch preserves the full frame but can distort aspect ratio, strict requires an exact size match.

reconstruction_strength.tooltip: Controls native Ref2VA source-reference authority for reconstruction. Balanced start: 0.55. Detail recovery is controlled separately below.

detail_recovery.tooltip: Run the dual-candidate Detail Recovery V3 after the second/global pass. It synthesizes structure detail and microtexture separately while low-frequency geometry, motion and audio remain locked.

detail_strength.tooltip: Strength of bounded multi-band detail transfer from the dedicated detail pass. 0 disables it; 0.35-0.55 is the recommended restoration range.

detail_steps.tooltip: Model evaluations used by the separate detail pass. Three is the recommended start; higher values cost more and can invent texture.

segment_seconds.tooltip: Local reconstruction window. Total source duration may be arbitrarily longer; VRAM follows this window, not total duration.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Hidden temporal continuation context between reconstruction chunks.

source_audio.tooltip: Optional original soundtrack. It is preserved untouched at final output and is not regenerated.

MiniMaxH3LongMediaVideoReconstructor.name: MiniMaxH3LongMediaVideoReconstructor
MiniMaxH3LongMediaVideoReconstructor.description: Prepare arbitrarily long low-quality source video for LongMedia neural reconstruction. The source is processed in local temporal chunks, so total video duration does not scale VRAM.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Review & Accept / 预览并接受候选 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptCandidateT8.description: Preview with accept_candidate=false. When true, atomically promotes the candidate and updates the manifest. Replacing a segment invalidates all dependent later segments.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Accepted Context / 读取已接受上下文 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAcceptedContextLoadT8.description: Loads segment N-1 only from the accepted manifest. It also returns the exact parent candidate identity needed to prevent accepting a stale continuation.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Auto Accept & Continue / 自动接受续跑 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoAutoQueueT8.description: Terminal node for the explicit background workflow. It accepts the current candidate, optionally composes a final MP4, requests the selected release policy even at pause/final boundaries, and queues exactly one next prompt. review_only remains non-mutating.

execution_mode.tooltip: auto_accept_and_continue accepts every successfully rendered candidate without human review and queues the next segment.

max_retries.tooltip: Additional attempts per failed segment; resolution is never reduced.

release_policy.tooltip: Applied after every accepted segment, including pause and final. clear_execution_cache resets ComfyUI execution tensors and soft cache. unload_all_models is stronger but globally unloads every ComfyUI model, not only H3.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Background Start / 后台长视频启动 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoBackgroundStartT8.description: Registers the current prompt before model execution so upstream OOM/errors can be retried. review_only is non-mutating; auto_accept_and_continue must be selected explicitly. Connect chain_id and controller outputs to the background workflow.

candidate_id.tooltip: Blank creates a unique id. Set a new id for every intentional re-roll.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Save Candidate / 保存候选片段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoCandidateSaveT8.description: Atomically writes only the current trimmed segment plus its bounded AV tail. It does not change accepted history; connect the descriptor to Review & Accept.

enabled.tooltip: Default on. Disable for exact source frames while still recording the tail statistics for a later segment.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Color Match / 长视频接缝颜色统一 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoColorMatchT8Advanced.description: Default-on optional seam color matching after Output Trim. Segment 0 stores its actual tail statistics; later segments use bounded global Lab distribution matching plus an 8x5 local RGB correction that fades out. Audio and native AV latent are never changed.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Compose Accepted / 合成已接受片段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoComposeAcceptedT8.description: Verifies every accepted file and streams them into one MP4. Memory is bounded to one video frame plus one segment of PCM; cosine_bridge preserves the exact sample count.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

context_audio.tooltip: video_and_audio continues the generated AV latent. video_only keeps motion context but leaves audio to the selected native/source mode.

first_frame.tooltip: Exact frame 0 for the first segment. Later segments normally ignore it; persistent_identity_reference may reuse it as a compatibility fallback.

first_frame_reuse.tooltip: segment0_only preserves legacy behavior. persistent_identity_reference adds one non-timeline image reference on continuation segments. A connected persistent_identity_image is preferred; otherwise first_frame is reused. This remains experimental, adds reference rows/VRAM, and is not identity lock.

persistent_identity_image.tooltip: Optional continuation-only identity crop. Prefer one clear face or upper-body image. It is ignored on segment 0 and unless first_frame_reuse is set to persistent_identity_reference; first_frame still owns exact frame 0.

persistent_identity_strategy.tooltip: single_reference uses persistent_identity_image when connected, otherwise first_frame. scene_plus_identity supplies both images as separate references; it costs more reference rows/VRAM and remains a gated experiment.

persistent_identity_interval.tooltip: Continuation injection interval. 1 preserves the existing every-segment behavior; 2 injects on continuation segments 1, 3, 5, ... and lets the intermediate segments use motion context only. This is an Experimental identity-versus-motion control, not an adaptive drift detector.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Conditioning / 长视频续写条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoConditioningT8.description: Independent long-video conditioning. It returns a cloned MODEL with a local H3 payload/layout patch; the input MODEL and all stable T8 nodes remain unchanged.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Previous Context / 读取上一段上下文 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextLoadT8.description: Segment 0 returns an empty passthrough context. Segment N loads only the validated AV tail saved for segment N-1; it never selects the newest file.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Save AV Tail / 保存下一段上下文 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoContextSaveT8.description: Atomically saves only the bounded H3 AV tail for this segment. Re-running the same segment replaces its own slot and never changes segment N-1.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

global_prompt.tooltip: Used when Prompt Relay is disabled. With Relay, leave empty or copy the Plan global prompt exactly.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Prompt overrides must be empty when Prompt Relay owns the timeline.

prompt_relay_mode.tooltip: disabled is exact bypass; report_only compiles/projects Relay without attention bias; apply_exp enables the projected route.

eav_mode.tooltip: Stock20 only. report_only audits CFI/g without modifying attention; apply_exp enables target-video FETA gain.

minimum_free_vram_mib.tooltip: Rechecked before every segment; this is a start floor, not a peak guarantee.

long_video_sampling_plan.tooltip: Optional Tail/manual second-pass plan. Prompt Relay remains scoped; EAV audits pass 1 only for manual second-pass mode.

source_motion.tooltip: Dance RGB motion source. Read a different source interval per segment; generated continuity is separate.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 In-Node Long Video + Relay/EAV / 内循环长视频增强 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopEffectsT8Adv.description: Append-only long-video runner that projects one global Prompt Relay timeline into every segment and/or creates one fresh Enhance-A-Video audit runtime per segment. Relay+EAV uses one Relay-then-FETA attention owner. The original in-node loop node and every old workflow remain unchanged.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

render_window_frames.tooltip: Each segment is sampled independently with this fixed H3 window. 124 is the bounded-memory baseline.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Optional list/object. Each segment may override prompt, seed and note.

resume_existing.tooltip: Resume only when the saved job contract matches. Disable to require an empty chain_id.

long_video_sampling_plan.tooltip: Optional Tail/manual second-pass plan. Disconnect to preserve the original loop sampler and cache contract.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 In-Node Long Video Loop / 节点内循环长视频 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoInNodeLoopT8Advanced.description: One execution generates all H3 segments strictly in sequence, atomically accepts each completed segment, resumes from disk after interruption, and streams the accepted files into one final VIDEO. Existing long-video nodes and workflows are unchanged. This route intentionally has no per-segment human review gate; use the existing Background route when review is required.

render_window_frames.tooltip: Fixed internal H3 window for every segment. Keep 124 for the current bounded-memory baseline; larger windows require separate VRAM validation.

segment_prompts_json.tooltip: Optional list/object. Each item may contain prompt, seed and note. Unspecified segments use global_prompt and the selected seed policy.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Chain Orchestrator / 总时长自动分段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoOrchestratorT8.description: Converts a total duration into a fixed-window H3 timeline and resumes at the first unaccepted manifest segment. A completed final manifest blocks downstream sampling instead of generating an accidental extra segment.

minimum_render_frames.tooltip: Keep 124 for the current approximate H3 trained minimum.

timeline_start_seconds.tooltip: -1 derives the fixed-settings timeline from the quantized first and continuation segment durations; set it explicitly if earlier settings differ.

is_final_segment.tooltip: Only the final segment may trim a hidden tail for an exact requested duration. Its continuation checkpoint is disabled automatically.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8
MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Segment Planner / 长视频分段规划 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoPlannerT8.description: Plans one retry-safe H3 chain segment. Segment 0 has no overlap; later segments render a 5/22/39-frame head context and expose exact AV trim metadata.

manual_sigmas.tooltip: Used only by manual_second_pass; must strictly descend to 0.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Tail/Second Pass Plan (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSamplingPlanT8Advanced.description: Optional append-only sampling plan for the two in-node long-video runners. Disconnected/disabled preserves their old sampler exactly.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Seam Drift / 长视频接缝色彩漂移审计 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoSeamDriftT8Advanced.description: Reports seam brightness, white-balance, chroma, texture and optional person-ROI changes. The opt-in candidate uses only bounded low-frequency gain/offset and rolls unsafe frames back to source. It never sharpens, invents detail or touches audio.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Video Voice Context / 长视频人物音色与句界 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceContextT8Advanced.description: Compiles Character-to-<Audio N> bindings, exact global/local audio pin frames, per-segment prompts and cross-boundary sentence diagnostics for the existing long-video runtime. It never reinjects or cuts waveform audio.

MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Context Review Gate / 首段人工确认门 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LongVideoVoiceReviewGateT8Advan.description: Releases the compiled segment prompts only after the optional first-shot human review is accepted. This is a planning gate; a real pause between segments uses the existing Background/Accepted workflow.

images.tooltip: Decoded images from the CURRENT H3 sample. The leading pinned overlap is removed.

trim_frames.tooltip: Connect trim_frames from MiniMax H3 Context Loop Context. In head mode this removes the repeated overlap; before mode supplies 0.

audio.tooltip: Decoded audio for the same clip. Trimmed by the matching duration so sound stays locked to picture. Leave unwired for silent clips.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate used to convert the trim into an audio duration. Must match what you feed Create Video.

match_tail.tooltip: Time-conform small H3 audio-grid mismatches so duration equals frames/fps exactly without a silence tail. H3's rounded 40 Hz grid can differ from picture duration by about 8ms.

retain_overlap_frames.tooltip: Legacy/manual visual overlap for an external stitcher. In a 0.5 chain, connect Current Shot's state output below and this integer is ignored; Loop Trim then resolves the exact per-scene blend from the Plan automatically.

state.tooltip: Recommended 0.5 chain route: connect Current Shot's state output. Loop Trim reads the active scene's resolved blend directly, so a Plan default can never override a per-scene value.

MiniMaxH3LoopTrim.name: MiniMaxH3LoopTrim
MiniMaxH3LoopTrim.description: Remove the leading pinned frames from a decoded H3 clip, trimming picture and sound by the same duration. In 0.5 chains, Current Shot state also resolves the scene blend without a separate default-versus-scene integer wire.
output_tooltips: Delivered frames with the repeated leading context removed.

Audio trimmed by the same duration and, when match_tail is enabled, fitted exactly to the delivered image duration. The same AUDIO value privately carries the full decoded overlap to Segment Save so AV audio feathers survive final assembly; no extra wire is needed.
Optional blend-ready image stream. When overlap_frames is positive, this retains only the final requested part of the repeated visual context before the delivered frames. Audio remains fully trimmed.
Number of repeated leading frames retained in images_with_overlap. Use as an overlap count in a compatible video stitcher.

head_chunks.tooltip: 注意力头分组数。更大通常降低单次 attention 临时显存，但增加调用开销；1 仍启用提前释放，只是不分组。

MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Low VRAM Attention / 低显存注意力 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3LowVRAMAttentionT8Advanced.description: 独立 T8 低显存注意力节点：提前释放 H3 归一化输入，并按头分组调用当前 Core attention。默认 4 组；数值公式不变，但不同内核形状可能产生浮点舍入差异。已有 KJ/Sage/Sol 或其他 callable 补丁不硬拦截；保留外部 block/attention forward 的层可能不安装本节点头分组。报告实际安装/保留层数，组合效果由用户承担。

MiniMaxH3MCJoinMatchEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MCJoinMatchEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MCJoinMatchEXPT8.display_name: H3 MC 接点匹配 · Join Match (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MCJoinMatchEXPT8.description: 独立可选latent统计处理，默认关闭。原算法source_whole_clip会改头部pin；keep_pin_T8是明确的新变体，恢复前22帧对应7单元，不冒称原算法。context_length须与实际已采样pin一致，不能从均值推断真实闪光/硬切应消除；所有结果须从接点到片尾审片。原音频和元数据保留，不增加NFE。 改编自NikoDemon80 Motion Context固定518c083d，GPL3、无担保；完整许可见licenses/MC_MOTION_CONTEXT_GPL3.txt。

MiniMaxH3MCRefineBlendEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MCRefineBlendEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MCRefineBlendEXPT8.display_name: H3 MC 保头细化混合 · Refine Blend (EXP/T8)
