MiniMaxH3MCRefineBlendEXPT8.description: 独立可选后处理，默认关闭。refined必须由显式上游采样器提供，本节点不采样。保持22原帧=7个原生latent单元，随后按物理帧渐变。默认原音频不动；clip_index=0为首段全取refined，不自动读取任何Chain界面。保留LATENT元数据，不保证画质或额外采样收益。 改编自NikoDemon80 Motion Context固定518c083d，GPL3、无担保；完整许可见licenses/MC_MOTION_CONTEXT_GPL3.txt。

MiniMaxH3MCSigmaTailEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MCSigmaTailEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MCSigmaTailEXPT8.display_name: H3 MC 独立Sigma尾部 · Sigma Tail (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MCSigmaTailEXPT8.description: 默认关闭、原SIGMAS对象直通。开启只生成独立的新尾部表，不自动接入HF/PTD/4+4，不修改任何原训练表或步数。此表并未获蒸馏模型兼容/画质认证，需用户显式接线；strength=-1是公式的真实零分母错误；其它可计算选择执行并报告，不以widget意图硬禁。后续联合采样可能改变音画，并非原声保持保证。 改编自NikoDemon80 Motion Context固定518c083d，GPL3、无担保；完整许可见licenses/MC_MOTION_CONTEXT_GPL3.txt。

assignments_json.tooltip: 逐场景明确零基scene_index、A/B和原文。须覆盖scene_count；不自动循环角色、不猜歌词。

MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 MV · A/B独唱分镜＋显式歌词Cue
MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloPlanEXPT8.description: Assign each existing VocalLock scene explicitly to A or B. One solo performer per scene, never a guessed duet. Uses original scene frame clock and one final original-song mux.
MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloPlanEXPT8.category: T8/MiniMax H3/MV & Lip Sync/Cast Solo EXP

model_id.tooltip: 仅审计标签，不是模型字节资格。需实际安装对应模型。

MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloRendererEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloRendererEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloRendererEXPT8.display_name: H3 MV · A/B逐镜独立参考生成
MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloRendererEXPT8.description: Uses the actually selected A/B IMAGE for each independent Ref2VA scene, no previous performer tail. Separate resume identity; original full song muxed once. Mechanical internal assembly is not human quality approval.
MiniMaxH3MVCastSoloRendererEXPT8.category: T8/MiniMax H3/MV & Lip Sync/Cast Solo EXP

global_creative_prompt.default: A singer performs through a coherent cinematic music video with natural expression and intentional scene changes.

performer_description.default: the same lead performer shown in the reference picture

visual_style.default: cinematic music video, natural skin, realistic light and texture

camera_pattern.tooltip: 每行或每个 | 一种镜头，按场景循环使用。
camera_pattern.default:
stable medium close-up with subtle handheld movement
smooth lateral tracking medium shot
restrained slow push-in with a stable background

non_vocal_action.default: keeps the mouth naturally closed and moves with the rhythm

exact_lyrics_json.tooltip: 可选：按场景提供精确歌词字符串列表。留空时绝不猜歌词，也不生成字幕。

MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Ref2VA Prompt Compiler / 本地口型分镜提示词 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVRef2VAPromptCompilerT8Advance.description: Deterministically compiles one six-section Ref2VA prompt per local scene. It uses <Picture 1>/<Audio 1>, never guesses lyrics and also exposes typed Prompt Relay events. No LLM or external API is used.

global_creative_prompt.default: A coherent cinematic performance focused on the same lead performer, with natural expression and restrained motion.

performer_description.default: the same lead performer shown in the reference picture

visual_style.default: cinematic realism, natural skin, realistic light and texture

camera_pattern.tooltip: 每行或每个 | 一种镜头方案。默认锁定机位以减少人物轮廓拖影；显式改为推拉、手持或横移会提高时域重影风险。V2仍强制中近景、正面或3/4脸。
camera_pattern.default: locked-off static camera with stable framing, no camera movement, and continuous mouth visibility

exact_vocal_text_json.tooltip: 可选：按场景提供精确歌词/对白字符串列表；只有这里的原文会进入<d>，留空绝不猜词。

non_vocal_action.default: keeps the mouth naturally closed and breathes with the rhythm

MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockPromptCompilerV2T8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockPromptCompilerV2T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockPromptCompilerV2T8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Vocal Lock Prompt Compiler V2 / 官方六段式口型提示词 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockPromptCompilerV2T8Ad.description: Compiles the official six-section Ref2VA structure with <Subject 1> from <Picture 1>, isolated <Audio 1> reuse, fully_preserved/fully_copy markers, and mandatory visible-mouth performance framing. It is deterministic and local.

full_song.tooltip: 最终成片使用的完整原曲。

vocal_lock_audio.tooltip: 必需：与原曲同起点、同时间线的本地隔离人声或清晰对白。

vocal_active_ratio.tooltip: 场景内高于本地人声能量门的最小时间比例。

manual_boundaries_json.tooltip: 可选秒数列表，例如 [5.2, 11.8]；留空自动分析。

MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockScenePlannerV2T8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockScenePlannerV2T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockScenePlannerV2T8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Vocal Lock Scene Planner V2 / 独立人声分镜 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockScenePlannerV2T8Adva.description: Requires full_song and a timeline-aligned isolated vocal_lock_audio. It uses local CPU energy analysis for boundaries and vocal-active intervals, without transcription, remote separation, an LLM, or any external API.

global_creative_prompt.default: A coherent cinematic performance focused on the same lead performer, with natural expression and restrained motion.

performer_description.default: the same lead performer shown in the reference picture

visual_style.default: cinematic realism, natural skin, realistic light and texture

scene_directions_json.tooltip: 可选：必须与scene_count等长，每项为camera/lighting/performance/emotion对象。留空使用安全棚拍弧线；冲突的镜像、投影、海报、屏幕、背景人物和道具词会拒绝。

exact_vocal_text_json.tooltip: 可选：按场景提供精确歌词/对白；留空绝不猜词。

non_vocal_action.default: keeps the mouth naturally closed and breathes with the rhythm

MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockVisualDirectorV3T8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockVisualDirectorV3T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockVisualDirectorV3T8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Vocal Lock Visual Director V3 / 单人物逐镜头导演 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVVocalLockVisualDirectorV3T8Ad.description: Compiles one explicit six-section Ref2VA shot per scene with an exact one-person, one-face contract that forbids mirrors, projections, screens, posters, duplicate faces, background people and visible props. It is append-only and leaves V2 unchanged.

full_song.tooltip: 最终成片使用的完整原曲。

vocal_policy.tooltip: 没有人声干声时推荐 assume_vocal；energy_proxy 仅按能量估计；vocal_stem_required 要求连接本地干声。

manual_boundaries_json.tooltip: 可选秒数列表，例如 [5.2, 11.8]；留空自动分析。

MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 MV Vocal Scene Planner / 本地歌曲分镜 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MVVocalScenePlannerT8Advanced.description: Analyzes local AUDIO with deterministic CPU tensor math and chooses 5–10s scene boundaries before generation. A local vocal stem is optional. No remote LLM, TTS, music service or external API is called.

MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 Manual Second Pass · Separate Stage Setup (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ManualPassStageSetupEXPT8.description: One original full first stage OR independent manual second stage. Does not sample. Wire first OUTPUT to second latent_image, not learned-upscale denoised_output. Each stage has independent MODEL, conditions and fresh NOISE; same seed reproduces old loops. dual_clock_euler/euler completion adapted; other Core samplers run without false certification.

latent.tooltip: Target MiniMax H3 AV latent. For example, use a 192-frame H3 latent.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

start_frames.tooltip: Full first source clip or a frame batch containing its ending. The final preserve_frames are frozen at the bridge start.

start_audio.tooltip: Audio matching start_frames. The final preserved interval is frozen at the bridge start.

end_frames.tooltip: Full second source clip or a frame batch containing its beginning. The first preserve_frames are frozen at the bridge end.

end_audio.tooltip: Audio matching end_frames. The first preserved interval is frozen at the bridge end.

start_fps.tooltip: Frame rate represented by start_frames. CFR input is converted deterministically to H3 24 fps.

end_fps.tooltip: Frame rate represented by end_frames. CFR input is converted deterministically to H3 24 fps.

preserve_frames.tooltip: Shared AV boundaries only: 39, 90, 141, 192, ... (39 + 51*k). The target must leave a generated middle.

MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge.name: MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge
MiniMaxH3MaskedAVBridge.description: Create a true two-ended H3 AV masked bridge. The ending of the first clip and beginning of the second clip are encoded into the target latent and protected with PR #15375-style video+audio denoise masks; only the middle is generated. 0 = preserve, 1 = denoise.

detail_source.tooltip: generated keeps model texture and only corrects the whole-mask mean; local flicker can remain. source_recolour explicitly keeps the paired original source texture and applies target colour. Use only for colour changes, not replacement geometry, material or generated texture.

MiniMaxH3MaskedColorStabilizeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MaskedColorStabilizeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MaskedColorStabilizeEXPT8.display_name: H3 Masked Color Stabilize / 局部颜色稳定（显式后处理 EXP/T8）
MiniMaxH3MaskedColorStabilizeEXPT8.description: Explicit RGB colour correction after decoding, before optional Composite. Use the original paired source clip/mask and an authored target at source_reference_frame. Retains Lab detail residuals subject to gamut clipping; no motion warp, frame blending, sampling or audio changes. This does not certify the raw model output. Disconnect or set strength=0 to bypass.

MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPat.name: MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPatch
MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPat.display_name: MiniMax H3 Mem Eff Sage Attention Patch
MiniMaxH3MemoryEfficientSageAttentionPat.description: EXPERIMENTAL! Activates custom sageattention on the MiniMax H3 self-attention to reduce peak VRAM usage, overrides the attention mode. Requires latest sageattention version.

strength.tooltip: 相对固定枢轴深度的位移；orbit为strength×100度。大位移补洞更多，非性能/画质保证

camera_plan.tooltip: 高级编辑器自动写入规范JSON；留空使用预设。空间轨与源时间轨独立。

MiniMaxH3MeridianCameraEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianCameraEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianCameraEXPT8.description: 先运行预设获得真实几何预览，再打开大编辑器。固定首源相机坐标、深度单位、roll=0；无反向源时间或自动角色跟踪。改素材/窗口后显式重置旧路径。预览是灰洞点云warp，不是生成视频。

model_path.tooltip: 留空自动寻找models/meridian/meridian_dmd_int8_convrot_comfy.safetensors；支持MERIDIAN_MODEL环境变量。下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Meridian-Comfy；DMD已合并，不重复加载

omega_checkpoint.tooltip: 正确Omega1B512原始PT，不是普通VGGT或INT8。默认models/meridian/vggt-omega/checkpoints/vggt_omega_1b_512.pt；VGGT_OMEGA_CKPT。下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Meridian-Comfy；单独遵守FAIR非商用研究许可

cache_gib.tooltip: 自有磁盘缓存预算，不是显存准入；0关闭磁盘缓存

MiniMaxH3MeridianConfigEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianConfigEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianConfigEXPT8.description: 独立Meridian merged-DMD原生ConvRot INT8。懒加载，不更改旧双采或用户全局优化。外部MODEL/VAE补丁保留并提示未验证，关闭其不可靠的磁盘缓存。模型及Omega下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Meridian-Comfy；两者许可分别适用，源码/assets及H3 VAE另备。

audio_mode.tooltip: 冻结/变速选silent；source_1to1只交付原声，不认证新生成口型

MiniMaxH3MeridianGenerateEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianGenerateEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianGenerateEXPT8.description: 原生INT8 merged-DMD＋两路480级视频token参考＋768级训练桶。CFG1、euler、shift3/3、三次前向，原生joint AV。自动完整解码核验H264 MP4后交付。取消遵循Core普通任务中断；不改旧节点或全局队列。

window_frames.tooltip: 源窗口，按24fps归一；IMAGE只重建一次，不复制成73张再重建

MiniMaxH3MeridianMaterialEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MeridianMaterialEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MeridianMaterialEXPT8.description: 只接IMAGE或VIDEO之一。保留VIDEO活动trim/crop/画面比例，按真实PTS取所选窗口。Omega联合几何一次；1280letterbox后使用训练ROI，不拉伸。大窗口可能OOM，不自动缩小或重复运行。

bias.tooltip: Negative values make the model see a slightly cleaner time. No random noise is added.

MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Smooth Model-Time Bias / 平滑模型时间偏置 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ModelTimeBiasSamplerT8Advanced.description: A scientifically explicit Navyblue/Detail-Daemon-style experiment for H3. It biases only the sigma visible to the shared AV Transformer under a smooth tail window; integration sigmas and NFE stay unchanged.

MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Auto Gate / 动作自动修复旁路 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionAutoGateT8Advanced.description: Uses ComfyUI native lazy inputs. A calm clip marked ABSTAIN returns the exact pass-1 frames/audio without evaluating the connected second-pass graph; only should_repair=true requests the repaired inputs.

conditioning.tooltip: Conditioning from the stock MiniMax H3 Image to Video or Reference to Video node. Motion Context preserves existing Ref2VA references and appends its continuation data.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE used to encode the previous clip's context frames.

latent.tooltip: The NEW clip's empty H3 AV latent from the stock conditioning node. Do not connect the previous sampled latent here; that belongs on the optional context_latent input.

context_frames.tooltip: Decoded, delivered frames from the PREVIOUS clip. Supplying the whole clip is safe: only the requested tail is used.

context_length.tooltip: Exact number of previous-clip frames to carry. Native H3 runs (1, 5, 22, 39, ...) use one efficient video Guide; off-grid values use an exact native still sequence instead of being shortened.

encode_mode.tooltip: video: one efficient temporal VAE call for native H3 run lengths (1, 5, 22, ...); exact off-grid lengths safely fall back to one call per frame. frames: always pin each frame as a separate still.

anchor_mode.tooltip: head: place the Guide on the target timeline; target_start 0 reproduces it at the beginning and returns a trim count. before: legacy negative indices, nothing wasted, but the coordinates overlap the text rows.

crop.tooltip: How context frames are fitted to the new latent canvas. disabled stretches to the target size; center preserves aspect ratio and center-crops.

audio_context_length.tooltip: Frames of tail audio to pin, independent of the video window. 0 follows context_length. In timeline mode the window is END-aligned with the pinned video, so 22 with a 22-frame video window overlays it exactly; longer windows extend backwards into vacated coordinate space for longer or audio-only continuity.

audio_mode.tooltip: timeline: pinned audio gets coordinates on this clip's own timeline, end-aligned with the pinned video, so the model reads it as this clip's sound so far and continues it. ref: stock placement in a span before the clip, which the model imitates (similar music, not phase-locked) rather than continues.

target_start.tooltip: Target frame where a head-mode visual Guide begins. 0 keeps normal continuation and returns the overlap trim; a positive value places the Guide inside the target and returns trim 0. Legacy before mode requires 0.

context_latent.tooltip: Previous clip's SAMPLER OUTPUT latent (the same one you wire into the decode nodes). When supplied, the pinned audio is sliced straight from it, skipping the decode/re-encode round trip that dulls sound a little more at every link of a chain. Takes priority over context_audio; audio_vae is not needed on this path.

audio_vae.tooltip: H3 audio VAE. Supply with context_audio to carry the previous clip's tail sound across the join. Not needed when context_latent is wired.

context_audio.tooltip: Audio of the previous clip. The tail matching the pinned frames is encoded and pinned alongside them. Ignored when context_latent is wired.

video_context_latent.tooltip: Previous clip's sampler-output H3 latent. When supplied in video encode mode, its phase-aligned video tail becomes the Guide block directly, avoiding RGB decode and VAE re-encode. Incompatible or imported context falls back to context_frames.

MiniMaxH3MotionContext.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContext
MiniMaxH3MotionContext.description: Pin a run of consecutive frames from a previous clip as never-denoised conditioning rows, so the model reads real motion instead of guessing it from a single still. Stock and semantic anchors are preserved outside the carried Guide interval.
output_tooltips: Conditioning with the previous clip's motion and optional timeline audio appended. Connect this to the guider/sampler path.
Number of pinned leading frames reproduced at target_start 0. Connect to MiniMax H3 Context Loop Trim; before mode and interior Guide placement return 0.

segments.tooltip: How many clips Chain generates before it stops. 0 keeps going until you click Stop.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextChain.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextChain
MiniMaxH3MotionContextChain.description: Approve advances Load/Save and runs the next clip. Run/Re-roll queues the current slot (use this instead of ComfyUI's Run). Chain is Approve on a loop; at Load 0 / Save 1 with no clip 1 saved it generates clip 1 first. segments is how many clips Chain runs before stopping (0 = until Stop). Reset sets Load 0 / Save 1. Clear latents deletes numbered chain slots. Load, Save, and this node must sit in the same canvas group or the buttons do nothing.

codec.tooltip: H.264 automatically uses NVIDIA NVENC hardware encoding when available, with transparent libx264 CPU fallback. Choose H.264 CPU (libx264) to force software encoding.

autoplay.tooltip: Auto-play the video preview when generating finishes or the node is loaded.

auto_save_project.tooltip: Save a portable .ext project beside each completed Full Batch video. All three modes supported. Ignored in Clip-by-Clip and for interrupted batches. Large projects add disk space and saving time.

save_individual_clips.tooltip: Full Batch only. Export each final user-visible clip beside the assembled video, with final video treatment and audio. Disabled leaves the existing export path unchanged.

relayvsr_x2.tooltip: Optional RelayVSR x2 on the COMPLETE finished video only. Automatically downloads official weights once when missing. Keeps the H3 original.

relayvsr_detail.tooltip: RelayVSR x2 detail strength in percent (0 = bicubic-like, 100 = full generated detail). Default 50%. Affects only the RelayVSR output, never H3 clips.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextDiskFinalDecode.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextDiskFinalDecode
MiniMaxH3MotionContextDiskFinalDecode.display_name: MiniMax H3 Extender Final Decode / Preview

MiniMaxH3MotionContextDiskJoin.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextDiskJoin
MiniMaxH3MotionContextDiskJoin.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Context Disk Join

latent_path.tooltip: A saved latent file, or a folder (relative paths resolve against the ComfyUI output directory). Pointing at a specific FILE always loads that file, ignoring clip_index.

clip_index.tooltip: The clip to CONTINUE FROM: that clip's slot is loaded. Generating clip 2 from clip 1: set 1 here and 2 on the Save node. 0 = newest file in the folder (NOT retry-safe: a re-roll loads its own rejected audio).

vae.tooltip: Optional video VAE. When connected, decodes and outputs previous clip frames as IMAGE.

audio_vae.tooltip: Optional audio VAE. When connected, decodes and outputs previous clip soundtrack as AUDIO.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextLoadLatent.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextLoadLatent
MiniMaxH3MotionContextLoadLatent.description: Load an AV latent saved by MiniMax H3 Save AV Latent. Can also decode images and audio if VAEs are connected.
output_tooltips: Saved previous-clip AV latent for Video Extender's prev_latent or Motion Context's context_latent.
Decoded frames of previous clip (when VAE is connected). Wire to Video Merge (images_a) or Video Extender (prev_frames).
Decoded audio of previous clip (when audio_vae is connected). Wire to Video Merge (audio_a) or Video Extender (prev_audio).

latent.tooltip: The sampler's output latent (the same one you wire into the decode nodes).

filename_prefix.tooltip: Saved under the ComfyUI output folder. The default keeps all chain latents in one folder so the Load node can always pick the newest.

clip_index.tooltip: Which clip of the chain THIS is. Saves to that clip's fixed slot, so a re-roll overwrites its own reject instead of stacking new files. Generating clip 2: set 2 here and 1 on the Load node. 0 = old behaviour, a new numbered file every run (numbers count runs, not clips).

MiniMaxH3MotionContextSaveLatent.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextSaveLatent
MiniMaxH3MotionContextSaveLatent.description: Save the sampler's AV latent to disk so the next run can load it for lossless motion & audio continuation.
output_tooltips: Passthrough of the input latent so you can wire this node directly in-line.
Absolute path of the saved H3 AV safetensors checkpoint.

clip_b_untrimmed.tooltip: This clip's audio straight off the VAE decode, BEFORE the trim node. It still carries the pinned head, which is what gets compared.

trim_frames.tooltip: Wire this from the Motion Context node's trim output, the same value the trim node gets. It is the pinned span.

clip_a_latent.tooltip: The PREVIOUS clip's AV latent: the same one wired into Motion Context's context_latent. The node decodes and tail-matches it itself. Without it only clip B is described, nothing is measured.

audio_vae.tooltip: The H3 audio VAE, needed to decode clip A's audio out of its latent.

fps.tooltip: Must match what you feed Create Video.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextSeamProbe.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextSeamProbe
MiniMaxH3MotionContextSeamProbe.description: Measure a chain join in the graph: does clip B continue clip A's audio, and does the level step at the cut.
output_tooltips: clip_b_untrimmed, unchanged. Wire it on to the trim node.
The measurement report, for a Preview Text node.

audio.tooltip: Decoded audio for the same clip. Trimmed by the matching duration so sound stays locked to picture. Leave unwired for silent clips.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate used to convert the trim into an audio duration. Must match what you feed Create Video.

match_tail.tooltip: Time-conform decoded audio so its duration equals frames/fps exactly. H3's 40-Hz audio grid can land a few milliseconds before or after a 24-fps picture boundary; this prevents that drift from accumulating across chained clips.

video_crossfade_frames.tooltip: Video overlap retained for final KJ crossfade. Audio still trims the full context.

MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim.name: MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim
MiniMaxH3MotionContextTrim.description: Remove the leading pinned frames from a decoded H3 clip, trimming picture and sound by the same duration.

MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Load Verified First Pass (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionFrozenFirstPassLoadEXPT8.description: Explicit cold Motion source. Requires an independently retained native AV manifest and whole-file SHA, exact first-pass ID and original H3 geometry. Never samples or silently accepts a different frozen source.

mode.tooltip: report_only never expands frames. auto_conservative_exp applies only when all abstain gates pass. manual_ranges uses the ranges field exactly.

manual_ranges.tooltip: Examples: 36-60:4 or 1.5s-2.4s:3; used only in manual_ranges mode.

minimum_residual_motion.tooltip: Absolute decoded-frame residual gate after a small global-translation search. This prevents a quantile-only rule from always selecting something.

MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroug.name: MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroughEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroug.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Overload Analyze Pass-through / 动作过载串行分析 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzePassThroug.description: Runs the same source-bound motion analysis as the original node, but only as a downstream dependency. Use for single-output graph delivery when a non-idempotent checkpoint writer is upstream.

mode.tooltip: report_only never expands frames. auto_conservative_exp applies only when all abstain gates pass. manual_ranges uses the ranges field exactly.

manual_ranges.tooltip: Examples: 36-60:4 or 1.5s-2.4s:3; used only in manual_ranges mode.

minimum_residual_motion.tooltip: Absolute decoded-frame residual gate after a small global-translation search. This prevents a quantile-only rule from always selecting something.

MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Overload Analyze / 动作过载分析 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionOverloadAnalyzeT8Advanced.description: Read-only H3 latent and decoded-frame analysis. It separates motion measurement from compute allocation, can abstain on calm clips, and never patches MODEL or sampling.

MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Quality Audit / 高速动态质量审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionQualityAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only, dependency-free temporal proxy audit. Use a reviewed face/subject mask or manual ROI for face-focused analysis. It does not claim face identity detection and never changes, uploads, or automatically accepts generated media.

audio_mode.tooltip: pass1_original is the stable exact-pass1 default. A full human review rejected pass2_recovered_exp because its middle window suddenly sounded distant before returning; keep it diagnostic-only. blend_exp sounded normal in that one clip at pass1_mix=0.8 but remains opt-in.

pass1_mix.tooltip: Used only by blend_exp; 1.0 is all pass-1 audio. One reviewed I2VA clip passed at 0.8, which is not a general audio guarantee.

MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Recover AV / 动作音画回时钟 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoverAVT8Advanced.description: Returns the regenerated clip to its exact world-frame clock by selecting one real generated frame from every hold group. The safe default keeps pass-1 audio and does not phase-vocode the deliverable soundtrack.

denoise_fraction.tooltip: Fraction of the existing schedule retained for pass 2; not a sigma value.

MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Recovery Composer / 动作二采编排 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRecoveryComposerT8Advance.description: Authenticates the prepared AV latent and signed plan, then selects the final fraction of an existing H3 sigma schedule for the second V2V pass. It installs no MODEL wrapper and never auto-stacks EAV, STG, Restart or BlockCache.

MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Bind External Prompt Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayBindEXPT8.description: Pair the stock external Relay MODEL/CONDITIONING with the signed retimed pass-2 AV. Relay's generated AV is used only to authenticate the packed layout, never to replace Motion's VAE/phase-vocoder source. Connect Stage EAV Config→Apply→Audit separately to observe actual calls.

MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Retimed Relay Length (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionRelayLengthEXPT8.description: Expose the signed expanded H3 frame count to an independent Prompt Relay Plan. Rejects abstain and unaligned timelines; no model call or sampling.

MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Repair Plan / 动态风险重做计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRepairPlanT8Advanced.description: Maps Motion Quality Audit proxy ranges into the existing non-destructive Selective Repair Plan. It never renders, overwrites, or automatically accepts media.

MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Retiming Prepare / 动作扩时二采准备 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionRetimingPrepareT8Advanced.description: Expands only the frames selected by a signed motion plan, encodes the longer H3 video latent, and optionally seeds the shared AV Transformer with a phase-vocoder guide made from pass-1 audio. Keep final audio on pass1_original unless explicitly reviewed.

MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Segment Plan / 动作分段窗口计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionSegmentPlanT8Advanced.description: Turns one signed full-clip motion plan into budgeted sequential windows. It does not impose a global pixel/frame prohibition; it reports hot cuts so the user can raise the budget or lower max_hold before rendering.

MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Audit Pass 2 Candidate (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditEXPT8.description: Before Recover AV and optional Window Collect/Gate, recheck that the sampled candidate belongs to the current motion plan and exact connected source/retimed AV. Original pass-1 audio remains the safe delivery default; no quality approval.

MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditPassThroughEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditPassThroughEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditPassThroughEXPT.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Audit Pass 2 In-line (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionStageAuditPassThroughEXPT.description: The same source-bound second-pass candidate audit, only as an in-line dependency of a single final output sink.

MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Motion Recovery · Bind Separate Pass 2 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MotionStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind the signed motion plan, original frames/audio, expanded frames/audio seed, actual AV and external MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS before one independent refinement pass. Does not run a VAE, sampler, phase vocoder or delivery decision.

store_dtype.tooltip: float32_exact preserves recovered frame values; float16_half_disk halves the frame-bank storage but is not pixel-exact.

MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Motion Window Collect / 动作窗口断点收集 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MotionWindowCollectT8Advanced.description: Banks one recovered window per queue item and deterministically assembles all signed windows when complete. Missing windows pass the baseline through, so a cancel, crash or OOM requires rerendering only the missing item.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Enabled by default so the candidate reaches the final composite. Disable only when you want a preview-only run that returns the original frames.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Multi-Face Composite / 多人候选合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceCompositeT8Advanced.description: Applies one shot-local Face Refine candidate to the original full video and chains up to three people. Candidates are accepted by default so the example produces a repaired final video; disable accept_candidate for preview-only review. Overlapping masks still reject by default, pixels outside the audited changed mask remain bit-exact, and audio is untouched.

window_frame_count.tooltip: Must be 5, 22, 39, 56, 73, 90, 107 or 124. The 73-frame default is about 3.04 seconds at 24 fps. If a shot is short by at most 16 frames, its last frame is used only as H3 context and the padded tail is discarded during final composition.

crop_scale_mode.tooltip: legacy_crop_factor preserves existing workflows. target_face_px automatically resolves crop_factor so the face reaches at least about the requested height in a manual H3 crop canvas. Source boundaries can make it larger.

target_face_px.tooltip: Minimum target face height inside the H3 crop canvas. The reviewed 512px single-person route covered about 205-312px; 300px targets its upper end.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Multi-Face Repair Job / 单角色修复任务 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceRepairJobT8Advanced.description: Selects one character in one shot and creates a 17n+5 Face Refine Parity job. YuNet localizes the face inside that person's SAM mask; SFace rejects identity-incompatible detections. Generate each person sequentially, then composite.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Multi-Face · Load Exact Source Inputs (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceLoadEXPT8.description: Restore selected original plan/window/AV without rerunning SAM, VAE encode or sampling. Requires exact independent completed stage and current full parent RGB/audio. No approval.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Multi-Face · Save Exact Source Inputs (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceSourceSaveEXPT8.description: Explicitly save one character's original plan, source window and encoded AV after verified sampling. Binds exact parent RGB/audio and independent StageResult. No approval.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Multi-Face · Source-Bound Candidate Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageAuditEXPT8.description: Before Parity Stitch and sequential Composite, verify that this sampled character candidate belongs to the same job window, unchanged parent and source AV. Unknown sampler completion is not portable or automatically accepted.

MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Multi-Face · Bind One Character Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3MultiFaceStageBindEXPT8.description: Bind one multi-person repair job, its model window and unchanged parent source to a separate sampled stage. Verify absolute window/padding and actual external MODEL, SAMPLER, SIGMAS and AV; each character needs its own instance. Does not auto-accept.

model.tooltip: MiniMax H3 MODEL; the output is a scoped clone.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

task_type.tooltip: Middle timeline keyframes require both first and last frames. Use Hybrid when reference media is also connected.

first_frame_noise_aug.display_name: first frame raw noise_aug / 首帧原始混噪值
first_frame_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 value for the first timeline frame, not a calibrated strength percentage. Keep 0.999 unless running a controlled A/B.

last_frame_noise_aug.display_name: last frame raw noise_aug / 尾帧原始混噪值
last_frame_noise_aug.tooltip: Raw H3 value for the last timeline frame, not a calibrated strength percentage. Keep 0.999 unless running a controlled A/B.

reference_visual_noise_aug.display_name: reference raw noise_aug / 普通视觉参考全局值
reference_visual_noise_aug.tooltip: One raw H3 value shared by non-timeline image/video reference blocks; not an independent or calibrated strength percentage.

MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Multi-Keyframe Conditioning / 多关键帧条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3MultiKeyframeConditioningT8Adva.description: Opt-in Advanced FL2VA/Hybrid conditioning with first, last, and chained middle timeline keyframes. It clones MODEL and uses scoped H3 patches; the stable Conditioning node and saved workflows remain unchanged.

video_steps.tooltip: Number of committed video Euler macro updates.

audio_steps.tooltip: Number of audio micro updates and full joint H3 DiT calls. Must be at least video_steps.

MiniMaxH3MultiRateSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3MultiRateSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3MultiRateSamplerEXPT8.description: Experimental H3 Euler sampler: video uses macro steps while audio uses more micro steps. audio_steps is the actual number of full joint H3 DiT calls, so 4/10 costs about 10 model evaluations, not 4. Start with 4/8.

active_clips.tooltip: Generate Clip 1 through Clip N. Later clip groups are automatically and visibly bypassed.

previews.tooltip: Off disables all clip previews. Last Active previews only the final enabled clip. All Active previews every enabled clip.

MiniMaxH3MusicVideoController.name: MiniMaxH3MusicVideoController
MiniMaxH3MusicVideoController.description: Workflow controller for the checkpoint-free H3 Music Video example. Its frontend companion applies real ComfyUI bypass mode to tagged clip/preview groups and mirrors Active Clips into a cache-isolated execution parameter.

MiniMaxH3NAGAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NAGAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NAGAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 NAG · Actual Calls / 实际调用 (T8 EXP)

MiniMaxH3NAGEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NAGEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NAGEXPT8.display_name: H3 NAG · Negative Attention / 负向注意力 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NAGEXPT8.description: Negative attention guidance works at CFG=1. Enabled NAG with an encoded empty prompt is different from disabling it. Adds a dense negative attention pass in each active block. The selected forward, head groups and positive attention override are preserved. A custom producer must expose the optimized-attention/output-projection interface. Existing model and LoRA selection is preserved; disabling this node leaves upstream patches intact.

mode.tooltip: disabled performs the same Euler math without file I/O; checkpoint_each_step writes after every completed NFE; resume loads the last valid boundary and emits only its remaining sigmas.

checkpoint_path.tooltip: Relative path under output/MiniMaxH3/nfe_checkpoints. Absolute paths, traversal and symlinks are rejected. Use a unique name per render.

model_contract_id.tooltip: Required outside disabled mode. Record the exact base checkpoint/hash, all LoRAs and strengths, and attention/model wrappers. A mismatch blocks resume; the node does not pretend this text hashes all loaded weights.

run_contract_json.tooltip: Required non-empty JSON outside disabled mode. Connect the MiniMax H3 NFE Run Contract output, or paste another strict immutable JSON object. The plain Conditioning report is text, not valid JSON.

confirm_checkpoint_write.tooltip: Safety gate. Required for checkpoint_each_step. In resume mode, false continues read-only; true also advances the same atomic checkpoint.

allow_replace_existing.tooltip: Only for intentionally starting a new session at an existing path. Resume of the already verified same session does not need this switch.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Upper CPU chunk used to verify every checkpoint tensor. It changes verification memory/speed, never the mathematical state.

MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock NFE Checkpoint + Resume / 双时钟步边界断点恢复 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NFEResumeSamplerT8Advanced.description: Append-only experimental sampler setup for exact completed-step checkpoints of T8 dual_clock_euler/native_flow. It atomically stores the packed AV state, original noise/latent/mask and complete sigma table after every finished NFE. Other samplers, mid-forward recovery and undeclared model/conditioning changes fail closed. Existing samplers and workflows are unchanged.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Upper CPU transfer chunk while hashing conditioning tensors. It only changes verification memory/speed, never the contract hash.

MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 NFE Run Contract / 断点运行合约编译器 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NFERunContractT8Advanced.description: Compiles the exact final prompt, media map, conditioning report and real conditioning tensor contents into strict deterministic JSON for the NFE checkpoint/resume node. It never mutates conditioning or sampler state.

MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Native Dual · Learned / Audio Handoff (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NativeDualHandoffEXPT8.description: Original Dual audio reconciliation after the existing learned3D upscaler. LOW4 auto continues unfinished joint audio; LOW20 auto preserves completed audio. Keeps template-locked audio prefix and old first_pass/zero migration. No sampler or upscale.

MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 Native Dual · Separate LOW4 / LOW20 / HIGH3-5 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NativeDualStageSetupEXPT8.description: Sets up ONE original Dual stage: LOW4 is simple8 prefix, LOW20 full native flow, HIGH3/4/5 published LBH tables with this MODEL's own AV shifts. No sampling or loop. LOW denoised_output -> existing learned3D -> Native Dual Handoff -> independent HIGH.

checkpoint_path.tooltip: Relative .h3latent.safetensors path returned by the Save node. It may be pasted after a restart or connected directly in the same graph.

expected_manifest_json.tooltip: Optional independently retained manifest. When supplied, any latent, mask, metadata, dtype, shape or checkpoint-ID mismatch fails closed.

expected_file_sha256.tooltip: Optional whole-file SHA-256 returned by Save. Use it to detect replacement of both payload and embedded manifest.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: CPU hash chunk bound; it does not change the resulting digest.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native AV Latent Checkpoint Load / 原生音画Latent检查点加载 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointLoadT8Adv.description: Loads one H3 no-pickle AV latent checkpoint from the bounded ComfyUI output store, verifies its embedded exact-content manifest, and optionally requires an independently saved manifest and whole-file SHA-256.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Relative filename prefix under output/MiniMaxH3/latent_checkpoints. A unique suffix is always added; absolute and traversal paths are rejected.

checkpoint_id.tooltip: Logical identity that must match when the checkpoint is reloaded.

confirm_save.tooltip: Safety gate. False only computes the exact content manifest and writes nothing; enable explicitly after reviewing the target and checkpoint ID.

verify_after_write.tooltip: Reloads the temporary safetensors file and verifies its embedded exact AV manifest before atomic placement. Keep enabled for resumable work.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Maximum temporary CPU hash chunk. This changes memory/speed only, not the checkpoint content digest.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThrou.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThroughSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThrou.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native AV Checkpoint Pass-through Save / 原生音画检查点串行保存 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointPassThrou.description: Non-output checkpoint writer for a single downstream delivery path. It preserves the exact AV latent while writing the same verified native checkpoint format. Repeated evaluation within one Core execution reuses the first file only after the exact AV manifest matches; confirm_save remains false by default.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Relative filename prefix under output/MiniMaxH3/latent_checkpoints. A unique suffix is always added; absolute and traversal paths are rejected.

checkpoint_id.tooltip: Logical identity that must match when the checkpoint is reloaded.

confirm_save.tooltip: Safety gate. False only computes the exact content manifest and writes nothing; enable explicitly after reviewing the target and checkpoint ID.

verify_after_write.tooltip: Reloads the temporary safetensors file and verifies its embedded exact AV manifest before atomic placement. Keep enabled for resumable work.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Maximum temporary CPU hash chunk. This changes memory/speed only, not the checkpoint content digest.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native AV Latent Checkpoint Save / 原生音画Latent检查点保存 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentCheckpointSaveT8Adv.description: Atomically saves one complete H3 nested video/audio latent as a no-pickle .h3latent.safetensors checkpoint under the ComfyUI output directory. confirm_save is false by default and existing files are never overwritten.

timeline_latent.tooltip: Segment 0, or the output of this node from the previous continuation.

continuation_segment.tooltip: The sampled latent produced by the matching Long Video Conditioning.

planner_report_json.tooltip: Connect Long Video Segment Planner report_json for this segment.

conditioning_report_json.tooltip: Connect Long Video Conditioning report_json used for this segment.

output_device.tooltip: cpu keeps the combined output off GPU, but does not evict ComfyUI's cached input latents or models.

audio_context_policy.tooltip: The safe default requires the previous audio tail to have been supplied to Long Video Conditioning. allow_video_only still removes the overlap duration but cannot claim audio continuity.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Latent Continuation Concat / 原生续段去重拼接 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentContinuationConcatT.description: Appends one H3 Long Video continuation and removes its complete proven 5/22/39-frame head context on the native video/audio clocks. Planner and Conditioning reports must be connected directly; no sampling or VAE decode runs.

checkpoint_id.tooltip: Logical checkpoint identity; must match during resume verification.

expected_manifest_json.tooltip: Leave empty to create a baseline. Paste the previously saved manifest to verify a reloaded latent before continuing.

mismatch_policy.tooltip: error is the safe resume default. report_only exposes a MISMATCH report without allowing it to be mistaken for a verified checkpoint.

hash_chunk_megabytes.tooltip: Upper bound for each temporary CPU hash chunk. It affects speed/memory, not the resulting content SHA-256.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Latent Resume Manifest / 原生Latent恢复清单 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentResumeManifestT8Adv.description: Builds a chunked exact SHA-256 manifest for one complete H3 AV latent. When a previous manifest is supplied, the default policy fails closed on any content, shape, dtype, mask or checkpoint-ID mismatch. It writes no files.

output_device.tooltip: cpu avoids allocating the combined output on GPU. Input tensors can still remain cached by ComfyUI, so this is not a global unload operation.

require_identical_metadata.tooltip: When enabled, non-sample metadata must match exactly. Otherwise the first segment's metadata is preserved and differences are reported.

MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Latent Timeline Concat / 原生时格拼接 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeLatentTimelineConcatT8Adv.description: Concatenates independently sampled complete H3 AV latents on the native temporal grid: later video segments drop the exact 5-frame/2-latent prefix and audio drops a cumulative 24fps-to-40Hz phase amount. No sampling or VAE decode is performed.

av_latent.tooltip: Connect the matching Long Video Conditioning latent before the sampler.

context.tooltip: Connect the same validated Previous Context used by Conditioning.

planner_report_json.tooltip: Connect the matching Segment Planner report_json directly.

conditioning_report_json.tooltip: Connect the matching Long Video Conditioning report_json directly. Conditioning must use context_audio=video_only.

MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Native Masked Video Context / 原生画面硬续接 Plan B (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3NativeMaskedVideoContextT8Advan.description: Plan B for Long Video continuation. It copies the validated previous native video-latent tail into the current target and hard-locks only that video prefix. The current audio tensor and any Vocal Lock audio mask are reused unchanged.

MiniMaxH3NativeStageBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NativeStageBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NativeStageBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Native · Bind Explicit Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NativeStageBindEXPT8.description: Connect an existing native MODEL/SAMPLER/SIGMAS and stage latent. No sampling, schedule replacement or hidden second pass. Adds stage effects/results to base-flow, LBH and complete-first graphs. Keep the original upscaler/audio reconcile outside. Not a PDD/VDN/V2 qualification.

MiniMaxH3NoFaceDecisionEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3NoFaceDecisionEXPT8
MiniMaxH3NoFaceDecisionEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Explicit No-Face Decision (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3NoFaceDecisionEXPT8.description: Connect Boolean to Core If/Else Switch: true=original Face branch, false=original full RGB/AUDIO. UNKNOWN/negative-unconfirmed block delivery, not false. No-face requires manual confirmation and exact current observation SHA; not human truth or Stage completion.

MiniMaxH3NodeSourceDiagnosticT8.name: MiniMaxH3NodeSourceDiagnosticT8
MiniMaxH3NodeSourceDiagnosticT8.display_name: T8 节点来源／运行版本诊断

MiniMaxH3ObservedParityPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ObservedParityPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ObservedParityPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Original Parity Plan from ONCE Observe (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ObservedParityPlanEXPT8.description: Original unmodified planner/code/math/schema outputs; read the bound detector observations once in a call-local namespace, no module-global mutation or second YOLO. Use ONLY on selected face-found lazy branch; no-face/unknown never manufactures a plan. Original crop/manual ROI fallback parameters remain independently editable.

scene_cut_threshold.tooltip: Low-resolution RGB mean absolute difference; smoothing resets at every cut.

MiniMaxH3ObservedStandardPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ObservedStandardPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ObservedStandardPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Original Standard Plan from ONCE Observe (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ObservedStandardPlanEXPT8.description: Original unmodified planner/code/math/schema outputs; read the bound detector observations once in a call-local namespace, no module-global mutation or second YOLO. Use ONLY on selected face-found lazy branch; no-face/unknown never manufactures a plan. Original crop/manual ROI fallback parameters remain independently editable.

MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Official Risk Diagnostic / 官方问题证据诊断 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3OfficialRiskDiagnosticT8Advance.description: Read-only evidence classifier for VRAM/V-copy, reference load, Sage FP8, audio integrity, multi-speaker cross-talk and periodic dark flashes. Unknown remains unknown; no model fingerprint or canvas-size hard gate is used.

MiniMaxH3OmniPromptBridge.name: MiniMaxH3OmniPromptBridge
MiniMaxH3OmniPromptBridge.display_name: MiniMax H3 Omni Media Prompt Bridge
MiniMaxH3OmniPromptBridge.description: Read the planner's ordered Omni media bundle and call the MiniMax-H3 Prompt Rewriter Omni backend directly, without expanding or wiring individual media ports.

MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Open Regenerate · 实际运行报告 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateAuditEXPT8.description: after_sampling连接实际采样输出，报告已观察前向及Sharp分支调用，原样返回LATENT。没有观察到采样时保持未验证，不把报告当成人工画质接受。

MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateRecipeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateRecipeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateRecipeEXPT8.display_name: H3 Open Regenerate · 完整配方加载 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateRecipeEXPT8.description: 加载作者已合并的Refiner+Turbo+Sharp普通权重，另加独立Sharp时间曲线分支。也可显式选择仅Sharp线性因子供IC配方使用；此时上游需独立加载真正HyperFlow与IC。曲线来源另选作者使用的Ref2VA pruned底模；不会用当前底模的另一张曲线替换它。保留上游MODEL/LoRA。加载不代表采样或画质通过，采样后连接实际运行报告。

MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 Open Regenerate · 细化采样准备 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3OpenRegenerateSetupEXPT8.description: 输入已编码/已放大的H3视频潜空间。输出Euler原始sigma和锁定的VAE编码静音，不二次套12/3时钟。用BasicGuider；原声音轨最后单独合并。不加载/叠加LoRA，不把Kijai纯refiner当成官方Turbo+Sharp合并配方。

enabled.tooltip: When off, returns None and does not evaluate the optional image branch. MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo ignores None reference entries.

image.tooltip: Connect a Load Image node here only when this global reference slot is needed.

MiniMaxH3OptionalReferenceImage.name: MiniMaxH3OptionalReferenceImage
MiniMaxH3OptionalReferenceImage.description: Optional global image-reference slot. Disabled slots return None and are ignored by native MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.

enabled.tooltip: Off = T2V starter. On = use the connected image as the I2V first frame.

image.tooltip: Connect Load Image here for I2V. The branch is not evaluated while disabled.

MiniMaxH3OptionalStartFrame.name: MiniMaxH3OptionalStartFrame
MiniMaxH3OptionalStartFrame.description: Optional starter first frame: disabled gives T2V, enabled gives I2V.

frame_count.tooltip: Exact video frame count; 0 keeps duration rounding. Audio still uses the requested seconds.

source_time_origin_seconds.tooltip: Source frame/audio zero on the shared timeline. Start seconds uses that timeline; the default keeps old coordinates.

audio_boundary_policy.tooltip: absolute_endpoints maps shared timeline endpoints once so adjacent audio windows meet without double rounding.

MiniMaxH3OutputTrimT8.name: MiniMaxH3OutputTrimT8
MiniMaxH3OutputTrimT8.description: Applies Duration Planner trim metadata to decoded IMAGE frames and optional AUDIO.

model.tooltip: Matching native ComfyUI full/non-pruned H3 MODEL. Do not connect an existing LoRA, pruned model or another PDD node.

av_latent.tooltip: Connect av_latent from the existing T8 Conditioning node. It is used to configure ComfyUI's native joint AV sampler.

pdd_lora_name.tooltip: Converted *_comfyui_pdd.safetensors file. Ordinary Load LoRA nodes drop the required dynamic PDD heads.

base_variant.tooltip: Select how the PDD runtime should interpret the adapter. File metadata and variant mismatches are reported but do not block loading.

strength.tooltip: Official released setting is 1.0. Lower values interpolate both the dynamic LoRA residual and PDD heads and are unvalidated.

MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 PDD 8-Step Setup (T8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3PDD8StepSetupT8Advanced.description: Loads a converted Alibaba PAI MiniMax-H3 PDD adapter with its dynamic video/audio output heads. It applies the 258 backbone adapters as model-only bypass residuals and returns the required Euler/simple 8-step sampler and sigmas at shifts 12/3. Use only the matching full non-pruned FL2VA or Ref2VA base.

MiniMaxH3PDDStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PDDStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PDDStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 PDD · Separate Absolute LOW4 / HIGH4 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PDDStageSetupEXPT8.description: Connect an existing PDD MODEL and its original full nine-point SIGMAS. Sets up only LOW heads 0–3 or HIGH heads 4–7 at this stage's actual AV geometry; no sampler executes. Keep learned upscale and joint-audio reconcile external. Independent models/LoRA/noise/conditions. Native head banks and source-authenticated legacy dynamic injection support stage identity/resume. Unknown executable additions remain unverified, not silently removed.

MiniMaxH3PTDAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PTDAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PTDAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 PTD 实际专家与时钟审计 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PTDAuditEXPT8.description: 排序输入只建立依赖；报告实际 hop／专家／AV 时钟，不把输入 latent 当完成证明，不授予缓存或GPU质量资格。

MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 PTD 连续阶段真实审计 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousAuditEXPT8.description: 只接受实际已执行的typed HEAD/完成对象并核内容；其它latent或伪造JSON不能作为完成证明。无GPU/画质/portable资格。

MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousHEAD_EXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousHEAD_EXPT8
MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousHEAD_EXPT8.display_name: H3 PTD 连续 HEAD · 2或3步 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousHEAD_EXPT8.description: Guider 使用已选择的PTD MODEL。4步前2／6步前3，保存真实内部FP32 noisy AV；不是x0、不是标准4+4，不写冷缓存。原完整PTD入口不变。

MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousTAIL_EXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousTAIL_EXPT8
MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousTAIL_EXPT8.display_name: H3 PTD 连续 TAIL · 接续全局专家 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PTDContinuousTAIL_EXPT8.description: 直接续接HEAD内部状态与原物理AV时钟，不新随机噪声、不重置专家索引；TAIL Guider保留用户阶段MODEL/有序LoRA。仅同画布2+2/3+3，未实现放大或冷TAIL。

MiniMaxH3PTDSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PTDSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PTDSamplerEXPT8.display_name: H3 PTD 采样器与完整网格 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PTDSamplerEXPT8.description: 从 PTD MODEL 取得对应 EPFL 或 Compact 合同的采样器和完整网格。不可切半、接普通 Euler 或冒充旧 4+4。Compact 暂无连续 HEAD/TAIL 状态交接协议。

checkpoint.tooltip: models/ptd 下文件名或明确选择的绝对路径；本节点不会下载或转换权重

MiniMaxH3PTDSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PTDSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PTDSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 PTD 专家加载与采样 · Hop Setup (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PTDSetupEXPT8.description: 读取文件元数据选择 EPFL 4／6 步或 stacked-hop Compact PTD 完整网格；Compact 支持 schema1 行量化存储，加载时还原 BF16，不代表 INT8 推理。只读 safetensors，不执行 DCP/pickle。原用户底模和 LoRA 保留，实际覆盖见报告；指定 Compact 4 步已完成本地实跑，其他组合与完整画质需另验。

MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 音画循环 · 运行审计 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVAuditEXPT8.description: after_sampling仅建立执行顺序。报告该MODEL实际预测/视图次数、补噪和时钟；不据配置推断采样步数、成片来源、无缝效果或GPU通用资格。

MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVDecodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVDecodeEXPT8.display_name: H3 音画循环 · 解码 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVDecodeEXPT8.description: 采样结果与设置节点的计划配对。关闭时调用既有完整原生解码；开启时两VAE周期补边，视频17k+5裁为17k，音频按24fps帧时钟裁剪。无交叉淡化、重采样或自动质量认证；计划只表示几何，不是结果来源回执。

pad_clips.tooltip: 每侧补边的17帧组数；3的倍数可消除音频补边tick取整误差，计算量随之增加。

views.tooltip: 1或2；视频只用第一视图。奇数组数的第二视图不是精确半圈。

MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 音画循环 · 设置 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PeriodicAVSetupEXPT8.description: 默认关闭，原MODEL直通。开启后从实际AV latent推导17k+5时钟，在模型预测中周期补边与旋转；第二视图只融合音频。MODEL接原采样器，原AV latent仍接采样输入，计划接循环解码。不修改LoRA、采样器、步数或sigma；非空区域控制尚无循环时间适配。

MiniMaxH3PersonAppendEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PersonAppendEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PersonAppendEXPT8.display_name: H3 Person · Append AV / 窗口精确合并 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PersonAppendEXPT8.description: Append full native 22-frame decoded windows on the global frame/PCM sample timeline. Discard overlap once; final frames exactly match source length. Generated audio is context for the NEXT window, not automatic final delivery. Save silent by default, or explicitly mux original source audio (including any removed person's voice). This is in-memory assembly, not persistent reroll/resume certification.

prompt.default: Remove the green-masked person and reconstruct the background. Preserve the rest of the video, including its camera motion and frame timing.

MiniMaxH3PersonConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PersonConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PersonConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 Person · Native Conditioning / 原生移除条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PersonConditioningEXPT8.description: External Ref2VA MODEL + Person Remover V1 LoRA strength1; no internal loading. Qwen sees Picture1/Video1; native VAE encodes green guide and generated history. MODEL-only history adapter preserves delegates and never patches global Core. Use output MODEL with stock CFG1 (same positive/negative), er_sde/simple12, shift video12/audio3. Separate sampler/decode/append. No Turbo or automatic double pass.

MiniMaxH3PersonMaskEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PersonMaskEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PersonMaskEXPT8.display_name: H3 Person · External MASK + Green Preview / 外置遮罩预览 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PersonMaskEXPT8.description: One MASK per frame, no broadcast or invented tracking. Optional original MASK + actual Source Conform map reuses its frame selection. Green is an RGB visual guide, not a sampling mask. Empty frames remain empty. No segmentation model download.

MiniMaxH3PersonPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PersonPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PersonPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Person · Window Plan / 移除窗口计划 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PersonPlanEXPT8.description: Source, externally prepared green guide and one clean first frame must share geometry. 24fps, 22-frame native windows, 18-frame generated AV history. Author recipe is 12 steps PER WINDOW (120 delivered frames need 6 windows / 72 sampler steps). Full-frame regeneration, not pixel locking; visual removal does not remove a voice.

MiniMaxH3PersonWindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PersonWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PersonWindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Person · Select Window / 选窗与历史 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PersonWindowEXPT8.description: First window uses the clean anchor; later windows use the previous generated boundary and 18 aligned generated AV frames. Connect cumulative Append outputs, not original source PCM. Short final tails pad guide frames only and are trimmed on Append.

MiniMaxH3PikaFlexSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PikaFlexSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PikaFlexSetupEXPT8.description: 先用现有LoRA加载器加载Pika FL2VA或Ref2VA，建议强度1。本节点提供作者6步sigma、LCM重新加噪及12/3音视频时钟；连接BasicGuider。不会加载或清除LoRA，不改提示词、参考素材、首尾帧及遮罩。已有加速/风格LoRA均保留，叠加效果由用户判断。

model_high.tooltip: 从共用原始底模另开LoRA分支，可独立叠加多个LoRA。

MiniMaxH3PikaTwoPassSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PikaTwoPassSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PikaTwoPassSamplerEXPT8.description: Pika完整6步：低尺寸采样→学习型3D潜空间放大→高尺寸继续。LOW/HIGH分别连接对应尺寸的条件和AV潜空间，时间网格保持相同。底模可共用；各阶段可串联多个LoRA，独立设置顺序和强度。不接model_high时沿用LOW模型。不会下载或替换LoRA。音频继续联合采样；LOW输出是中间预测，不是完成的视频。

MiniMaxH3PlainPromptRecipeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PlainPromptRecipeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PlainPromptRecipeEXPT8.display_name: H3 · 完整提示词 / Ordinary Prompt
MiniMaxH3PlainPromptRecipeEXPT8.description: One complete ordinary prompt. No local events, time ranges, attention routing or Relay gain. The zero-event descriptor supports existing frame-count/cache receipts; compiled_prompt connects to ordinary conditioning nodes.

expected_master_sha256.tooltip: Optional exact SHA256. Blank binds the actual selected saved master for this job.

MiniMaxH3PostprocessSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PostprocessSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PostprocessSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Postprocess Save / 后处理保存·原片保留 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PostprocessSaveEXPT8.description: Full-length final RGB crop/pad/resize, against an already saved untrimmed zero-origin24fps SDR master. Copy original audio packets and verify PCM/PTS. Failure blocks only the postprocessed output, preserves master, and writes postprocess_failed. Never reruns sampling or automatically accepts quality.

prepared_bundle_path.tooltip: 由准备工具生成的本地JSON绝对路径，不是工作流JSON。不同提示词需要重新准备匹配的文本/音频条件。

MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8.display_name: Tao / LTX · 读取已准备生成输入 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedGenerationBundleEXPT8.description: 读取本地准备清单，不下载、不编码提示词、不运行模型。需要匹配的教师/文本缓存或LTX AV输入；完整文件身份在生成节点执行时再次检查。

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Decode Frozen Latent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXDecodeEXPT8.description: Run only the LTX VAE/movie worker from a matching committed latent receipt. Original audio is retained by the existing worker; generation is never implicit.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXEffectsBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXEffectsBindEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · External EAV / Relay (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXEffectsBindEXPT8.description: Between Bundle and Generate/Load/Decode. Bind external Stage EAV and/or LTX Relay timeline with actual independently encoded post-connector event caches. No sampling, text encoding or old workflow change. Use a new chain ID.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Generate Refined Latent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXGenerateEXPT8.description: Run only the prepared LTX refinement worker. Commit a SHA-bound latent receipt; never start VAE decode or implicitly run another sampler.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Load Frozen Refined Latent (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXLoadGenerationEXPT8.description: Explicitly load a committed generation SHA after a restart. No GPU worker, sampling or decode is started; current bundle/seed/engine identity must match.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayEncodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayEncodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayEncodeEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · Encode Relay Event Caches (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayEncodeEXPT8.description: Explicit isolated native INT8 Gemma/AV connector event encoding. No diffusion sampler or VAE. Requires the pinned prepared-cache provider and its matching native INT8 checkpoints. 64 GiB free host RAM and 2 GiB free GPU runtime reserve. Changed text/source needs a new cache_id.

MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayPlanEXPT8.display_name: Prepared LTX · External Relay Timeline (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedLTXRelayPlanEXPT8.description: Read only the SHA-bound prepared CPU video and plan its exact 8n+1 output frames. Global text comes from the selected bundle/cache. No TE/model/sampler or VAE.

noise_seed.tooltip: 视频噪声种子；Tao多请求依次加1（uint64回绕）。教师音频种子来自准备清单，不随这里改变。

chain_id.tooltip: 只用字母数字下划线连字符。改输入/种子/代码或关闭恢复时请换新ID；不会覆盖旧结果。

resume_existing.tooltip: 仅复用身份和哈希完全匹配的阶段。只生成成功而解码失败时只补解码。

serial_lease_path.tooltip: 本地串行GPU锁文件的绝对路径，必须与同时使用的其他研究入口一致。不要通过换锁文件绕过占用。

MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8.display_name: Tao / LTX · 串行生成与解码 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PreparedVideoEXPT8.description: 完整身份检查→生成latent→生成进程退出→独立VAE解码。Windows单GPU实验入口。已有严格匹配缓存只复用；报告区分新生成/恢复/旧回执迁移。尚未代表所有输入/模型质量通过。

MiniMaxH3PresetExporter.name: MiniMaxH3PresetExporter
MiniMaxH3PresetExporter.description: Save timeline configuration alone or with all referenced media in a portable local folder.

MiniMaxH3PresetLoader.name: MiniMaxH3PresetLoader
MiniMaxH3PresetLoader.description: Find a local timeline preset and feed it into the Material Planner.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · External HIGH EAV Apply (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEAVApplyEXPT8.description: External Stage EAV Config -> this node -> HIGH Sampler Only. Uses the exact HIGH restart plan and clean-source mask, not its noisy state as an anchor. LOW effects may be absent or different. Optional Relay must be stage-bound first. CFG1; persistent effect identity remains unqualified.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT.display_name: H3 Progressive · HIGH Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighEffectsAuditEXPT.description: Reads actual immutable completed HIGH evidence; does not run LOW or inspect an old cached Apply counter.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · HIGH Handoff Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighHandoffEXPT8.description: Connect actual external learned output, frozen LOW boundary and independent HIGH clean source. Draws only HIGH video noise, restores original native AV coordinates and clean-source masks; no LOW/HIGH sampling or learned lift. For the original noise policy use video_noise seed=(LOW seed+1) modulo 2^64. Optional HIGH sigma tail must start at the frozen boundary. Full pretrained/effect/continuation qualification remains separate.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Load Exact Completed HIGH AV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighLoadEXPT8.description: Select frozen completed HIGH using path and SHA. Loads no models, runs no sampling/lift. Reconnect the returned AV to decoding or later stages. No implicit cache lookup, retry or claim of matching today's settings.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Save Completed HIGH AV (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighSaveEXPT8.description: Save typed completed HIGH with its execution receipt, exact output identity and metadata. Unique new artifact; never overwrites an old result. No additional sampling or learned lift. Save both path and SHA.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · HIGH Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveHighStageEXPT8.description: Execute only the native Euler tail using explicit zero-noise reconstruction and the original clean source/masks. Independent MODEL/LoRA/conditions. seed is the sampler seed (original policy: same as LOW), not the HIGH video-noise seed. Never executes LOW or learned upscale; no automatic cache or retry.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Boundary to External Lift Input (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLiftInputEXPT8.description: No sampling or learned network executes. Converts only clean video to original VAE coordinates; zero audio is a lifter placeholder. The original evolving audio stays in low_boundary for HIGH. Connect the existing learned 3D latent upscaler using these target dimensions.

render_window_frames.tooltip: 内部窗口至少124帧、17n+5网格，无固定帧数上限；短片按总时长裁出。窗口越大，显存和耗时通常越高。

low_evaluations.tooltip: 完整8步表中填4为4+4，填6为6+2；至少留1步HIGH。

resume_existing.tooltip: 相同输入重新执行会核验后复用阶段/成片。关闭则拒绝已有数据链；不清理旧结果。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Progressive Long Video / 渐进双采长视频 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLongVideoEXPT8.description: 独立渐进长视频实验：每段完整Euler表拆成LOW+HIGH，复用现有3D放大器。使用内容绑定的接受画面续接、原生AV遮罩与磁盘恢复；不替换旧双MODEL节点。完整权重成片验收尚未完成。只支持T2VA或单首帧I2VA；不宣称通用多参考支持。关闭resume_existing会拒绝已有链，不删除旧文件；改配置使用新chain_id。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · External LOW EAV Apply (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEAVApplyEXPT8.description: External Stage EAV Config -> this node -> LOW Sampler Only. Binds LOW's native mask and full absolute video clock, not local step progress. Optional Relay must be stage-bound first. No sampling here. CFG1; no learned/GPU/media quality or persistent effect identity qualification.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · LOW Effects Execution Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowEffectsAuditEXPT8.description: Reads actual immutable LOW completion evidence. No sampling or mutable Apply-node counter lookup. Missing effects and incomplete user-stack coverage never count as verified application.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Load Exact Frozen LOW Boundary (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowLoadEXPT8.description: Select completed LOW path and exact SHA. No MODEL loading or LOW sampling, and no assertion that today's LOW settings match this frozen artifact. Feed its boundary to Lift Input/HIGH Handoff; remove LOW output nodes from a HIGH-only recovery graph. Corruption/missing/busy artifacts fail, never silently regenerate.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Save Frozen LOW Boundary (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowSaveEXPT8.description: Writes a new typed artifact with exact SHA under output/MiniMaxH3/progressive_stage_artifacts. No overwrite. Not ordinary Stage Save: evolving audio and clean video remain distinct. Unknown executable identity may be archived but not certified for persistent reuse. Save both path and SHA.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · LOW Sampler Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveLowStageEXPT8.description: Execute only LOW native Euler. No HIGH model/prompt/lifter input. Returns typed model-space clean_video + evolving audio_next + original audio noise, not completed AV or ordinary denoised output. Connect the dedicated Lift Input and Save nodes.

mode.tooltip: haar 要求 LOW 宽高严格各为 HIGH 一半；尺寸不符不会静默回退。

MiniMaxH3ProgressivePairedNoiseEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressivePairedNoiseEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressivePairedNoiseEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Paired Noise / 高低分关联噪声 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressivePairedNoiseEXPT8.description: 给现有 LOW Sampler 和 HIGH Handoff 提供噪声，不运行采样或放大。independent 保留旧 LOW seed/HIGH seed+1；haar 让半尺寸 LOW 与 HIGH 共用空间噪声。音频不缩放，但关联模式的随机序列与旧模式不同；不保证画质更好。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · External Relay + ONE Stage Conditioning (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveRelayStageApplyEXPT8.description: Connect this phase's own paired Relay Conditioning MODEL/positive and original target-resolution guides. Rebinds actual LOW/HIGH packed layout and prepares stage guides, without sampling. Use instead of ONE Stage Conditioning, not after it. HIGH can use a different Relay Plan or be the only enabled phase. disabled removes only that authenticated Relay owner. Persistent effect identity is not yet certified.

sampler.tooltip: 连接原生 Setup 的 euler，不使用 dual_clock_euler。

sigmas.tooltip: 完整首采时间表：从 1 到 0，至少 2 步。

upscaler_model.tooltip: models/latent_upscale_models 内的 H3 学习型潜空间放大模型。必须显式选择。

low_evaluations.tooltip: 小画幅的步数。例：完整 8 步中选 6，则放大后还采 2 步。至少留 1 步。

low_scale.tooltip: 小画幅宽高比例，按 32 像素对齐；0.5 不是保证 4 倍加速。

reserve_vram_mib.tooltip: 阶段边界和采样回调检查的显存余量，不代表峰值预测或不会 OOM。

model_hires.tooltip: 可选HIGH阶段MODEL；可独立串联LoRA/注意力补丁，原有补丁保留。结构和AV时钟须匹配；不接沿用model。

guide_resize.tooltip: 首帧LOW参考缩放；preserve_mean显式保持通道均值，HIGH原参考不变。

eav_mode.tooltip: 分阶段EAV使用完整8/20步原视频sigma时钟，CFG1。report_only只测量，apply_exp实际增强；不是画质认证。

eav_start_video_progress.tooltip: 1-原视频sigma；切换分辨率不重置。旧API省略该参数仍保留原0/1合同。

eav_g_hard_limit.tooltip: 真实超限正常报错，不截断或重试。关闭选disabled，tau=0不是关闭。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Progressive Sampler / 渐进分辨率首采 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSamplerEXPT8.description: 先以较小画幅采样，再用学习型模型放大潜空间，完成剩余步数。仅当前 Core 原生 Euler 的 T2VA/首帧 I2VA；输入必须是空 AV 潜空间。不是完成一采后的 VDN 二采，不锁音轨，不启用像素锚或分块。已有本机短片速度对照；画质仍需按素材审看，不保证省显存。可选HIGH模型及分阶段EAV；Relay接配对MODEL/positive，TST可接MODEL配置节点。缺失放大模型时不会改用普通插值。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Progressive Dual Setup / 渐进双模型配置 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveSetupEXPT8.description: 给LOW/HIGH配置同一完整原生Euler时间表，不执行采样。两路各接兼容LoRA和单一后端；TST应接在此节点输出之后。不接model_hires则复用LOW源配置，不改动输入MODEL。

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXP.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXP.display_name: H3 Progressive · ONE Stage Conditioning (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStageConditioningEXP.description: Prepare one selected stage's native conditioning. Use separate nodes/inputs for independently editable LOW and HIGH prompts. Only LOW reference latent is resized; HIGH retains its original guide. No model call. Relay requires its own paired stage-layout adapter, not an unpaired copied binding.

MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Progressive · Plan + LOW Source (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3ProgressiveStagePlanEXPT8.description: Plan only: no MODEL, conditioning, sampling or learned lift. Original native Euler AV time grid. Empty T2VA/I2VA or explicit initialized AV. Not an accepted-parent continuation or standalone Avatar delivery contract.

MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 投影分块 · 实际调用审计 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksAuditEXPT8.description: model接所选分块MODEL；after_sampling接对应采样结果，仅建立执行顺序。读取真实调用、行数、委托和清理状态，不从LATENT或Stage类型推断采样成功、NFE、画质或峰值显存。

stage_queries.tooltip: 只对已核实dense路径把Q暂存CPU；增加主存与传输，不缩减K/V。

MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksEXPT8.display_name: H3 投影分块 · Projection Chunks (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ProjectionChunksEXPT8.description: 可选分块norm/QKV、输出投影、输入和最终层；完整K/V仍可见。Relay及未知注意力保留完整Q委托，不清模型或LoRA。LOW/HIGH可从共用底模各接一份，独立设置；不会改变采样器、步数、音频或3D放大器。按实际调用报告覆盖，不保证省显存或提速，当前不认证跨进程缓存。

character_limit.tooltip: Default 7000 matches the current official MiniMax H3 CLI submission limit. It is not a detected hard limit of the local open-weight tokenizer. Raising it opts out of official submission compatibility; the report warns and the prompt is never truncated.

token_limit.tooltip: 0 reports token counts without applying a token ceiling.

MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Budget + Role Compiler / 提示词预算与角色编译 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptBudgetCompilerT8Advanced.description: Never truncates. The default 7000-character audit ceiling matches the current official H3 CLI submission rule without claiming a local tokenizer hard limit. Also audits token budgets, media count/order, assignment coverage and subject-to-picture/video/audio bindings.

MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced.display_name: T8 Video Prompt Compiler / 多后端提示词编译 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptCompilerT8Advanced.description: Compiles one structured visual/audio brief for MiniMax H3, Wan 2.2, LTX-Video or a generic cinematic backend. This is text compilation only.

MiniMaxH3PromptEditAuditT8.name: MiniMaxH3PromptEditAuditT8
MiniMaxH3PromptEditAuditT8.display_name: H3 Prompt Edit Report / 定向编辑运行报告 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3PromptEditGuiderT8.name: MiniMaxH3PromptEditGuiderT8
MiniMaxH3PromptEditGuiderT8.display_name: H3 Prompt Edit Guidance / 提示词定向编辑 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptEditGuiderT8.description: Use original and edited prompts with the same actual media. 0 uses original; 1 uses edited; other strengths evaluate two branches. Different text lengths use native position layouts.

prompt_1.tooltip: Connect the first STRING prompt. More prompt inputs appear automatically.

prompt_packet.tooltip: 直接连接 T8 Video Prompt Compiler；只接受 backend=minimax_h3 且哈希完整的 packet。

events_json.tooltip: 显式事件列表。auto_equal只写prompt；其他模式还要写start/end。使用[]表示只保留全局Prompt Packet且不安装Relay补丁。

timing_mode.tooltip: frames的end为包含端点；seconds/percent的end为时间边界。

math_profile.tooltip: 默认使用Prompt Relay论文公式。

prompt_relay_events.tooltip: 可选：连接链式 Event 节点后以它为权威事件源；未连接时继续读取 events_json。

MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Packet → Relay Plan / 编译提示词转时间线 (Advanced)
