MiniMaxH3PromptPacketRelayPlanT8Advanced.description: Converts an authenticated MiniMax H3 Prompt Compiler packet into an auditable Prompt Relay timeline. The packet's compiled visual/audio prompt remains global; local events are never inferred or rewritten.

endpoint.tooltip: Empty uses 127.0.0.1:1234 for OpenAI-compatible or 127.0.0.1:11434 for Ollama. Non-loopback endpoints require HTTPS and explicit permission.

api_key_env.tooltip: Environment-variable name only; never paste the secret value here.

ollama_keep_alive.tooltip: 0 asks Ollama to unload after the response; ignored by other providers.

contract_repair_attempts.tooltip: Optional deterministic repair requests after contract validation fails. Default 0 preserves old workflow request count; retries do not resend images.

MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Provider Router / 提示词服务路由 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptProviderRouterT8Advanced.description: Uses the pinned H3 three-field rewriting contract with local passthrough, an OpenAI-compatible server (OpenAI/LM Studio/llama.cpp), or Ollama. Network use is explicit; keys come only from environment variables.

model.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL；输出为局部克隆。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须直接来自同一版本 Prompt Relay Plan 节点。

task_type.tooltip: 支持 T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Ref2VA/Hybrid 的目标视频时间路由；显式接入 Query Route 后可实验性扩展到目标音频。

audio_mode.tooltip: 支持原生生成、锁定源音频、重混源音频和仅参考音频。默认Plan只路由目标视频；joint_av_exp会直接路由目标音频，不能与lock_source组合。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先用 report_only 检查 token/layout/显存报告；确认后显式选择 apply_exp 才安装注意力路由。零个或一个局部事件时会自动原样直通，不安装补丁；单事件通常应合并进 global_prompt。

query_chunk_rows.tooltip: 目标视频/显式联合音频 query 分块。更小更省显存但更慢；不会创建完整 S×S mask。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Conditioning / 分段提示词条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayConditioningT8Advanc.description: Authoritatively encodes the Plan prompt through the native H3 Qwen chain, binds exact local token spans, and optionally patches a cloned H3 MODEL with a bounded-memory plan-selected query relay. Stable nodes remain unchanged.

prompt.tooltip: 只写这一时间段的局部动作，不重复全局人物/场景/声音设定。
prompt.default: The subject performs one clearly observable action.

start.tooltip: auto_equal时忽略；frames为整数起始帧，seconds为秒，percent为0..100；多个Event必须按开始时间排序。

end.tooltip: frames模式只接受整数并包含end帧；seconds/percent模式把end视为边界。

enabled.tooltip: 关闭后不把本事件加入链；如果整条链都关闭，Plan会变成全局提示直通，不需要拆线。

previous_events.tooltip: 连接上一个Event节点；第一个Event留空。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Event / 单事件串联 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayEventT8Advanced.description: Adds one explicit local action to a chainable Prompt Relay event list. Duplicate this node for each event; start/end are interpreted by the Packet bridge timing mode.

model.tooltip: 未接其他补丁的原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须来自同段 Long Video Window 节点。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先 report_only；确认报告后再显式切到 apply_exp。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditionin.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditionin.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Long Video Conditioning / 长视频分段路由条件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoConditionin.description: Isolated composition of the existing Long Video motion-context payload repair and Prompt Relay attention routing. It requires the paired projected Plan and never changes the old Long Video Conditioning schema.

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 整条长视频只创建一次的全局 Prompt Relay Plan。

length.tooltip: 直接连接 Long Video Planner 的 length。

context_frames.tooltip: 直接连接 Long Video Planner 的 context_frames。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Long Video Window / 长视频绝对时间窗口 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayLongVideoPlanT8Advan.description: Projects one global Prompt Relay timeline into the exact rendered Long Video window. Continuation frame 0 maps to accepted-start minus context overlap, so events do not restart at each segment. Existing Plan and Long Video nodes stay unchanged.

global_prompt.tooltip: 始终可见的全局场景、人物、风格与声音约束。
global_prompt.default: Cinematic continuous shot, coherent subject identity, natural motion, stable lighting and synchronized ambience.

local_prompts.tooltip: 每行一个局部事件；也兼容使用 | 分隔。清空文本和time_ranges时生成只含global_prompt的无补丁直通Plan。
local_prompts.default:
The woman looks toward the camera and raises her hand.
She turns and walks rapidly into the illuminated street.
The camera pulls back while she becomes small in the distance.

length.tooltip: 24fps；会向上对齐到 MiniMax H3 的 17n+5 帧网格。

timing_mode.tooltip: auto_equal 自动均分；其他模式读取 time_ranges。

time_ranges.tooltip: 每行一个范围，并按开始时间从早到晚排列。frames 只接受整数帧且结束帧包含在范围内；seconds/percent 的结束值作为边界；percent 使用 0..100。

math_profile.tooltip: paper_v1 是论文公式；legacy_repo_compat 只用于复现社区旧参数，不代表论文实现。

epsilon.tooltip: 论文默认 0.1；paper_v1 会让事件边界权重回到 epsilon。

allow_gaps.tooltip: 关闭时，各局部事件必须覆盖完整目标时间线。

allow_overlaps.tooltip: 关闭时，局部事件时间范围不能重叠。

prompt_relay_events.tooltip: 可选：连接链式 Event 节点后以它为权威事件源；未连接时继续读取local_prompts/time_ranges。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Plan / 分段提示词时间线 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPlanT8Advanced.description: Compiles one global prompt plus line-separated local events into an auditable H3 timeline. paper_v1 uses the published epsilon/window/sigma equation; legacy_repo_compat is comparison-only.

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Preview / 时间线预检 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayPreviewT8Advanced.description: Validates an authenticated Prompt Relay plan and shows every event's frame/second range before any H3 model is loaded or sampling begins. Its plan output is an unchanged pass-through for inline use.

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 来自 Prompt Relay Plan 的原始、已校验时间线。

query_route.tooltip: video_only_paper只路由目标视频并保持论文范围；joint_av_exp还会按H3原生音频时间轴路由目标音频，属于未被论文验证的实验扩展。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Query Route / 联合音画路由 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayQueryRouteT8Advanced.description: Optionally extends a Prompt Relay Plan from the paper-faithful target-video route to an experimental native-H3 target-audio-plus-video route. Connect this between Plan and Conditioning; old workflows bypass it unchanged.

query_chunk_rows.tooltip: Must match the Prompt Relay Conditioning node for a useful estimate.

precision.tooltip: Element width used only for the explicit bias-size estimate.

keyframe_stills.tooltip: Count first/last/intermediate still guides at the target canvas size.

reference_images_match.tooltip: Count only match-size reference images; use manual rows for max-size refs.

reference_video_frames_each.tooltip: Requested frames per reference video; the report shows H3 aligned-down frames.

additional_text_rows.tooltip: Conservative allowance for Qwen system/media tokens beyond UTF-8 prompt bytes.

manual_extra_packed_rows.tooltip: Manual allowance for max-size refs or other conditioning not represented above.

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Relay Resource Estimate / 资源预估 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayResourceEstimateT8Ad.description: Model-free estimate of native H3 packed rows and Prompt Relay's bounded explicit chunk-bias allocation. It does not estimate total VRAM and is never a 16GB safety certificate. The Plan output is an unchanged pass-through.

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 接全局Plan／Query Route后，再接长视频内循环；不要接已投影窗口。

text_policy.tooltip: preserve_all保持旧图。accepted_window_text_exp只保留与当前交付窗口相交的局部文本；已结束／未来／只在已知上下文的事件不重复送入CLIP。跨段事件仍保留原sigma。dialogue_start_owner_exp另外只让事件起始交付窗口保留<d>台词；跨段视觉描述及AV上下文不删。Global不可放<d>，未标记的对白无法识别。一次性台词尽量完整放入一个物理段；不保证逐字／不重复，组合需新chain_id。

MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Long Relay · 窗口文本策略 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3PromptRelayWindowTextEXPT8.description: Optional global-Plan policy for native long-video projection. Old all-key behavior stays the default. The experiment omits completed/future event text without changing accepted AV context, crossing-event sigma or sampling. It is not paper-faithful all-key Relay or a no-repeat guarantee.

prompt.tooltip: 原始短提示词；对白、歌词和画面文字会要求保持原文。

base_model_path.tooltip: 相对路径从 ComfyUI/models/text_encoders 解析，也可填绝对目录。精确基座为 Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct。

adapter_path.tooltip: 相对路径从 ComfyUI/models/loras 解析，也可填绝对目录。精确LoRA为 lightx2v/MiniMax-H3-Prompt-Rewriter-LoRA-8B。

load_policy.tooltip: 16GB显卡建议自动CPU分片；gpu_only需要足够显存。

max_new_tokens.tooltip: 默认1024兼顾完整度与16GB分片速度；过低可能截断三段结构，过高只提高上限而不会强迫模型生成到上限。

unload_after_generate.tooltip: 生成、报错或OOM后都尝试只释放本节点的模型和缓存。

free_comfy_models_before_load.tooltip: 加载8B前释放ComfyUI当前模型，为16GB显卡留空间；不会在生成后全局卸载。

allow_hub_download.tooltip: 默认只允许本地模型，避免运行时意外下载大文件。

MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Rewriter 8B / 多模态提示词改写 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriter8BT8Advanced.description: Runs the pinned LightX2V Qwen3-VL-8B LoRA for T2VA/I2VA/L2VA/FL2VA. It is separate from the H3 32B CLIP because their parameter shapes are not LoRA-compatible. Unload-after-generate is enabled by default.

MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Rewriter Unload / 手动卸载 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3PromptRewriterUnloadT8Advanced.description: Releases only the optional Prompt Rewriter 8B cache retained by this node pack.

semantic_contract_json.tooltip: Strict local JSON. Each group requires id, any_of and scope. Scope is full, integrated, soundscape or music. Empty anchors always ABSTAIN.

MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Prompt Semantic Contract Audit / 提示词语义合同审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3PromptSemanticContractAuditT8Ad.description: Checks explicit required/forbidden phrase groups, exact dialogue blocks and media tags. It defaults to the original prompt until a mechanical pass is human-reviewed and explicitly accepted; it does not claim semantic equivalence.

MiniMaxH3PropContinuityLintEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3PropContinuityLintEXPT8
MiniMaxH3PropContinuityLintEXPT8.display_name: H3 道具ID／左右手连续性检查（只读）
MiniMaxH3PropContinuityLintEXPT8.description: 独立文本配方与冲突报告；相同kind不同ID不会合并。全局秒数、显式交接；不识别画面、不替换导演台草稿、不自动采用或排队。

MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Qwen Prefix Cache Stats / 前缀缓存统计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3QwenPrefixCacheStatsT8Advanced.description: Reads hit/miss/size counters from one bounded in-memory Qwen prefix cache. Connect Conditioning.report to after_report to force this node to run later.

cache_epoch.tooltip: Increment to create a fresh empty cache without mutating the input CLIP.

MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Qwen Reference Prefix Cache / 参考前缀缓存 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3QwenReferencePrefixCacheT8Advan.description: Opt-in, bounded CPU-memory cache for the exact visual-reference prefix of the native H3 Qwen3-VL encoder. Prompt text is still recomputed. It wraps only this CLIP output and never patches ComfyUI core files or the input CLIP object.

keyframe_indices.tooltip: Comma-separated 0-based frame indices; count must equal the MASK batch.

MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAFT Mask Propagation / 光流遮罩传播 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RAFTMaskPropagationT8Advanced.description: Propagates one reviewed person/object mask through a shot with bidirectional RAFT and forward-backward confidence. Run once per identity. It stops at detected cuts and never assigns identity automatically.

release_policy.tooltip: offload_after removes only RAFT weights from GPU; it never calls the global ComfyUI unload-all-models path.

MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAFT Motion Audit / 光流运动审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RAFTMotionAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only RAFT optical-flow audit for real motion, sudden cuts and temporal collapse. It does not repair faces, sharpen frames or modify H3 sampling. Model selection has no filename/hash/byte-size allowlist.

MiniMaxH3RESEffectsBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RESEffectsBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RESEffectsBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 RES External Effects / 外置效果接线 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RESEffectsBindEXPT8.description: Adds the exact pre-sampling RES context for existing external Stage EAV. Connect paired external Relay MODEL before RES History and its CONDITIONING to BasicGuider. Passes the same sampler/sigmas; no sampling, hidden model, or universal reuse approval.

checkpoint_path.tooltip: Relative to output/MiniMaxH3/res_checkpoints. Create-only; unique name per render.

model_contract_id.tooltip: Human-readable base/LoRA/strength declaration. Actual loaded MODEL identity is separately checked at execution.

run_contract_json.tooltip: Connect final NFE Run Contract; required outside disabled mode.

MiniMaxH3RESHistoryEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RESHistoryEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RESHistoryEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 RES History / RES历史步边界 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RESHistoryEXPT8.description: Deterministic RES on one unchanged sigma table. Saves post-step x plus solver history at one chosen boundary, continues the full run, or resumes read-only from that boundary. Not LOW/HIGH upscaling or universal Stage; actual loaded weights/ordered LoRA/AV coordinates are bound at execution; unknown owners remain usable for full sampling, not portable recovery. Legacy Euler/graphs unchanged.

MiniMaxH3RESStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RESStageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RESStageLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 RES Complete Stage / 读取完成态 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RESStageLoadEXPT8.description: Read-only explicit completed RES artifact by exact path/SHA. No MODEL load, sampling, history resume or assertion that current settings match the frozen result.

MiniMaxH3RESStageSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RESStageSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RESStageSamplerEXPT8.display_name: H3 RES Complete Stage / RES完成态 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RESStageSamplerEXPT8.description: One actual native RES History sampler invocation. Keeps the original five inputs and two AV outputs, adds observed completion for existing Stage Save. Only a recognized exact execution can authorize explicit frozen-result reuse. Unknown MODEL patches remain runnable, unqualified for persistent reuse. Not partial x0, LOW/HIGH handoff, universal CUDA or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Base Descent Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3RFBaseStageSetupEXPT8.description: ONE native dual-clock descent with explicit full/partial/tail SIGMAS. No hidden restart. Bias/STG/Relay/EAV stay external. Stage Sampler preserves the original template and exact model-space endpoint before Core's float32 output boundary for frozen restart.

MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Endpoint + Original Template (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3RFHandoffEXPT8.description: Bind completed OUTPUT and the original base template; no model call or random draw. Original template can be omitted only when a Stage Sampler RF result already contains it. Do not substitute denoised or the completed endpoint for the original inpaint/audio anchor. A plain Core output lacks the exact pre-conversion state; base_sigmas preserves schedule dtype only.

MiniMaxH3RFRestartJointClockSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFRestartJointClockSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFRestartJointClockSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Restart Joint Clock (No Double Audio Rebase) (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3RFRestartJointClockSetupEXPT8.description: Explicit corrected RF restart: each AV stream is re-noised once on its own clock. Keeps joint AV sampling and original inpaint anchor/noise/masks. Legacy RF nodes/graphs remain unchanged; replace only Restart Setup to opt in. Audio quality still needs listening review.

MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 RF · Restart Descent Only (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3RFRestartStageSetupEXPT8.description: Sets up only the second RF descent. Original device-local packed AV re-noise executes inside its single-stage SAMPLER, never a base pass. Use the original base NOISE for inpaint. Zero steps/sigma is explicit zero-NFE identity. Model, effects and conditions remain editable.

unet_name.tooltip: Must be the full, non-pruned, non-quantized BF16 H3 diffusion model. INT8/FP8/NVFP4/ConvRot checkpoints are incompatible with v0.1.

lora_name.tooltip: Mandatory MiniMax H3 RAVEN Streaming LoRA; strength stays 1.0.

enforcement.tooltip: Default blocks before loading unless plugin/model/CUDA/BF16 and the reviewed ~24GiB GPU + 192GiB host-memory envelope pass. report_only still loads the model and is explicitly high risk.

MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAVEN Guarded Loader / 受保护加载器 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RavenGuardedLoaderT8Advanced.description: Preflights the separately installed MIT RAVEN ComfyUI plugin, full BF16 H3 base, mandatory RAVEN LoRA and reviewed memory envelope before delegating to the external loader. No upstream runtime source is copied here.

allow_experimental_over_192.tooltip: Legacy compatibility input. Requests above the reviewed192-frame band now produce an advisory only, without requiring acknowledgement. External RAVEN engine shape and resource constraints still apply.

enforcement.tooltip: Mechanical conflicts include references/keyframes, non-empty latent, masks, non-causal MODEL, missing adapter and external object patches.

MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAVEN Request Audit / 流式请求审计 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RavenRequestAuditT8Advanced.description: Delegates strict T2VA conditioning, empty-AV-latent and causal-MODEL checks to the external runtime, verifies the mandatory 266-module adapter and blocks unreviewed model/attention patches before the external streaming sampler.

preset.tooltip: Published mode fixes 4 steps, shifts 12/3, sink/window 2/2 and CPU-pinned KV. Manual mode is forwarded exactly but is unreviewed.

MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RAVEN Streaming Profile / 流式参数配置 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3RavenStreamingProfileT8Advanced.description: Emits one synchronized RAVEN parameter set for both the T8 audit and the external RAVEN Streaming Sampler. The default is the published 4-NFE profile.

MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 RealBasicVSR Temporal Restore / 时序修复 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RealBasicVSRRestoreT8Advanced.description: Optional post-process based on the official OpenMMLab RealBasicVSR x4 architecture. It restores temporal/detail consistency in small serial chunks, keeps AUDIO as the exact original object and never downloads a model at runtime.

MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Joint AV RF Restart / 联合音画流重启 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RectifiedFlowRestartSamplerT8Ad.description: Runs the normal dual-clock trajectory, re-noises the clean endpoint with the rectified-flow interpolation, then performs a second joint AV descent. This is true stochastic restart and is higher risk than tail subdivision.

MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Reel Delivery Compose / 成片合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryComposeT8Advanced.description: Streams a validated file-level reel into an atomic MP4. It requires explicit confirmation, supports hash-verified phase resume, and never materializes the whole reel as a ComfyUI IMAGE/AUDIO batch.

MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Reel Delivery Plan / 成片交付计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ReelDeliveryPlanT8Advanced.description: Validates exact 24fps file clips, trims, bounded visual crossfades and dialogue/music/ambience/SFX lanes. Planning is read-only and fingerprints every source file.

mods.tooltip: Bundle from Load H3 RefMods / Load H3 RefMod Axis / Create H3 RefMod.

override.tooltip: Use the config fixed into the mods' own metadata (by 'Fix H3 RefMod Config') instead of the widgets below: retention + curve come from the first mod in the bundle that carries one. Handy for sharing mods whose magic settings took real tuning. Off (default) = use the manual parameters. If no mod has a saved config it falls back to the manual parameters and prints a note.

retention.tooltip: Master reference strength, multiplied with each loader row's strength. MiniMax retention levels: 1.0 = fully_preserved, 0.7 = partially_preserved, 0.4 = attribute_transfer (keep style/attributes, not identity), 0.15 = weak_reference. 0 = no reference.

curve_direction.tooltip: Weighting envelope across THIS MOD'S OWN ref frames (stacked images / video-ref latent frames) — i.e. WHICH reference content dominates, NOT where the concept appears in the output video (ref tokens are not bound to output time; for output-timing control use the 'H3 RefMod Step Curve' node instead, which runs over the denoise timeline). 'constant' (default) = every ref frame at full strength (official-ref parity). The old default 'concept_at_end' fades early stack frames toward blur, roughly HALVING average strength on multi-frame mods. Old saved workflows keep their saved values.

scramble_seed.tooltip: Ref scrambling seed. -1 (default) = off: all refs in saved order. With 2+ refs in the bundle, a seed >= 0 shuffles the ref order and keeps a random subset, so a different ref leads each run (a multi-ref mod 'pops' a different video/image per seed). Same seed = same scramble; set this widget's control-after-generate to 'randomize' for per-run variation.

curve_shape.tooltip: How the weighting travels between its endpoints: 'linear', 'ease' (smoothstep), 'sigmoid'/'tanh' (S-curves, tanh with a steeper knee), 'quadratic', 'cubic', 'exponential', 'stair' (stepped), 'elastic' (overshoots), 'bump'/'dip' (peak/trough mid-stack). Only matters when curve_direction != constant.

curve_value.tooltip: Endpoint weight ('user input'): both endpoints for 'constant' and 'concept_at_ends', the start for 'concept_at_start', the end for 'concept_at_end', the mid peak for 'concept_at_middle'. On single-image ('image'-kind) mods this acts as a simple STRENGTH CAP (directions are meaningless on one frame): 0.4 = the ref blends 40% toward its blurred self.

graph_preset.tooltip: Optional shared graph preset — leave on '(none)' to use the curve widgets above. Selecting one loads direction/shape/value from a saved debug-grid PNG (graph embedded in its metadata) or a legacy .json, in models/refmods/graph_presets/. Share the preset PNG itself to share a curve. New presets appear after a restart.

scramble_keep.tooltip: Refs retained in subset mode; shuffle keeps all refs.

max_total_tokens.tooltip: Total reference token budget after copies; 0 disables the limit.

save_preset_as.tooltip: Optional: type a name and run to save the current (resolved) curve as a PNG preset — the curve graph itself with the graph embedded in its metadata — in models/refmods/graph_presets/. Share that image to share the curve. Leave empty to skip.

output_tooltips: The conditioning with the ref blocks injected, same type as the input.
Optional 1024x1024 curve graph: the strength envelope (direction/shape/value) with the concept zone shaded. Leave unconnected to skip the preview.
MiniMaxH3RefModApply.name: MiniMaxH3RefModApply
MiniMaxH3RefModApply.description: Inject a loader bundle of RefMods into a MiniMax H3 conditioning. Accepts both the pack's MINIMAX_H3_COND and the built-in CONDITIONING and returns the same type. For video references use a Ref2VA checkpoint and reference workflow; FL2VA first-frame conditioning does not provide a motion-copy guarantee.

trigger.tooltip: Any change re-runs the disarm; 'randomize' after each generate makes that automatic.

MiniMaxH3RefModBundleSave.name: MiniMaxH3RefModBundleSave
MiniMaxH3RefModBundleSave.description: Save selected references in one version-5 file. Copies are stored once; strengths are not baked in. Existing destination files are replaced.

mods.tooltip: The mods to fix a config into (e.g. from Load H3 RefMods). Each mod's .safetensors is re-saved with the settings below embedded in its metadata; the bundle passes through unchanged.

retention.tooltip: Master reference strength for Apply H3 RefMod — the value that makes THIS concept work (1.0 = fully_preserved, 0.7 = partially_preserved, 0.4 = attribute_transfer, 0.15 = weak_reference).

curve_direction.tooltip: The Apply frame-curve direction this concept needs (same list as Apply H3 RefMod).

curve_shape.tooltip: The Apply frame-curve shape this concept needs.

curve_value.tooltip: Apply curve endpoint value (1.0 = full strength there).

step_curve_direction.tooltip: The H3 RefMod Step Curve direction this concept needs (over the denoise timeline).

step_curve_shape.tooltip: The Step Curve shape this concept needs.

step_curve_value.tooltip: Step Curve endpoint value (1.0 = full ref there).

model.tooltip: Cloned model with scoped refs — wire Load Model -> this -> Continuum Sampler 'model'. This link is what makes the bridge execute before sampling.

mods.tooltip: Bundle from Load H3 RefMods / Create H3 RefMod — injected into every Continuum chunk while 'enable' is on.

enable.tooltip: Master switch for the injection. Off = pure passthrough (this bridge is removed from the cloned model).

retention.tooltip: Master reference strength (same scale as Apply H3 RefMod): 1.0 = fully_preserved, 0.7 = partially_preserved, 0.4 = attribute_transfer, 0.15 = weak_reference.

curve_direction.tooltip: Weighting across each mod's own ref frames (NOT output-video time): 'constant' keeps every frame at full strength. Other directions fade part of the stack toward blur — mainly useful for multi-ref mods.

curve_shape.tooltip: How that weighting travels between endpoints.

curve_value.tooltip: Endpoint weight; on single-image mods this acts as a plain strength cap.

scramble_seed.tooltip: -1 = off (all refs, saved order). >= 0 shuffles the bundle and keeps a subset, re-drawn on every queued run when the widget's control-after-generate is set to 'randomize'.

name.tooltip: Saved mod name (appears in the Load H3 RefMods dropdown after a reload).

mode.tooltip: Compressed Reference pools the latent and optionally refines its reconstruction. Full Reference stores the VAE encode, subject to resolution/frame/token limits. Neither mode trains H3 weights. Legacy mode values remain accepted.

concept_type.tooltip: Metadata only; does not select a learning algorithm. What this mod represents — 'identity' (a specific person/character), 'pose_motion' (a pose/dance/gesture/camera move), 'clothing', 'background', 'style', or 'generic'. Stored in the mod and used by the loaders' prompt_hint output (merges concept_type + description into a string you can concat onto your CLIP prompt). 'identity' in training mode with a small grid also triggers a warning nudging you toward 'encode' mode or a bigger grid — pooling is lossy in exactly the way that destroys facial identity.

background_retention.tooltip: Only used when 'mask' is connected. Floor weight for the region outside the mask: 0 = that region collapses to a heavily blurred copy of itself (kills specific structure like a skyline/treeline while staying smooth and in-distribution), 1 = mask has no effect. Middle values (0.3-0.6) partially blur instead of fully.

ref_resolution.tooltip: Target short edge in px (downscale only, never upscale), applied to BOTH modes: 'encode' stores at that res, 'training' encodes smaller too (it pools to a grid anyway, so native-res encoding is wasted compute — this is the main speed dial for training mode). 1024 is a good default; 512 halves encode cost; 2048 = official max fidelity, 4x the tokens of 1024.

pool_h.tooltip: Pooled mode: spatial latent grid after pooling. The grid is auto-fit to the source's aspect ratio (long edge = max of the two dials, other edge derived), so a portrait person isn't squished into a square grid (the 'fat/chubby' distortion). Square sources keep the exact dial value. 16x16 = 64 tokens/frame (concept sweet spot); 32x32 = 256; 64x64 = 1024, full-mode parity for identity.

pool_w.tooltip: Pooled mode: grid width (long edge if the source is wider than tall).

latent_frames.tooltip: Per-video temporal limit. Encode mode samples up to this many source frames on H3's 17k+5 grid before VAE encoding (5, 22, 39...; 16 selects 5 across the clip; below 5 selects the first image); training mode pools to up to this many latent frames after encoding. Aligned clips remain unchanged when the limit is at least their frame count. Images use 1. Higher values increase memory and token cost; max_tokens can still reduce the result.

identity.tooltip: Compressed Reference only: optimization steps to reduce latent reconstruction error. 0 uses pooling alone. This is not identity strength or model training.

merge.tooltip: Merge mode (training only): instead of stacking each ref's own pooled latent, optimize ONE shared grid against every full encode jointly — the result lands on what's COMMON across all the views (structure, motion, identity) rather than any single shot's framing/background. Ideal for a collection: many angles of a subject, a folder of similar clips -> one tiny consensus mod, one ref block's worth of tokens. Keeps every full encode in VRAM during refinement. Off = stack (each ref keeps its own frames). Ignored when mode='encode'.

motion_only.tooltip: EXPERIMENTAL — extract only what MOVES. Video refs are converted to per-frame temporal differences (|f[t+1] - f[t]|, normalized) before encoding, so the mod carries where/how things move and the static appearance (background, the lineart look, an outfit) never enters the latent. For a lineart animation this keeps the moving lines and drops the static drawing. Needs video refs — a still has no motion, so image refs keep their appearance (warned). Training mode only; the ref channel is content-based, so treat the result as a soft motion guide, not a ControlNet. Combines with 'merge'.

multiplier.tooltip: Data multiplier: repeat the extracted ref N times along time so a short video/GIF (few tokens) isn't drowned out by the main video's tokens. Each repeat duplicates the same latent frames, so attention weight on the ref scales roughly with N. 1 = no repeat; file size grows with N.

max_tokens.tooltip: Hard cap on the total tokens the mod injects (0 = no cap; 5120 is a good performance default). If the stacked refs exceed it, near-duplicate latent frames are dropped first (video refs are full of frames that differ only by noise — each one still costs a token per spatial patch in every block), then frames are resampled to fit. The cap is honored after the multiplier. Lower latent_frames/ref_resolution instead to avoid wasting encode work: ~23K tokens = one 1024px encode-mode video ref at 16 frames.

description.tooltip: Optional text describing the concept (e.g. 'a ginger woman with messy hair', 'an animation style', 'handheld camera movement'). Stored in the mod and printed in the info block — documentation only, no wiring.

save.tooltip: Save the mod to mods/ so Load H3 RefMods can pick it up later.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference still: one image of the concept (angle / expression / outfit). Optional — leave empty when using video refs and/or a folder bundle.

ref_video.tooltip: Reference video frames [T,H,W,C] (a multi-frame batch = a video ref with motion). Optional — leave empty when using image refs and/or a folder bundle.

refs_bundle.tooltip: All images/videos from a Load H3 RefMod Folder node, appended after the autogrow refs (bulk extraction).

mask.tooltip: Subject mask (or a batch, one per reference in order: images then videos) marking what to keep at full weight. Everything outside the mask collapses toward a heavily blurred copy of itself per spatial cell (stays in-distribution — a flat noise-mix here decodes as a woven/static texture instead of 'nothing'), controlled by background_retention. Fixes 'encode' mode pulling in a background/style that doesn't belong to the subject. A single mask broadcasts to every reference; a batch must match the reference count.

av_encoder.tooltip: Legacy MiniMax-H3 VAERef. Loads its video checkpoint using the native ComfyUI VAE; prefer vae to share an already loaded VAE.

vae.tooltip: Standard VAE, used when av_encoder is not connected.

extraction_preset.tooltip: manual preserves controls. identity_encode: Full Reference, resolution=1024, steps=0, merge/motion_only off. style_experimental: Compressed Reference, pool=8x8, steps=150, merge/motion_only off. motion_sequence: Compressed Reference, pool=16x16, merge/motion_only off; preserves frame limit and Refinement Steps. It keeps appearance, not frame differences.

subfolder.tooltip: Optional folder inside models/refmods, for example celebs or voices.

mask_list.tooltip: Connect Collect H3 RefMod Masks to preserve different mask sizes. One mask broadcasts; otherwise images, videos, then folder references in order. Use mask OR mask_list.

budget_policy.tooltip: On max_tokens overflow: truncate uses the existing frame reduction; error stops without saving. 0 max_tokens disables the cap.

image_refs.tooltip: stack: all references become one video-kind ref (previous behaviour). H3 places references on the time axis right before the generated video, so a stack of stills can show up as the opening frames (issue #24). separate: each reference is its own member of one bundle file; stills become image refs like native Ref2VA pictures and load from a single loader slot. Ignored with merge.

output_tooltips: Bundle with this mod at strength 1.0 (one member per reference when image_refs is separate). Feed it to Apply H3 RefMod (or Load H3 RefMods after saving).
MiniMaxH3RefModExtract.name: MiniMaxH3RefModExtract
MiniMaxH3RefModExtract.description: Turn one or more references of the same concept into a RefMod. Stills plug into ref_image_1, video frames into ref_video_1, and the next slot of that type appears. refs are stacked into one video-kind mod, so a multi-image moodboard keeps each ref's own content instead of averaging away. 'training' mode (default) compresses the refs to a grid and refines it — good identity at a fraction of the tokens; 'encode' stores the full-res encode (max identity, MB-size mod). Flip 'merge' on to extract a collection as ONE consensus latent (joint refinement against every ref) instead of a stack. Set image_refs to 'separate' to save each ref as its own member of one bundle (stills become image refs) when stacked stills show up at the start of the output.

folder.tooltip: Folder with reference images/videos. An absolute path, or a folder name inside ComfyUI's input/ directory (empty = input/ itself).

max_items.tooltip: Max media files loaded (images first, then videos, by filename).

max_frames.tooltip: Video frames kept (uniformly sampled during decode, so a long video is never fully decoded into RAM — memory stays bounded by this cap x max_edge resolution). 240 = ~10s at 24fps.

max_edge.tooltip: Longest edge in px for loaded images/videos (downscale only, never upscale). Loading many 4K files at native resolution is what OOMs ComfyUI — the Extract node resizes to ref_resolution anyway, so 1024-1280 is plenty for folder extraction.

visual_preview.tooltip: Full video decodes every stored latent frame; increases memory use. Comparison appends the weakened sequence after the stored sequence. Audio remains limited to two seconds.

MiniMaxH3RefModMaskList.description: Collect a MASK list or batch without resizing. Connect mask_list to Create H3 RefMod or Master. Use one mask for all references, or one per image, video, then folder reference in order.

MiniMaxH3RefModMasterExtract.name: MiniMaxH3RefModMasterExtract
MiniMaxH3RefModMasterExtract.description: Extract appearance and/or audio into one RefMod bundle. Visual and audio VAEs run sequentially. Choose separate files or a single file with save_layout. This extracts references; it does not jointly train identity and voice.

MiniMaxH3RefModSave.name: MiniMaxH3RefModSave
MiniMaxH3RefModSave.description: Save each distinct RefMod in a bundle. Runs without a connected output; existing destination files are replaced. Loader strengths are preserved in the output bundle, not baked into files.

model.tooltip: The H3 model to patch. Returned unchanged apart from the per-step ref-mixing wrapper.

override.tooltip: Use the step_curve fixed into a mod's own metadata (by 'Fix H3 RefMod Config') instead of the curve widgets. Needs the mods bundle connected to the optional 'mods' input below. Off (default) = use the manual widgets. If no mod carries a saved step_curve it falls back to the manual widgets and prints a note.

curve_direction.tooltip: Strength envelope over the DENOISE timeline (the one temporal axis refs actually respond to): 'constant' (default) = full ref at every step — pure passthrough, nothing is re-mixed. 'concept_at_start' holds refs at full strength in the early steps (high sigma — composition and identity set first) and releases them toward the final steps (clean texture, no ref grain); 'concept_at_end' opens weak and locks full strength in the late steps (identity detail refined at the very end of denoising); 'concept_at_middle' peaks mid-denoise; 'concept_at_ends' holds the extremes and dips mid-denoise. Old 'decrease'/'increase' values still resolve.

curve_shape.tooltip: How the per-step strength travels between its endpoints (linear / ease / sigmoid / tanh / quadratic / cubic / exponential / stair / elastic / bump / dip). Only matters when curve_direction != constant.

curve_value.tooltip: Endpoint strength ('user input'): both endpoints for 'constant' and 'concept_at_ends', the start for 'concept_at_start', the end for 'concept_at_end', the mid peak for 'concept_at_middle'. 1.0 = full ref there.

mods.tooltip: Optional bundle, only read when 'override' is on: the first mod carrying a saved step_curve config supplies this node's curve. Leave unconnected when override is off.

reference_fps.tooltip: Playback FPS of the reconstructed video, used for Qwen timestamps. Saved compressed or stacked refs do not preserve original timing.

vae.tooltip: H3 video VAE: reconstructs visual refs for Qwen. Not needed for audio-only bundles.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE. Without it reference images/videos only condition the text encoder.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE. Without it reference audio only conditions the text encoder.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference conditioning for MiniMax H3. Use the same tags when prompting.

original.tooltip: Straight from the sampler, untouched. Its head is what matches the previous clip.

hold_frames.tooltip: Kept exactly as sampled: the frames the pin established. Match the Motion Context context_length, or drive it from the trim so the two cannot drift apart. Has to be a whole number of latent steps (5, 22, 39, 56).

blend_frames.tooltip: Frames to ramp from held to refined after the hold. 0 is a hard cut, which will show as a pop.

audio.tooltip: Leave on original. The audio pin returns at 0.88 at best and stamps transients forward on material without dialogue, so refining it is a separate experiment.

use_refine.tooltip: Off ignores the refined input and passes the original through, so you can A/B the refine without unwiring the second sampler.

clip_index.tooltip: Driven by the Chain node, the same way Load and Save are, as long as this node sits in their canvas group. 0 is the first clip: nothing pinned, so the whole thing gets refined and the hold is skipped.

refined.tooltip: The same latent after a second sampler: one step from the main schedule's last level. With use_refine off, whatever feeds this is not executed at all.

MiniMaxH3RefineBlend.name: MiniMaxH3RefineBlend
MiniMaxH3RefineBlend.description: Experimental. Holds the pinned frames from the original clip and ramps into a refined version over the frames after them. Audio passes through unrefined by default.

MiniMaxH3RefineEndpointsEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3RefineEndpointsEXPT8

MiniMaxH3RepairSegmentSelectT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Repair Segment Select / 重做段选择 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3RepairSegmentSelectT8Advanced.description: Selects one item from a non-destructive repair plan and exposes it to the existing generation graph. Acceptance remains a separate user action.

MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Residency Strategy / 低显存驻留策略 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3ResidencyStrategyT8Advanced.description: Compiles a side-effect-free report_only/minimum_memory/balanced/faster policy from current ComfyUI and AIMDO telemetry. Applying it remains explicit through a compatible loader; this node never unloads other models or monkey-patches globally.

model.tooltip: Load sam3.1_multiplex_fp16.safetensors.

conditioning.tooltip: SAM3.1 CLIP text conditioning, normally: person

analysis_max_side.tooltip: 0 keeps source size. SAM3.1 still uses its fixed 1008-square backbone; this mainly bounds input/preview tensors rather than backbone VRAM.

MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SAM3.1 Multi-Person Track / 多人分色追踪 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SAM31MultiPersonTrackT8Advanced.description: Runs current ComfyUI native SAM3.1 multiplex tracking per detected shot, caps the result at 2-3 people and emits color-coded shot-local track IDs. Default cleanup selectively unloads only the SAM model and its clones before H3 repair. Colors are not character identity.

MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 SLA Dynamic LoRA Bypass V2 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SLADynamicLoRABypassV2T8Advance.description: Loads the selected H3 SLA LoRA as a model-only dynamic residual. Quantized base weights are not merged or re-quantized. Place this before SLA Precision V2 Attention.

MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SLA Precision V2 Runtime Audit (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2AuditT8Advanced.description: Fails closed after sampling unless logical NFE, 50 H3 blocks per sparse step, dense boundaries, protected audio/language blocks and zero kernel fallback are all observed.

MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SLA Precision V2 Attention (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SLAPrecisionV2T8Advanced.description: Precision-first MiniMax H3 SLA attention derived from PlagueKind v1.4.3 at pinned commit 066ada9: FP32 routing, direct Triton sparse attention, logical sigma-step tracking, first/last dense protection and precise language/audio segment protection. Input MODEL must already carry the SLA LoRA; the recommended route uses the matching dynamic bypass node.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Calibration Window / 画幅安全标定窗口 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDCalibrationWindowT8Advance.description: Resamples one strict H3 24fps/17n+5 calibration window and uses aspect-preserving center-cover resize. It never stretches source geometry, never pads short clips and does not alter the existing Source Media Window.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · DCT + AV Transition (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDDCTTransitionEXPT8.description: Consumes one completed stage and the next independently prepared target. Official DCT high-frequency expansion plus H3 audio flow reindex; solves the next segment's NOISE. Does not sample or silently reuse old stages.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Modality-Stable AV Noise / AV独立随机噪声 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModalityStableNoiseT8Advan.description: Generates deterministic video and audio noise from separate derived seeds. Changing only the video canvas therefore cannot silently change the audio noise stream. Intended for controlled H3 SPEED baselines and diagnostics.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Model + VAE Fingerprint / 模型与VAE指纹 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDModelVAEFingerprintT8Advan.description: Streams the complete selected diffusion checkpoint and video VAE files to produce binding SHA-256 fingerprints. It does not load model weights onto GPU; first execution can be disk-I/O heavy and ComfyUI may cache unchanged inputs.

scales.tooltip: Strictly increasing spatial scales ending in 1.0.

manual_transition_sigmas.tooltip: One descending public H3 video sigma per resolution transition.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Plan / 渐进分辨率计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds a multiple-of-32 H3 spatial progression with the official SPEED kappa and sigma-alignment equations. Manual sigmas are the safe default until an H3 dataset spectrum is validated. NFE is preserved exactly.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · External Relay for ONE Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDRelayApplyEXPT8.description: Re-encodes one external Prompt Relay Plan at this stage's exact canvas, checks the rebuilt AV target against Stage Setup, and binds MODEL with CONDITIONING. Connect its outputs to this stage's Sampler, optionally through Stage EAV Apply. Inspect downstream actual-call audit; this node alone is not effect execution proof.

execution_scope.tooltip: Strict mode requires media-free native-audio T2VA, exactly 20 steps, shifts 12/3, and an unpatched stock H3 model. Multimodal research mode enables stage-rebuilt I/FL/L/Ref/Hybrid mechanics. Turbo8 research mode requires media-free T2VA, exactly 8 steps and a compatible weight-patched MODEL; the node cannot prove a LoRA file's identity from patch tensors.

dct_chunk_size.tooltip: Number of B*C*T spatial slices transformed per chunk.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Whole-Chain Sampler / 整链采样 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSamplerT8Advanced.description: Runs native H3 Euler sampling over spatial stages, rebuilding AV layout and conditioning at every canvas. Video receives official DCT expansion. Audio stays spatially untouched and is reindexed on the shared public H3 flow; this H3-specific audio extension remains EXP until real GPU listening tests pass.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

length.tooltip: 24fps; the H3 builder snaps to the 17n+5 grid.

checkpoint_fingerprint.tooltip: SHA/header fingerprint used to bind a delta-optimal spectrum profile. Manual-sigma plans do not require it.

vae_fingerprint.tooltip: Video-VAE fingerprint used to bind a delta-optimal spectrum profile.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Stage Source / 分阶段条件源 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSourceT8Advanced.description: Retains raw H3 text/media inputs so every SPEED stage can resize and re-encode keyframes/references for its own canvas. It does not load a second H3 model and does not alter the stable Conditioning node.

video_latent.tooltip: Separated H3 video LATENT [B,24,T,H,W], never joint AV latent.

batch_id.tooltip: A unique stable ID for this actual source batch; repeats are rejected.

dataset_provenance_json.tooltip: Optional reviewed natural-corpus provenance. Appended after the legacy inputs so existing widget positions remain unchanged.

source_entry_json.tooltip: Optional manifest-bound source and decoded-window hashes for this batch.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Dataset Accumulate / 频谱数据集累积 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetAccumulateT.description: Accumulates exact per-clip H3 spatial power statistics across ComfyUI executions without retaining source or CUDA latents. Duplicate batch IDs and exact clip-spectrum repeats fail closed; model, VAE, task and latent contracts must remain identical.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Dataset File / 频谱数据集文件 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFileT8Advan.description: Loads or explicitly saves one accumulated spectrum dataset under the ComfyUI output directory. Save is atomic, stores no source latent/video, requires confirmation and refuses silent overwrite or unsafe paths.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8A.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Dataset Finalize / 频谱数据集定稿 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumDatasetFinalizeT8A.description: Fits one task/model/VAE-bound H3 SPEED profile from accumulated sufficient statistics. Fewer than 100 unique clips or a weak fit remains a research probe and cannot authorize the validated delta-optimal Plan mode.

video_latent.tooltip: Separated MiniMax H3 video LATENT [B,24,T,H,W], not the joint AV latent.

checkpoint_fingerprint.tooltip: Record a checkpoint SHA/header fingerprint; filenames alone are not proof.

independent_clip_count.tooltip: Must not exceed the actual latent batch count. Typing 100 for one clip does not promote it; dataset status needs 100 actual batch entries whose independence remains a dataset provenance assertion.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 SPEED Spectrum Harvester / 空间频谱标定 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDSpectrumHarvesterT8Advance.description: Fits P(omega)=A|omega|^-beta from H3 VIDEO LATENT samples. It never substitutes WAN/FLUX constants. A single clip remains a research probe; dataset status requires at least 100 actual independent batch entries.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Load Exact Previous Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageLoadEXPT8.description: Loads the selected completed previous stage by path+SHA under the SPEED-only store. Connect prior_spec to the next Stage Setup and completed_stage to DCT Transition; no previous MODEL, noise, conditioning encode or sampler runs. This freezes a selected past stage, not an automatic cache hit against edited past-stage settings.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Sample ONE Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSampleEXPT8.description: Calls the native H3 Guider.sample once for this stage's sigmas. MODEL, CONDITIONING, SAMPLER and NOISE remain externally wired. Output is the public-flow state used by DCT Transition, not a decoded x0. A live result is not portable persistent cache proof.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Save ONE Frozen Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSaveEXPT8.description: Writes a new immutable SPEED-only artifact by completed typed result. Returns an exact path and SHA for explicit later selection. No automatic cache lookup. Unknown MODEL, noise or effect stacks cannot claim portable restoration; authenticated external Stage EAV and SPEED Relay calls are supported.

MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 SPEED · Prepare ONE Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SPEEDStageSetupEXPT8.description: Rebuilds exactly one planned H3 AV canvas/conditioning and its native-flow Euler schedule. Independent MODEL/LoRA branch per stage. The previous spec enables original T2VA text reuse; set reuse=false to rebuild edited stage text. No sampling or hidden fallback. External Stage EAV and SPEED Relay adapters are available. Explicit Save/Load accepts only completed stages with authenticated execution and effect-call evidence; automatic cache reuse is disabled.

preserve_audio_length.tooltip: Preserve an already trimmed audio interval instead of padding it to the video endpoint.

MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Safe AV Save / 安全音视频保存 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SafeAVSaveT8Advanced.description: Encode raw even-size IMAGE and AUDIO at 24fps through isolated single-thread H264/AAC. Strict decode before publication, no overwrite. Requires FFmpeg on PATH. Returns reusable VIDEO without a second SaveVideo.

latent.tooltip: The sampler's output latent (the same one you wire into the decode nodes).

filename_prefix.tooltip: Saved under the ComfyUI output folder. The default keeps all chain latents in one folder so the Load node can always pick the newest.

clip_index.tooltip: Which clip of the chain THIS is. Saves to that clip's fixed slot, so a re-roll overwrites its own reject instead of stacking new files. Generating clip 2: set 2 here and 1 on the Load node. 0 = old behaviour, a new numbered file every run (numbers count runs, not clips).

MiniMaxH3SaveLatent.name: MiniMaxH3SaveLatent
MiniMaxH3SaveLatent.description: Save the sampler's AV latent to disk so the next run can load it for lossless motion & audio continuation.
output_tooltips: Passthrough of the input latent so you can wire this node directly in-line.
Absolute path of the saved H3 AV safetensors checkpoint.

MiniMaxH3SaveVideoIsolatedEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SaveVideoIsolatedEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SaveVideoIsolatedEXPT8.description: Windows Job-owned FFmpeg export from original frame data; 8/10-bit and original audio. Explicit disk/deadline guards. Strict complete decode before exclusive publication. No change to old SaveVideo or sampling; no quality certification.

MiniMaxH3SaveVideoSerialEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SaveVideoSerialEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SaveVideoSerialEXPT8.description: Explicit single-thread H.264/AAC export preserving selected 8/10-bit depth, color space, fps and original audio. Separate unique output directory; never overwrites old media. No sampling or quality certification.

MiniMaxH3ScenePromptAdoptEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ScenePromptAdoptEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ScenePromptAdoptEXPT8.display_name: H3 FreeToken·核当前镜头后采用
MiniMaxH3ScenePromptAdoptEXPT8.description: 默认保当前原稿，迟到提案可看原镜头历史但不可跨scene/revision/request采用；事实与质量仍需真人判断。

MiniMaxH3ScenePromptRewriteEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ScenePromptRewriteEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ScenePromptRewriteEXPT8.description: 实际原H09 provider，发出前绑定票据，返回后仍归原镜头；不采H3、不自动采用、无新下载/云服务。

MiniMaxH3ScenePromptTicketEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3ScenePromptTicketEXPT8
MiniMaxH3ScenePromptTicketEXPT8.description: 复用旧Request，绑定scene_id+revision+request_id+原稿/素材SHA。每个新异步请求明确更换request_id；不改旧请求格式或prepared配置。

start_percent.tooltip: 0 is the first/high-noise denoise step.

end_percent.tooltip: 1 is the last/low-noise denoise step.

lock_final_audio.tooltip: Replace final generated audio latent with encoded drive audio. Use mux_audio for unchanged source PCM.

allow_unverified_patch_stack.tooltip: Allow patches_replace/LongVideo/MultiKeyframe combinations that have not passed the Scheduled Audio validation matrix.

MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8A.name: MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Scheduled Drive Audio Injection (T8 Advanced)
MiniMaxH3ScheduledDriveAudioInjectionT8A.description: Experimental dual-clock sampler that repeatedly anchors the complete supplied drive-audio latent on its own sigma path. It does not isolate speech from music or effects. report_only is an unchanged dual-clock bypass.

MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoArchive.name: MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoArchive
MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoArchive.display_name: MiniMax H3 Archive Temporary Segment Video

MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoInitialize.name: MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoInitialize
MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoInitialize.display_name: MiniMax H3 Initialize Temporary Segment Video

MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoOutput.name: MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoOutput
MiniMaxH3SegmentVideoOutput.display_name: MiniMax H3 Finish Temporary Segment Video

lora_name.tooltip: MiniMax H3 LoRA file to load

strength.tooltip: Overall LoRA strength

preset.tooltip: Quick preset selection. Choose 'Custom' to use individual toggles below.

lora_path_opt.tooltip: Optional: Connect from LoRA Analyzer to use its selected LoRA

analysis_json.tooltip: Optional: Connect from LoRA Analyzer for impact-colored checkboxes

block_weights_string.tooltip: Optional positional or named block profile. A connected string overrides the individual controls.

save_refined_lora.tooltip: Save the exact filtered/scaled LoRA applied by this node.

save_path.tooltip: Directory where the filtered LoRA will be saved.

save_filename.tooltip: Base filename. A timestamp and .safetensors are added automatically.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveLoRALoader.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveLoRALoader
MiniMaxH3SelectiveLoRALoader.description:
Selective LoRA loader for MiniMax H3. Toggle the 50 main packed DiT blocks on/off.

Use other_weights for token-refiner and any non-main H3 tensors. Supports both native
diffusion_model.blocks.* keys and lora_unet_blocks_* training keys.

replace_existing.tooltip: Only enable after reviewing a new take for a slot that already has an accepted repair overlay.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Accept / 修复接受 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairAcceptT8Advanced.description: Explicitly accepts a reviewed candidate into an atomic repair overlay. The original accepted manifest and every original segment stay unchanged.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Bind / 修复绑定 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairBindT8Advanced.description: Binds one repair-plan item to an immutable accepted-manifest revision and exposes the exact existing generation inputs. It does not load models, queue work or modify the accepted chain.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Compose / 修复合成 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairComposeT8Advance.description: Streams the immutable base segments plus accepted repair overlays into one bounded-memory MP4. base_rollback ignores the overlay without deleting anything.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Repair Stage / 修复暂存 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveRepairStageT8Advanced.description: Verifies a generated candidate against the bound frame/sample/timeline and base-manifest contract. It remains preview-only and writes no repair overlay.

MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Selective Segment Repair / 选择性分段重做 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SelectiveSegmentRepairT8Advance.description: Creates a non-destructive repair list from explicit indices or quality evidence. It never overwrites or automatically accepts existing media.

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8.display_name: H3 Semantic Bridge / 应用条件 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeApplyT8.description: 接在原生条件编码之后、采样之前。Relay请使用内部Bridge入口；不要重复增强。

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeAutoConfigT8.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeAutoConfigT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeAutoConfigT8.display_name: H3 Semantic Bridge / 自动模型参数 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeAutoConfigT8.description: 按权重内容SHA／固定元数据契约自动配置。原版/BUNNY .10；已识别武术v1 .12；动漫战斗1.0。不会按文件名猜测或把所有trans都设1。未知训练模型请用手动节点。report_json显示实际参数。

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeComposeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeComposeT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeComposeT8.display_name: H3 Semantic Bridge / 多桥组合 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeComposeT8.description: 显式按 first→second 串行应用，每桥保留自己的强度／契约；不是LoRA加法融合。继续串接本组合节点可加载最多8桥，最后只接一次Apply或Relay/内循环Bridge插口。顺序影响效果，重复同SHA拒绝，变化换chain_id；多桥可能损害画面／声音。

model_name.tooltip: 原版/BUNNY：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Semantic-Bridge-Comfy ；T8动漫战斗：https://huggingface.co/t8star/semantic_bridge_T8-comic-combat 。放在 models/semantic_bridge/t8_compat；不是LoRA或H3主模型。

token_scope.tooltip: all_tokens复现原作者；text_only仅修改原生tag=1行，仍不能保证歌声。

chunk_tokens.tooltip: 0 = whole sequence; required by some trained Transformer bridges.

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8.display_name: H3 Semantic Bridge / 模型与设置 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeConfigT8.description: 手动参数，旧默认0.10不变。新手请用‘自动模型参数’节点按文件内容读取推荐值。动漫战斗固定1.0/per_token/all_tokens/chunk=0；武术v1不是1.0。固定契约不匹配会在预检报错。多桥用显式‘组合’，不要串多个Apply。

sidecar_path.tooltip: 留空只读所选权重同目录inference_settings.json；也可明确选择说明的本机绝对路径。model_file仅显示标签，不用于找权重。

MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeSidecarPresetEXPT.name: MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeSidecarPresetEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeSidecarPresetEXPT.display_name: H3 语义桥·模型专属参数说明（显式采用）
MiniMaxH3SemanticBridgeSidecarPresetEXPT.description: 读取Trainer inference_settings.json并核实际完整权重SHA。固定内嵌契约优先；0.12只是未校准起点。默认不采用/不Apply，旧0.10和多桥顺序不改。

MiniMaxH3SetAVNoiseMask.name: MiniMaxH3SetAVNoiseMask
MiniMaxH3SetAVNoiseMask.description: Set video and/or audio denoise masks on a MiniMax H3 AV latent using the required two-stream NestedTensor format. Use this instead of ComfyUI's stock Set Latent Noise Mask for H3 AV latents; a stock single-tensor mask can drop the audio mask stream and unintentionally regenerate protected audio.

tail_steps.tooltip: How many of the lowest levels before zero to reshape. Everything above them is kept.

strength.tooltip: Above 0 lifts the tail, spending less time at the lowest noise, which is expected to add less fine detail. Below 0 does the opposite. 0 leaves the schedule unchanged.

MiniMaxH3SigmasTail.name: MiniMaxH3SigmasTail
MiniMaxH3SigmasTail.description: Experimental. Reshapes only the last few noise levels before zero; the start, the levels above the tail and the final zero stay put.

base_vae.tooltip: VAE oficial do MiniMax-H3 (fornece encoder, quant_conv e as estatisticas de latente).

single_frame_decoder.tooltip: Checkpoint decoder-only do autor (585 tensores, naming diffusers). Tambem aceita um ja convertido.

tiling.tooltip: Tiling espacial. MANTENHA LIGADO acima de ~768px: o curriculo do autor parou em 1024 e a imagem inteira acima disso produz grade na fronteira de 32px (blocagem 2.9x em 1024, 3.5x em 1536, contra ~1.5x com tiling). Desligar so compensa em imagens pequenas, onde rende um pouco mais de nitidez.

tile_size.tooltip: So vale com tiling ligado. 512 e o otimo MEDIDO, nao um chute: numa imagem 1056x640, PSNR 26.00 dB com costura 0.91 (indistinguivel), contra 22.17/1.49 com 256 (o default do ComfyUI, que multiplica costuras) e 21.35/2.42 com 1024 (acima da resolucao treinada). O autor treinou 475k das 500k imagens em <=512px, entao o tile de 512 mantem cada pedaco na regiao com massa de treino.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False preserves the source on selected output. Acceptance is always explicit and never automatic.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish / H3肤质收尾 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishAdvancedT8.description: Append-only advanced P0 route with explicit mask provenance, area gates, CPU-bounded chunks, exact outside-mask pixels, exact alpha/aux preservation, shape-derived host/commit preflight and source-by-default selection. face_refine_plan builds a conservative inner-face proxy mask; it is not a semantic face parser.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False keeps the exact source selected. Enable only after labelled full-video review and downstream Texture/Safety gates.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Dichromatic Specular / 二色反射高光抑制 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishDichromaticT8Advanced.description: Experimental clean-room highlight attenuation for reliable semantic skin masks. It requires both a neutral-illuminant dichromatic specular estimate and local chroma dilution, so same-chromaticity bright skin is preserved. This is bounded SDR finishing, not physical inverse rendering. Source stays selected until full human review.

low_frequency_strength.tooltip: 0 keeps the source low-frequency layer; 1 uses the candidate's low-frequency tone/brightness correction.

source_detail_gain.tooltip: Gain for high-frequency detail already present in the source. 1.0 is neutral; this does not create missing detail.

separation_radius_percent.tooltip: Low-pass radius as a percentage of the shorter image side. Resolution-relative scaling avoids one fixed pixel radius across sizes.

maximum_radius_px.tooltip: Hard CPU-cost cap for the calculated separation radius.

maximum_new_clipped_fraction.tooltip: Frames exceeding this new clipping fraction return to source.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Source remains selected until the recombined candidate is reviewed.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Frequency Split / 肤色纹理解耦 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishFrequencySplitT8Advan.description: Rebuilds a Skin Finish candidate from its low-frequency tone/brightness layer and the source frame's existing high-frequency detail. It is non-generative: it cannot deblur, create pores, repair identity or decide that a result is better.

include_neck.tooltip: Neck remains excluded by default; clothing is always protected.

maximum_alignment_rms.tooltip: Strict five-landmark residual. This node does not raise it; a rejected pose may use the profile-crop fallback instead.

profile_crop_expansion.tooltip: Square face crop used only after strict five-point alignment rejects the pose. 1.45 passed the bounded six-frame profile probe.

minimum_ready_frame_fraction.tooltip: If fewer frames contain at least one reliable tracked face, the whole batch returns an empty mask instead of intermittent processing.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSem.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSemanticMaskT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSem.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Multi-Person Profile Semantic Mask / 多人侧脸语义皮肤遮罩 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonProfileSem.description: Keeps the existing strict YuNet five-point FFHQ alignment first. Only when that alignment is rejected, it parses an expanded square crop in the original profile pose, projects the mask back, and intersects it with the exact SAM3.1 person track. It does not frontalize a face or loosen the five-point residual gate.

include_neck.tooltip: Neck remains excluded by default; clothing is always protected.

maximum_alignment_rms.tooltip: Normalized five-landmark residual on the 512 parser canvas.

minimum_ready_frame_fraction.tooltip: If fewer frames contain at least one reliable tracked face, the whole batch returns an empty mask instead of intermittent processing.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMa.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMaskT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMa.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Multi-Person Semantic Mask / 多人语义皮肤遮罩 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonSemanticMa.description: Matches one pinned-YuNet five-point face to each shot-local SAM3.1 person track, aligns it to the FFHQ 512 template, runs the pinned ParseNet on CPU, and intersects the projected semantic skin mask with that person's track. Missing or ambiguous evidence fails closed to an empty mask.

absolute_start_frame.tooltip: Absolute zero-based frame index of this chunk. The first chunk must start at 0; later chunks may overlap a reviewed bounded tail.

preset.tooltip: Multi-person mode intentionally exposes only shared color-neutral finishing. Per-person hue/saturation changes are not automatic.

minimum_detail.tooltip: Gradient-detail floor used only to downweight already blurred faces. Skin Finish does not sharpen or reconstruct them.

bbox_ema_alpha.tooltip: Causal current-observation weight; resets naturally at shot-local tracks.

include_neck.tooltip: Off by default. A conservative neck strip is still clipped to the person track.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Source remains selected until the candidate has been reviewed.

audio.tooltip: Passed through as the same AUDIO object. Do not concatenate duplicate audio from overlapped chunks; use Video Finalize for file-level audio.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Multi-Person / 多人肤质收尾 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishMultiPersonT8Advanced.description: Reuses an existing native SAM3.1 multi-person track plan without loading SAM again. Shot-local person masks are intersected with CPU YuNet face regions; small, profile, blurred or occluded faces are downweighted. A hashed causal state lets overlapped long-video chunks continue without temporal RGB averaging.

semantic_report_json.tooltip: Connect report_json from the same Multi-Person Semantic Mask node. The report binds source, track plan and mask.

default_policy.tooltip: source_unmatched changes only explicitly profiled people. default_profile applies the default controls to every remaining track.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False preserves source on selected output; acceptance is never automatic.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Per-Person / 逐人物逐镜头肤质收尾 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPerPersonT8Advanced.description: Reassigns a source-bound combined ParseNet skin mask to exact SAM3.1 tracks, then applies reviewed per-character or per-shot parameters. Exact shot:track profiles override character profiles. Cross-person overlap and unmatched people remain bit-exact source pixels.

selector.tooltip: Use the reviewed character ID, or switch selector_type to shot_track and enter a shot-local key such as 0:1.

tone_adjust.tooltip: Bounded midtone exposure-like adjustment; not automatic skin-tone matching. Keep 0 unless reviewed on the actual character.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Person Profile / 逐人物肤质参数 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPersonProfileT8Advanc.description: Adds one explicit character_id or shot:track Skin Finish profile to a small hashed in-memory stack. Chain the output into another profile node for more people. It never estimates skin tone or accepts a candidate automatically.

comparison_position.tooltip: Left side is source; right side is candidate.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Preview / 肤质收尾预览审计 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishPreviewAuditT8Advance.description: Builds a source/candidate split, full-resolution masked crop, used/rejected mask view, amplified difference and a ±2-frame loop. The selected output stays on source unless accept_candidate is explicitly enabled and audio passthrough remains PCM-exact.

mask_feather_px.tooltip: Zero is the conservative semantic default; extra feathering may approach eyes or lips and requires review.

chunk_frames.tooltip: Two frames is the conservative CPU/RAM default.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False returns the exact source VIDEO without analysis or writes. Enable only to render a candidate for human review; the node never accepts aesthetic quality automatically.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8A.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8A.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Quality Stream / 语义低内存肤质收尾 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishQualityVideoStreamT8A.description: Two-pass file VIDEO route that never materializes a full IMAGE batch. Pass 1 keeps only pinned YuNet face metadata; pass 2 runs pinned CPU ParseNet, Skin Finish, Frequency Split, Texture Guard and a cross-chunk Safety Audit on bounded chunks, then incrementally encodes H.264 and packet-copies verified source audio. Accepted runs preflight a reviewed 2048 MiB available-system-RAM floor when host measurement is supported; insufficient RAM returns source and writes no file.

audit_scope.tooltip: mask_only works without SAM. track_union requires every edited pixel inside a tracked person. unique_track_owner also rejects edits where two person masks overlap.

temporal_policy.tooltip: report_only records source-relative treatment jumps. hard_gate also rejects jumps above the configured limit.

maximum_temporal_effect_jump.tooltip: Maximum adjacent-frame change in mask-weighted treatment statistics, not raw video motion. Shot boundaries reset the comparison.

scene_cut_reset_threshold.tooltip: Used only without a track plan. A source-frame mean absolute change above this value resets the temporal comparison.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Even after hard gates pass, the source remains selected until a human explicitly enables this switch.

output_tooltips: The untouched candidate when all hard gates pass; exact source when any hard gate fails. Finalizers should consume this output.
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Safety Audit / 肤质候选安全审计 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSafetyAuditT8Advanced.description: Final fail-closed audit for a Skin Finish IMAGE candidate. It can reject mask spill, excessive changes, treatment jumps, multi-person track spill and audio mismatch. It cannot auto-score beauty or replace human review.

include_neck.tooltip: Off by default so face finishing cannot spill onto neck or clothing.

crop_expansion.tooltip: Expanded upright square around each source-bound face box. Existing face plans do not retain five-point landmarks, so this is not affine alignment.

feature_protection_px.tooltip: Protection dilation in the fixed 512x512 parser canvas.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Semantic Mask / 语义皮肤遮罩 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSemanticMaskT8Advance.description: Builds a source-bound semantic skin mask with the pinned local FaceXLib ParseNet checkpoint. Eyes, brows, nose, lips, mouth, hair and accessories are excluded by class. Missing, altered or unsafe weights fail closed to an empty mask; no network download or persistent model cache is used.

highlight_detail_suppression.tooltip: Restores the input candidate only where bright positive detail was lost. The correction cannot pass beyond that candidate; 0 is exact ordinary split.

maximum_specular_delta.tooltip: Hard per-pixel luma correction cap before Texture Guard.

accept_candidate.tooltip: The source stays selected until the labelled candidate is reviewed.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Ad.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Ad.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Specular-Aware Split / 高光感知纹理解耦 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSpecularFrequencyT8Ad.description: Runs the unchanged Frequency Split, then selectively restores only the darker highlight intent that split lost. The result stays between the frequency base and the input Skin Finish candidate; mask exterior, alpha and audio stay bound.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False keeps the exact source selected. Enable only after labelled full-video review and downstream Texture/Safety gates.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Guided Surface / 引导滤波肤质收尾 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishSurfaceT8Advanced.description: Clean-room guided-filter surface candidate for reliable semantic skin masks. It balances compact and broad highlights plus blemishes while explicitly retaining source texture.
