Broad highlights are measured against masked local skin illumination and treatment fades inside hard mask edges; this remains a display-referred finish, not physical specular separation. Source stays selected until full human review.

preset.tooltip: subtle is the safe default; oil_control reduces bright oily patches; tone_even favors low-frequency tone consistency.

skin_mask.tooltip: Required for processing. Without a reliable explicit mask the node returns the source unchanged and reports ABSTAIN.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish / H3肤质收尾 (T8)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishT8.description: Creates a conservative non-generative skin-finishing candidate only inside an explicit MASK. Missing or unreliable masks ABSTAIN to the exact source. Before allocating full candidate/audit outputs it checks a shape-derived host RAM and Windows commit floor. It cannot reconstruct identity, missing facial structure, blur or lip sync.

shadow_protection.tooltip: Source luma at or below this value is preserved.

highlight_protection.tooltip: Source luma at or above this value is preserved.

minimum_texture_ratio.tooltip: Per-frame high-pass RMS floor relative to source. This is a hard retention guard, not a perceptual quality score.

maximum_new_clipped_fraction.tooltip: Maximum newly clipped masked-pixel fraction before frame fallback.

accept_candidate.tooltip: Source remains selected until the guarded candidate is reviewed.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Texture Guard / 肤质纹理保护 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTextureGuardT8Advance.description: Append-only fail-closed guard for an existing Skin Finish candidate. Source deep shadows and near-clipped highlights are preserved; frames that introduce clipping or fall below a source-relative high-frequency floor return to source. It is not a beauty score, semantic parser, deblur or pore generator.

selector.tooltip: global ignores this text; character_id uses a reviewed assignment; shot_track uses the SAM-local key such as 0:1.

frame_in_shot.tooltip: Local frame inside the selected Studio Timeline shot.

interpolation_to_next.tooltip: Controls continuous parameters until the next key in the same Studio shot. Preset is categorical and switches only at the next key.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Adv.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Adv.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Timeline Keyframe / 肤质时间关键帧 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineKeyframeT8Adv.description: Adds one source-bound Skin Finish keyframe to a hashed Studio Timeline plan. Keyframes interpolate only inside their Studio shot; SAM shot:track identity remains an independent routing domain. Chain multiple nodes for more keys.

semantic_report_json.tooltip: Connect report_json from the same source-bound Multi-Person Semantic Mask node.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False preserves source on selected output; acceptance is never automatic.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Studio Timeline / 逐人物肤质时间执行 (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishTimelineT8Advanced.description: Applies reviewed Skin Finish keyframes to exact semantic skin owned by each SAM3.1 track. Routing precedence is SAM shot:track, character_id, global, then bit-exact source. It never blends across Studio cuts or accepts automatically.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False returns the exact source VIDEO and writes nothing. Enable only after reviewing the Skin Finish candidate.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Video Finalize / 原音频封装 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoFinalizeT8Advanc.description: Finalizes reviewed full-length IMAGE frames against an untrimmed file-backed ComfyUI VIDEO. Video is encoded frame by frame while original compressed audio packet payloads are copied and SHA-256 verified. Unsupported codecs, trims, HDR/10-bit, geometry or packet drift fail closed.

minimum_detail.tooltip: Downweights already blurred faces; this node never sharpens or reconstructs missing detail.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False returns the source VIDEO without analysis or file writes. Enable only after choosing to render a review candidate.

MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Skin Finish Video Stream / 两遍低内存肤质收尾 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SkinFinishVideoStreamT8Advanced.description: Consumes an untrimmed file-backed VIDEO without GetVideoComponents. Pass 1 retains only pinned CPU YuNet face metadata; pass 2 processes bounded frame chunks, incrementally encodes H.264 and packet-copies verified source audio. No complete IMAGE batch is materialized. Source is selected by default.

expected_dense_blocks.tooltip: Must match the upstream Sol node's dense_blocks widget, e.g. 0-2,-1. Those blocks intentionally have no Sol forward patch.

allow_unreviewed_composition.tooltip: When false, DiT replacements, whole-model wrappers and unknown full-block patches force ABSTAIN. True downgrades only that finding to a warning.

MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Adva.name: MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Adva.display_name: MiniMax H3 Sol-Attn Compatibility Audit / 外部补丁所有权审计 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolAttnCompatibilityAuditT8Adva.description: Passes MODEL through unchanged while checking a separately installed Sol-Attn version, CUDA/BF16 architecture, complete H3 attention ownership, shadowing and unreviewed DiT/model-wrapper combinations. It does not import or run the kernel.

frames.tooltip: Decoded H3 draft frames; AUDIO is intentionally not accepted.

frame_policy.tooltip: Official route trims without adding frames. preserve_all_exp is only for runtimes that explicitly accept a non-8n+1 length.

fps.tooltip: Source H3 frame rate; used only to calculate exact audio-bypass trim duration.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced.display_name: H3 Super: Draft to LTX Refiner / H3草稿转LTX二阶段 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineDraftToLTXT8Advanced.description: Prepares decoded H3 RGB frames for NVIDIA's H3 Super Acceleration Stage 2: trim to the LTX 8n+1 frame grid, aspect-preserving center-crop to half the requested output size, then encode it with ComfyUI's full LTX-2.5 video VAE before the official x2 latent upsampler. The refiner was trained on the full VAE latent distribution; TAEHV is only used for the final fast decode. H3 audio must bypass Stage 2 on a separate wire.

model.tooltip: LTX-2.5 dev transformer with the distilled refiner LoRA applied at 0.8.

schedule_mode.tooltip: The preset always uses 0.5, 0.412, 0.350, 0. manual_exp parses the next field.

manual_sigmas.tooltip: Comma-separated, finite, strictly descending values ending at zero. Used only when schedule_mode=manual_exp.

attention_backend.tooltip: Dense isolates the sigma change. The Sol route is optional and experimental.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetu.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetu.display_name: H3 Super: LTX-2.5 Low-Sigma Identity Refiner / LTX低Sigma保脸细化 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXIdentityRefinerSetu.description: Append-only identity-preserving Stage-2 route. The default schedule is [0.5, 0.412, 0.350, 0]: three Euler updates with complete terminal denoising. Dense attention is the validated-first default. Optional Sol-Attn uses a conservative constant tau 1.0 EXP policy instead of remapping custom knots to the official per-step tau schedule. H3 audio remains on the external bypass.

model.tooltip: LTX-2.5 dev transformer with the distilled refiner LoRA applied at 0.8.

attention_backend.tooltip: auto uses an already-loaded ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton; otherwise it safely stays dense.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXRefinerSetupT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXRefinerSetupT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineLTXRefinerSetupT8Advan.description: Configures the official LTX-2.5 Stage-2 Euler schedule [0.909375, 0.725, 0.421875, 0], keeps self-attention layer 0 dense, and routes layers 1-47 through the loaded ComfyUI-SolAttn_triton backend with tau 1.0/1.25/1.5. Missing Sol-Attn falls back to dense without blocking. Apply the official LTX-2.5 distilled LoRA at the returned 0.8 strength before this node.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced.display_name: H3 Super: TAEHV Decode / TAEHV解码 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVDecodeT8Advanced.description: Decodes the refined normalized LTX video latent with the published TAEHV wide path.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced.display_name: TAEHV Encode (Legacy/Diagnostic) / TAEHV编码（旧兼容/诊断）
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVEncodeT8Advanced.description: Legacy-compatible TAEHV round-trip encoder. Do not connect this output to the H3 Super LTX-2.5 refiner: NVIDIA keeps the original full LTX video VAE encoder because the refiner was trained on that latent distribution.

model_name.tooltip: Place the official weight in ComfyUI/models/taehv or models/vae.

MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced.display_name: H3 Super: TAEHV Wide Loader / TAEHV宽模型加载 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolEngineTAEHVLoaderT8Advanced.description: Loads the taeltx2_3_wide codec used by NVIDIA's published H3 Super Stage 2. The architecture is selected explicitly; execution is never blocked by a filename, hash, or byte-size allowlist.

MiniMaxH3SolarAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SolarAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SolarAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Solar · 实际运行报告 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolarAuditEXPT8.description: after_sampling仅建立执行顺序。显示MODEL最近请求实际调用/音画时钟与静音替换、保留行数；不认证输入latent来源、已加载LoRA、成片质量或通用GPU收益。

silence_file.tooltip: models/solar下的文件名或明确选择的绝对路径；不自动下载。

seed.tooltip: 建议与RandomNoise连接同一seed；不改RandomNoise自身。

av_latent.tooltip: 可选：开启时提前检查实际AV形状和静音长度；关闭时不读取。

MiniMaxH3SolarSilenceSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SolarSilenceSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SolarSilenceSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 Solar · 静音采样作用域 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolarSilenceSetupEXPT8.description: 默认关闭，输入MODEL原样直通。开启时读取真实编码静音并委托现有采样作用域；不加载LoRA、不改sampler/步数/sigma、不生成最终原声。0或部分mask行保留原输入音频。

fps.tooltip: 当前结构时钟要求24fps；非24fps素材先显式转换。

first_frame_source_index.tooltip: -1表示坐标未声明；声明时须等于source_start，不检验视觉身份。

source_audio.tooltip: 与输入structure同一零点的完整原声；仅最终保存使用。

MiniMaxH3SolarStructureEncodeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SolarStructureEncodeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SolarStructureEncodeEXPT8.display_name: H3 Solar · 结构与原声区间 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SolarStructureEncodeEXPT8.description: 显式24fps结构重渲染。沿用已选CLIP/VAE，实际长度向下对齐17n+5；可选首帧是同一源时刻的外观参考。原声只精确切片供最终保存，不驱动采样。

latent.tooltip: Target AV latent from MiniMax H3 Reference to Video.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE. Used to encode the master-song slice into the target audio latent.

master_audio.tooltip: Full master song or master vocal audio. The node writes the exact requested slice into the H3 latent and protects it from denoising.

clip_start_seconds.tooltip: Start time of this raw clip within the master song timeline. For clip N, this usually advances by raw_clip_seconds - context_seconds from the previous clip.

context_length.tooltip: Optional preserved visual prefix from the previous clip. Uses exact H3 runs 5/22/39/56/...; 0 disables visual prefixing entirely.

source_fps.tooltip: FPS of source_frames when visual context is connected.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE. Required only for the legacy source_frames continuation path.

source_frames.tooltip: Legacy decoded-frame continuation path. Prefer source_latent for checkpoint-free live clip chaining.

source_latent.tooltip: Preferred live continuation input. Copies the previous H3 video latent tail directly into the new target while the master-song audio slice remains authoritative.

MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext.name: MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext
MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext.display_name: H3 Song Audio + Masked Video Context
MiniMaxH3SongMaskedAVContext.description: Write an exact master-song slice into the target H3 audio latent and protect the entire audio stream from denoising. For continuations, prefer a previous live H3 source_latent so the video tail is copied directly without decode/re-encode.

MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Sound Canvas / 声音画布 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SoundCanvasT8Advanced.description: Plans dialogue, music, ambience and SFX on one explicit timeline. The no-extra-speech guard preserves non-speech audio instead of trimming the master.

video_latent.tooltip: H3 video latent [B,24,T,H,W], or an existing H3 joint AV latent.

audio_latent.tooltip: H3 audio latent [B,32,2,T], or an H3 joint AV latent whose audio stream will be used.

video_denoise_strength.display_name: video denoise / 画面重绘强度
video_denoise_strength.tooltip: Used only by remix. No linear visual-strength claim is made before real A/B calibration.

audio_mode.tooltip: lock=preserve source latent; remix=use strength; regenerate=mask 1.

audio_denoise_strength.display_name: audio denoise / 音频重绘强度
audio_denoise_strength.tooltip: Used only by remix; regenerated or padded audio still requires perceptual validation.

audio_fit_policy.display_name: audio fit / 音频时钟对齐
audio_fit_policy.tooltip: strict never adjusts. trim/pad policies are explicit; a padded tail is zero latent with mask 1 so H3 may generate it. Every adjustment is reported.

dtype_device_policy.tooltip: match_video converts only the smaller audio stream; strict refuses a mismatch.

MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8
MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Source AV Prepare / 来源音画重绘准备 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceAVPrepareT8.description: Strictly assembles H3 video/audio latents, preserves metadata and masks, aligns the audio clock only under an explicit policy, and creates separate video/audio denoise masks. This is stream assembly, not temporal concat; denoise strength is experimental and is not claimed to be a linear redraw weight.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Source Audio · 全局切口与声音归属 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPlanEXPT8.description: 24fps全局PCM时钟，显式字词/呼吸保护、角色与实际声音参考编号。默认拒绝切断整句；不ASR/TTS、不替换Temporal Chunk或原音。

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE; used to decode regenerated source audio.

source_frames.tooltip: Source frames used to derive the exact final audio duration.

video_info.tooltip: Connect the source VHS video loader's video_info. The VHS audio socket must remain unconnected; this link identifies the selected source file safely.

regenerated_latent.tooltip: Sampler output from H3 Source Audio Regen Mask. Requested only in Regenerate with H3 mode.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPolicy.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPolicy
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioPolicy.description: Source-audio policy for AV Extensions. Keep mode reads the source file directly with ffmpeg; a genuinely missing audio stream becomes exact-duration silence. The VHS source loader audio output must stay unconnected. Regenerate mode decodes a soundtrack generated by H3 across the complete source clip.

source_frames.tooltip: Source video frames. The count is normalized to H3's 24 fps timeline before padding to an exact H3 run.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenLength.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenLength
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenLength.description: For full source-audio regeneration, converts the source duration to 24 fps and pads only the end to the next native H3 video-VAE length (5, 22, 39, ...).

latent.tooltip: Fresh H3 AV latent whose length is driven by H3 Source Audio Regen Length.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

source_frames.tooltip: The complete source video. All visual latent steps are protected; only audio is regenerated.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenMask.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenMask
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioRegenMask.description: Full-source H3 audio regeneration mask. The complete source video is encoded and protected with video mask 0 while the complete H3 audio stream keeps mask 1. H3 therefore regenerates soundtrack only, without changing source video pixels.

MiniMaxH3SourceAudioWindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceAudioWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioWindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Source Audio · 选窗 DRIVE / FINAL (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceAudioWindowEXPT8.description: DRIVE显式右补静音至合法5+17k帧；FINAL保留原PCM精确切片，视频解码后按keep_frames裁回。两路不同用途，声音参考仍经Reference Route单独接入。

MiniMaxH3SourceClockEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceClockEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SourceClockEXPT8.display_name: H3 Source · Decode + Clock / 同次解码时钟 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceClockEXPT8.description: Observe PTS at the actual native Core decode. Core owns crop/trim/rotation/RGB/audio. Strict CFR observation is bound to the emitted RGB/PCM; opaque providers keep their decoder and are unverified. Full frames are resident: not streaming or memory-safe.

MiniMaxH3SourceConformEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceConformEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SourceConformEXPT8.display_name: H3 Source · Conform Once / 一次同源准备 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceConformEXPT8.description: One legacy Source AV preparation: exact nearest frame indices, Lanczos resize, 17n+5 and 32k stereo rules retained. Complete immutable map binds actual RGB/PCM. No clock input means declared fps, not verified CFR. Missing source audio is reported generated silence.

MiniMaxH3SourceControlDeriveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceControlDeriveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SourceControlDeriveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Source · Derive Control / 控制来源绑定 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceControlDeriveEXPT8.description: Owned RGB channel-mean preprocessing or explicit per-frame manual MASK annotation. Connect full decoded source BEFORE Conform; no implicit mask broadcast. Annotation identity is not proof of correct object/occlusion. Unknown external preprocessors may connect directly to Map Control and run with unverified origin.

width.tooltip: 0 uses the Conform canvas. LOW/HIGH share indices, not geometry.

MiniMaxH3SourceControlMapEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceControlMapEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SourceControlMapEXPT8.display_name: H3 Source · Map Control / 共用帧映射 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceControlMapEXPT8.description: Reuse exact source indices without re-timing. RGB Lanczos and MASK nearest-exact use the chosen stage geometry. Equal shape/JSON alone never certifies origin. Reject stale own map/lineage; opaque external controls remain usable with unverified-origin report.

length.tooltip: Snapped up to H3's 17n+5 target grid.

source_audio.tooltip: Optional source soundtrack. Missing audio becomes reported stereo silence.

MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8.name: MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8
MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Source Media Window / 来源视频窗口 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SourceMediaWindowT8.description: Selects a 24fps, 17n+5 source window, resizes it to an H3 canvas, and creates an exactly timed 32kHz stereo audio window for the standard video/audio VAE encoders. The full IMAGE input is already resident; this is not streaming decode and does not claim a memory-safe long-video path.

MiniMaxH3SparkApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SparkApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SparkApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Spark 注意力·独立阶段（SM89）
MiniMaxH3SparkApplyEXPT8.description: MODEL→MODEL，LOW/HIGH各自接SIGMAS与阶段。保留已有block owner/未知hook/mask；无法组合处委托且报告未生效。真实kernel异常不回退。

MiniMaxH3SparkAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SparkAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SparkAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Spark 实际调用审计（采样后）
MiniMaxH3SparkAuditEXPT8.description: after_sampling接实际采样latent保证执行顺序。Sparse=0不算Spark通过，保留委托范围和真实异常；不自动认证画质或速度。

MiniMaxH3SparkPreflightEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3SparkPreflightEXPT8
MiniMaxH3SparkPreflightEXPT8.display_name: H3 Spark 后端预检（只读）
MiniMaxH3SparkPreflightEXPT8.description: 核官方v0.1.2来源SHA和SM89/cu130轮子。不会安装、采样或自动选模型；不授画质/提速资格。

rescale.tooltip: Must remain 0; shared AV global-std rescale is intentionally rejected.

MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Spatio-Temporal Guidance / 时空引导 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3SpatioTemporalGuidanceT8Advance.description: H3-specific skip-layer spatio-temporal guidance. It adds one perturbed joint AV forward at every active step and refuses block-replacement conflicts.

MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speaker Routing Audit / 多人对白路由预检 (Advanced/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeakerRoutingAuditT8Advanced.description: Compiles dialogue speakers to deterministic <Audio N> ordinals and abstains on missing/duplicate references, unstructured vocalizations or ambiguous same-gender descriptors. It never changes the dialogue plan.

MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech ADR Exact Fit / 配音精确时长 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechADRFitT8.description: Fits AUDIO to an exact sample count using refusal, pad/trim, or bounded phase-vocoder stretch. Exact duration is not a lip-sync claim.

MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Assemble / 语音时间线 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechAssembleT8.description: Assembles rendered turns on exact sample boundaries and emits actual audio-boundary timeline plus planned-text SRT/VTT.

render_seconds.tooltip: Explicit H3 render window. It is aligned to 17n+5 frames and is not inferred from text length.

MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Conditioning / 语音条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechConditioningT8.description: Builds native H3 audio-first conditioning without loading a model. Described voice uses T2VA; reference voice uses Ref2VA with a dark image.

MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Decode / 仅解码语音 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechDecodeT8.description: Decodes only the H3 audio latent. Conservative energy trim is optional and does not replace ASR or speaker verification.

MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Finalize & Release / 完成并释放 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechFinalizeT8.description: Passes AUDIO through, then requests the selected ComfyUI release policy. unload_all_models is global and is never described as H3-only.

error_release_policy.tooltip: unload_all_models is global. Current ComfyUI already does this for recognized CUDA OOM; the guard closes non-OOM/cancel gaps.

MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Abnormal-Exit Guard / 异常释放保护 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechGuardT8.description: Arms a prompt-lifecycle guard before speech conditioning. If OOM, cancellation, or another upstream exception prevents Finalize, the selected error release is requested.

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Accept / 接受语音分段 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormAcceptT8.description: Atomically stores one accepted chunk before advancing the manifest; safe to resume after a crash.

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormComposeT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormComposeT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormComposeT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Compose / 合成长文本 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormControlT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormControlT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormControlT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Control / 长文本控制 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Long Form Start/Resume / 长文本恢复 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechLongFormStartT8.description: Creates or resumes an atomic accepted-segment manifest. Render only next_index per prompt; this avoids retaining every long-form latent in one execution.

MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Performance Direction / 演绎控制 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechPerformanceT8.description: Adds emotion, pace, pitch, energy and nonverbal prompt direction. These model controls remain uncalibrated and are reported as such.

acting_direction.default: natural, emotionally connected, with clear diction

emotion_intensity.tooltip: Prompt strength only; this is not a calibrated acoustic control.

target_units.tooltip: Words for Latin text; characters for CJK text.

MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Plan / 语音规划 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechPlanT8.description: Separates spoken text from acting direction and performs language-aware chunking. It never guesses the render duration.

trim_mode.tooltip: New reference-voice workflows conservatively remove only low-energy H3 alignment padding. Existing workflows saved as none remain unchanged.

asr_model_directory.tooltip: Optional CPU faster-whisper CTranslate2 model directory. Required only when verify_mode is not off.

MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Studio / 一站式语音 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechStudioT8.description: Native ComfyUI speech graph: conditioning -> sampler -> audio-only decode -> explicit release. Stock res_multistep/simple is the initial quality baseline.

MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech VRAM Preflight / 显存预检 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechVRAMPreflightT8.description: Reports present whole-device free VRAM and DynamicVRAM configuration. It cannot predict sampler peak and never grants a memory_safe label.

asr_model_directory.tooltip: Absolute faster-whisper CTranslate2 directory, or a folder name under ComfyUI/models/TTS. Required only when verification is enabled.

speaker_model_directory.tooltip: Local WavLM X-Vector model directory. A voice_profile with a reference is also required when speaker checking is enabled.

min_speaker_similarity.tooltip: Dataset-dependent EXP threshold; report_cosine does not gate output.

peak_limit_dbfs.tooltip: Final attenuation-only peak protection; never boosts quiet speech.

MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8.name: MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8
MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Speech Verify & Align / ASR校验裁切 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3SpeechVerifyT8.description: Runs optional CPU faster-whisper verification. Exact-target mode removes Ref2VA lead-in only when the complete requested text is found in order.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · Apply to This Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVApplyEXPT8.description: Bind one stage after its Setup/Bind. Supports V2, Native Dual, explicit native, PDD, Manual Pass and RF without changing legacy EAV. Keeps the selected backend and authenticated Relay; does not silently replace VSA with Dense. Native V2 sparse FETA uses bounded extra video projections and the original kernel; CUDA qualification and sparse Relay bias remain pending. Foreign producers may bypass effects. Connect matching stage SIGMAS and AV latent and inspect the downstream audit.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · Actual Calls Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditEXPT8.description: Wire after the matching sampler. Reports actual absolute sigmas, FETA/Relay calls and incomplete producer coverage. No GPU-quality claim or persisted-cache authorization.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditPassThroughEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditPassThroughEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditPassThroughEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · Actual Calls Audit In-line (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVAuditPassThroughEXPT8.description: The same actual-call EAV audit, only as an in-line dependency of a single final output sink.

MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage EAV · External Config (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageEAVConfigEXPT8.description: Reusable immutable configuration. Connect only LOW, only HIGH, or separate configs to both. Progress is absolute 1-video_sigma; it is not reset at the stage boundary. disabled is exact bypass; tau=0 is not an off switch.

MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Result · Load Exact Frozen Artifact (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageLoadEXPT8.description: Explicitly selects a saved stage by relative manifest path and exact SHA. Never runs LOW or loads a model. Keeps x_sigma and denoised_output distinct. This freezes the selected prior result, not a claim that edited LOW settings still match. To rerun only HIGH, use saved LOW denoised_output at the existing learned upscale handoff.

MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Noise · External FreeNoise / Legacy Plan (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageNoiseEXPT8.description: Wraps one NOISE generation; no diffusion. Reuses original FreeNoise video permutation/blend, preserves source seed/batch_index and exact audio noise. Same segment_index for both passes reproduces old loops. from_model_plan reads the optional MODEL's old FreeNoise configuration. disabled or absent model plan is exact provider bypass; configuration report is not execution.

stage_role.tooltip: Only used without stage_context; does not change sampler math.

MiniMaxH3StageReuseEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageReuseEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageReuseEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage · Sample or Reuse / 采样或复用 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageReuseEXPT8.description: Opt-in verified reuse of a completed Stage. Checks actual MODEL, ordered LoRAs, conditions, source latent, seed, sigma and implementation. Unknown user stacks still execute. Reconnect to Decode/Save to retry delivery without resampling.

MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Sampler · ONE Stage + Result (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageSamplerEXPT8.description: Runs exactly one native SamplerCustomAdvanced call. The five native inputs and first two outputs are unchanged; adds typed stage evidence for optional saving. No loop, second pass, retry or automatic cache. Binds V2, Native Dual, explicit native, Manual Pass and RF adapters.

MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage Result · Save Frozen Artifact (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageSaveEXPT8.description: Writes a new immutable native AV artifact under output/MiniMaxH3/stage_artifacts. Outputs exact path and mandatory SHA for explicit restoration. Existing artifacts are never overwritten. Incomplete or unknown sampler execution is rejected before a completed artifact is written; inspect report_json.

MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8
MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8.display_name: H3 Stage · Independent UNET Load After Result (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3StageUNETLoaderAfterEXPT8.description: Wait for a verified completed stage, then independently load this stage's diffusion model through Core UNETLoader. Identical bare loader nodes may be deduplicated by Core; a MODEL clone still shares the live network. This node keeps HIGH MODEL/LoRA editable without hidden sampling, but may consume extra CPU/RAM/VRAM until the earlier model is released. Connect a frozen StageLoad result for HIGH-only resume.

start_mode.tooltip: Connect H3 Extension Start Mode. load_video = use the cropped source-video canvas; generate_starter = use the manual width/height below.

source_width.tooltip: Width from H3 Crop Source To /32. Requested only in load_video mode.

source_height.tooltip: Height from H3 Crop Source To /32. Requested only in load_video mode.

MiniMaxH3StartCanvasSelector.name: MiniMaxH3StartCanvasSelector
MiniMaxH3StartCanvasSelector.description: Choose one shared H3 generation canvas for the masked AV extension workflow. In load_video mode it reuses the cropped source-video size; in generate_starter mode it uses the manual starter width/height.

latent.tooltip: Fresh target AV latent for Extension 1.

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE; used for existing-video starts.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE; used for existing-video starts.

MiniMaxH3StartMaskedContext.name: MiniMaxH3StartMaskedContext
MiniMaxH3StartMaskedContext.description: Checkpoint-free Extension-1 start selector. Existing Video requests decoded source AV; T2V/I2V request the live generated starter latent.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

target_mode.tooltip: 1-frame is cheapest and most experimental; 22-frame is the next native 17n+5 grid point; 124-frame is the approximate trained-range baseline.

reference_strength.tooltip: 1 keeps reference latents clean; lower values add seeded reference noise.

edit_image.tooltip: Primary source image, presented to Ref2VA as <Picture 1>.

MiniMaxH3StillConditioningT8.name: MiniMaxH3StillConditioningT8
MiniMaxH3StillConditioningT8.description: Experimental Ref2VA single/multi-image semantic editing. Picture 1 is the primary edit source; this is not mask-based pixel editing.

MiniMaxH3StillDecodeT8.name: MiniMaxH3StillDecodeT8
MiniMaxH3StillDecodeT8.description: Decodes only the H3 video latent and selects one still candidate.

MiniMaxH3StillPreflightT8.name: MiniMaxH3StillPreflightT8
MiniMaxH3StillPreflightT8.description: Checks the experimental Ref2VA still-image contract before sampling.

input_count.tooltip: Number of extension latent sockets shown by the node. Set this value, then click Update inputs.

active_extensions.tooltip: Optional cap on extension sockets considered. Leave unconnected for modular/custom workflows.

MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS.name: MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS
MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS.display_name: H3 Stream AV Extensions to VHS
MiniMaxH3StreamLiveExtensionAVToVHS.description: Modular low-RAM AV Extension final output. Set Input Count and click Update inputs to expose as many extension latent sockets as needed. Disconnected sockets are skipped. Clips are decoded one at a time and streamed directly into VHS without materializing the full RGB movie.

input_count.tooltip: Number of clip latent sockets shown by the node. Set this value, then click Update inputs.

active_clips.tooltip: Optional cap on clip sockets considered. Leave unconnected for modular/custom workflows.

MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS.name: MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS
MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS.display_name: H3 Stream Final Music Video to VHS
MiniMaxH3StreamLiveMusicVideoToVHS.description: Modular low-RAM final Music Video output. Set Input Count and click Update inputs to expose clip latent sockets. Standalone workflows may leave trailing sockets disconnected; connected clips must remain a contiguous prefix because each clip belongs to a fixed master-song window. Clips are decoded one at a time and the untouched master song is muxed.

MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Studio Shot Select / 镜头选择 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3StudioShotSelectT8Advanced.description: Selects one planned shot and exposes prompt, length and seed for existing Conditioning/Sampler nodes. It does not queue or load anything by itself.

MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Studio Timeline / 创作时间轴 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3StudioTimelineT8Advanced.description: Compiles many shots into deterministic H3 17n+5 windows. Long visual-only shots can be split explicitly; long dialogue must be split by the author.

base_frames.tooltip: D0/base frames that own the background.

refined_frames.tooltip: T2/refined frames for the subject only.

subject_alpha.tooltip: Reviewed per-frame final alpha. Zero means exact D0 ownership.

accept_candidate.tooltip: False keeps selected output on D0. Enable only for a reviewed candidate.

mask_frame_policy.tooltip: Strict requires one alpha frame for every video frame.

protect_mask.tooltip: Optional face/text/identity protection; one removes T2 ownership.

audio.tooltip: D0/source audio is returned as the exact same object.

MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Subject-Safe RGB Composite / 人物安全RGB合成 (v8 Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3SubjectSafeRGBCompositeT8Advanc.description: Keeps the D0/base frame everywhere outside a reviewed per-frame subject alpha and blends the refined T2 candidate only inside that alpha. No automatic person, face, text, camera or quality decision is performed.

MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 TAEH3 Preview Capability / 快速预览能力 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TAEH3PreviewCapabilityT8Advance.description: Read-only inspection of ComfyUI's native TAEH3 progress-preview path and the installed models/vae_approx asset. It never changes preview settings or sampling.

checkpoint.tooltip: 下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Taeh3-Comfy；放models/vae_approx。taeh3.safetensors为时序版；2D另存taeh3_2d_kijai.safetensors，不覆盖时序版。

MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8.display_name: H3 一采动态预览＋安全取消（TAEH3 EXP/T8）
MiniMaxH3TAEH3SamplingPreviewEXPT8.description: MODEL串联到原采样器。预览实际x0的连续开头片段，仅近似观察运动，不是最终画质／声音。不会增加扩散步；有少量解码开销。LOW/HIGH来自实际阶段；普通采样标为未识别。取消仅作用于本面板绑定的请求，不清队列、不结束服务。缺少预览模型时原采样继续。模型下载：https://huggingface.co/t8star/Taeh3-Comfy；保留models/vae_approx目录。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 安装检查 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECheckEXPT8.description: 只检查独立运行文件是否齐全，不编译、不加载GPU，也不安装依赖。文件齐全不代表实际推理已验收。

kind.tooltip: 推荐flex解码；W4A16已审短片整体可接受，但量化差异更大，不承诺省显存或更快。

timeout_seconds.tooltip: 单次编译时间上限。编译需要至少12000MiB空闲显存和24GiB空闲内存。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 本机编译 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAECompileEXPT8.description: 只在准备引擎时运行。独立子进程串行编译，不改已有引擎，不下载或安装依赖；取消只结束本次子进程。

native_video_vae.tooltip: 原版H3视频VAE；不选择音频VAE。编码保持原生时仍需这份权重。

decoder_engine.tooltip: 本机编译的解码引擎；单帧或小尺寸需要flex引擎。

cpu_output_budget_mib.tooltip: 解码后的CPU像素缓冲上限，不是显存上限。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 解码加速 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEDecoderEXPT8.description: 推荐先用此模式：只替换视频解码，图片/参考视频编码保持原生。连接到原来video_vae的位置，音频VAE不变。

native_video_vae.tooltip: 原版H3视频VAE；不选择音频VAE。编码保持原生时仍需这份权重。

decoder_engine.tooltip: 本机编译的解码引擎；单帧或小尺寸需要flex引擎。

cpu_output_budget_mib.tooltip: 解码后的CPU像素缓冲上限，不是显存上限。

image_encoder_engine.tooltip: 选择T1单帧编码引擎，不把单图补成17帧。

video_encoder_engine.tooltip: 选择T17视频编码引擎；内部自动分块。

MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TRT VAE 编码＋解码 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TRTVAEFullEXPT8.description: 可选完整模式：参考图/视频编码也用TRT，编码差异可能影响后续采样。单图未体现提速，默认建议只加速解码。

sigmas.tooltip: 完整原生视频sigma表；HIGH只使用其对应区间，不能传只有后4步的表冒充完整8步。

mode.tooltip: disabled不安装补丁；report_only测量不改Query；apply_exp实际修正。

tau.tooltip: 修正强度；0仍计算诊断。增大不等于更清晰，需固定素材对照。

max_workspace_mib.tooltip: 显式临时tensor预算，超过会拒绝；不是整卡显存上限或无OOM保证。

MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 TST Temporal Query / 时序Query修正 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TSTModelEXPT8.description: 独立MODEL补丁。接在LoRA、后端、Relay/EAV配置之后。原生Euler、CFG1；完整SIGMAS必须与采样器一致。不是画质保证，未完成完整权重成片验收。帧均值代理的有符号Query修正，非作者代码当前的输出增益算法。LOW/HIGH可分别配置；HIGH沿用完整时间表的位置，不从0计时。

MiniMaxH3TakeSidecarEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TakeSidecarEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TakeSidecarEXPT8.display_name: H3 作品溯源侧车·私有／分享副本
MiniMaxH3TakeSidecarEXPT8.description: 绑定真实成片／原生工作流SHA与显式原声／生成声／后期声。分享副本不含本机路径、文件名或原始metadata。不重新编码、不替换音轨、不自动上传或人审；确认后create-only保存两个独立JSON。

MiniMaxH3TaoMateHDEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TaoMateHDEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TaoMateHDEXPT8.description: Teacher-coupled progressive generation. Load TaoMate-HD LoRA with the existing loader. At CFG=1, 3 solver evaluations use 2 LOW + 1 HIGH. CFG>1 can call the MODEL more often; the report separates solver evaluations and observed MODEL calls. Larger counts are experimental subdivisions. No streaming or eight-GPU acceleration claim; MODEL and LoRAs remain user-selected.

MiniMaxH3TemporalCompletedAudioEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalCompletedAudioEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalCompletedAudioEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Verified Completed LOW Audio Passthrough (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalCompletedAudioEXPT8.description: Explicit opt-in delivery for already completed native audio and existing preserve/video-only HIGH. Actual completion receipt + terminal zero required; partial4 is rejected, not frozen. Does not sample HIGH, certify voice quality or fix mouth motion.

frame_chunk_size.tooltip: Processes frames with a one-frame temporal halo to bound temporary memory.

maximum_output_megapixels.tooltip: Fail-closed output pixel budget; this does not include the input tensor.

MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Temporal Detail Enhance / 时序保护细节增强 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TemporalDetailEnhanceT8Advanced.description: Motion-gated luma detail enhancement with optional multiple-of-32 bicubic upscaling. It reduces sharpening in moving regions to limit flicker, does not touch audio, and cannot reconstruct missing faces or geometry.

MiniMaxH3TemporalDialoguePlanEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalDialoguePlanEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalDialoguePlanEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Global + Speech + Performance Plan (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalDialoguePlanEXPT8.description: Explicit dialogue events: event_id, speaker, utterance, start_seconds, end_seconds. Performance events: event_id, cue, start_seconds, end_seconds. Global/Performance must not contain repeated speech commands. No guessing or automatic deletion of free-text dialogue.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundlePrepareEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundlePrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundlePrepareEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Prepare Literal Bundle / ALL Piece Lifts (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundlePrepareEXPT8.description: Optional literal restart preparation. Original per-piece learned lift, native values once. No HIGH sampling. Foreign live-only metadata uses ordinary Full instead.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundleWindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundleWindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundleWindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Select Literal Piece / NO Earlier Work (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16BundleWindowEXPT8.description: Exact piece, stored original lift, global AV noise context and native bank. No sampling/encoding/lift.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 External Scoped EAV / Relay Pair (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsApplyEXPT8.description: Independent effect configs bound to actual scoped H16 audio/video prefix. Relay native spans and local layout rebuilt; zero/single event bypass, finite bias is not hard isolation.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16EffectsAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Audit Actual Scoped Effects (T8 EXP)

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16JointPass2EXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16JointPass2EXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16JointPass2EXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Integrated Scoped PASS2 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16JointPass2EXPT8.description: Convenience loop over the same separated scoped H16 windows and external configs. One global AV noise preparation, original per-segment learned lifts. Old H16 remains unchanged.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Load Whole Capsule / ONLY Remaining Windows (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeLoadEXPT8.description: Literal CPU restore. Select index+1 with Bundle Window; no LOW/CLIP/media encoding/learned lift/noise regeneration/earlier HIGH. Reconnect original HIGH MODEL/sampler/seed/SIGMAS.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Freeze Whole Literal Restart Capsule (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16ResumeSaveEXPT8.description: Independent H16 format, explicit saved prefix plus all native source/conditions/noise/piece lifts. Not old crossfade cache, MODEL identity certification or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 One Refined AV Window / Real Prefix (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowEXPT8.description: Explicit new H16 EXP: accepted AV prefix read-only, exact append, original unsampled audio padding retained. No old post-loop crossfade/energy gate. Old H16 defaults remain unchanged.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Load Explicit Scoped AV Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowLoadEXPT8.description: Literal selected prefix, no earlier sampling. Exact new-contract manifest SHA and current source/noise/lift/native conditions required. Not an automatic MODEL/provider-equivalence claim.

MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · H16 Freeze Exact Scoped AV Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalH16WindowSaveEXPT8.description: Separate new format binds real accepted audio, native bank, source, lift, global noise, policy and implementation. Old H16 refined crossfade caches cannot become new prefix receipts.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

audio_mode.tooltip: lock_source preserves source latent; remix_source denoises it; reference_only/native generate target audio.

add_source_as_reference.tooltip: Presents drive_audio to Qwen/DiT as an official <Audio N> reference.

prompt_primary_audio_ordinal.tooltip: Prompt audio ordinal intended as the primary source; remapped after video soundtracks. Use 0 to disable.

final_audio.tooltip: Optional clean/stem track passed through for final mux; defaults to drive_audio.

allow_above_reference_area.tooltip: Legacy workflow compatibility input. Canvases above the 1920x1088 reference area are now allowed regardless of this value and only emit a VRAM/runtime warning.

MiniMaxH3TemporalNativeRecipeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalNativeRecipeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalNativeRecipeEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Native HIGH Media Recipe (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalNativeRecipeEXPT8.description: The original native media builder plus an explicit live text recipe. Use the actual HIGH dimensions and full source length. Window Bank re-encodes text before HIGH; media VAEs are not rerun per window. Old Conditioning is unchanged.

MiniMaxH3TemporalRelayConfigEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalRelayConfigEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalRelayConfigEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · External Relay Config (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalRelayConfigEXPT8.description: Optional finite timing bias, not hard audio isolation; zero/single-event windows bypass.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5JointPass2EXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5JointPass2EXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5JointPass2EXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Integrated Joint PASS2 (same separated windows) (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5JointPass2EXPT8.description: Global learned lift/noise once, the same scoped joint windows in sequence. External EAV and Relay remain optional config inputs. Does not change the old integrated node/default.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · External Native Scoped Relay Pair (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayApplyEXPT8.description: Fresh native prepared char/token spans and actual local AV layout; clock projected once. Connect the paired MODEL+positive to the matching scoped Window; never reuse full-text Relay.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5RelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Audit Scoped Relay / Explicit Bypass (T8 EXP)

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Load Literal V5 Capsule / NO Earlier Work (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeLoadEXPT8.description: Loads exact selected inert values on CPU. No LOW sampling, CLIP encoding, VAE media encode, learned lift or noise regeneration. Connect the original HIGH noise seed/sampler/refine sigmas and matching MODEL, then only window index+1. Not automatic reuse or quality approval.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Freeze Literal V5 Restart Capsule (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5ResumeSaveEXPT8.description: Explicit whole restart capsule: actual partial4, learned lift, global noise, all native window conditions and accepted AV prefix. No MODEL/CLIP/callback pickle or provider certification.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · One Joint AV Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowEXPT8.description: Partial4 audio remains editable. The actual accepted audio/video prefix is protected. Optional positive must be this native scoped condition, optionally paired by Scoped Relay. base_window_result connects to the unchanged external v5 EAV/Audit nodes.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowLoadEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowLoadEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowLoadEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Load Explicit Scoped Window (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowLoadEXPT8.description: Reconstruct current native bank; exact source/lift/noise/policy/content checks. Old unscoped caches cannot serve as new accepted-dialogue receipts.

MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowSaveEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowSaveEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowSaveEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Freeze Scoped Window + Audio Receipt (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalV5WindowSaveEXPT8.description: Independent sidecar; old v5 cache reader/source pins remain intact. Copy both explicit scope.json path and SHA. Not automatic reuse or provider/quality certification.

MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowBankEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowBankEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowBankEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Precompile ALL Native Window Text (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowBankEXPT8.description: Select speech on real writable intervals from window 0; retain visual performance on render intervals. All CLIP encodes happen here, not between HIGH windows.

MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TemporalWindowConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 Temporal Dialogue · Select One Scoped CONDITIONING (T8 EXP)

tile_width.tooltip: Tile width in pixels, rounded down to 32. The default is the model's widest native canvas.

tile_height.tooltip: Tile height in pixels, rounded down to 32. The default is the model's native short edge.

tile_overlap.tooltip: Overlap between neighbouring tiles in pixels. More overlap hides tile seams and costs more tiles.

MiniMaxH3TiledSampler.name: MiniMaxH3TiledSampler
MiniMaxH3TiledSampler.description: Denoise a MiniMax H3 AV latent in overlapping spatial tiles. Each tile is a full pass over a crop of the video stream, keeping a canvas larger than 768x1344 inside the model's native field of view and tying peak VRAM to the tile size instead of the canvas. Audio, text, keyframes and references ride along in every tile.

tail_lock_start_seconds.tooltip: Connect a verified speech_end_seconds or an explicit planned boundary. It is quantized upward to the H3 40Hz audio-latent grid.

tail_denoise_strength.tooltip: Use 0 to request an unchanged background-bed latent endpoint.

transition_seconds.tooltip: Default 0 makes the lock boundary explicit. A nonzero transition delays the fully locked tail and is reported, not assumed perceptually safer.

audio_latent_fit_policy.tooltip: Strict rejects a duration mismatch. fit_reported explicitly trims or zero-pads the encoded latent and records the action.

MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8.name: MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8
MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Timed Background Bed Lock / 分时背景底轨锁定 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TimedAudioBedLockT8.description: Two-pass H3 helper: encodes an independent full-duration music/ambience/SFX bed into the AV latent and locks its tail after an explicit dialogue boundary. It preserves the video stream and does not separate speech from a mixed master.

MiniMaxH3TimedImageReferenceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TimedImageReferenceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TimedImageReferenceT8Advanced.description: Adds one Qwen-only semantic image at an exact target time. Chain on the H3 CLIP line and use #prompt_tag in core Ref2VA. It is not VAE-encoded, does not enter minimax_refs and consumes no native slot.

MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Timed Video Reference (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TimedVideoReferenceT8Advanced.description: Presents selected video frames to Qwen at their generated-timeline times. This is semantic-only conditioning: no native H3 reference slot, VAE latent or audio is added.

generation_seconds.tooltip: Generation duration, synchronized both ways with the cyan timeline range.

output_tooltips: Mix trimmed source audio by timeline position, preserving silence in gaps.
Concatenate standalone reference audio in material-bin order.
MiniMaxH3TimelineDirector.name: MiniMaxH3TimelineDirector
MiniMaxH3TimelineDirector.description: Assemble H3 references on an editable timeline. Overlapping video can use native Add Guide, editable reference, or boundary-only mode; gaps automatically anchor their boundary frames.

output_tooltips: Mix trimmed source audio by timeline position, preserving silence in gaps.
Concatenate standalone reference audio in material-bin order.
MiniMaxH3TimelineEncoder.name: MiniMaxH3TimelineEncoder
MiniMaxH3TimelineEncoder.description: Encode a material plan and final H3 prompt into references, native Guides, conditioning, and AV latent.

generation_seconds.tooltip: Generation duration, synchronized both ways with the cyan timeline range.

import_preset.tooltip: Optional local preset loaded by MiniMax H3 Local Preset Loader.

prompt_index.tooltip: Optional. Connect a segment prompt index to output only the images and standalone audio assigned to that segment. Leave disconnected to use all materials.

MiniMaxH3TimelinePlanner.name: MiniMaxH3TimelinePlanner
MiniMaxH3TimelinePlanner.description: Edit a timeline and output a lightweight material plan. The plan may feed a prompt rewriter before the rewritten prompt and same plan enter the H3 Plan Encoder, avoiding cycles.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE used for the pixel re-encode anchor at the resolution transition.

latent_image.tooltip: Target-resolution H3 AV latent defining size and duration. Existing latent content and noise masks are accepted.

sampler.tooltip: Standard Euler only; SelfLift reuses its transition-step prediction to keep the original NFE count.

transition_step.tooltip: Number of low-resolution denoiser evaluations. The paper uses 6 of 8 NFEs for its 8-step image model; H3 requires independent validation.

lowres_scale.tooltip: Spatial scale of the low-resolution prefix (paper: 0.5).

rho.tooltip: Fraction of highest-risk spatiotemporal locations corrected toward the pixel-VAE anchor. The H3 default 0 uses only the external latent upscaler and skips the VAE round trip. For SelfLift-zero with upscaler_model=none, start near 0.6.

w_min.tooltip: Correction-strength floor. H3's widespread nearest-lift error can require 1.0; 0.5 is the paper's image-model setting.

w_max.tooltip: Correction-strength ceiling. Keep at 1.0 for the H3 SelfLift-zero diagnostic.

upscaler_model.tooltip: External H3 latent upscaler (models/latent_upscale_models). The first detected H3 model is selected by default; 'none' uses nearest-neighbor lifting.

model_hires.tooltip: Optional: model used for the high-resolution stage instead of `model` (e.g. a different checkpoint or LoRA stack). Must share the same architecture and latent format. The low-resolution prefix always runs on `model`.

highres_tiling.tooltip: Experimental: select 1–8 spatial tiles from available memory at high-resolution preparation. Audio input and references remain complete; only the first tile's audio prediction is retained. Quality and speed may change.

MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 LoRA · 生成音频/视频行作用域
MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAApplyEXPT8.description: MODEL独立外置。仅支持完整plain LoRA的实际token层；generated模式不直接修改text/条件/参考行，但共享attention仍可能影响另一模态。fc2保留原生融合并在MLP输出补残差。不支持目标明确报错，不静默加载半份；未知owner保留并报告未生效。旧loader不改。

MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 LoRA · 实际行作用域审计（采样后）
MiniMaxH3TokenLoRAAuditEXPT8.description: MODEL接上游作用域节点，after_sampling接实际采样LATENT保证顺序。报告实际层调用、委托和清理，原样返回LATENT；不是全轨迹完成证明或画质/声纹认证。

overlap.tooltip: Number of keyframe frames: last `overlap` of source vs first `overlap` of target. Must equal the keyframe count used for generation (48 = 2s @ 24fps), NOT the whole segment.

install_directory.tooltip: 正式 Topaz Video 程序目录，不是模型目录。

model_definitions_directory.tooltip: 正式安装对应的 models JSON 定义目录。

model_data_directory.tooltip: 正式 Topaz 配置的模型数据目录，可能与定义目录不同。

MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8.display_name: Official Topaz · 环境检查 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TopazEnvironmentEXPT8.description: 检查正式安装、签名、滤镜，并在报告中列出模型ID、各倍率候选权重与可用参数。文件存在不代表能运行。不会安装、下载或运行增强；星光需独立官方 Neuroserver 与有效权限。

model_id.tooltip: apo-8 Apollo：高质量通用，适合非线性运动；apf-2 Apollo Fast：速度优先；chr-2 Chronos：通用高质量变帧率；chf-3 Chronos Fast：速度优先；aion-1 Aion：新版通用插帧。请先在正式Topaz软件内下载对应模型。

duplicate_threshold.tooltip: 0或负值关闭重复帧检测；过高可能误删正常静止帧。一般保持0.01。

output_directory.tooltip: 留空写入ComfyUI/output/MiniMaxH3-Topaz；也可填写其他本地盘。

custom_model_id.tooltip: 仅用于列表未收录的正式插帧模型ID；填写后覆盖model_id。

output_profile.display_name: 高级输出策略（普通用户保持默认）
output_profile.tooltip: 默认delivery_h264自动接收常见8/10/16-bit SDR并统一输出8-bit H.264，无需按原片位深选择。Main10仅供明确需要保持10-bit的高级用户。HDR仍需先转为SDR。

gpu_device_index.tooltip: 单卡保持0；多卡选择Topaz使用的GPU。

MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8.display_name: Official Topaz · 视频插帧 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TopazFrameInterpolationEXPT8.description: 独立正式tvai_fi插帧：2x/4x提高帧率但保持时长和尺寸；默认自动接收常见SDR位深并保存高质量8-bit H.264 MP4，非兼容音轨自动转AAC。不是慢动作，不与高清模型混用，不需要保持Topaz软件开启。

model_id.tooltip: iris-3 Iris：真人脸、低清人像；prob-4 Proteus：通用且参数最全；rhea-1 Rhea：中等质量细节恢复；nyx-3/nxf-1/nxl-1 Nyx：强降噪；ahq-12/amq-13/alq-13 Artemis：分别用于高/中/低质量素材；thf-4 Theia Fidelity：偏忠实；thd-3 Theia Detail：偏细节；ghq-5 Gaia HQ：高质量实拍/CG；gcg-5 Gaia CG：CG、锯齿和摩尔纹；ganim-1 Gaia Animation：动画。当前正式定义中Gaia Animation通常仅2x、Nyx Fast/XL仅1x、Nyx通常为1x/2x；其他常用模型通常有1x/2x/4x。不同安装版本以环境报告为准，不存在的倍率不是漏下载。

scale.tooltip: 不改变帧率；需在正式 Topaz 中准备对应倍率的权重。

vram_fraction.tooltip: Topaz可使用的显存比例，不是启动门槛。默认0.80；显存紧张可试0.60。

parameters_json.tooltip: 仅供精确覆盖独立控件或未来参数；普通用户不要填写。

size_mode.tooltip: scale 使用上方倍率。target_dimensions 使用下方宽高，忽略倍率；需保持原比例、1至4倍，不裁剪或拉伸。

target_width.tooltip: 仅自定义尺寸模式生效；填写32至8192之间的偶数。

target_height.tooltip: 仅自定义尺寸模式生效；宽高须同时填写并保持原视频比例。

output_directory.tooltip: 可选母版输出目录。留空写入ComfyUI/output/MiniMaxH3-Topaz；磁盘不足时可填写另一个本地目录。

custom_model_id.tooltip: 仅用于列表中尚未收录的新正式模型ID；填写后覆盖model_id。

output_profile.display_name: 高级输出策略（普通用户保持默认）
output_profile.tooltip: 默认delivery_h264自动接收常见8/10/16-bit SDR并统一输出8-bit H.264，无需按原片位深选择。Main10和lossless_master只供明确需要保留位深或审计的高级用户。HDR仍需先转为SDR。节点已直接保存，不要再接SaveVideo。

parameter_mode.tooltip: model_defaults使用模型默认；auto_estimate让Topaz抽帧估计；manual使用下方独立参数。

auto_estimate_frames.tooltip: 仅auto_estimate生效；默认8较稳定，复杂长片可试12至20，越多启动越慢。

preblur.tooltip: 负值偏抗锯齿/摩尔纹，正值偏去模糊；例如-0.20或+0.20。仅manual生效。

noise.tooltip: 例如0.20轻度、0.45中度；过高会蜡化皮肤。仅manual生效。

details.tooltip: 例如0.25自然、0.50较强；过高可能生成假纹理。仅manual生效。

halo.tooltip: 例如0.20轻度、0.50用于明显边缘光晕；过高会损失边缘。仅manual生效。

sharpen.tooltip: 内部映射Topaz blur参数；例如0.15轻锐、0.35较锐。仅manual生效。

compression.tooltip: 例如0.25轻度网压、0.55明显块效应。仅manual生效。

add_noise.tooltip: 默认0；例如0.01可帮助过度平滑素材保留纹理。仅manual生效。

grain.tooltip: 默认0；例如0.10轻颗粒、0.20明显胶片感。仅manual生效。

grain_size.tooltip: 仅输出颗粒大于0时有意义；1.0细颗粒，2.0较粗。

keep_color.tooltip: 默认true；关闭只建议用于色彩对比测试。

input_blend.tooltip: 0=完全增强，1=完全原片；0.10至0.20可减弱过度锐化或蜡感。

engine_instances.tooltip: 0最稳。1在本机60帧仅由11.5秒降到10.5秒，收益小但占用更多显存；16GB卡不建议更高。

gpu_device_index.tooltip: 单卡保持0；多卡时选择正式Topaz所使用的GPU序号。

MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8.display_name: Official Topaz · 视频高清增强 (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3TopazVideoEXPT8.description: 正式tvai_up高清增强；默认自动接收常见8/10/16-bit SDR并统一输出高质量8-bit H.264 MP4。兼容音轨直接保留，其他音轨自动转AAC；无需用户选择格式或再接“保存视频”。不插帧、不自动下载；Topaz软件无需保持打开。

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Checkpoint Load / 轨迹续跑 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointLoadT8Advan.description: Loads an internal-x_sigma checkpoint produced through Trajectory Probe trajectory_model. Connect checkpoint_latent, remaining_sigmas, resume_noise, and the same trajectory_model to the second SamplerCustomAdvanced stage.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advan.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advan.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Checkpoint Save / 轨迹保存 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryCheckpointSaveT8Advan.description: Atomically saves the first-stage sampled AV latent only after explicit confirmation. The checkpoint stays inside the ComfyUI output directory.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Control Plan / 轨迹控制规划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds normalized multi-object bbox trajectories from explicit keyframes. This is TrailBlazer-inspired creator interaction for H3 control-video conditioning, not a claim of reproducing TrailBlazer's U-Net attention edits.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanc.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanc.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Control Render / 轨迹控制视频 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryControlRenderT8Advanc.description: Renders the plan as a soft region, box path or reference sprite IMAGE batch for the existing H3 Fun Control Apply node. It creates no audio and owns no H3 attention.

MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Trajectory Probe / 采样轨迹探针 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TrajectoryProbeT8Advanced.description: Splits only the stateless T8 dual_clock_euler sigma schedule and binds the checkpoint contract to the exact same-session MODEL/SAMPLER identity. It does not sample or write files.

low_vram.tooltip: OFF (default): apply the LoRA at run time (bypass) — sharpest, but costs extra peak VRAM. ON: merge the LoRA into the weights — lowest VRAM so small GPUs can run, but softer on quantized bases (the delta is partly rounded away). Turn ON only if you OOM.

MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA.name: MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA
MiniMaxH3TurboLoRA.description: Apply the MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA to the H3 diffusion model.

model.tooltip: Connect the Dual-Clock MODEL, optionally through the complete KJNodes MiniMax H3 Sage patch. Do not connect an external LoRA.

sigmas.tooltip: Connect SIGMAS from the same Dual-Clock node. Consumer Turbo8 requires 8/12/3; SLA exact requires 4/6/3. A mismatch fails before sampling instead of producing a misleading collapsed video.

turbo_lora_name.tooltip: Regular Turbo LoRA for the recommended 8-step route. File identity, metadata and structure are reported only and never block loading.

sla_lora_name.tooltip: LightX2V SLA LoRA used only by the upstream-exact SLA profile. Alternate files are passed to the real loader without an identity gate.

profile.tooltip: consumer_turbo8_recommended: corrected regular Turbo LoRA, 8/12/3, dense or authenticated KJ Sage attention. sla_4step_upstream_exact_exp: SLA LoRA, 4/6/3, exact released 85% sparse experiment; base-family matching is diagnostic only. sla_4step_int8_bypass_exp: 4/6/3 INT8 ConvRot research route using dynamic model-only LoRA bypass to avoid base re-quantization. disabled_identity: no LoRA or attention change.

base_policy.tooltip: Records whether the base resembles the published BF16/FP8 evidence. Unknown, quantized and INT8 bases still pass through to real execution.

max_router_workspace_mib.tooltip: Fail-closed SLA router workspace ceiling. It affects only the SLA profile and is not a whole-workflow VRAM limit.

sla_start_percent.tooltip: INT8 bypass only: begin SLA sparse attention at this ComfyUI denoising progress. Default 0.15 keeps the first 4-step model forward dense. Other profiles ignore this range.

sla_end_percent.tooltip: INT8 bypass only: stop SLA sparse attention after this denoising progress. With 4 NFE, 0.15-0.90 maps to dense/sparse/sparse/sparse because model calls begin at 0%, 25%, 50% and 75%.

MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Turbo / SLA Profile Router (Advanced EXP)
MiniMaxH3TurboSLAProfileRouterT8Advanced.description: Separates the project-validated consumer Turbo8 route from the exact LightX2V SLA experiment. Consumer Turbo8 loads the corrected Alpha8 bypass LoRA and requires 8 NFE with video/audio shift 12/3. SLA exact loads the selected SLA LoRA and requires the published 4 NFE with shift 6/3. The released evidence used BF16/FP8, but other selected base families are reported rather than blocked. It never silently runs an SLA LoRA as a dense Turbo fallback. The explicit INT8 bypass experiment keeps the quantized base untouched and applies the SLA residual dynamically; it is not a validated quality preset.

MiniMaxH3TurboSampler.name: MiniMaxH3TurboSampler
MiniMaxH3TurboSampler.description: 4-step sampler for the MiniMax-H3 Turbo LoRA. Feed into SamplerCustomAdvanced and set the scheduler to 4 steps. Auto-adapts to the ComfyUI version: on recent builds that handle the audio schedule natively (ModelSamplingAV) it steps as a plain single-schedule sampler; on older builds it steps video and audio on their separate clocks.

second_pass_input.tooltip: Connect the Reconcile AV latent that enters pass 2.

fail_on_locked_mismatch.tooltip: At strength 0, stop the workflow if audio differs after pass 2.

locked_atol.tooltip: Maximum sampler roundoff allowed before failure. After the check, locked audio is replaced by the exact pass-2 input latent.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Audio Audit / H3二采音频硬校验 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioAuditT8Advanced.description: Compares the audio latent immediately before and after pass 2. In the explicit strength-0 lock route it allows only bounded floating-point roundoff, then restores the exact input audio before decode. Larger changes fail closed, preventing a mechanically valid but sonically rewritten result from being saved. Do not insert this node into the native author-parity route: native pass 2 must complete audio as well as video.

coarse_sampler.tooltip: Connect LOW's T8 Dual-Clock sampler to normalize its exported partial audio. Native FLOW_AV/Euler needs no correction.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioContinueEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioContinueEXPT8
MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioContinueEXPT8.display_name: H3 Two-Pass Audio / 双采声音连续续采 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassAudioContinueEXPT8.description: Explicit opt-in: use LOW sampler output socket0 (not denoised_output) for unfinished audio; retain HIGH visual latent and selected visual noise. No new initial audio noise or extra audio freeze/steps; sampler-internal random noise is unchanged. LOW/HIGH sigma boundary and audio clocks must match. Existing workflows remain unchanged. Not a quality guarantee.

refine_sigmas.tooltip: Connect refine_sigmas from MiniMax H3 Learned Two-Pass Parity Plan.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Detail Mixer / 二采混合细节设置 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassDetailMixerT8Advanced.description: Applies Tail subdivision, Model-Time Bias, H3 STG and joint AV RF Restart to an existing partial high-resolution refine schedule without replacing it with a new full trajectory. Use only after learned latent upscale/reconcile. Temporal Detail remains after AV Decode.

audio_policy.tooltip: auto keeps the high-resolution template audio for lock/remix masks, otherwise it continues the first-pass audio.

second_pass_audio_source.tooltip: legacy_policy preserves old saved-workflow behavior. first_pass is the explicit audio-lock route: reuse pass-1 audio while pass 2 refines video. For native author-parity generation, keep legacy_policy so pass 2 can finish the joint audio trajectory.

second_pass_audio_strength.tooltip: Pass-2 audio denoise only for an explicit non-legacy source. Use 0 to lock the selected audio exactly; values above 0 deliberately regenerate it and remain experimental.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advance.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advance.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Latent Reconcile / H3二采潜空间协调 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassLatentReconcileT8Advance.description: Combines learned-upscaled first-pass values with a newly rebuilt high-resolution H3 Conditioning template. It fails closed on stale low-resolution keyframes, reference metadata mismatches, audio-clock mismatches, or NaN.

model.tooltip: Connect the MODEL output of MiniMax H3 Dual-Clock Sampler so the actual video/audio shifts are available.

MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Two-Pass Sigma Plan / H3二采Sigma计划 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3TwoPassSigmaPlanT8Advanced.description: Splits one native H3 rectified-flow trajectory in base-flow time, then maps both halves with the actual video/audio shifts carried by MODEL. Default 4+4 keeps eight total joint AV Transformer calls.

MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 Unified Cast / 统一角色表 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3UnifiedCastT8Advanced.description: Builds one validated character-continuity contract for video prompts. It stores text metadata only and does not load a face, voice, or vision model.

vae_name.tooltip: VAE completo do H3 (com encoder). Para o checkpoint decoder-only do autor, use o outro node.

tiling.tooltip: Tiling espacial. MANTENHA LIGADO acima de ~768px: o curriculo do autor parou em 1024 e a imagem inteira acima disso produz grade na fronteira de 32px.

tile_size.tooltip: 512 e o otimo MEDIDO: numa imagem 1056x640, PSNR 26.00 dB / costura 0.91, contra 22.17/1.49 com 256 (o default do ComfyUI) e 21.35/2.42 com 1024. O autor treinou 475k das 500k imagens em <=512px.

MiniMaxH3VDNExecutionPlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNExecutionPlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNExecutionPlanT8Advanced.description: Builds the exact OpenVDN sampling contract from the connected MODEL: DMD uses 8 NFE, Stage B uses 50 NFE, both use native AV Euler and video/audio shifts 12/3. No user-overridable mismatched step count.

allow_structural_base.tooltip: Required for the current local INT8/ConvRot H3 base. This records an explicit unproven-base exception; it does not relabel it exact.

MiniMaxH3VDNModelComposerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNModelComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNModelComposerT8Advanced.description: Clones a clean native H3 MODEL, applies the pinned OpenVDN default/turbo adapters, and attaches the 50-layer VDN branch through Comfy ModelPatcher. Supports native H3 text, first/last-frame, image/video/audio-reference and hybrid PackedLayouts while rejecting every competing attention owner. Users must review the MiniMax H3 Community License before running the weights.

MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 VDN Two-Pass Refine / VDN二采 (Advanced EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VDNRefinePlanT8Advanced.description: Restart VDN on its own stage sigma grid after a completed first pass and learned video latent upscale. Rebuild high-resolution Conditioning and reconcile audio first. Connect fresh RandomNoise; do not add another Turbo LoRA. Quality is experimental.

MiniMaxH3VDNRelayApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRelayApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VDNRelayApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 VDN · External Prompt Relay Apply (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3VDNRelayApplyEXPT8.description: Paired Relay Conditioning -> VDN Stage -> this node -> optional Stage EAV. Adds real temporal bias to original VDN window keys and beta-weighted nonlinear text seeds to the original linear scan. Explicit experimental VDN extension, not paper-softmax or trained quality equivalence. Independent stage config, no extra diffusion NFE or dense fallback. Workspace is adapter working-set estimate, not total VRAM. Unsupported kernels fail normally.

MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 VDN · External Prompt Relay Audit (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3VDNRelayAuditEXPT8.description: Wire after this stage's sampler/save. Reports real window/linear calls and coverage, not just the presence of a Relay plan. Unknown bypassed producers remain unverified.

allow_structural_base.tooltip: Explicit provenance exception for a structurally matching Comfy H3 base whose exact official BF16 revision is unavailable.

MiniMaxH3VDNRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VDNRuntimeAuditT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VDNRuntimeAuditT8Advanced.description: Read-only audit for the pinned OpenVDN MiniMax H3 branch and adapters. Checks exact asset identity, native H3 structure, attention ownership and the explicit structural-base exception without loading the 4.28GB branch. The report also exposes the separately governed weight-license boundary.

MiniMaxH3VDNStageSetupEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VDNStageSetupEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VDNStageSetupEXPT8.display_name: H3 VDN · Complete / Own-Grid Tail Stage (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3VDNStageSetupEXPT8.description: Connect an existing OpenVDN Composer MODEL. Prepares only the full DMD8/B50 or its own fresh-noise tail; does not sample or load weights. Keep learned upscale/reconcile external. Independent model/LoRA/condition/noise. VDN Stage EAV has an actual producer adapter. VDN temporal Relay needs the separate VDN Relay Apply adapter; low-VRAM side-model persistent identity and full pretrained/GPU quality remain pending.

mode.tooltip: report_only has no side effects. fixed_total_reserved_exp sets a total reserve. external_usage_plus_margin_exp requires global cleanup first.

fixed_total_reserved_gib.tooltip: 4.0 GiB is the validated conservative starting point for the exact RTX 4060 Ti 16 GiB, 736x416, 124-frame Hybrid Stock20 workflow. It is not a universal safe value; re-measure other GPUs and workloads.

clean_before_load.tooltip: Global side effect: unloads every ComfyUI model before measuring/applying. Required by external_usage_plus_margin_exp.

policy_epoch.tooltip: Increment to explicitly invalidate ComfyUI's cached policy output.

MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3 VRAM Policy / VBAR显存预留策略 (Advanced)
MiniMaxH3VRAMPolicyT8Advanced.description: Plans a guarded process-global ComfyUI reserve and DynamicVRAM/VBAR simple headroom. The default is report-only. Connect the policy to the Advanced Hybrid Loader to guarantee it is applied before model loading.

MiniMaxH3Validate24FPSVideo.name: MiniMaxH3Validate24FPSVideo
MiniMaxH3Validate24FPSVideo.description: Require a 24 fps source and loaded frame batch for current H3 workflows. Convert the source to constant 24 fps before loading it. VHS metadata cannot certify VFR timing.

MiniMaxH3VedaApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Veda · Apply Flex Sparse (T2VA EXP)
MiniMaxH3VedaApplyEXPT8.description: Explicit MODEL clone. Only exact T2VA video grids in the bundle are allowed; no silent resize or unsupported-plan fallback. Masked calls preserve the original dense backend and report zero sparse coverage for those calls. Relay-style partial-query calls also delegate with an explicit audit. Uses PyTorch Flex, not official FA4. Windows apply_exp requires --disable-dynamic-vram due to a verified native crash. Optional fused tile I/O is experimental and does not establish a speedup. Existing unverified Relay/EAV/DiT owners are preserved with an explicit Veda-bypassed audit, not sparse coverage.

MiniMaxH3VedaAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Veda · Audit After Sample (T2VA EXP)
MiniMaxH3VedaAuditEXPT8.description: Place after the actual sampler to observe Veda calls. This report never certifies video quality or end-to-end speedup.

MiniMaxH3VedaBundleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaBundleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaBundleEXPT8.description: Select the author's predictor bundle from models/veda_scorers. This is a tile-score predictor, not an H3 UNET or Turbo LoRA. The recommended teacher recipe uses a separate Turbo v4 step600 LoRA and explicit eight-step sampling; the training step is not NFE. Checks format and SHA; does not run inference or download weights.

MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicApplyEXPT8.description: Independent, model-free tile-64 TripPool route inspired by BSAI; not the released Miowtion predictor or FA4. Exact native H3 grid, global conditioning rows/columns, per-MODEL clone and history audit. Default observes dense; optional sigma window delegates outside the selected interval. Sink off removes global K/V only for video queries and is not quality approved. No speed guarantee.
