MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Veda · Heuristic Audit After Sample (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VedaHeuristicAuditEXPT8.description: Connect after the actual sampler. Sparse calls are heuristic, never evidence of trained predictor use, quality, or speedup.

MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAApplyEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAApplyEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAApplyEXPT8.display_name: H3 Veda R2VA · Apply Flex Sparse (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAApplyEXPT8.description: Independent MODEL clone for LOW or HIGH. Official R2VA predictor/selection with T8 Flex, not upstream INT8. trained budgets read the file (official 32/32). Text/audio stay dense. strict_exact is default; non-trained sizes require explicit nearest_exp. Preserves foreign EAV/Relay owners and masks with audited dense delegation. Windows apply requires UTF8 and --disable-dynamic-vram. No speed/flicker-fix promise.

MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAAuditEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAAuditEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAAuditEXPT8.display_name: H3 Veda R2VA · Audit After Sample (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VedaR2VAAuditEXPT8.description: Pass through the actual sampler LATENT, exposing sparse/delegate calls and plan/grid evidence. Does not certify human quality or end-to-end speed.

MiniMaxH3VedaR2VABundleEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VedaR2VABundleEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VedaR2VABundleEXPT8.description: R2VA visual-reference predictor, not an H3 DiT or LoRA. Select models/veda_r2va. Separate from the legacy T2VA loader; official preview uses 32 reference / 32 generated tiles.

MiniMaxH3VideoComponentsSerialEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoComponentsSerialEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VideoComponentsSerialEXPT8.description: Native file decoding with explicit per-stream thread_count=1. Original crop, trim, rotation, float RGB, audio and bit depth retained; no global codec patch.

conditioning.tooltip: Conditioning from MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo, MiniMaxH3ImageToVideo, or TextToVideo.

latent.tooltip: Empty H3 AV latent for the NEW clip (from the conditioning node).

vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 video VAE.

mode.tooltip: auto: extend if prev_frames is wired, else generate new video. disabled: bypass extend entirely. always_extend: fail if prev_frames is not wired.

context_length.tooltip: Number of frames from previous video to pin (typically 22 or 5).

encode_mode.tooltip: video: compresses motion into latent space (recommended).

anchor_mode.tooltip: head: pinned frames at start of timeline, trimmed after decode.

crop.tooltip: Crop mode when resizing context frames to target resolution.

audio_context_length.tooltip: Frames of tail audio to carry over. 0 follows context_length.

prev_frames.tooltip: Decoded frames of previous video clip (e.g. from Load Video / VAEDecode).

prev_latent.tooltip: Sampler output latent of previous clip. When connected, extracts motion guide and audio directly from the sampler latent without a lossy VAE decode/encode round-trip, preventing color drift and motion jitter.

prev_audio.tooltip: Decoded audio of previous clip (if prev_latent is not available).

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE (required when using prev_audio).

MiniMaxH3VideoExtender.name: MiniMaxH3VideoExtender
MiniMaxH3VideoExtender.description: Extend MiniMax H3 videos seamlessly with motion & audio continuity, or pass through for new videos.
output_tooltips: Conditioning with motion context applied (or original conditioning if bypassed).
Number of pinned leading frames to trim. Wire to MiniMax H3 Contex Loop Trim.

images_b.tooltip: Current newly rendered clip frames (e.g. from Loop Trim).

images_a.tooltip: Previous clip frames (e.g. from Load Video). If empty, passes images_b through.

audio_a.tooltip: Previous clip audio (from Load Video or previous decode).

audio_b.tooltip: Current clip audio (e.g. from Loop Trim).

seam_smooth.tooltip: Anti-stutter motion smoothing at the seam boundary (0=off, 1=smooth seam frames, 2-3=smooth transition window). Eliminates frame jitter/stutter while preserving exact total frame count.

blend_frames.tooltip: Crossfade transition frames at the seam (0 = direct cut with seam_smooth). Setting >0 blends tail/head frames.

color_match.tooltip: Color correction for images_b to match images_a. 'seam_fade' (recommended) eliminates color flash/pop by matching boundary color and smoothly transitioning; 'match_mean_std' matches overall tone across the whole clip.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate for calculating audio crossfade duration when blend_frames > 0.

MiniMaxH3VideoMerge.name: MiniMaxH3VideoMerge
MiniMaxH3VideoMerge.description: Seamlessly merge previous video + current video (images & audio) with optional color matching and seam smoothing.
output_tooltips: Merged image sequence (images_a + images_b) or images_b if images_a is empty.
Merged audio track (audio_a + audio_b) or audio_b if audio_a is empty.

mute_first_frames.tooltip: 对应开头N帧的声音置零，保留时长；太大会削掉首字。

fade_in_ms.tooltip: 静音后半余弦淡入；N=0时仅淡入。不做全片降噪或归一化。

MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8.display_name: T8 末端音频静音＋淡入（VIDEO EXP）
MiniMaxH3VideoOpeningMuteFadeT8.description: 只改开头音频，不缩短或重采样。tensor VIDEO帧数据直通；文件VIDEO按实际帧PTS定位，视频流复制。原有trim/crop/非MP4视图由Core流式导出后处理，不加载全片RGB。AAC有损编码可能有尾部padding。

geometry_align.tooltip: 实验：只校正扩区接缝几何，原片像素不变；需OpenCV，关闭不加载。

source_mode.tooltip: 默认联合解码会重建原片像素，跳过接缝修色/几何；可选preserve_source保留原片。选择后保存沿用候选模式。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 生成首帧候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCandidateT8.description: 只生成首个窗口并显示真实首帧。先单独运行本节点审图，再连接选择/接续。候选名或生成设置改变需使用新缓存。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAudit.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAuditT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAudit.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 模型组合审计 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintCompatibilityAudit.description: 读取真实MODEL内容与patch/wrapper，不按文件名猜。Stock20与已锁定KJ低显存补丁可用；Turbo/SPEED/SLA/VDN/Fast H3/Prompt Relay尚无扩画组合验收时明确标为不支持。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 保存所选扩画 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintComposeCandidateT8.description: 沿用候选的颜色设置，首帧RGB与所选预览不符时拒绝发布。原声音保留。

geometry_align.tooltip: 实验：校正扩画侧轮廓，原片像素不变；需OpenCV，未人审前不默认开启。

source_mode.tooltip: 默认联合解码：原片也经过VAE重建，跳过接缝修色/几何校正；原音频不变。preserve_source可选精确保留原片像素，但接缝可能更明显。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintContinueCandidateT.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintContinueCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintContinueCandidateT.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 接续所选候选 (EXP)

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGeometryPreviewT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGeometryPreviewT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGeometryPreviewT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 扩画范围预览 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGeometryPreviewT8.description: 只预览原片位置和待补区域，不运行生成模型，也不代表扩画效果。请用独立预览工作流；连着采样分支不会暂停生成。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 区域提示/人物保护计划 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintGuidanceT8.description: 区域提示按H3原生32px空间token路由；人物框使用原片坐标，只审计已锁定原片中的人物及边界风险，不声称扩出区域能绝对阻止人物幻觉。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 读取已存候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCandidateT8.description: 按生成时返回的candidate_id读取原候选PNG，不采样、不解码VAE、不自动确认。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelec.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelectionT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelec.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 读取已完成选择 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadCompletedSelec.description: 读取已确认且全部窗口已完成的缓存，可直接接保存节点；不加载生成模型、不采样。未完成缓存会拒绝。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 读取已准备缓存 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadPreparedT8.description: 用相同原片、Plan参数和run_name读取已完成的源视频/音频/提示词缓存。不加载CLIP/VAE，不重新编码提示词；缺失或损坏会报错。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 恢复已确认候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintLoadSelectionT8.description: 明确输入之前确认时返回的selection_id。读取原候选和确认记录，可接Continue；不会自动生成或改选。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 准备区域引导缓存 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintPrepareGuidedT8.description: 独立的区域引导准备路径；不会改变普通Prepare节点或已有工作流。请使用新的run_name。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 区域引导模型 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintRegionalModelT8.description: 把已准备的区域提示绑定到原生H3 MODEL；兼容已审计KJ低显存Attention/FFN，拒绝LoRA、其他Attention所有者和未知wrapper静默叠加。

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSampleT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSampleT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSampleT8.description: Draft native MODEL path, including audited KJ memory patches. Other acceleration adapters remain pending.

MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8.name: MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8.display_name: H3 Video Outpaint · 确认所连候选 (EXP)
MiniMaxH3VideoOutpaintSelectCandidateT8.description: 将喜欢的候选接入。只有已看过首帧并开启确认，才允许接续；不会自动挑选候选。

MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceCompositeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceCompositeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceCompositeEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Visible MASK Composite (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceCompositeEXPT8.description: AFTER old Stitch/Gate: candidate already contains original blend alpha. Connect its changed_mask (or exact final applied support), NOT fallback mask or raw crops. Only limits existing changes, never applies original alpha twice. Full geometry must match; audio passes the same object. Changes invalidate composite/delivery only; completed sampling stages and manual approvals remain separate.

MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceMaskBindEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceMaskBindEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceMaskBindEXPT8.display_name: H3 Face · Bind Visible MASK (T8 EXP)
MiniMaxH3VisibleFaceMaskBindEXPT8.description: Bind full original RGB and full-coordinate user visible-face MASK. White permits existing changes, black preserves exact source. One-frame broadcast is explicit. No automatic segmentation/occlusion proof, sampler, resizing, crop or time conversion.

clip.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP.

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE.

length.tooltip: 24fps; snapped up to the 17n+5 H3 grid.

add_source_as_reference.tooltip: Presents drive_audio to Qwen/DiT as an official <Audio N> reference.

prompt_primary_audio_ordinal.tooltip: Prompt audio ordinal intended as the primary source; remapped after video soundtracks. Use 0 to disable.

final_audio.tooltip: Optional clean/stem track passed through for final mux; defaults to drive_audio.

allow_above_reference_area.tooltip: Legacy workflow compatibility input. Canvases above the 1920x1088 reference area are now allowed regardless of this value and only emit a VRAM/runtime warning.

MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerConditioningEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerConditioningEXPT8.display_name: H3 Marker · Bind / 原生空间条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerConditioningEXPT8.description: Insert the actual Marker Prompt image at an explicit raw-reference position; native first/last pictures count BEFORE it. Bind its actual resized RGB and generated legend before tokenize. Explicit marked-VAE/Qwen default or experimental clean-VAE/marked-Qwen; no box erasure/quality promise. Other images/video/audio and native LOW/HIGH remain intact. Bridge once; EAV/Relay external. Stored ReferenceSet is not silently merged into raw inputs.

expected_source_sha256.tooltip: Optional editor preview RGB binding. Input change rejects a stale preview. Empty is explicit manual authoring.

MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPrepareEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPrepareEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPrepareEXPT8.display_name: H3 Marker · Prepare / 标记图准备 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPrepareEXPT8.description: Render explicit source rectangles without modifying the original, or retain an existing hand-drawn IMAGE exactly. Hand-drawn xyxy is optional; same-color actor/target and shared targets are allowed. No auto-detection, MASK, VAE, sampling, audio, removal or identity lock. Connect marked_image to ordinary reference conditioning; binding is unverified here.

MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPromptEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPromptEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPromptEXPT8.display_name: H3 Marker · Prompt / 空间提示词 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerPromptEXPT8.description: Deterministic new marker legend/actions; preserve original prompt/dialogue bytes. manual_original emits the original prompt unchanged. No LLM, audio/camera/time defaults or embedding edit. Picture number is a declaration until an actual downstream media bind. Static legend and one-off actions remain separate outputs for external temporal/Relay plans.

model.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 MODEL；输出为局部克隆。

clip.tooltip: 原生 MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL CLIP。

audio_vae.tooltip: MiniMax H3 audio VAE。

prompt_relay_plan.tooltip: 必须直接来自同一版本 Prompt Relay Plan 节点。

task_type.tooltip: 支持 T2VA/I2VA/FL2VA/L2VA/Ref2VA/Hybrid 的目标视频时间路由；显式接入 Query Route 后可实验性扩展到目标音频。

audio_mode.tooltip: 支持原生生成、锁定源音频、重混源音频和仅参考音频。默认Plan只路由目标视频；joint_av_exp会直接路由目标音频，不能与lock_source组合。

execution_mode.tooltip: 先用 report_only 检查 token/layout/显存报告；确认后显式选择 apply_exp 才安装注意力路由。零个或一个局部事件时会自动原样直通，不安装补丁；单事件通常应合并进 global_prompt。

query_chunk_rows.tooltip: 目标视频/显式联合音频 query 分块。更小更省显存但更慢；不会创建完整 S×S mask。

MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerRelayConditioningEX.name: MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerRelayConditioningEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerRelayConditioningEX.display_name: H3 Marker · External Relay / 外置分段条件 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VisualMarkerRelayConditioningEX.description: External Relay Plan owns compiled text/local actions/dialogue. This adapter appends ONLY the actual-bound static marker legend, not recurring actions. Fresh native token spans/layout and paired MODEL/positive/latent. Explicit split/reference mode; EAV stays downstream. Does not rewrite old plans or reuse old text bindings.

positive.tooltip: Conditioning containing MiniMax H3 image/video refs or keyframes.

reference_strength.tooltip: Maps directly to minimax_visual_cond_noise_aug. Test 0.999, 0.995, then 0.990; values <=0.950 are aggressive.

MiniMaxH3VisualReferenceStrengthEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3VisualReferenceStrengthEXPT8
MiniMaxH3VisualReferenceStrengthEXPT8.description: Experimental global MiniMax H3 visual-conditioning strength. Lower values add seeded noise to visual reference/keyframe latents and may reduce overly smoothed texture, but can weaken identity and composition.

MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Library Delete / 删除音色 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryDeleteT8.description: Moves an entry to a recoverable local trash folder; it does not permanently erase it.

MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryLoadT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryLoadT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibraryLoadT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Library Load / 加载音色 (EXP/T8)

MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Library Save / 保存音色 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VoiceLibrarySaveT8.description: Explicitly persists a voice profile and any reference audio in the local ComfyUI user directory.

rights_confirmed.tooltip: Required for reference_voice. Confirm that you have consent or another lawful right to use the connected person's voice.

peak_limit_minus_3_dbfs.tooltip: Only attenuates peaks above -3 dBFS; it never boosts quiet references.

MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8.name: MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8
MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8.display_name: MiniMax H3 Voice Profile / 音色资料 (EXP/T8)
MiniMaxH3VoiceProfileT8.description: Creates a workflow-memory voice profile. Reference mode prepares a 2-15s 32kHz stereo anchor and requires explicit rights confirmation.

action_preset.tooltip: WASD controls the character; IJKL controls the camera; F makes pan fast.

custom_timeline_json.tooltip: Only used when preset=custom. Segments must tile 0..37 without gaps.

MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3-World Action Timeline / 动作时间线 (T8)
MiniMaxH3WorldActionTimelineT8Advanced.description: Builds the exact 37-step H3-World action script for one 832x480, 124-frame clip. Custom ranges use end-exclusive latent indices.

MiniMaxH3WorldI2VAConditioningT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldI2VAConditioningT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldI2VAConditioningT8Advanced.description: First-frame H3-World conditioning. Action sentences are encoded and refined independently, then bound one-to-one to 37 video latents.

model.tooltip: Native ComfyUI MiniMax H3 FL2VA MODEL.

compile_flex_attention.tooltip: Recommended. First run compiles one shape-specific FlexAttention kernel.

MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3-World Model Composer / 模型组合 (T8)
MiniMaxH3WorldModelComposerT8Advanced.description: Loads the H3-World LoRA and installs its required per-action text refiner segmentation plus directed FlexAttention runtime.

MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced.name: MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced
MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced.display_name: MiniMax H3-World Safe Video Save / 安全视频保存 (T8)
MiniMaxH3WorldSafeVideoSaveT8Advanced.description: Saves the fixed 832x480x124 H3-World result with an isolated, single-thread libx264 process. The MP4 is published only after strict video and audio decoding succeeds.

MiniMaxH3Wuli4ComposeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3Wuli4ComposeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3Wuli4ComposeEXPT8.display_name: H3 Wuli·原生4步三文件组合
MiniMaxH3Wuli4ComposeEXPT8.description: 原始full FL2VA MODEL→trunk→widen→head set，三原件SHA核验、强度1。只用Core现有LoRA/reshape/set/headbank；外置条件和Sampler，不改旧图。

MiniMaxH3Wuli8RecipeEXPT8.name: MiniMaxH3Wuli8RecipeEXPT8
MiniMaxH3Wuli8RecipeEXPT8.description: 外置原生UNETLoader选择Wuli8完整模型。明确12/3、simple8、Euler，Guider使用CFG1；不证明任意HIGH或所有LoRA组合。

latent.tooltip: The target: Empty MiniMax H3 Latent AV, longer than both contexts (e.g. 192 frames with 39 kept at each end).

vae.tooltip: The H3 video VAE.

audio_vae.tooltip: The H3 audio VAE.

preserve_frames.tooltip: Frames kept at each end: a shared video / audio boundary, 39, 90, 141 ... (39 + 51k). More context = a smoother join, a shorter generated middle.

crop.tooltip: How the clips are fitted to the target canvas.

start_audio.tooltip: Clip A's sound (silence if not connected).

end_audio.tooltip: Clip B's sound (silence if not connected).

start_fps.tooltip: Clip A's frame rate. Anything but 24 is converted to H3's 24 fps on the constant-frame-rate grid (frames repeated or dropped, never blended); its sound keeps its own timing. Assemble converts the same way.

end_fps.tooltip: Clip B's frame rate, converted the same way.

output_tooltips: The target AV latent with clip A's last and clip B's first preserve_frames encoded in (video and audio) and a noise mask: 0 = kept ends, 1 = the middle to generate. Wire to the sampler.
For H3 AV Bridge Assemble.
Frames generated between the kept ends: target frames - 2 x preserve_frames.
Text: target frames and size, frames / video steps / audio ticks kept at each end, the generated middle in frames and seconds, any fps conversion.
MiniMaxH3_AVBridge.name: MiniMaxH3_AVBridge
MiniMaxH3_AVBridge.display_name: H3 AV Bridge (generate between two clips)
MiniMaxH3_AVBridge.description: Generate the middle between two existing clips: the end of clip A and the start of clip B are encoded into the target and protected (picture and sound), only the middle is generated - so it starts exactly where A ends and lands exactly where B begins. Feed the latent to the sampler with your conditioning, decode video and audio, then H3 AV Bridge Assemble. 24 fps clips.

images.tooltip: The decoded bridge (all of its frames).

audio.tooltip: The decoded bridge sound.

start_frames.tooltip: Clip A, as given to the bridge.

end_frames.tooltip: Clip B, as given to the bridge.

start_audio.tooltip: Clip A's sound, as given to the bridge: made stereo, resampled to the bridge sound's rate and fitted to clip A's length (silence if not connected).

end_audio.tooltip: Clip B's sound, handled the same way (silence if not connected).

output_tooltips: IMAGE batch at 24 fps: all of clip A + the generated middle + all of clip B (clips resized to the bridge's size when they differ).
Stereo sound at the bridge sound's rate, cut on the picture's sample boundaries: exactly as long as the frames.
Text: frame accounting (A + generated + B), sound length in samples and seconds, and any resizing; also shown on the node.
MiniMaxH3_AVBridgeAssemble.name: MiniMaxH3_AVBridgeAssemble
MiniMaxH3_AVBridgeAssemble.description: Clip A + the generated middle + clip B, picture and sound: the bridge's two kept contexts are dropped (the clips themselves are used there) and the sound is cut on the picture's absolute sample boundaries, so nothing drifts.

model.tooltip: H3 MODEL after all acceleration nodes. Its model_options are checked for conflicting stacks (Block Cache with Spectrum or EasyCache, EasyCache with LazyCache, First-Block Cache with another cache, duplicate dit patches); a conflict raises an error.

output_tooltips: The input MODEL, unchanged (same object), when no conflict was found. Continue the chain from here.
One line confirming that no conflicting cache or dit-patch stack was detected.
MiniMaxH3_AcceleratorConflict.name: MiniMaxH3_AcceleratorConflict
MiniMaxH3_AcceleratorConflict.description: Fail loud before sampling if incompatible H3 accelerators are stacked (EasyCache + Block Cache, Spectrum + Block Cache, duplicate dit patches). Passes MODEL through on success so it can sit inline: N4 → ProtectedLayer → this → SigmaShift → …

candidates.tooltip: H3 Anchor Studio's candidates output (checked against the metadata's checksums).

metadata.tooltip: H3 Anchor Studio's metadata (h3.anchor_candidates JSON): checksums, person check and colour scores of each candidate.

job.tooltip: The H3 job that keeps the decision.

decision.tooltip: review: only output this source frame's approved anchor (wait if none). approve / reject: record that for candidate '#' in the job (once; an approved one is saved as a 16-bit PNG in the job folder).

candidate.tooltip: The '#' of the candidate on H3 Anchor Studio's sheet to approve or reject.

note.tooltip: Free text kept with the decision in the job (and shown in status).

masks.tooltip: H3 Anchor Studio's masks: the approved candidate's mask is saved with it and becomes anchor_mask.

bank.tooltip: A Reference Bank to add the approved anchor to (role identity).

output_tooltips: The approved anchor image for this source frame, read back from the job. Waits (no error) while none is approved.
Its saved mask (1 = the new character); all zero when no masks were connected at approval.
The bank with the approved anchor (identity).
What was approved (candidate, checksum, job, note), or what to do while no anchor is approved.
MiniMaxH3_AnchorApproval.name: MiniMaxH3_AnchorApproval
MiniMaxH3_AnchorApproval.description: Approve or reject an anchor candidate (H3 Anchor Studio's '#'). The decision is kept in the H3 job and the approved anchor joins the Reference Bank as identity, so later runs, H3 Subject Memory and every segment use it; a rejected candidate is never used. With decision = review it gives the approved anchor of this source frame; until one is approved, what needs it waits (no error) and 'status' says what to do.

source.tooltip: The source frame (or crop) the candidates repaint.

prompt.tooltip: The anchor prompt: kept in the metadata with the approval.

detection_threshold.tooltip: Score threshold for core SAM3_Detect when it looks for the person in each candidate and reference (needs model + conditioning); lower finds more.

min_overlap.tooltip: The candidate's person must cover this share of the performer's area; someone merely touching the spot does not count.

tile.tooltip: Size in pixels of each square tile on the contact sheet (source + each candidate, letterboxed).

source_mask.tooltip: The performer in the source frame (H3 Multi-Subject Selector's mask).

model.tooltip: SAM 3 / 3.1 MODEL: finds the person in each candidate.

conditioning.tooltip: The text 'person:20' (CLIP Text Encode with the SAM 3 checkpoint's CLIP; ':20' lets SAM 3 return up to 20 people - plain 'person' returns only one).

candidate_masks.tooltip: Or the person in each candidate, one mask per candidate.

reference_masks.tooltip: The character in each reference (default: found by SAM 3 when model + conditioning are connected, else the whole image).

output_tooltips: At the source size.
The new character in each candidate.
Source + candidates, numbered, with their numbers.
|candidate - source| x 4 per candidate.
h3.anchor_candidates: for H3 Anchor Approval.
MiniMaxH3_AnchorStudio.name: MiniMaxH3_AnchorStudio
MiniMaxH3_AnchorStudio.description: Compares anchor candidates (the take's first frame repainted with the new character, made by your H3 image path) with the source frame: a contact sheet with each candidate's numbers, the new character's mask in each (the person standing where the performer stands, found by core SAM 3), its colour match to the source subject and to the references, and a difference map. Approve one with H3 Anchor Approval. Colour match is clothing and body colour, not a face comparison.

latent.tooltip: Joint AV latent or audio latent whose audio noise mask is read (not changed).

timing.tooltip: auto: read the audio latent rate and layout from the connected audio VAE. manual: enter them directly.

latents_per_second.tooltip: Audio latent frames per second. 40 for MiniMax H3, 25 for LTX.

layout.tooltip: Where time runs in the audio latent. time last for MiniMax H3 and audio-only models, time then bins for LTX spectrogram latents.

vae.tooltip: The audio VAE used to encode this latent. Required when timing is auto.

output_tooltips: Text: the mask source, latent frame count and duration, then each run of equal values as 'start-end s = value (keep / generate / soft)'. Route to a Preview Any node.
MiniMaxH3_AudioMaskDebug.name: MiniMaxH3_AudioMaskDebug
MiniMaxH3_AudioMaskDebug.description: Report which audio time ranges the latent's noise mask keeps (0.0) and generates (1.0). Accepts a joint AV latent or an audio latent alone; route the string to a Preview Any node.

latent.tooltip: Joint AV latent or audio latent to mask.

timing.tooltip: auto: read the audio latent rate and layout from the connected audio VAE. manual: enter them directly.

latents_per_second.tooltip: Audio latent frames per second. 40 for MiniMax H3, 25 for LTX.

layout.tooltip: Where time runs in the audio latent. time last for MiniMax H3 and audio-only models, time then bins for LTX spectrogram latents.

start_time.tooltip: Start of the regenerated audio range in seconds. Ignored when time_ranges or mask is used.

end_time.tooltip: End of the regenerated audio range in seconds. Ignored when time_ranges or mask is used.

existing_mask.tooltip: keep: merge the new ranges into the audio mask already on the latent, so copies of this node chain. replace: discard the existing audio mask first. The video side of a joint mask is kept either way.

vae.tooltip: The audio VAE used to encode this latent (for a joint AV latent, the audio VAE, not the video one). Required when timing is auto.

mask.tooltip: Mask over the audio timeline: time runs along the width axis, stretched to the audio duration. White = regenerate, black = keep.

time_ranges.tooltip: Comma-separated seconds forming in,out pairs (e.g. 0,1.5,3,4.25). Takes priority over mask and start/end when set.

output_tooltips: The latent with the audio noise mask attached.
Which audio time ranges were marked for regeneration.
MiniMaxH3_AudioMaskToLatent.name: MiniMaxH3_AudioMaskToLatent
MiniMaxH3_AudioMaskToLatent.description: Regenerate the selected audio time ranges and keep the rest. Ranges come from time_ranges when set, else from the mask when connected, else from start_time/end_time. Accepts a joint AV latent or an audio latent alone. On a joint latent without an existing noise mask the video is fully preserved; apply Set Latent Noise Mask before this node to control the video side.

reference.tooltip: Reference stem (e.g. isolated vocal).

low_mel_ratio_min.tooltip: Low-mel energy ratio below this fails (bass collapse).

on_fail.tooltip: report only: the verdict shows on the node and in the outputs. stop the run: a failure stops the queue - put this gate BEFORE your Save (wire the passthrough output) and nothing failing is saved.

output_tooltips: True when mel L1, centroid drift, RMS ratio and low-mel ratio are all within their thresholds.
The measured values against the thresholds and the failed checks; starts with 'FAILED' on a failure. Also shown on the node.
The checked audio, unchanged: wire it on to your Save so a failed gate (on_fail = stop the run) stops before it.
MiniMaxH3_AudioQualityGate.name: MiniMaxH3_AudioQualityGate
MiniMaxH3_AudioQualityGate.description: Post-sampling QC on the decoded audio stream: mel L1 vs reference, spectral-centroid drift (EasyCache muffled-bass signature), and RMS. Fails the shot when bass collapses or the centroid drifts. Mel here is measurement-only — not model conditioning.

audio.tooltip: One audio clip (batch 1, mono or stereo) to transcribe. It is mixed to mono and resampled to 16 kHz for Whisper (torchaudio needed for other rates).

model.tooltip: Official openai-whisper checkpoint. Downloaded on first use to models/stt/whisper; runs on CUDA when available, after ComfyUI unloads its models to make room.

language.tooltip: Spoken language passed to Whisper; auto lets Whisper detect it.

model_after_run.tooltip: Unload after run: drop the Whisper model and free VRAM after each run (also after an error). Keep loaded: reuse it on the next run with the same model.

manual_transcript.tooltip: Optional exact lyrics or dialogue typed by the user. When connected and non-empty, this wording overrides Whisper while Whisper remains an approximate timing reference.

output_tooltips: Plain-text transcript block for a prompt writer: requested and detected language, a confidence band from Whisper's mean avg_logprob, the transcript and [start-end] segments in seconds; with manual_transcript, that exact text first.
The effective transcript text: manual_transcript when it is non-empty, otherwise Whisper's text.
The input audio passed through unchanged.
MiniMaxH3_AudioTranscript.name: MiniMaxH3_AudioTranscript
MiniMaxH3_AudioTranscript.description: Transcribes one source audio clip locally with official Whisper, using CUDA Smart Swap and first-use model download, then returns structured context plus the effective transcript. Optional user-supplied lyrics or dialogue overrides Whisper wording while Whisper still supplies approximate segment timing.

audio.tooltip: The clip to shorten (every batch item and channel, rate kept).

seconds.tooltip: Seconds to remove from the start (0.04167 ≈ one 24fps frame).

output_tooltips: The same audio without its first 'seconds' (rounded to whole samples); sample rate unchanged.
One line: seconds and samples removed, and the new length.
MiniMaxH3_AudioTrimStart.name: MiniMaxH3_AudioTrimStart
MiniMaxH3_AudioTrimStart.description: Trim N seconds off the FRONT of an audio clip. Used by multishot chaining to drop each shot's duplicated first frame (1/24s) from video AND audio together.

latent2.tooltip: E.g. the same segment after a short refine pass.

keyframes.tooltip: frame:weight pairs (0-based pixel frames). Held before the first and after the last.

interpolation.tooltip: Between keyframes: linear ramp, smooth (cosine ease in / out), or hold (keep the earlier keyframe's value until the next keyframe).

audio.tooltip: Which sound to keep; blend follows the same weights.

mask.tooltip: Where latent 2 may be used (frames at the canvas size, or latent size).

output_tooltips: H3 audio + video latent: video = latent 1 x (1 - w) + latent 2 x w per latent frame (w = mean keyframe weight of the pixel frames it holds, times the mask); audio per the audio choice. No noise mask.
One line: frames and latent frames, latent 2's weight at the first / last frame, the first frame it is used, audio choice, masked or not.
MiniMaxH3_BlendLatentsByFrames.name: MiniMaxH3_BlendLatentsByFrames
MiniMaxH3_BlendLatentsByFrames.description: Blend two latents of the same segment frame by frame: keyframes give latent 2's weight per pixel frame (0 = all latent 1, 1 = all latent 2), e.g. 0:0, 22:0, 44:1 keeps the first 22 frames that join the previous segment and fades into a refined pass by frame 44 - the LongTakeNoCuts fix for detail loss over long chained shots. A mask limits where latent 2 is used (white = latent 2 allowed). Removes any noise mask.

model.tooltip: Native MiniMax H3 MODEL. It is cloned and patched; errors if the model is not native H3, Spectrum Apply or EasyCache/LazyCache is already on it, or block 0 / the last block already has a dit replace patch.

residual_diff_threshold.tooltip: Relative change of block 0's residual (audio and video scored separately, the larger counts) below which the cached tail of the remaining blocks is reused. 0 = never reuse; higher = more reuse.

start_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress (0-1, converted to sigma) at which cache reuse may start. Must be lower than end_percent.

end_percent.tooltip: Sampling progress (0-1) after which no cache reuse happens and the cache is cleared; the remaining steps run every block.

max_consecutive_hits.tooltip: Maximum model calls in a row that may reuse the cache before a full forward is forced to refresh it. 1 = at most every other call is cached.

cache_device.tooltip: Where the cached residual tails and metric samples are stored. cpu = system RAM (saves VRAM, copies each step); gpu = the model's device.

metric_stride.tooltip: Subsampling stride (tokens and channels) for the change metric. 1 = compare every value; higher = cheaper, coarser metric. Does not affect what is cached.

verbose.tooltip: Logs hit/refresh with the audio and video diff and sigma for every model call. The cache summary is logged after sampling either way.

output_tooltips: Clone of the H3 model with the block cache installed (block 0 and last block patched, sample/diffusion wrappers). Wire it to the sampler.
MiniMaxH3_BlockCacheT8.name: MiniMaxH3_BlockCacheT8
MiniMaxH3_BlockCacheT8.description: H3-specific F1B0 residual cache with dual audio+video metric. Patches only block 0 and the last block; refuses if any dit index is already occupied. cache_device defaults to cpu for 8 GB VRAM.

latent.tooltip: An H3 AV latent whose noise mask (video and audio) is removed.

output_tooltips: The same latent with no noise_mask: the sampler generates every video step and audio tick.
MiniMaxH3_ClearAVNoiseMask.name: MiniMaxH3_ClearAVNoiseMask
MiniMaxH3_ClearAVNoiseMask.description: Remove the whole denoise mask (both streams) from an H3 AV latent; the samples are unchanged.

images.tooltip: Decoded clip as display sRGB frames (VAE Decode output); every frame is measured, sRGB-decoded to linear for the luma / DR / headroom metrics.

reference.tooltip: Optional reference frame for Oklab palette distance.

output_tooltips: Text summary of the clip metrics (colourfulness, luma DR, clipped fraction, headroom, texture, flicker, Oklab distance).
One 256x48 IMAGE strip: grey bar = luma p1..p99, red bar = clipped fraction, green bar = colourfulness (/109), thumbnail of the first frame at the right.
Every number above plus per-frame lists, as JSON.
MiniMaxH3_ColorQC.name: MiniMaxH3_ColorQC
MiniMaxH3_ColorQC.description: Score a decoded clip for Hybrid HDR A/B: Hasler-Süsstrunk colourfulness (display sRGB 0-255), linear luma DR, clipped highlight fraction, headroom, texture energy, temporal flicker, and optional Oklab distance to a reference. Also per frame: colourfulness trend, frame-to-frame Oklab drift (worst frame named), chroma and luma histograms, a banding heuristic and deltaE_OK against the reference - all in metrics_json for A/B tables.

image.tooltip: Scene-linear frames in scene_colorspace. Every frame is round-tripped; a scene-linear clip whose peak is <= 1.0 fails as 'clamped to SDR'.

scene_colorspace.tooltip: OCIO colorspace of the input; the round trip goes scene -> display/view -> back to this space.

display.tooltip: OCIO display of the view transform under test; must hold the chosen view.

view.tooltip: OCIO view under test; a non-invertible view shows up as round-trip error.

tolerance.tooltip: Largest allowed absolute per-channel difference (scene-linear units) between input and round-tripped frame; above it the check fails.

on_fail.tooltip: report only: the verdict shows on the node and in the outputs. stop the run: a failure stops the queue - put this gate BEFORE your Save (wire the passthrough output) and nothing failing is saved.

output_tooltips: True when max_error <= tolerance, every value above 1.0 stays above 1.0 after the round trip, and the input was not SDR-clamped.
Largest absolute per-channel difference between any frame and its round trip (scene-linear units).
Text: OCIO config source, max error vs tolerance with the worst channel, HDR probe note; starts with 'FAILED' on failure.
IMAGE batch, one per frame: per-pixel max absolute error over R/G/B (one channel, not normalised), at the input size.
The checked image, unchanged: wire it on so a failed gate (on_fail = stop the run) stops before what comes next.
MiniMaxH3_ColorRoundTripQC.name: MiniMaxH3_ColorRoundTripQC
MiniMaxH3_ColorRoundTripQC.description: Encode a probe through scene-linear → display → scene-linear and report error. Fails loudly in report when tolerance is exceeded or HDR highlights are lost. Use the HDR probe [0, 0.5, 1, 4, 16] in tests — values above 1.0 must survive.

task_spec.tooltip: h3.task_spec JSON from H3 Task Spec: segment length on the 17k + 5 grid, context + blend shorter than a segment, context 5/22/39/56, 24 fps.

strict.tooltip: On: any error stops the run with the reasons. Off: errors are only reported (report / ok) and the spec is passed on anyway.

media.tooltip: The source plate: its width and height must be multiples of 32 and the job's frame range must lie inside it. An edit task without it is an error.

model.tooltip: Only checked for presence: unconnected adds a warning. Not used otherwise.

vae.tooltip: Only checked for presence: unconnected adds a warning. Not used otherwise.

output_tooltips: Passed through when it is valid.
h3.validation JSON: ok, errors (list of text), warnings (list of text).
True when there are no errors (warnings do not count).
MiniMaxH3_CompatibilityValidator.name: MiniMaxH3_CompatibilityValidator
MiniMaxH3_CompatibilityValidator.description: Checks a task spec against its inputs before anything runs: the 17k + 5 grid, sizes in multiples of 32, 24 fps, the frame range inside the media, the context length. strict stops the run with the reasons; otherwise they are reported.

context_latent.tooltip: The previous clip's AV latent (Motion Context Load Latent).

tail_frames.tooltip: Pixel frames to noise; only these are whole latent steps (2/7/12/17). Use the same value as Motion Context's context_length.

alpha.tooltip: Flat noise strength over the window (0.45 validated). Lower keeps more of the previous clip's look.

alpha_end.tooltip: Strength at the frame touching the seam. Not larger than alpha.

ramp_steps.tooltip: Latent steps at the end that ramp down (one step is up to 4 frames).

seed.tooltip: Seed of the CPU generator for the gaussian noise; the same seed gives the same noise on every latent step of the tail.

noise_scale.tooltip: match_latent_std scales the noise to the window's own spread, so alpha means the same at any latent scale. unit = plain N(0, 1).

output_tooltips: Same AV latent with gaussian noise blended into the last latent steps of the video stream; audio unchanged. Wire to Motion Context's context_latent only; do not decode it.
Text: which latent steps got noise, noise scale and seed, the alpha per step, and a warning when the tail does not start on a latent-cycle boundary. Also shown on the node.
MiniMaxH3_ContextLatentTaperNoise.name: MiniMaxH3_ContextLatentTaperNoise
MiniMaxH3_ContextLatentTaperNoise.description: Gaussian noise on the last latent steps of the previous clip's AV latent, ramping down towards the seam, for Motion Context's context_latent (which wins over context_frames). The audio stream is untouched so the join's sound stays continuous. Only for context_latent: do not decode it. Experimental.

images.tooltip: The previous clip's decoded frames (what would go to context_frames).

tail_frames.tooltip: How many frames at the END get noise. Motion Context pins the LAST context_length frames, so keep this at least context_length. Earlier frames pass through untouched.

alpha.tooltip: Flat noise strength over the window (0.45 validated). Lower keeps more of the previous clip's look.

alpha_end.tooltip: Strength at the frame touching the seam. Not larger than alpha.

ramp_frames.tooltip: Frames at the end that ramp from alpha to alpha_end (3 validated: 0.333/0.217/0.100).

seed.tooltip: Noise pattern seed; one stream for every frame, so the whole tail is reproducible.

pattern.tooltip: poc_chroma_blocks = the validated 6-colour palette. The other two are untested.

grid_mode.tooltip: poc_36x64 reproduces the recipe exactly (16 px blocks only at 576x1024). block_size keeps the block size constant at any resolution.

block_size.tooltip: Block size in pixels for grid_mode = block_size.

output_tooltips: Same IMAGE batch with block noise blended into the last tail_frames frames (earlier frames unchanged). Wire to Motion Context's context_frames only, never on as the next clip's source.
Text: which frames got noise, pattern, block grid, seed and the noise amount (alpha) per frame. Also shown on the node.
MiniMaxH3_ContextTaperNoise.name: MiniMaxH3_ContextTaperNoise
MiniMaxH3_ContextTaperNoise.description: Blocky chroma noise on the tail of the previous clip before it reaches Motion Context's context_frames, ramping down towards the seam, so H3 keeps the motion but stops copying the old colour (character-swap chains). The output is only a context: never chain it on as the next clip's source. Experimental (validated upstream, not on your graphs yet).

model.tooltip: The MiniMax H3 diffusion model to patch.

window_frames.tooltip: Frames per window at 24 fps, snapped up to a legal H3 length (17k + 5). A clip this long or shorter runs untouched. 141 is about 6 seconds.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Smallest overlap between neighbouring windows, snapped up to 17m + 5 frames so every window starts on a 17-frame cycle. More overlap gives a softer transition and costs time. With 141 / 39 the stride is 102 frames and the audio edges are exact.

positions.tooltip: global: every window keeps the clip's own time positions, so it predicts what the whole clip would there (recommended). local (experimental): every window is laid out as a clip of its own, keyframes inside it re-indexed and the others left out - for A/B tests only.

output_tooltips: The patched model: feed it to an H3 sampler.

Text: snapped window and overlap (frames and latent steps), stride, positions mode, whether audio cut points are exact, the kill-switch variable, and any wrapped model function wrapper. Also shown on the node.
MiniMaxH3_ContextWindowSampling.name: MiniMaxH3_ContextWindowSampling
MiniMaxH3_ContextWindowSampling.description: Experimental. Patches an H3 model so every denoising step splits the clip into overlapping time windows, runs the model once per window and cross-fades the predictions. The whole clip stays in one sampling pass (unlike H3 Continuation, which renders segments one after the other); attention runs per window, so its cost grows with the window, not with the clip. Windows start on 17-frame cycles and are legal H3 lengths; the audio is cut at the same moments. Masks and core's H3 Fun ControlNet are cut per window. Feed the patched model to any H3 sampler. Image quality over long clips is not measured yet.

total_frames.tooltip: How long the finished clip should be, in frames at 24 fps. 409 is about 17 seconds. This is the only number you normally set.

window_frames.tooltip: Frames per pass - how much H3 renders at once, which is bounded by VRAM. Snapped up to the nearest legal length (n %% 17 == 5) because a window off the grid does not tile onto the latent rows at all. 141 (about 6 s) is H3 Context Window Sampling's default; 81 fits 8 GB comfortably, 217 gives longer coherent motion if you have the memory.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Shared frames between neighbouring passes - the material the stitch cross-fades over. More overlap buys a softer seam and costs render time, since overlapped frames are generated twice. It is rounded so the stride stays a whole number of 17-frame cycles; otherwise later windows stop sharing the first window's latent structure and cannot be stitched at all.

snap.tooltip: Which way to move window_frames onto the grid. 'up' never drops frames you asked for; 'down' keeps peak VRAM below the length you chose.

output_tooltips: How many passes this plan needs.
Legal window length after snapping - feed this to the sampler, not your raw request.
Frames advanced per pass (window minus overlap).
The full plan: per-window start, end, latent rows and the RoPE start (reference only - nothing applies it).
Plain-English summary, including anything that had to be adjusted and why.
Overlap after snapping (17m + 5) - wire it with window_frames into H3 Context Window Sampling.
MiniMaxH3_ContextWindows.name: MiniMaxH3_ContextWindows
MiniMaxH3_ContextWindows.description:
Plan a long clip as overlapping H3 passes.

H3 will not render an arbitrarily long shot in one go, so length comes from tiling it with windows that overlap and are then stitched. The tiling is not free choice: a legal window is n %% 17 == 5 frames and every window after the first must start on a 17-frame cycle boundary.

The schedule also lists each window's start on H3's 40 Hz temporal RoPE timeline (start_frame * 40/24), for reference only. ComfyUI's H3 builds every pass's positions from its own origin, and no node in this suite shifts them. Positions inside a pass are relative, so a shift would not change how its frames relate to each other. H3 Continuation keeps passes continuous by pinning the previous pass's tail inside the new one instead.

This node does the tiling arithmetic and tells you what it had to change and why. Nothing here touches weights, so it is instant. Its windows are exactly the ones H3 Context Window Sampling uses for the same window / overlap: wire window_frames and overlap_frames into that node to sample with this plan.

samples.tooltip: The sampler's output latent for this segment.

images.tooltip: The decoded frames of the WHOLE segment (VAE Decode of samples).

approval.tooltip: accept unless drift: hold the segment when a drift limit is crossed. accept: always. always ask: hold every segment until H3 Continuation Next's decision.

max_colour_drift.tooltip: Largest colour change (CIE Lab dE of the mean) from segment 0.

min_sharpness.tooltip: Smallest sharpness (Laplacian variance) as a fraction of segment 0.

max_seam_jump.tooltip: Largest change across the seam, in multiples of the clip's usual frame change.

audio.tooltip: The decoded sound of the whole segment.

freeze_tail.tooltip: H3 often ends by freezing on its last image. keep: as is. report: measure it. cut before it: shorten this segment to the longest 17k+5 length that ends before the freeze, so the next segment continues from moving frames.

output_tooltips: The frames this segment added.
The sound this segment added.
Text: pinned-head check, frozen-ending handling, frames added and accept / hold decision, drift and seam metrics, accepted total and session folder.
The session state after this segment.
MiniMaxH3_ContinuationCommit.name: MiniMaxH3_ContinuationCommit
MiniMaxH3_ContinuationCommit.description: Finish a segment started by H3 Continuation Next: check the pinned head came back unchanged, keep only the new frames and sound (cut on the video's global time, so sound never drifts), store the new tail, measure drift against the first segment, and accept the segment, hold it for your approval, or reject it. Accepted frames go to output/h3_continuation/<name>/frames as a numbered 16-bit PNG sequence, the sound to audio/ as one WAV per segment.

session.tooltip: Name of the long video. Its files go to output/h3_continuation/<name>.

positive.tooltip: The segment's conditioning (prompt, references, guides).

latent.tooltip: An empty H3 picture + sound latent of ONE segment (e.g. from Empty MiniMax H3 AV Latent or Reference to Video): it sets the size and the segment length.

overlap_frames.tooltip: Frames of the previous segment the model continues from. 39 keeps sound and picture on the same boundary; 22 / 56 are allowed (the report gives the boundary offset). More = smoother, less new footage per segment.

decision.tooltip: For a segment that Commit held for approval: accept it (it joins the video) or reject it (its frames are generated again). 'keep waiting' stops here.

restart.tooltip: Archive this session (renamed with the date) and start again from frame 0.

video_vae.tooltip: The H3 video VAE - needed with source_video (the plate is encoded per segment).

audio_vae.tooltip: The H3 audio VAE - needed when sound is kept (source sound or soundtrack).

source_video.tooltip: A long plate to EDIT (Load Video). Each segment takes its own frames from it; where source_mask is black the plate is kept. Must have the latent's size.

source_mask.tooltip: The plate's mask as a video (white = regenerate), same length and size as source_video.

control_video.tooltip: A long control video (pose / depth / edges render of the whole film). Each segment's frames come out of segment_control for H3 Mask-Aware ControlNet.

soundtrack.tooltip: A long soundtrack the video follows (sound = keep the soundtrack). The session ends with the soundtrack.

sound.tooltip: generate: the model makes the sound. keep the source video's sound / keep the soundtrack: that sound is held fixed and the picture follows it (lip sync, music). regenerate where masked: the source sound is kept except where the mask covers a frame.

output_tooltips: This segment's latent, with the pinned head.
The conditioning, minus guides inside the pinned head (it is already fixed).
For H3 Continuation Commit.
Text: this segment's frame range and pinned overlap, source / soundtrack / control notes, dropped guides, and frames accepted so far in the session.
This segment's frames of source_video (for an exact composite before Commit). Empty unless source_video is connected.
This segment's frames of source_mask (all white with source_video and no mask). Empty without source_video.
This segment's frames of control_video. Empty unless control_video is connected.
MiniMaxH3_ContinuationNext.name: MiniMaxH3_ContinuationNext
MiniMaxH3_ContinuationNext.description: Start the next segment of a long H3 video. The last frames of the previous ACCEPTED segment are put at the start of this segment as their exact latent tokens and held there by the noise mask, so the model continues the shot instead of restarting it. Wire the latent it outputs to the sampler and the segment output to H3 Continuation Commit. Queue the graph once per segment; the session on disk remembers where it is, survives a restart, and never changes frames it has already accepted. Long inputs (a plate to edit, its mask video, a control video, a soundtrack) are cut to each segment here: only the segment's frames are decoded.

plate.tooltip: Full-size PLATE frames the transform was tracked on. Canny runs here before cropping. Hint frames = min(plate frames, transform boxes); a mismatch is warned in the report.

transform.tooltip: H3_TRANSFORM from H3 Track + Crop. Its per-frame boxes crop the plate-space hints to the H3 canvas, matching the crops exactly.

hint_type.tooltip: canny: torch Canny edges of the plate, then cropped. passthrough: crop the wired plate_hints (any plate-space depth/pose/HED/MLSD image) instead.

low_threshold.tooltip: canny: hysteresis low threshold on gradient magnitude normalised to each frame's maximum (0-1). Weak edges above it are kept only when connected to a strong edge.

high_threshold.tooltip: canny: hysteresis high threshold (same 0-1 per-frame normalised magnitude). Edges above it are always kept; higher = fewer edges.

blur_sigma.tooltip: canny: Gaussian blur sigma in plate pixels applied to the grey image before gradients. Higher = fewer fine/noise edges.

output_tooltips: IMAGE batch at the crop canvas size, one per frame: white edges on black (canny) or the cropped plate_hints. Wire to control_video of Apply MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet or H3 Mask-Aware ControlNet.
Plain-text summary: hint type, crop size, frames, planner mode, and a warning when plate and transform lengths differ.
MiniMaxH3_ControlHints.name: MiniMaxH3_ControlHints
MiniMaxH3_ControlHints.description:
Produce control hints in CROP space using the exact H3_TRANSFORM from Track + Crop (same affine_crop_batch as N1 — never re-detect).

canny: native torch Canny on the plate, warped into crop space.
passthrough: warp externally computed plate_hints (depth/pose/HED/MLSD).

Feed the hints to core's Apply MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet (control_video) or to H3 Mask-Aware ControlNet (control_video), which also respects the latent mask.

exr_sequence.tooltip: Rendered EXR frames to load: a folder (every .exr / .sxr, sorted), a glob such as D:/sim/smoke.*.exr, or one file. Read with OpenImageIO; empty or no match is an error.

sim_type.tooltip: Kind of simulation. Only written as text into retention_json and the report ("<Video 1>: <type> sim reference"); it does not change the frames.

interaction_mode.tooltip: Only written as text into retention_json (the 'camera: <mode>' line) and the report; it does not change the frames.

fps.tooltip: Rate of the external sim, only recorded in retention_json ('timing' line and fps field); frames are not retimed.

output_tooltips: The EXR frames as an IMAGE batch, one per file in sorted order, linear float with values above 1.0 kept (no clamp); 1-channel EXRs become grey RGB.
JSON: video_label <Video 1>, sim_type, interaction_mode, fps and retention_analysis_lines (four text lines: sim, camera, environment, timing).
Text: frames loaded, size, peak value, sim type and mode.
MiniMaxH3_DCCBridge.name: MiniMaxH3_DCCBridge
MiniMaxH3_DCCBridge.description: Ingest externally-rendered EXR sim frames via OpenImageIO (subimage 0 only). Flat RGB or single-channel EXR; >3 channels raises — no silent truncation. HDR values above 1.0 are preserved (16f/32f). No solver — missing EXR raises.

cropped_images.tooltip: Raw decoded crops from the VAE — one per frame, before compositing. Output geometry matches input so you can feed straight into Plate Restore.

original_images.tooltip: Full-resolution plate frames. The bbox region is resized to crop size for measurement — same path Plate Restore uses.

bboxes.tooltip: Subject Crop boxes — one per frame.

grow_px.tooltip: Grow the edit mask before building the preserved ring for MTF measurement. Same semantics as Plate Restore — too large and the ring vanishes.

sharpen.tooltip: How much of the measured MTF correction to apply. 0 = off. Turn down if edges halate or grain doubles up with Detail Reinject.

max_gain.tooltip: Cap per-frequency gain — prevents boosting sensor noise as texture. Lower on noisy plates.

grain.tooltip: How much plate grain to add inside the edit region. 0 = MTF only. Turn down if the composite already looks gritty.

seed.tooltip: Seed for per-frame grain synthesis (deterministic per frame index).

edit_mask.tooltip: Crop-space mask: white = regenerated subject. Defines where MTF and grain are applied. Without it the whole crop is treated as generated.

output_tooltips: Detail-matched crops — same size as input, ready for Plate Restore.
Per-level gains, NLF measurements, grain added.
MiniMaxH3_DetailMatch.name: MiniMaxH3_DetailMatch
MiniMaxH3_DetailMatch.display_name: H3 Detail Match (measured sharpness + plate grain)
MiniMaxH3_DetailMatch.description:
Restore the plate's measured sharpness and grain on decoded crops BEFORE Plate Restore composites them back.

MTF gains are measured on the preserved ring (same evidence as Plate Restore) and normalised so contrast differences are not mistaken for blur. Grain is matched from the plate's noise level function. Wire this between decode and Plate Restore.

plate.tooltip: Original frames whose fine detail (high band: image minus its blur) is transferred. Same size and frame order as generated.

generated.tooltip: Regenerated frames (e.g. H3 Stitch Back output). Their low band (blurred lighting/colour) is kept; outside the mask they pass through. Frames = min(plate, generated).

mode.tooltip: divide: blur(generated) * plate / (blur(plate) + eps), detail as a ratio. subtract: blur(generated) + (plate - blur(plate)), detail as an offset. Identical inputs return unchanged in both.

blur_method.tooltip: Low-pass filter that splits low and high bands: Gaussian or Box (flat average), both with blur_radius.

blur_radius.tooltip: Blur radius in pixels. Detail finer than this comes from the plate; coarser structure stays from generated. Larger = more plate structure transferred.

strength.tooltip: 0-1 mix from generated (0) to the full reinjected result (1) inside the mask.

eps.tooltip: divide mode: added to |blur(plate)| before dividing, to keep near-black areas from blowing up. Larger = weaker detail in very dark regions.

mask.tooltip: Where detail is transferred: 1 = full transfer, 0 = generated unchanged; resized bilinearly to the frame, last frame reused if short. Not wired = the whole frame.

output_tooltips: IMAGE batch (RGB, not clamped), one frame per input pair: generated with the plate's fine detail inside the mask.
Plain-text summary: mode, strength, blur radius, frame count.
MiniMaxH3_DetailReinject.name: MiniMaxH3_DetailReinject
MiniMaxH3_DetailReinject.description:
Transfer plate micro-texture onto the regenerated region so the texture seam dies even when geometry is perfect.

Frequency separation: the region keeps the generated image's own low band (lighting, colour) and takes the plate's fine detail.
divide: blur(generated) * plate/(blur(plate)+eps) (lighting-invariant).
subtract: blur(generated) + (plate - blur(plate)).
An unchanged region comes back unchanged.

Mask-limited with strength 0–1. Exterior pixels are the generated image (mask=0 outside region).

refined_image.tooltip: Sharpened or upscaled result that may have drifted in global colour.

tone_lock.tooltip: How much source low-frequency colour returns. Too low and the still keeps the refiner's colour cast.

refinement_strength.tooltip: How much refined detail is mixed in. Too high drifts identity.

detail_radius.tooltip: Separates broad tone from fine detail in pixels.

output_tooltips: IMAGE at the source's size and frame count: source + refinement_strength × (refined detail with the source's blurred tone put back), clamped 0-1.
Text summary: source size and the tone_lock, refinement_strength and detail_radius used.
MiniMaxH3_DetailToneLock.name: MiniMaxH3_DetailToneLock
MiniMaxH3_DetailToneLock.description: After a detail-refinement pass, restore the source's broad lighting and colour while keeping sharpened micro-detail.

model.tooltip: MODEL to patch. Cloned; its denoise-mask function is replaced so every step thresholds the latent noise_mask with a soft ramp. Needs a noise_mask on the latent to have any effect.

softness.tooltip:
Ramp width in mask-value units.

0 = hard threshold, identical to stock differential diffusion.
0.15-0.3 = a soft edge that tracks your mask's own feather; the useful range for video.
1 = no schedule at all, blends by the raw mask.

strength.tooltip: Blend the scheduled mask back toward the raw one. 1 = full schedule, 0 = ignore the schedule entirely. Dial down when the schedule is fighting the composite.

output_tooltips: Clone of the model with the soft-edge per-step mask function installed. Wire it to the sampler with a masked latent.
One line: what the chosen softness does and the strength used.
MiniMaxH3_DifferentialDenoise.name: MiniMaxH3_DifferentialDenoise
MiniMaxH3_DifferentialDenoise.description:
Differential diffusion whose PER-STEP masks keep a soft edge instead of the usual hard binary threshold.

Stock differential diffusion thresholds your greyscale mask at every step, so however carefully you feathered it, each intermediate mask is razor sharp. On video that edge lands on a different pixel each frame and crawls. This ramps instead, and because a ramp of width w in mask-VALUE space spans w/|gradient| in PIXEL space, the softness follows the blur already in your mask: feathered stays feathered, sharp stays sharp. No spatial blur, so it stays temporally stable.

clip.tooltip: Qwen3-VL-32B MiniMax text encoder (CLIPLoader type 'minimax').

vae.tooltip: minimax_h3_video_vae — encodes keyframes and references.

start_second.tooltip: Start of the render window, in seconds.

end_second.tooltip: End of the render window, in seconds.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Render length in seconds. Snapped up to H3's 17k+5 frame grid at 24 fps.

start_frame.tooltip: Start of the render window, in timeline frames.

end_frame.tooltip: End of the render window, in timeline frames.

duration_frames.tooltip: Render length in timeline frames (at the timeline's frame_rate).

timeline_data.tooltip: JSON state of the timeline editor (auto-managed; do not edit by hand).

segment_lengths.tooltip: Auto-populated from the timeline editor (pixel-space frame counts).

guide_strength.tooltip: Auto-populated from the timeline editor. H3 has no per-keyframe strength, so it is ignored.

model.tooltip: The fl2va weights (minimax_h3_fl2va_*), used when the toolbar is on 'Refs OFF'. Connect both models and the node loads whichever the toolbar switch calls for — the other one is never read from disk.

model_ref2va.tooltip: The ref2va weights (minimax_h3_ref2va_*), used when the toolbar is on 'Refs ON'. Optional — with only one model connected that one is used either way.

audio_vae.tooltip: minimax_h3_audio_vae. Only needed when audio references are used (ref2va).

global_prompt.tooltip: Conditions the whole video: style, scene, characters. Written above the storyboard.

use_custom_audio.tooltip: ON: timeline audio clips are used as <Audio j> references (ref2va). The mixdown is always available on combined_audio regardless.

use_custom_motion.tooltip: ON: the reference-video track feeds <Video k> references (ref2va).

inpaint_audio.tooltip: Unused on H3 — audio is generated jointly with the video and cannot be inpainted.

frame_rate.tooltip: Timeline editing rate. Output is always 24 fps; times are converted via seconds.

display_mode.tooltip: Show the ruler and segment ranges in frames or seconds.

custom_width.tooltip: Output width. With height set too this is a BOX: 'maintain aspect ratio' keeps the first image's aspect inside it. 0 = derive from the image.

custom_height.tooltip: Output height. See custom_width.

resize_method.tooltip: How timeline images are fitted to the output canvas.

divisible_by.tooltip: Snap output dimensions to this multiple. H3 needs 32.

img_compression.tooltip: H.264 CRF baked into each keyframe. 0 = off (recommended for H3).

override_audio.tooltip: Use the reference video's own soundtrack as the timeline audio.

ref_image_size.tooltip: ref2va only. 'match' scales references to the output pixel area (fast); 'max' keeps a 2048 px short edge for identity, at real speed cost.

ref_images.tooltip: Extra <Picture i> references (single image or batch), appended after the character slots. ref2va only.

ref_image_notes.tooltip: One line per image on 'ref_images', describing what it is: 'the kitchen set', 'a storyboard reference for the opening'. Without a line the picture is still numbered but the prompt says nothing about it. Blank lines count, so line 3 always belongs to the third image.

duration.tooltip: Automation (connection-only). Render length in SECONDS.

width.tooltip: Automation (connection-only). Output width in pixels, overriding the settings panel's Width. Wire a resolution node here; leave it unconnected to use the panel.

height.tooltip: Automation (connection-only). Output height. See width.

output_tooltips: The checkpoint the toolbar path needs (ref2va with Refs ON, fl2va with Refs OFF; the other one if only one is connected) with shift_video / shift_audio applied. Wire to the guider.
The compiled prompt encoded by core H3 Reference To Video (Refs ON) or H3 Image To Video (Refs OFF), with the reference / keyframe images attached. Wire to the guider.
Joint video+audio latent. Wire to SamplerCustomAdvanced.
Timeline audio mixdown. Wire into CreateVideo to replace the generated audio.
Always 24.0 — H3's native output rate. Wire into CreateVideo.
The resolved output width in pixels (after the canvas box, resize and divisible_by snapping).
The resolved output height in pixels (see width).
Frame count actually generated (snapped to the 17k+5 grid).
The compiled storyboard prompt that was encoded.
JSON describing the retake window. Wire into MiniMax H3 Retake Stitch to splice the result back into the base video. Empty when retake is off.
MiniMaxH3_Director.name: MiniMaxH3_Director
MiniMaxH3_Director.description: Visual timeline for MiniMax H3. Segments become a storyboard prompt with [0s-1.5s] shot markers, timeline images become first/last keyframes (fl2va) or <Picture i> references (ref2va), the reference-video track becomes <Video k>, and audio clips become <Audio j> plus a muxable audio output. Retake Mode regenerates a marked range of a base video between its own surrounding frames.

mode.tooltip: Reference (Omni): each chunk runs core MiniMax H3 Reference To Video with the timeline's character/background images, reference videos and audios. First/Last Frame: each chunk runs H3 Image To Video; timeline Ref 1 = first frame of chunk 1, Ref 2 = last frame of the last chunk.
mode.default: Reference (Omni) — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio

model.tooltip: The H3 model (Reference / ref2va checkpoint). Sigma-shifted with shift_video / shift_audio, then sampled; also the fallback for First/Last Frame mode when model_fl2va is not connected.

clip.tooltip: H3's text encoder: encodes each chunk's compiled prompt.

vae.tooltip: H3's video VAE: encodes the reference / keyframe images and decodes every chunk's video latent to frames.

audio_vae.tooltip: Needed for final audio decode in both modes — H3 always builds a joint audio+video latent internally, even in First/Last Frame mode.

aspect_ratio.tooltip: Output aspect ratio (core Resolution Selector list). With megapixels and multiple it sets the output width x height; every reference / frame image is fitted to it.

megapixels.tooltip: Output pixel area in megapixels (x 1024 x 1024 pixels), split by aspect_ratio; width and height are then rounded to multiple.

multiple.tooltip: Width and height are rounded to a multiple of this many pixels (same formula as core Resolution Selector).

resize_method.tooltip: How every character/background reference image and First/Last Frame image gets fit to the output resolution when its own aspect ratio doesn't match. 'crop' scales up and center-crops the excess (no distortion, may crop the edges of a person/scene). 'pad' scales down to fit entirely within the frame and adds black bars (nothing cropped, but the bars become visible reference content). 'stretch' resizes directly, distorting proportions.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Total length of the finished video. Automatically split into multiple H3 generation calls if longer than chunk_duration_seconds, stitched together.

chunk_duration_seconds.tooltip: Length of each individual H3 call. H3's own trained range tops out around 15s per call — longer totals get split into chunks this long (the final chunk absorbs whatever's left over, so it may be shorter). Reference mode: each continuation chunk is fed the previous chunk's own last few frames and last few seconds of audio as reference video/audio, plus an explicit instruction to continue seamlessly rather than cut. First/Last Frame mode: continuation falls back to the previous chunk's last frame only.

ref_image_size.tooltip: 'match' scales references down to the generation's pixel area (faster). 'max' keeps up to a 2048px short edge for stronger identity fidelity, but reference tokens ride every sampling step so it's several times slower. Reference (Omni) mode only.

mode: Reference (Omni) — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio

hybrid_continuation.tooltip: Reference (Omni) mode only, needs model_fl2va connected. Reference mode's own carry-over (ref_video/ref_audio) is a soft reference, not a hard lock — H3 can still cut to a new composition at a chunk boundary despite it. When this is on, continuation chunks (2nd onward) switch to a hard-locked first-frame anchor instead: the exact last frame of the previous chunk, via the separate First/Last-Frame checkpoint's real keyframe-lock mechanism. The first chunk always runs Reference (Omni) normally, so character/background images still establish identity — continuation chunks just don't get fresh reference-image reinforcement after that (the anchor frame itself already carries the correct likeness forward, since it's real output from the reference-anchored first chunk, not a blank start).

mode: Reference (Omni) — up to 9 images, 3 videos, 3 audio

seed.tooltip: Noise seed of the first chunk; chunk N uses seed + N - 1.

steps.tooltip: Sampling steps per chunk (core BasicScheduler, denoise 1.0).

sampler_name.tooltip: Core sampler used for every chunk (KSamplerSelect + SamplerCustomAdvanced).

scheduler.tooltip: Core sigma schedule for every chunk (BasicScheduler) on the shifted model.

shift_video.tooltip: H3 video flow shift (core ModelSamplingMiniMaxH3): sets the sampler's sigma schedule. Applied to model and model_fl2va.

shift_audio.tooltip: H3 audio flow shift (core ModelSamplingMiniMaxH3), handed to the model to derive the audio schedule. Applied to model and model_fl2va.

prompt.tooltip: What the video is. Used when the timeline has no shots of its own - then the whole duration is one shot described by this. With a timeline loaded the timeline's own shots win and this is ignored.

timeline_data.tooltip: Raw timeline JSON: characters, segments (shots), background, style_line, refVideos, refAudios, soundscape / music, dialogue_language. Files it names are read from ComfyUI's input folder. '{}' (or invalid JSON) = no timeline: the prompt input becomes the single shot.

model_fl2va.tooltip: The separate First/Last-Frame checkpoint (not the same weights as the main Reference/Omni model input) — load it via its own loader. Used whenever a First/Last-Frame-style generation actually happens: First/Last Frame mode itself, and Hybrid Continuation's chunk-to-chunk lock while in Reference mode. If left unconnected, First/Last Frame mode falls back to the main model input instead — which should normally hold the Reference/ref2va checkpoint, not this one, so results may be degraded.

output_tooltips: IMAGE batch: every chunk's decoded frames joined in order (24 fps; each chunk is snapped to H3's 17n+5 frame grid).
AUDIO: every chunk's decoded soundtrack (audio_vae) joined in order.
The prompt each chunk was generated from, under '--- Chunk i/N (~s) ---' headers.
MiniMaxH3_DirectorAllInOne.name: MiniMaxH3_DirectorAllInOne
MiniMaxH3_DirectorAllInOne.description: Runs the whole H3 pipeline internally and hands back finished frames and audio. The reason to have this as well as the Director next to it: H3 is only reliable to about 15s per call, and this CHUNKS - anything longer is split, with each continuation chunk seeded from the previous chunk's own last frames and last seconds of audio so it continues rather than cuts.

original.tooltip: The source plate frames; compared frame by frame with 'edited' (the shorter batch sets the frame count).

edited.tooltip: The edited / generated frames, same size as 'original'.

edit_mask.tooltip: MASK, 1 = edited region (ignored); drift is averaged over the pixels outside it. One mask or one per frame.

threshold_px.tooltip: Pass limit in pixels for the PEAK per-frame mean exterior drift (RAFT-small flow magnitude). Keep >= 0.25: below that it measures the estimator's noise and bias.

source_subject_mask.tooltip: Mask of the subject in the SOURCE frames (optional). With the output's subject mask it measures where the new subject sits against the old one.

output_subject_mask.tooltip: Mask of the subject in the EDITED frames, from any segmenter run on them (e.g. the same points / prompt as the source mask).

bboxes.tooltip: Optional crop boxes (Subject Crop) when the masks are crop-sized: the placement is then also given in original-plate pixels.

output_tooltips: JSON {"drift_px": [...]}: mean flow magnitude in pixels outside the edit mask, one value per frame.
IMAGE batch, one per frame: flow magnitude in pixels (grey, not normalised; 0 inside the edit mask).
True when the peak per-frame drift is <= threshold_px.
Text: peak drift, threshold, frame count, PASS / FAIL (starts with 'FAILED' on failure), plus subject placement when the subject masks are wired.
Subject placement per frame and summary (empty when the subject masks are not wired).
MiniMaxH3_DriftQC.name: MiniMaxH3_DriftQC
MiniMaxH3_DriftQC.description: Measure pixel displacement OUTSIDE the edit mask only (RAFT-small, CPU). Calibration gate: synthetic shifts 0/0.5/1/2 px should read within ±0.25 px.

model.tooltip: H3 model to inspect for core's native ModelSamplingAV (coupled video/audio sigma schedule). It is not modified.

output_tooltips: The input model, passed through unchanged (no patch is applied).
Plain-text note: whether native ModelSamplingAV was found, and if not, that legacy dual-clock stepping lives in H3 Turbo Sampler.
MiniMaxH3_DualClockShim.name: MiniMaxH3_DualClockShim
MiniMaxH3_DualClockShim.description:
Detect whether this MODEL uses ComfyUI's native ModelSamplingAV (single coupled video/audio σ schedule). When native AV is present, passes MODEL through unchanged. When absent, documents the legacy dual-clock path in MiniMaxH3_TurboSampler without fabricating a stepping implementation here.

DEPRECATED (C2C L9.39): every supported core build has native ModelSamplingAV (core bdcb886), so this only reports and passes the model through. It still loads in saved workflows; remove it, or use H3 Sigma Presets to see the audio clock.

prompt.tooltip: The six-section H3 prompt to check: bare labels subject_definitions:, summary: ([task type] prefix), retention_analysis: (one 'label: marker - text' line per subject), detailed_description:, overall_soundscape:, non_diegetic_music:, in that order; no ## headers.

pipeline_notes.tooltip: JSON object (empty = none). Checked keys: mask_required (true needs a region_mask that is not the whole frame), frame_count (must be 17k + 5), guidance_scale (must be 1.0). Invalid JSON fails the gate.

region_mask.tooltip: The edit region (1 = edited). Only checked when pipeline_notes has mask_required: true - then it must exist and its first frame must not cover the whole frame.

drift_report.tooltip: Tracking drift text or JSON: 'peak' and 'threshold' numbers are read (or peak = max of drift_px / drift_per_frame); peak above threshold (pixels) fails the gate.

on_fail.tooltip: report only: the verdict shows on the node and in the outputs. stop the run: a failure stops the queue - put this gate BEFORE your Save (wire the passthrough output) and nothing failing is saved.

output_tooltips: True when every pre-flight check passed; False lists issues in report.
Text: one bullet per issue found, or 'All pre-flight checks passed.' Also shown on the node.
The validated prompt, unchanged: wire it into the text encoder so a failed check (stop the run) stops first.
MiniMaxH3_EditValidator.name: MiniMaxH3_EditValidator
MiniMaxH3_EditValidator.description: Pre-flight gate (#8): validates six-section prompt, pipeline_notes, optional region_mask and drift_report. gate=False lists all issues; with on_fail = stop the run it stops the queue instead.

idea.tooltip: What you want, in plain words. The vision model turns this plus the images into a MiniMax-shaped prompt.

preset.tooltip: 'global' writes scene, style, subjects and lighting and leaves the shots to your timeline. 'storyboard' writes the whole shot sequence with timestamps — use it only when your timeline segments carry no prompt text, or the two shot numberings will collide.

images.tooltip: Up to 9 reference images. They are described by the vision model and passed straight through to ref_images.

image.tooltip: A reference image. A new socket appears as you connect; disconnecting closes the gap.

system_prompt.tooltip: Overrides the built-in instructions. Leave empty to use the preset's own, which is derived from MiniMax's prompt-writing guide.

duration_seconds.tooltip: Told to the model so its timestamps fit. Match the Director's duration.

base_url.tooltip: Empty = the provider's default (Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434, LM Studio http://127.0.0.1:1234). http:// is added if you leave it off. No path — just host and port.

model.tooltip: Model name. Must be a VISION model — a text-only model will ignore your images without saying so. Empty falls back to the provider default.

seed.tooltip: Sent to the model, so the same seed and inputs give the same answer (servers that ignore seeds just ignore it). ComfyUI caches node outputs: change it to get a fresh answer.

max_image_size.tooltip: Long edge the images are downscaled to before they are sent. Larger costs time and buys little.

max_words.tooltip: Hard limit on the description. MiniMax's guide puts a detailed_description at 350-500 words; small models ignore that when asked politely, so the request is capped and the result trimmed to a sentence end. 0 disables both.

unload_after.tooltip: Drop the vision model from VRAM when done, so it is not still resident while H3 samples. Turn off only while iterating on prompts — reloading costs seconds, an OOM costs the render. Works with Ollama, and with llama-server in router mode. A plain llama-server or LM Studio cannot be told to let go over HTTP — give those an idle timeout of their own (llama.cpp: --sleep-idle-seconds N).

on_error.tooltip: 'passthrough' hands your raw idea on and warns, so a stopped Ollama does not kill the whole run.

api_key_env.tooltip: Name of an ENVIRONMENT VARIABLE holding the API key for a cloud endpoint — not the key itself. Widget values are saved inside the workflow, so a key typed here would travel with every copy you share. Empty falls back to MINIMAX_DIRECTOR_VLM_API_KEY, then OPENAI_API_KEY. Local Ollama and LM Studio need none.

output_tooltips: Wire into the Director's global_prompt.
The same images, batched. Wire into the Director's ref_images.
The duration you set above, passed on so you only type it once. Wire into the Director's `duration` input (the connection-only one, in seconds).
MiniMaxH3_EnhancePrompt.name: MiniMaxH3_EnhancePrompt
