device.tooltip: auto: ComfyUI's device (CUDA, ROCm or XPU).

chunk_latent_steps.tooltip: 0: the whole clip in one pass (reference). > 0: chunks of this many latent steps, cross-faded; less VRAM, approximate.

output_tooltips: The upscaled latent, same kind as the input (video or audio + video, audio passed through), on the computed grid (e.g. 1920x1088 px for 2k). Wire to Refine Latent.
KEPT output width in px after Finish Frames' crop (e.g. 1920 for 2k; the latent grid itself may be larger).
KEPT output height in px after Finish Frames' crop (1080 for a 1088-row grid, 2160 for 2176).
Text: source and target sizes, planned passes and each upscaler pass's own report.
MiniMaxH3_OpenRegenUpscale.name: MiniMaxH3_OpenRegenUpscale
MiniMaxH3_OpenRegenUpscale.description: The trained H3 3D latent upscaler (the Suite's engine) straight onto the regenerate target grid, no decode / re-encode. 4K runs two passes (to 2K, then 4K) so each stays within the trained range. width / height = the KEPT size (1080 for a 1088-row grid, 2160 for 2176). Ported from rdh9616/ComfyUI-Open-H3-Regenerate (Apache-2.0); fast decoder by NVIDIA (Apache-2.0).

video_latent.tooltip: H3 video latent [1, 24, T, h, w]; T must be 5k+2 latent frames (17k+5 frames). Batch 1 only. Its noise mask, if any, is kept.

audio_latent.tooltip: H3 audio latent [1, 32, 2, T] whose length must match the video's frames (40 audio latents per second). Its noise mask, if any, is kept.

output_tooltips: Joint AV latent (NestedTensor video, audio). When either input had a noise mask, a mask pair (missing one = all 1).
MiniMaxH3_PackAV.name: MiniMaxH3_PackAV
MiniMaxH3_PackAV.description:
Combine a separate video latent and audio latent into the single joint AV latent H3 samples.

H3 denoises picture and sound together, so they travel as one NestedTensor. Each stream keeps its own noise mask, which is what lets you pin one and regenerate the other.

av_latent.tooltip: H3 audio+video LATENT (nested video/audio samples). An existing noise_mask is kept: its video part is multiplied by the per-frame strength, its audio part is left as is.

transform.tooltip: H3_TRANSFORM from a face track/crop node. Face height per frame = crop box height / crop_factor (pixels); errors if it has no boxes.

strength_small_face.tooltip: Denoise strength (noise_mask value, 0-1) for frames whose face is at or below the small end of the ramp. 0 = keep those frames unchanged.

strength_large_face.tooltip: Denoise strength (0-1) for frames whose face is at or above the large end of the ramp. Faces in between are interpolated.

scale_mode.tooltip: Ramp ends. absolute_px = face_px_small to face_px_large; relative_to_clip = the smallest to the largest face height in this clip.

face_px_small.tooltip: Face height in source pixels at or below which strength_small_face applies (absolute_px only).

face_px_large.tooltip: Face height in source pixels at or above which strength_large_face applies (absolute_px only).

gamma.tooltip: Curve shape of the small-to-large ramp: position^gamma. 1 = linear; above 1 keeps strength near strength_small_face for longer; below 1 drops it sooner.

smooth_frames.tooltip: Gaussian smoothing window over frames for the strength curve (odd, capped at the clip length). 1 = no smoothing.

output_tooltips: Same latent with a noise_mask whose video part holds the per-frame strength (resampled to latent frames). Without an incoming mask the audio part is 0 (audio kept). Wire to the sampler.
Text: face height range, ramp ends, strength range and mean, frame and latent-frame counts, gamma.
MiniMaxH3_PerFrameDenoise.name: MiniMaxH3_PerFrameDenoise
MiniMaxH3_PerFrameDenoise.description: Scale denoise per latent frame inversely to face size (small face → stronger). Uses noise_mask on the video stream; preserves audio-side zeros from N4 lipsync lock. Place after N4 Masked Replace. One sigma schedule, per-frame strength via noise_mask.

images.tooltip: Frames to clean — usually after Reference Colour Match.

impulse.tooltip: Salt-and-snow sensitivity. Higher = more aggressive. Turn down if fine sparkle on the plate is being erased.

blotch.tooltip: Chroma blotch pull-back (red cheeks, colour specks). Higher = stronger. Turn down if legitimate blush or makeup is being flattened.

debug.tooltip: Include extra per-frame counts in the report JSON.

mask.tooltip: Restrict repairs to this region. Default: whole frame. Use to spare a deliberate effect area.

output_tooltips: The frames with detected impulse snow and chroma blotches repaired (inside 'mask' when wired); same size and frame count.
Union of impulse and blotch damage detected per frame.
JSON (per-frame impulse / blotch pixel counts) followed by a one-line summary: frames, impulse, blotch, total damage pixels.
MiniMaxH3_PixelRepair.name: MiniMaxH3_PixelRepair
MiniMaxH3_PixelRepair.display_name: H3 Pixel Repair (snow · specks · colour blotches)
MiniMaxH3_PixelRepair.description:
Clean impulse snow and local chroma blotches after colour matching.

Impulse repair uses a motion guard so real detail on moving clips is never touched. Blotch repair works in Oklab and leaves lightness alone.

cropped_images.tooltip: Generated crops from the decoder, one per frame. Must match the Subject Crop output size. If these drift in colour or position from the plate, registration and colour run on the preserved ring before compositing.

original_images.tooltip: The untouched plate frames at full resolution. Pixels outside the composite alpha are copied bit-exact from here — this is what restores grain and sharpness the VAE destroyed.

bboxes.tooltip: Crop boxes from Subject Crop (one per frame). Wrong boxes misalign the paste and make registration fail.

grow_px.tooltip: Grow the edit mask before building the preserved ring used for shift/colour measurement. Too small: ring sits on the seam. Too large: not enough pixels for a stable fit.

feather_px.tooltip: Gaussian feather width for the edit mask at composite time. Controls how softly the generated region blends into the plate.

register.tooltip: Spatial alignment on the preserved ring. off: skip. measure: report shift only. correct: warp the generated crop when shift is within max_shift_px; larger shifts are refused. mesh (experimental): a smooth warp per frame fitted on the background around the edit, for generations that squeeze or drift unevenly (unmeasured on H3 output).

max_shift_px.tooltip: Maximum sub-pixel shift applied in correct mode. Shifts above this are measured but not applied — check the report if the plate still looks offset.

colour.tooltip: Colour match on the preserved ring in linear light. affine: full 3×4 fit (falls back to mean if ill-conditioned). mean: per-channel offset only. off: skip.

temporal_lag_check.tooltip: Report frame-index lag between plate and generated crops (−3…+3). Non-zero lag usually means a frame-count bug upstream — this node never retimes, it only warns.

cast_matte.tooltip: Character swap: also composite where the new cast reaches past the edit mask (bigger hair, a wider costume) - where the aligned crop differs from the plate, next to the edit. Off keeps the composite inside the edit mask.

cast_reach.tooltip: How far past the edit mask the cast may reach, as a share of the crop height.

edit_mask.tooltip: Crop-space mask: white = regenerated subject, black = preserved plate. If omitted, the entire crop is treated as regenerated (same as Subject Uncrop without cropped_masks) and the report warns loudly.

output_tooltips: Full frames with restored composite.
The alpha actually used at composite time (full frame).
JSON measurements plus a one-paragraph summary.
MiniMaxH3_PlateRestore.name: MiniMaxH3_PlateRestore
MiniMaxH3_PlateRestore.display_name: H3 Plate Restore (offset · colour · clean plate)
MiniMaxH3_PlateRestore.description:
Paste decoded crops back onto the plate with sub-pixel registration, linear-light colour matching on the preserved ring, and a composite that keeps literal plate pixels everywhere the edit mask is off.

Superset of Subject Uncrop: wire cropped_masks / edit_mask so background inside the crop is not re-diffused.

driving_pose.tooltip: Pose hints IMAGE from N8 StrongestPose.

character_ref.tooltip: Sets the output size; blended under the pose except with pose_only.

rig_type.tooltip: pose_only = the clean pose, for a pose ControlNet. human_to_creature / stick_figure / mocap_data = the pose blended over character_ref (a preview), not a retarget.

keypoints_json.tooltip: Optional keypoints_json from H3 Strongest Pose. Its skeleton (points with confidence >= 0.3) is drawn at 70% over the hints in every rig type, at the given pixel coordinates - not rescaled to character_ref's size.

output_tooltips: IMAGE batch at character_ref's size, frames = the longer of the two inputs (a single image is repeated): the pose, or the pose blended over the plate per rig_type.
Plain-text motion package: rig type, frame count, whether keypoints were attached, blend used. Descriptive only; nothing reads it automatically.
Plain-text summary: rig type, frame count, output size, and where to wire the hints.
MiniMaxH3_PosePuppeteer.name: MiniMaxH3_PosePuppeteer
MiniMaxH3_PosePuppeteer.description: Package N8 driving pose as motion_hints + motion_text (#61), sized to the character plate. rig_type pose_only gives the clean pose (plus a skeleton drawn from keypoints_json): wire it into control_video of Apply MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet. The other rig types blend the pose over the character plate (a preview); none retargets bones to the character. Does not drive generation by itself.

source_av.tooltip: The PREVIOUS segment's AV latent. Its tail becomes the new segment's opening context.

length.tooltip: Frames for the new segment. Snapped to H3's grid (n % 17 == 5); use Context Windows to choose this so it matches the rest of the plan.

overlap_frames.tooltip: How much of the previous tail to pin. Snapped DOWN to the 17k+5 grid. This is the same number Stitch Continuation and Tone Compensate need - keep all three in agreement or the seam lands in the wrong place.

video_context_denoise.tooltip: How much the pinned video context may change. 0 holds it exactly, which is what makes the join invisible. Raise it only if the pinned frames are fighting the new prompt.

audio_context_denoise.tooltip: The same for audio. Keep at 0 unless the audio seam is audibly repeating.

output_tooltips: Sample this, then Stitch Continuation.
Frames after grid snapping.
Overlap after snapping - feed THIS to Stitch Continuation, not your requested value.
actual_overlap_frames / 24, in seconds.
Text: frames, pinned overlap and source length, context denoise values, and a note when the overlap was snapped.
MiniMaxH3_PrepareContinuation.name: MiniMaxH3_PrepareContinuation
MiniMaxH3_PrepareContinuation.description:
Build the NEXT segment's latent with the previous segment's tail pinned at its start, so the model continues a shot instead of starting a new one.

Audio and video are pinned together: H3 samples them jointly, so a continuation that carries only the picture drifts out of sync. Sample the result, then join it with Stitch Continuation.

model.tooltip: Model to attach the preview to.

decode.tooltip: latent2rgb is a single matmul — effectively free, rough colours. vae is the real decoder: true colours, but it costs real time per preview, so raise every_n_steps with it.

preview_target.tooltip: Where the preview appears: on this node, in the sampler's usual preview slot (needs VideoHelperSuite), or both.

max_resolution.tooltip: Long edge of the preview image. With latent2rgb the source is latent-sized (a 1344x768 shot is an 84x48 grid), so this upscales — smooth, but soft. Use decode='vae (quality)' when you need to judge detail.

preview_frames.tooltip: How many frames of the shot to show. Frames are thinned evenly, so this caps the cost without cropping the timeline.

preview_fps.tooltip: The shot's own frame rate — 24 for H3. FLOAT so the Director's 'fps' output can be wired straight in. Whether the preview actually plays at this rate depends on 'playback'; with 'true speed' it is a ceiling, not a promise.

vae.tooltip: minimax_h3_video_vae. Only needed for decode='vae (quality)'.

webp_quality.tooltip: WebP quality of the animation sent to the node.

every_n_steps.tooltip: Never preview more often than every N sampler steps.

max_preview_overhead.tooltip: Cap on how much of the render time previews may use, in percent. A full VAE decode can cost tens of seconds per preview; this spaces them out automatically instead of stalling the run. 0 disables the cap.

suppress_default_preview.tooltip: Hide ComfyUI's built-in single-frame preview while this runs.

playback.tooltip: 'true speed' spreads the sampled frames across the shot's real duration, so the preview lasts exactly as long as the finished clip — but with latent2rgb that caps at preview_fps / 3.35, because there is one image per latent frame and H3 compresses time by that much. 'source fps' plays them at preview_fps flat, like ComfyUI's own preview: motion reads at normal speed, the clip ends early. Judge timing with the first, movement with the second.

output_tooltips: Model with the preview attached.
MiniMaxH3_PreviewOverride.name: MiniMaxH3_PreviewOverride
MiniMaxH3_PreviewOverride.description: Live preview of the whole shot while it denoises, shown on this node. Core previews only ever draw the first latent frame; MiniMax H3's packed audio+video latent also has to be unpacked first, which the LTX preview nodes do not do. Wire between the Director's model output and the sampler.

mode.tooltip: H3 task. With the text empty, the output is this mode's scaffold.

_composer_prompt.tooltip: Your prompt. Empty = the selected mode's scaffold is output.

output_tooltips: Your text trimmed of outer spaces, or the selected mode's scaffold when the text is empty; also shown on the node.
MiniMaxH3_PromptComposer.name: MiniMaxH3_PromptComposer
MiniMaxH3_PromptComposer.description: Write an H3 prompt by hand. Leave the text empty and the node returns the scaffold for the selected mode (shot list, soundscape, music sections, the reference tags that mode needs) - fill it in and run again.

prompt.tooltip: A wired prompt (e.g. the Promptor's PROMPT). It is the output unless use_edited_text is on and the box has text; when it is empty the box text is used.

use_edited_text.tooltip: Off: a wired prompt wins, and after each run the box shows the prompt that was used. On: the text in the box wins - typing in the box turns this on. Turn it off to take a regenerated prompt again.

output_tooltips: The chosen prompt (wired or edited, see use_edited_text), trimmed of outer spaces; also shown on the node.
MiniMaxH3_PromptEditor.name: MiniMaxH3_PromptEditor
MiniMaxH3_PromptEditor.description: Shows the prompt that reaches H3 and lets you edit it: a wired PROMPT wins until you edit the text (use_edited_text).

family.tooltip: The H3 task. Its H3 Family Presets template fixes the reference roles (<Video 1> = the plate, <Picture 1> = the character).

brief.tooltip: What you want, in plain words: look, light, mood, what the character does. Only what the brief says is described - nothing is invented.

subject_name.tooltip: How <Subject 1> is named in the family template's sentences (e.g. '<Subject 1> is the character ...'); also given to the LLM. Blank = 'primary subject'.

head_size_mode.tooltip: Same as on H3 Subject Crop / H3 Family Presets.

face_closeup_reference.tooltip: A face crop of the character is wired as ref_image_1 (<Picture 2>).

backend.tooltip: template (no LLM): deterministic, offline. The others run OUTSIDE ComfyUI and are reached over HTTP - a crashing model server cannot take ComfyUI down. llama.cpp: run llama-server and pick 'openai-compatible server'.

base_url.tooltip: Blank = the backend's default (Ollama http://127.0.0.1:11434, llama-server http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1).

model.tooltip: Blank = the server's first model (Ollama, OpenAI-compatible). Cloud APIs need a model name.

api_key_env.tooltip: The NAME of the environment variable that holds the API key (blank = ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY). The key itself is never stored in the workflow.

timeout_s.tooltip: Seconds to wait for one HTTP request to the backend before it counts as failed (then retries, then on_failure).

retries.tooltip: Extra attempts after a timeout, 429 or 5xx (1 s, 2 s apart).

temperature.tooltip: Sampling temperature sent to the LLM backend (0 = most repeatable).

max_tokens.tooltip: Most tokens the LLM backend may reply with (its JSON of descriptive fields).

on_failure.tooltip: What to do when the backend fails: use the deterministic template (the report says why) or stop the run with the reason.

output_tooltips: The structured H3 prompt: the family's template sections filled from the 8-field plan (LLM-refined fields where the backend succeeded).
The 8-field plan as JSON, with where each field came from.
Text report: backend used and time, HTTP log, which fields came from the LLM, repairs and problems, and why the template was used on a failure (API keys removed).
MiniMaxH3_PromptWriter.name: MiniMaxH3_PromptWriter
MiniMaxH3_PromptWriter.description: Writes the structured H3 prompt for a task from a plain-language brief. 'template (no LLM)' is deterministic and needs no model; an LLM backend (Ollama, an OpenAI-compatible server such as llama-server or LM Studio, or a cloud API) refines the descriptive fields over HTTP. Any failure falls back to the template and the report says why. For mode-based prompts that look at connected images, video and audio, use H3 Prompt Writer.

task_type.tooltip: Task format for MiniMax H3 or Auto detection from vision context.

duration.tooltip: Target clip length in seconds. Given to the LLM for shot timing; LENGTH is this at 24 fps snapped up to H3's 17n+5 frame grid.

vision_context.tooltip: Connect VISION_CONTEXT from MiniMax H3 Vision.

reference_images.tooltip: How many reference pictures (<Picture N> tags) the prompt uses. Auto = 0, so vision_context decides; a number is a minimum (the larger of it and vision_context's count). Also feeds task detection when task_type = Auto.

reference_videos.tooltip: Any number marks a reference video as present (<Video 1> tag, task detection); the count itself is not used further. Auto: only vision_context decides.

reference_audios.tooltip: Any number marks a reference audio as present (<Audio 1> tag, task detection); the count itself is not used further. Auto: only vision_context decides.

output_language.tooltip: Language the LLM writes the prompt in.

provider.tooltip: LLM provider from the Promptor config.json (enabled entries, 'name (model)'). Called twice per run (blueprint, then storyboard): a cloud API provider sends the text over the network; ollama / local run on this machine.

temperature.tooltip: Sampling temperature of both LLM calls (0 = most repeatable).

max_tokens.tooltip: Upper limit on the tokens each of the two LLM calls may return.

output_tooltips: The H3 structured prompt after both LLM stages and clean-up (subject definitions, alignment line). On an LLM failure: the error text.
The duration input in seconds, unchanged.
Frame count: duration x 24 fps snapped up to H3's 17n+5 grid (5 s -> 124 frames). Wire to the video length.
MiniMaxH3_Promptor.name: MiniMaxH3_Promptor
MiniMaxH3_Promptor.description: Two-stage director pipeline for MiniMax H3 structured prompts. Ported from Comfyui-Minimax-H3-Promptor (1038lab, GPL-3.0).

references.tooltip: The anchor and/or the character's references.

reference_masks.tooltip: The person in each reference, one mask per image.

model.tooltip: SAM 3 / 3.1 MODEL.

clip.tooltip: SAM 3 / 3.1 CLIP: encodes each prop's name.

props.tooltip: The props to look for, comma-separated.

prompt.tooltip: The take's prompt: a prop named in it counts too.

locked_props.tooltip: Props that are wanted: always allowed.

anchor_index.tooltip: Which reference is the anchor (props the performer holds are allowed in it); -1 = none.

policy.tooltip: stop: when a new prop is found, block references and prompt (what follows does not run). warn: pass them through and put a warning in the report.

threshold.tooltip: SAM 3 score a prop needs (the reference's 0.7: fewer false props).

output_tooltips: Passed through when the check passes (policy stop).
Passed through when the check passes (policy stop).
True when no unlocked prop appears in the references, anchor or prompt that the performer does not hold in the source.
JSON: props held in the source, props found and where, allowed locked props, ok, policy, per-view checks and the warning / stop message.
Source and each reference side by side (256 px tiles): the person tinted blue, found props tinted red.
MiniMaxH3_PropConsistencyChecker.name: MiniMaxH3_PropConsistencyChecker
MiniMaxH3_PropConsistencyChecker.description: Stops a take whose references (or anchor, or prompt) give the new character a prop the performer does not hold in the source - a hat, a bag, a phone. The video model takes props from the source performance, so such a prop pops in and out. A prop the performer already holds is allowed (also in the anchor); locked props are always allowed. Props are found by core SAM 3 from their names.

model.tooltip: H3 MODEL to check. Raises an error if a patches_replace entry replaces a protected DiT block (0, last, Union blocks 10/20/30/40) or the final-layer paths; Block Cache T8 hooks are allowed.

output_tooltips: The input MODEL, unchanged (same object), when no protected layer is patched. Continue the chain from here.
One line with the DiT block count and confirmation that no protected block or final-layer path is patched.
MiniMaxH3_ProtectedLayerGuard.name: MiniMaxH3_ProtectedLayerGuard
MiniMaxH3_ProtectedLayerGuard.description: Refuse sampling if patches_replace hijacks protected DiT blocks (block 0, last block, Union injection blocks 10/20/30/40) or FinalLayer / norm_out / proj_out / audio_proj_out. Official Block Cache T8 hooks on block 0 and the last block are allowed. Passes MODEL through on success.

media.tooltip: From H3 Media Probe / Media Conform, or Load Video (C2C).

scale.tooltip: Proxy size: 1/2, 1/4 or 1/8 of the source width and height (rounded), or custom (custom_width / custom_height). h264 / prores round to an even size.

custom_width.tooltip: scale custom: 0 = keep aspect.

custom_height.tooltip: scale custom: 0 = keep aspect.

codec.tooltip: h264 (.mp4) small; prores (.mov) edit-friendly 10-bit; ffv1 (.mkv) lossless.

audio.tooltip: keep: the selection's audio (AAC, FLAC in .mkv); a silent source gives silence.

job_dir.tooltip: A folder inside ComfyUI's output folder; proxies go to <job_dir>/proxies/.

rebuild.tooltip: Encode again even when a matching proxy exists.

output_tooltips: Lazy handle on the proxy file.
h3.frame_ledger v1.1: proxy frame -> source frame (and frame number); scale_x / scale_y back to the source.
h3.proxy_manifest v1: source, settings, file, sha256, status.
Source and proxy first frames, side by side at proxy size.
Text: cache status (cached / written / rebuilt) and file name, source and proxy frames / size / codec / audio, size notes.
MiniMaxH3_ProxyManager.name: MiniMaxH3_ProxyManager
MiniMaxH3_ProxyManager.description: Writes a smaller proxy of a lazy video (1/2, 1/4, 1/8 or custom; h264 / ProRes / FFV1; audio kept or not) into a job folder and returns it as a lazy handle. Cached: the same source with the same settings is reused, a changed source makes a new proxy. The source map takes proxy frames and coordinates back to the source.

segment.tooltip: H3 Job Controller's segment JSON. The report is also recorded in that job's job.json.

images.tooltip: This segment's generated frames, the whole model window (held head frames and grid padding included); the content checks judge the accepted frames.

min_mean.tooltip: An accepted frame whose mean RGB (0-1) is below this counts as black; the check fails when more than 5% of them are black. 0 = never black.

freeze_max.tooltip: Largest share (0-1) of frame-to-frame steps in the accepted frames that may be still (mean change < 0.0001). 1 = never fail.

seam_max.tooltip: Largest mean absolute difference (0-1) between context_images and the segment's frames at the same place. Needs context_images.

diff_max.tooltip: 0 = do not judge the difference report.

colour_drift_max.tooltip: With a memory: the largest mean-colour distance (CIE76 delta E) from the scene's accepted frames. 0 = do not judge.

protect_px.tooltip: The mask is grown by this many pixels before the plate check.

background_max.tooltip: Largest difference from the plate allowed outside the edit (2/255).

mask_jump_max.tooltip: A frame whose mask area changes more than this share is flagged.

strict_masks.tooltip: Fail the segment on mask jumps / dropouts (otherwise a warning).

seam_ratio_max.tooltip: With a plate and continuation: the step into this segment may be at most this many times the steps around it, and this many times the plate's own ratio there (real motion is not a seam). 0 = do not judge.

context_images.tooltip: H3 Job Controller's context_images: compared with the segment's first frames (after held frames) for seam_max. Used only when their count and size match the plan.

diff_report.tooltip: H3 Sequence Diff's JSON report: its 'max' is judged against diff_max (only when diff_max > 0).

memory.tooltip: From H3 Subject Memory: judge the segment against its scene's look.

plate.tooltip: The plate of this segment's window (edit tasks): outside the mask the result must stay the plate.

mask.tooltip: The edit mask of this segment's window (e.g. from matte_window).

output_tooltips: h3.qc_report JSON: segment, attempt, verdict (pass / fail) and every check with its value. Feed H3 Job Commit's qc_report.
True when every check passed.
The input images, unchanged (wire on to H3 Job Commit).
MiniMaxH3_QCGate.name: MiniMaxH3_QCGate
MiniMaxH3_QCGate.description: Judges the generated segment: frame count, finite values, no black frames, not frozen, continues the accepted frames at the context, optionally the difference from the source (an H3 Sequence Diff report). The verdict decides commit / retry / review in H3 Job Commit.

audio.tooltip: The reference clip (first batch item is used): any channel count and sample rate.

max_seconds.tooltip: Trim the reference to at most this long. Long references cost speed on every sampling step.

output_tooltips: The clip as stereo 32 kHz (mono duplicated, extra channels dropped, resampled), cut to max_seconds: a Ref2VA reference audio.
One line: channels, rate and length out, and what was changed (or 'already valid').
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceAudio.name: MiniMaxH3_ReferenceAudio
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceAudio.description: Force a reference audio clip to stereo 32 kHz before Ref2VA. A MONO reference crashes the sampler with an unhelpful shape mismatch, because the layout reserves two channels.

images.tooltip: Reference images to add. Each is saved once as a 16-bit PNG (named by its pixel hash) in output/h3_refs/<name>/; exact and near duplicates are marked, not dropped.

roles.tooltip: One role for every image, or one per image, comma-separated: identity, face, head, hair, body, outfit, footwear, props, expression, performance, scene, lighting, camera, style.

near_max.tooltip: Near duplicate: dHash bits that may differ (of 64).

bank.tooltip: An existing bank to add these images to.

output_tooltips: h3.reference_bank v1
Changes when an image or a role changes.
Every entry with its id, role and duplicate mark.
The identity / face / head images (duplicates once).
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceBank.name: MiniMaxH3_ReferenceBank
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceBank.description: Keeps a job's reference images with their roles (identity, face, outfit, scene, lighting ...), marks exact and near duplicates, and saves each once. Chain banks to add more. Its fingerprint feeds H3 Task Spec's references; identity feeds the model's reference inputs; H3 Subject Memory reads the bank.

images.tooltip: Full frames after Plate Restore.

edit_mask.tooltip: Full-frame edit mask — Plate Restore's restore_mask output is exactly this. White = subject to match.

reference.tooltip: Single reference still (<Picture 1>). Resized to frame size if needed.

strength.tooltip: Blend toward the reference correction. Turn down if skin looks plastic or the plate colour bleeds into the subject.

mode.tooltip:
mean_std — match chroma mean and spread (stable on video).
histogram — CDF match per chroma channel (stronger, can flicker).

match_lightness.tooltip: Also match Oklab L. Leave off so the plate's lighting and shadows on the subject are preserved.

temporal_smooth.tooltip: Median window (frames) for smoothing the correction over time. Raise on noisy segments; lower if the subject colour changes on purpose.

reference_mask.tooltip: Optional mask on the reference (e.g. skin only). Unmasked = whole frame.

output_tooltips: The frames with the subject's Oklab chroma (and L when match_lightness is on) pulled toward the reference inside edit_mask; pixels outside the mask are the input unchanged.
Per-frame chroma shift removed, with Oklab +a (red) called out.
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceColorMatch.name: MiniMaxH3_ReferenceColorMatch
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceColorMatch.display_name: H3 Reference Colour Match (identity tone vs <Picture 1>)
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceColorMatch.description:
Hold the regenerated subject's colour to the reference still (<Picture 1>) in Oklab chroma after Plate Restore.

Lightness is left alone by default so the plate's lighting wins. The report calls out how much red drift (+a in Oklab) was removed per frame.

clip.tooltip: H3 text encoder. Encodes the (optionally wrapped) instruction with every connected reference image as vision input.

vae.tooltip: H3 video VAE that encodes each reference image to a reference latent (native transport). Not used for encoding with semantic transport.

source_image.tooltip: <Picture 1>, the main reference to edit; only the first image of the batch is used.

width.tooltip: Canvas width in pixels, rounded to the nearest multiple of 32. The latent is width/16 wide; also sets the reference area for match_generation_area.

height.tooltip: Canvas height in pixels, rounded to the nearest multiple of 32. The latent is height/16 tall; also sets the reference area for match_generation_area.

quality_profile.tooltip: How many frames (1, 5, 9, 13 or 20) H3 denoises jointly for the still. More frames cost more compute; the one-frame profile needs the separate H3 image VAE to decode sharply.

source_fidelity.tooltip: Chooses the preservation sentence added to the prompt (not sampler denoise): below 0.5 keep <Picture 1> recognizable, 0.5-0.8 keep its identity traits, 0.8+ preserve only traits the instruction does not mention.

source_fit.tooltip: How <Picture 1> is fitted to the canvas for the fitted_source output: crop_center fills and crops, contain_pad fits and pads with edge pixels, stretch ignores aspect ratio. References are encoded at their own size.

reference_detail.tooltip: Encode size of each reference: match_generation_area scales it to about the canvas area; max_identity_2048 limits the short edge to 2048 px. Never upscales; snapped to 32 px. Larger costs more VRAM.

optimize_for_still.tooltip: On: wraps the instruction in fixed text (picture roles, one finished still, a preservation sentence chosen by source_fidelity). Off: the instruction is used as typed.

reference_image_2.tooltip: Extra reference. Connected references are numbered <Picture 2>..<Picture 9> in socket order, skipping empty sockets; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_3.tooltip: Extra reference, numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_4.tooltip: Extra reference, numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_5.tooltip: Extra reference, numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_6.tooltip: Extra reference, numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_7.tooltip: Extra reference, numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_8.tooltip: Extra reference, numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_image_9.tooltip: Extra reference (up to 9 pictures in total), numbered as the next <Picture N> after the connected sockets above it; first image of the batch is used.

reference_transport.tooltip: native: references go to the vision encoder AND as VAE reference latents (needs vae). semantic (experimental): vision encoder only, no VAE latents; identity and fine detail may change.

output_tooltips: CONDITIONING for the sampler's positive input: the encoded instruction plus the reference latents (native transport).
Empty (all-zero) H3 audio-video LATENT: video width/16 × height/16 × the profile's latent frames, plus decode hints. Wire to the sampler, then to H3 Image Exact Frame Decode.
<Picture 1> resized to width×height with source_fit (IMAGE, 1 frame). Useful as source_image for frame selection or tone lock.
Frame count of the chosen quality_profile (1, 5, 9, 13 or 20 frames); the decoder keeps this many frames.
The exact text given to the text encoder (wrapped when optimize_for_still is on).
Text summary: canvas, frame profile, reference count and encode sizes, missing <Picture N> mentions, ignored batch images, and prompt warnings.
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceEditPrepare.name: MiniMaxH3_ReferenceEditPrepare
MiniMaxH3_ReferenceEditPrepare.description: REF2VA editing with up to nine ordered references.

model.tooltip: The MiniMax H3 model.

video_vae.tooltip: The MiniMax H3 video VAE (encodes the plate and the hint).

images.tooltip: The plate: source frames (17k+5 of them) at the generation size.

mask.tooltip: What to regenerate, per frame at the frame size (1 = regenerate).

strength.tooltip: ControlNet strength, as in core.

controlnet_where.tooltip: inside the mask: the ControlNet steers only the regenerated area (the fix). everywhere: core's behaviour, for comparison.

hint.tooltip: What the ControlNet is given. auto: the control video if connected, else inpaint from the plate. both: structure and the inpaint channels.

boundary_softness.tooltip: Soften the ControlNet's edge at the mask border, in latent patches.

schedule.tooltip: ControlNet strength over the steps: constant, fade out (layout early, detail to the model), fade in, smooth fade out.

audio_mode.tooltip: keep the plate's sound, regenerate it, or follow the mask per 1/40 s.

size_policy.tooltip: A frame that is not a multiple of 16: refuse, or pad right / bottom.

control_net.tooltip: MiniMax H3 Fun ControlNet (ModelPatchLoader). Without it: a masked edit only.

control_video.tooltip: The hint: depth, pose, edges, per frame.

audio_vae.tooltip: The MiniMax H3 audio VAE (needed with audio).

audio.tooltip: The plate's sound (silent track without it).

control_region.tooltip: Restrict the ControlNet further, e.g. pose only on the person (1 = steer).

sigma_start.tooltip: ControlNet is active only while the step's sigma is <= this value (a raw sigma, not a percent). 1.0 = from the first step. Also the 'start' of the schedule fade.

sigma_end.tooltip: ControlNet is active only while the step's sigma is >= this value (raw sigma). 0.0 = to the last step. Raise it to stop steering the final, low-noise detail steps.

output_tooltips: The H3 model with the mask-gated ControlNet patch (a clone); the input model unchanged when no control_net is wired or strength is 0. Wire to the sampler's model.
Joint AV latent: samples = NestedTensor(video, audio), noise_mask = NestedTensor(video mask 1 = regenerate, audio mask per audio_mode). Wire to the sampler's latent_image.
Plain-text summary: frame/latent sizes, mask token coverage, audio mode, ControlNet hint/strength and where it acts.
MiniMaxH3_RegionEdit.name: MiniMaxH3_RegionEdit
MiniMaxH3_RegionEdit.description: One node for a masked edit steered by a ControlNet. Inside the mask the ControlNet steers what is regenerated; outside it the latent keeps the plate and the ControlNet adds nothing, so the two never fight. Feed `model` to the sampler's model, `latent` to its latent_image. Plate encoded on H3's own grid (no crop, no offset), mask reduced on H3's frame grouping, sound kept per 1/40 s.

images.tooltip: Full-size PLATE frames (not crops). Sets the mask size and frame count, and is the backdrop of the preview.

mode.tooltip: sky: 1 where the depth value is ABOVE one clip-wide threshold (higher value read as far). ground: the rest. painted: painted_mask used as is. With no depth a top 1 (far) -> bottom 0 (near) ramp is the depth, so sky = upper part.

horizon_bias.tooltip: sky / ground: moves the threshold. threshold = min + (0.5 + bias) x (max - min) of the clip's depth. Negative = more pixels count as far (sky); -0.5 / +0.5 reach all / none.

feather_px.tooltip: Gaussian feather of the mask edge in plate pixels (kernel 2N+1). 0 = hard binary edge.

transform.tooltip: H3_TRANSFORM from H3 Track + Crop. Required when depth is wired: checks images match its source size and maps crop-space depth back into the plate through the crop boxes.

depth.tooltip: Depth from N9 (crop space) or plate depth — transform required when connected.

painted_mask.tooltip: painted mode only (required there): your mask, 1 = region. Resized bilinearly to the plate. Frame i uses mask frame i; a shorter mask repeats its last frame.

output_tooltips: Pixel-space MASK at plate size, one per frame, 1 = the chosen region (feathered). Feed to H3 Mask Prep.
Plate frames with the mask tinted blue (45% overlay) for checking.
Plain-text summary: mode, bias, feather, frame size, and the threshold used or the no-depth ramp fallback.
MiniMaxH3_RegionMask.name: MiniMaxH3_RegionMask
MiniMaxH3_RegionMask.description: Produces a pixel-space region MASK for the N2→N4→N5 spine (R18). Clip-global depth-horizon split (sky=far, ground=near). Modes: sky, ground, painted only — water/atmosphere removed (use painted_mask). When depth is connected, H3_TRANSFORM is required to validate plate vs crop space.

clip.tooltip: The H3 text encoder (Qwen3-VL). Encodes the text-only labels (<Video 1>, time stamps, <Picture N>) and the prompt, each segment tokenized on its own.

vae.tooltip: The H3 video VAE: encodes the source as <Video 1>, each reference picture and each pinned keyframe.

audio_vae.tooltip: The H3 audio VAE: encodes the soundtrack (or silence) resampled to 32 kHz stereo; that audio latent is held clean (noise mask 0).

source.tooltip: The source clip's frames, at 24 fps. Supplies motion, camera, framing and everything the prompt does not change.

prompt.tooltip: The six-section prompt, used verbatim.

ref_1.tooltip: <Picture 1>: usually a frame of the source painted in an image editor.

pins.tooltip: Optional: one output frame per reference image, e.g. '12, 190'. Each reference is then pinned as a keyframe at that frame for the first part of the denoise.

frames.tooltip: Output length at 24 fps, 17n+5.

audio.tooltip: The soundtrack kept in the output, usually the source's own. Silence when not connected.

ref_2.tooltip: <Picture 2>: optional extra reference image (first frame of the batch used), resized to its own aspect at short_edge. Needs a pin when pins are given.

ref_3.tooltip: <Picture 3>: optional extra reference image (first frame of the batch used), resized to its own aspect at short_edge. Needs a pin when pins are given.

ref_4.tooltip: <Picture 4>: optional extra reference image (first frame of the batch used), resized to its own aspect at short_edge. Needs a pin when pins are given.

output_tooltips: The encoded prompt with the source (<Video 1>), the pictures and any pinned keyframes attached. Wire to H3 Remake Noise and the sampler's guider.
Empty H3 audio + video latent of `frames` frames (5k+2 latent frames) on the canvas; video noise mask 1 (generated), audio latent of the soundtrack with mask 0 (held clean).
One line: frames, canvas and crop, picture count, pins, soundtrack held or silence.
MiniMaxH3_RemakeConditioning.name: MiniMaxH3_RemakeConditioning
MiniMaxH3_RemakeConditioning.description: Viggle Remake's conditioning, ported faithfully: the source clip as <Video 1> (text-only labels), each image as <Picture N> and, with pins, also a keyframe at that output frame; the source soundtrack held clean. Needs the Remake LoRA (Load LoRA bypass). For plate work prefer H3 Remake Replace: this node cover-crops off-size sources onto 832x480 / 1280x736.

model.tooltip: The H3 model (with the Remake LoRA) the keyframe-release wrapper is added to; the input is cloned, not changed.

keyframe_until.tooltip: The keyframes condition every forward whose sigma is at least this; below it they are dropped and the references alone remain.

output_tooltips: Clone of the model with a diffusion-model wrapper that drops the pinned keyframes from the payload once sigma < keyframe_until. Wire to the sampler.
MiniMaxH3_RemakeKeyframeUntil.name: MiniMaxH3_RemakeKeyframeUntil
MiniMaxH3_RemakeKeyframeUntil.description: Drops Remake's pinned keyframes once sigma falls below keyframe_until (0.9 = the last two of six forwards); the references alone remain.

positive.tooltip: H3 Remake Conditioning / Replace output. Only read for the shapes of its reference and keyframe latents, whose noise is drawn (and discarded) before the target's.

seed.tooltip: Seed of the one CPU generator used for all noise draws.

output_tooltips: NOISE for SamplerCustomAdvanced: per latent part (video, audio) drawn after skipping the reference / keyframe draws, in the reference script's order.
MiniMaxH3_RemakeNoise.name: MiniMaxH3_RemakeNoise
MiniMaxH3_RemakeNoise.description: Draws the starting noise in Remake's reference order (refs and keyframes first, then the target), so a seed gives the same video as the reference script.

vae.tooltip: The H3 video VAE that encodes the prefix frames (padded to 17m+5, first 5m latent frames kept).

latent.tooltip: H3 audio + video latent with a noise mask (H3 Remake Conditioning / Replace). Its first prefix_frames/17*5 latent frames must be fewer than the render's.

prefix.tooltip: The previous take's frames, on this render's canvas.

prefix_frames.tooltip: How many of its frames open this render, a multiple of 17.

prefix_at.tooltip: The previous take's frame they start at; -1: its last prefix_frames.

output_tooltips: The latent with its first prefix_frames/17*5 video latent frames replaced by the encoded prefix and their noise mask set to 0 (held clean); audio unchanged.
MiniMaxH3_RemakePrefix.name: MiniMaxH3_RemakePrefix
MiniMaxH3_RemakePrefix.description: A hop: the previous take's frames open this render, their latents clean with noise_mask 0 - never stepped, they come out unchanged, like the held soundtrack.

clip.tooltip: The H3 text encoder (Qwen3-VL). Encodes the text-only labels (<Video 1>, time stamps, <Picture N>) and the prompt, each segment tokenized on its own.

vae.tooltip: The H3 video VAE: encodes the window as <Video 1>, each picture, the pinned anchor and any held context / plate frames.

audio_vae.tooltip: The H3 audio VAE: encodes the soundtrack (or silence) resampled to 32 kHz stereo; that audio latent is held clean (noise mask 0).

window.tooltip: This segment's plate frames (H3 Job Controller window -> Frame Window, or H3 Subject Crop's crops), 17n + 5 frames at 24 fps.

anchor.tooltip: H3 Anchor Approval's anchor: frame anchor_frame of the take repainted with the new character / head / item.

mode.tooltip: character: the performer is replaced everywhere. face / head and item / prop: only inside 'mask' (required).

prompt.tooltip: Empty: a six-section prompt written for the mode. Otherwise used verbatim.

subject.tooltip: Who / what the anchor shows, for the default prompt.

short_edge.tooltip: Remake's trained sizes: 480 or 736. The long side follows the window's aspect.

mask.tooltip: What is replaced, one mask per window frame (face / head, item / prop; optional for character).

references.tooltip: More identity pictures (H3 Reference Bank identity, H3 Subject Memory anchors): EVERY image of the batch is its own <Picture N>, after the anchor; 4 at most.

context_images.tooltip: H3 Job Controller's context_images: the accepted frames this window continues from. 17, 34 ... frames open the render, held clean.

audio.tooltip: The window's soundtrack: held clean, never re-voiced.

bboxes.tooltip: H3 Subject Crop's boxes when 'window' is a crop: the plate-sized anchor is cut with the box of anchor_frame.

anchor_frame.tooltip: The window frame the anchor repaints (pinned there on the first window).

hold_outside_mask.tooltip: Experimental: hold the plate outside the mask in the latent too (Remake was trained to regenerate the whole target; Plate Restore restores the outside exactly either way).

output_tooltips: The prompt (written for the mode when empty) with the window as <Video 1>, the anchor + references as <Picture N> and, on the first window only, the anchor pinned at anchor_frame.
H3 audio + video latent on the canvas (5k+2 latent frames). Video mask 1 except held context frames (and, with hold_outside_mask, the plate outside the mask); audio held clean.
The window on the render canvas.
Canvas-space mask for H3 Plate Restore.
Whole-window boxes for H3 Plate Restore (decoded canvas -> window).
JSON: mode, frames, canvas and window size, pinned frame, prefix frames, picture count and notes.
MiniMaxH3_RemakeReplace.name: MiniMaxH3_RemakeReplace
MiniMaxH3_RemakeReplace.description: Replace a character, a head / face or an item through Viggle Remake: the approved anchor (H3 Anchor Approval) and this segment's plate window become Remake conditioning in the window's own framing, so <Video 1> sits token-for-token on the output and the result maps back onto the plate. First window: the anchor is pinned as a keyframe. Later windows (H3 Job Controller context): the accepted tail opens the render, held clean. Mask modes return the edit mask and boxes for H3 Plate Restore. Needs the Remake LoRA. Experimental: not A/B-tested on H3 weights.

images.tooltip: The decoded retake (VAEDecode output).

audio.tooltip: The retake's audio (VAEDecodeAudio output). Left out, the base video's own audio is kept throughout.

keep_base_audio.tooltip: Ignore the generated audio and keep the base video's soundtrack across the whole result.

output_tooltips: Full-length video frames at 24 fps.

Stereo 44.1 kHz soundtrack: base head + the retake's audio (or the base audio with keep_base_audio / no audio) + base tail, each piece padded to its video piece. Without a retake: the audio input, or silence.
Always 24.0 (H3's frame rate). Wire into CreateVideo.
MiniMaxH3_RetakeStitch.name: MiniMaxH3_RetakeStitch
MiniMaxH3_RetakeStitch.description: Splices a Retake Mode result back into its base video: base head + the generated range + base tail, video and audio, all on H3's 24 fps grid. Wire the Director's retake_info in; it carries the range that was rendered.

job_dir.tooltip: A folder inside ComfyUI's output folder; every run writes a new review_<date>_<time> folder in it (PNGs, contact_sheet.png, ab.mp4, review.html, manifest.json).

title.tooltip: Heading and page title of review.html (HTML-escaped); also stored in the manifest.

contact_every.tooltip: A contact cell every N frames.

frames.tooltip: Positions to show instead, e.g. 0, 12, 40.

difference.tooltip: Heatmap per shown frame (a third contact-sheet column and a page image): ssim = 1 - block SSIM on luma, pixel = mean |A - B|. none = no heatmaps.

timecode.tooltip: Burn the frame position and timecode into the cells.

include_qc.tooltip: Show the 'qc' verdict and checks on the page and the 'QC failed here' label on failing frames. The manifest keeps the QC summary either way.

include_annotations.tooltip: Show the 'annotations' notes on the page (a Notes list and under their frames).

ab_movie.tooltip: Write the A | B side-by-side movie (h264).

fps.tooltip: For IMAGE inputs and timecodes.

original.tooltip: Version A (a C2C video, read lazily). Its frame numbers label the cells and its rate wins over fps. Connect this or original_images.

generated.tooltip: Version B (a C2C video, read lazily), resized to A's size where they differ. Connect this or generated_images.

original_images.tooltip: Version A as an IMAGE batch, used when 'original' is not connected.

generated_images.tooltip: Version B as an IMAGE batch, used when 'generated' is not connected. The shorter of A and B sets how many frames are compared.

output_tooltips: Full path of the written review.html (open it in a browser; its images sit next to it).
One IMAGE: a row per shown frame, original | generated (| difference), 256 px wide cells; also saved as contact_sheet.png.
Path of ab.mp4, the A | B side-by-side H.264 movie of every compared frame; empty when ab_movie is off.
h3.review_package v1: files with sha256, counts, QC verdict.
MiniMaxH3_ReviewPackage.name: MiniMaxH3_ReviewPackage
MiniMaxH3_ReviewPackage.description: Writes a review folder: review.html (A/B wipe per frame, difference heatmaps, QC markers, notes), a contact sheet, an A | B movie and a JSON manifest with checksums. Self-contained, no network.

images.tooltip: The decoded frames (VAEDecode output). Passed on unchanged, whether or not a file is written.

save.tooltip: Off = pass the frames through and write nothing. Here so you never have to bypass the node.

filename_prefix.tooltip: Prefix for the saved file, under ComfyUI's output folder. Supports the same tokens as Save Image, e.g. %date:yyyy-MM-dd%.

output_tooltips: The input batch, untouched.
MiniMaxH3_SaveLastFrame.name: MiniMaxH3_SaveLastFrame
MiniMaxH3_SaveLastFrame.description: Saves the LAST frame of an image batch as a PNG, whatever the length, and passes the whole batch through unchanged. Put it straight after VAEDecode. Turn 'save' off to skip writing a file without unwiring or bypassing the node.

script.tooltip: One prompt per shot, separated by --- on its own line.
script.default:
Shot 1 prompt goes here.
---
Shot 2 prompt goes here.
---
Shot 3 prompt goes here.

shot_count.tooltip: 0 = count from the script. 2 = third segment continues scene 2.

output_tooltips: Prompt of shot 1 (wire to the first shot's text encoder).
Prompt of shot 2; the last script prompt again when the script has fewer shots.
Prompt of shot 3; the last script prompt again when the script has fewer shots.
Prompt of shot 4; the last script prompt again when the script has fewer shots.
Number of shots after parsing (and after shot_count padding or truncation).
Text: shots parsed, prompts dropped or repeated for a 3-shot graph.
MiniMaxH3_ScriptSplit.name: MiniMaxH3_ScriptSplit
MiniMaxH3_ScriptSplit.description: Split a multishot script into per-shot prompt strings. Plain text with --- separators or JSON {"prompts": [...]}.

images.tooltip: The decoded frames of the whole film.

fix_color_preset.tooltip: Exposure / colour at the seams. low / medium: affine, high: MKL, max: flatten the level over the whole clip.

fix_motion_preset.tooltip: Optical-flow alignment + local blend at each seam, for motion jolts.

fix_flash.tooltip: Repair single bright / dark flash frames. Off if the shot has real flashes (lightning, explosions): those would be flattened.

flash_threshold.tooltip: Share of a frame that must flash before it is repaired (0.2-0.4).

cut_detection.tooltip: Find real shot cuts (PySceneDetect if installed, else exposure steps) and leave them alone. Off: every detected step is treated as a seam.

cut_threshold.tooltip: Shot-cut sensitivity: lower finds more cuts (10-20).

blend_frames.tooltip: Frames over which the level ramps at a seam.

use_gpu.tooltip: Statistics, colour and flow on the GPU if there is one.

output_tooltips: IMAGE batch, same frame count and size as the input, with the chosen colour / motion / flash corrections applied at the seams (unchanged when all are off or under 2 frames).
Text: device and settings, each boundary found (seam or real cut), the gain / luma step per corrected seam, flash and motion repairs, and warnings.
MiniMaxH3_SeamCorrection.name: MiniMaxH3_SeamCorrection
MiniMaxH3_SeamCorrection.description: Find the seams of a long video made of H3 segments and remove their exposure / colour steps (affine or MKL colour transfer per segment), optionally the motion jolts (optical-flow warp + blend at the seam) and single flash frames. Real shot cuts are detected and left alone. Works on the decoded frames of the whole film.

task_spec.tooltip: h3.task_spec JSON (H3 Task Spec or the validator's pass-through). With a shot plan in it the segments follow the shots; a plan that does not tile the range exactly stops the run.

output_tooltips: h3.segment_plan v1 (with an h3.frame_ledger).
Text, one line per segment: shot and transition, model frame range (held frames, grid padding), context frames, accepted range, cross-fade.
Number of segments in the plan.
MiniMaxH3_SegmentPlanner.name: MiniMaxH3_SegmentPlanner
MiniMaxH3_SegmentPlanner.description: Splits the job's range into H3 segments. Context, blend, tracking handles and grid padding stay separate fields; the accepted ranges tile the range exactly (checked).

images.tooltip: This segment's frames (IMAGE batch), encoded 16 at a time into seg_<segment>.<ext> and passed on unchanged.

job_dir.tooltip: A folder inside ComfyUI's output folder.

fps.tooltip: Frame rate written into the segment file and its .json note. Every segment of a job needs the same rate for the assembler's remux.

codec.tooltip: h264 (.mp4, even size), prores 422 HQ 10-bit (.mov), ffv1 lossless (.mkv).

quality.tooltip: h264 only: higher = better, bigger.

overwrite.tooltip: Replace this segment's file if it exists.

output_tooltips: The same frames, passed on.
The file written: path, frames, codec, size.
MiniMaxH3_SegmentWriter.name: MiniMaxH3_SegmentWriter
MiniMaxH3_SegmentWriter.description: Writes this run's frames as ONE segment file (seg_00012.mp4 + a .json note) in a job folder inside ComfyUI's output folder, without keeping them. Run it per segment; H3 Sequence Assembler joins the segments without re-encoding.

job_dir.tooltip: The folder H3 Segment Writer wrote into.

output_name.tooltip: File name in the job folder; its extension must match the segments' container.

allow_gaps.tooltip: Join even if a segment number is missing.

overwrite.tooltip: Replace output_name if it already exists in the job folder; off = stop with an error instead.

wait_for.tooltip: Connect H3 Segment Writer's chunk_json to assemble in the same run, after it.

output_tooltips: Full path of the joined video in the job folder.
Text: segments joined (first..last number), output name, frames, codec, size, rate, and any allowed gaps.
Frames in the joined video.
MiniMaxH3_SequenceAssembler.name: MiniMaxH3_SequenceAssembler
MiniMaxH3_SequenceAssembler.description: Joins the segment files of a job folder (seg_00000, seg_00001, ...) into one video by remuxing - no decoding, no re-encoding, nothing held in memory. A missing segment number stops it unless allowed.

path.tooltip: A pattern (shot.####.exr, %04d, @@@@, $F4), a folder, or one frame of the sequence.

checksums.tooltip: Hash every file completely (slow on big EXRs). Off: size + first 64 KB, enough to catch copied frames.

contact_frames.tooltip: How many frames to show, spread evenly.

output_tooltips: Contract h3.sequence_manifest v1.
What is wrong, in sentences.
Frames that exist, read, and have the expected size.
A few frames side by side.
MiniMaxH3_SequenceAuditor.name: MiniMaxH3_SequenceAuditor
MiniMaxH3_SequenceAuditor.description: Checks an image sequence before anything renders from it: missing frames, duplicates, unreadable or empty files and frames of another size, against an expected range and size. Reads only file headers; a few frames are decoded for the contact sheet.

method.tooltip: pixel: mean |A - B|. ssim: 1 - block SSIM. ms-ssim: 1 - multi-scale SSIM (structure at several scales; not a learned perceptual metric).

threshold.tooltip: A frame whose difference is above this is 'changed'.

max_heatmaps.tooltip: Heatmaps kept: the worst frames, in frame order.

a_images.tooltip: Version A as an IMAGE batch instead.

b_images.tooltip: Version B as an IMAGE batch instead.

frame_map_a.tooltip: h3.frame_ledger of A: with B's, frames are paired by SOURCE frame number.

frame_map_b.tooltip: h3.frame_ledger of B (one entry per B frame). Only used together with frame_map_a: frames are paired where both show the same SOURCE frame number; otherwise they pair by position.

mask.tooltip: 1 = compare here (one mask for all, or one per frame).

output_tooltips: Heatmaps of the worst frames (black = same, yellow = most).
JSON: per-frame scores, mean / p95 / max, worst frames.
JSON: [first, last] frame numbers above the threshold.
The difference over time; red line = threshold.
MiniMaxH3_SequenceDiff.name: MiniMaxH3_SequenceDiff
MiniMaxH3_SequenceDiff.description: Compares two versions frame by frame (pixel, SSIM or multi-scale SSIM on luma), inside a mask if given, aligned by their frame maps if given. Streams both in chunks. Outputs heatmaps of the worst frames, a numeric report, the changed intervals and a flicker graph.

latent.tooltip: An H3 AV latent (video + audio).

video_mask.tooltip: One mask per frame at the canvas size, or a latent-size mask (H3 Mask To Latent Space).

audio_mask.tooltip: One mask per frame; each 1/40 s audio tick takes the largest value of its frames. The picture mask works here too (sound regenerates with the picture).

video_lock.tooltip: Keep every video frame (mask 0), e.g. to re-sample only the sound.

audio_lock.tooltip: Keep the whole sound (mask 0), e.g. to regenerate only the picture.

output_tooltips: The same samples with a two-stream noise mask: video [1,1,T,h,w] and audio [1,1,2,ticks], 1 = generate, 0 = keep. Wire to the sampler.
Text: how each stream's mask was made (reduced, kept, locked or all generate) and the protected share of video cells and audio ticks.
MiniMaxH3_SetAVNoiseMask.name: MiniMaxH3_SetAVNoiseMask
MiniMaxH3_SetAVNoiseMask.description: Set the video and/or audio denoise masks of an H3 AV latent (white = generate, black = keep, grey = partial). Use it instead of core's Set Latent Noise Mask, whose single mask H3 reads as video only - protected audio is then regenerated. The video mask is snapped to H3's own grid (latent steps of 1/4 frames, 32 px tokens). A stream you do not connect keeps the latent's existing mask, or generates.

images.tooltip: The frames to analyse (a window or a short clip).

method.tooltip: auto = PySceneDetect when installed, else the colour-histogram detector.

sensitivity.tooltip: Higher finds more cuts. Histogram: a cut where the colour correlation is below 0.30 + 0.60 x sensitivity. PySceneDetect: content threshold 45 - 35 x sensitivity.

min_shot_frames.tooltip: Shorter shots merge into the one before.

fades.tooltip: Also report dips to black or white as transitions.

add_cuts.tooltip: Rows to cut at anyway, e.g. 12, 40.

remove_cuts.tooltip: Rows NOT to cut at, e.g. 18.

window_json.tooltip: From H3 Frame Window Reader: cuts are also reported as source frames.

output_tooltips: Contract h3.shot_manifest v1: one entry per shot.
The rows where a new shot starts, comma separated.
Number of shots (cuts kept after merging and manual add / remove, plus one).
The first frame of every shot, side by side.
MiniMaxH3_ShotBoundaries.name: MiniMaxH3_ShotBoundaries
MiniMaxH3_ShotBoundaries.description: Finds the shots of a clip: hard cuts with a confidence (and dips to black / white if asked), a minimum shot length, manual add / remove, and a contact sheet of every shot's first frame. Latent context should not cross a cut: the manifest says so for later stages.

timeline.tooltip: seconds | prompt | transition, one shot per line (# = a note). JSON works too: [{"seconds": 4, "prompt": "...", "transition": "cut"}, ...].

fps.tooltip: The job's rate (H3 generates at 24): seconds become whole frames.

Text, one line per shot: shot, scene, transition, frame range (frame count), the prompt's first 70 characters.
Number of shots.

MiniMaxH3_ShotPlanner.name: MiniMaxH3_ShotPlanner
MiniMaxH3_ShotPlanner.description: A prompt timeline -> the shots of a long job. One shot per line: seconds | prompt | transition. cut (the default) starts a new scene and carries no context across; continue keeps the take going with a new prompt; dissolve N cross-fades N frames. Feed H3 Task Spec's shot_plan.

media_path.tooltip: A file or folder inside ComfyUI's output folder (e.g. the Sequence Assembler's output).

show.tooltip: Show name: first folder under publish_root and the {show} naming field. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-' (max 64).

seq.tooltip: Sequence name: folder under the show and the {seq} naming field. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

shot.tooltip: Shot name: folder under the sequence and the {shot} naming field. Letters, digits, '.', '_' or '-'.

task.tooltip: Task name (e.g. comp, anim): folder under the shot that holds the v### versions, and the {task} naming field.

stage.tooltip: wip / review / final: written into the file name ({stage}) and the manifest. A label only - it changes no other behaviour.

naming.tooltip: Fields: {show} {seq} {shot} {task} {stage} {version:03d} {ext} (a folder is published as a folder of that name).

require_qc.tooltip: pass: refuse to publish (nothing is written) unless the 'qc' JSON has a passing verdict. none: publish anyway; the verdict is still recorded.

overwrite.tooltip: never: an existing version number is an error. same version: re-publish into the existing v### folder named by 'version' (files of the same name are replaced). Version 0 always takes a new one.

checksum.tooltip: sha256 every file and verify the copies.

qc.tooltip: QC JSON (as H3 Review Package reads it).

metadata.tooltip: Extra JSON kept in the manifest.
